Subsequently, by imposing the continuity conditions at the SQD interfaces, we obtain exact expressions for the diffusion coefficients. These results are then used to map the scattering efficiency together with the spatial distributions of probability and current densities. Our simulations demonstrate that the presence of this intrinsic gap significantly enhances electron trapping at the center of the SQD. Finally, we prove that the interplay between the external field and SOC breaks spin symmetry, thereby enabling robust and spin-selective confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive solutions to the Dirac equation、exact expressions、simulations。；研究对象：硅烯量子点（silicene quantum dot, SQD）在垂直磁场下的电子散射与束缚机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硅烯特有的自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）产生的本征能隙可显著增强电子在量子点中心的俘获；外加磁场与SOC的协同作用可打破自旋对称性，实现自旋选择性束缚。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硅烯特有的自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）产生的本征能隙可显著增强电子在量子点中心的俘获；外加磁场与SOC的协同作用可打破自旋对称性，实现自旋选择性束缚。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于低能狄拉克方程求解，通过量子点界面连续性条件推导扩散系数的精确解析表达式，并数值模拟散射效率、概率密度和电流密度的空间分布。

papers.title: Stretching and bending of (really) thick elastic plates
papers.abstract: The mechanical energy of an elastic plate separates into stretching and bending energies. This is a result for asymptotically thin plates, but it is often a surprisingly accurate approximation for thick plates, too. Here, we address this conundrum: We compute the deformations of a thick elastic plate resulting from imposed, asymptotically small deformations of its midline to discover effective stretching and bending moduli. They soften with increasing plate thickness, but, strikingly, their ratio remains approximately constant. In this way, our calculations provide a justification for applying the thin-plate picture of stretching and bending to thick plates such as biological cell sheets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“计算”“提供 justification”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：厚弹性板的力学行为，特别是其拉伸与弯曲变形，以及有效模量随厚度的变化。具体体系包括生物细胞片等厚板。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 厚板的拉伸和弯曲有效模量随厚度增加而软化，但两者的比值近似保持不变，从而为将薄板理论中的拉伸-弯曲分离图像应用于厚板提供了理论依据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：厚板的拉伸和弯曲有效模量随厚度增加而软化，但两者的比值近似保持不变，从而为将薄板理论中的拉伸-弯曲分离图像应用于厚板提供了理论依据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过解析计算，对厚弹性板施加渐近小的中线变形，推导出有效的拉伸和弯曲模量。

papers.title: Can the Brownian diffusion coefficient be reconstructed from Lyapunov exponents?
papers.abstract: We consider an ac-driven particle moving in a spatially periodic and symmetric potential. In the zero- temperature limit, for the analyzed parameter set, its dynamics is non-chaotic and the particle does not manifest diffusive properties. At non-zero temperatures, the asymptotic long-time motion follows normal (Brownian) diffusion. Recent studies have shown that within tailored parameter regimes, the diffusion coef- ficient is a quasiperiodic function of the external driving amplitude [1]. Although no general relation between Lyapunov exponents and Brownian diffusion exists, we demonstrate that the quasiperiodic diffusion coefficient at non-zero temperature can be accurately reconstructed from the maximal Lyapunov exponent of the corresponding deterministic system (at vanishing temperature). We propose an approximate formula for this purpose, which shows good agreement with numerical simulations, although some discrepancies are detected in the vicinity of the local maxima of the diffusion coefficient. Finally, we examine the robustness of the correlation between diffusion and the Lyapunov exponent under variations of the system parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Lyapunov exponents、数值模拟、近似公式。；研究对象：交流驱动下在空间周期对称势场中运动的布朗粒子，及其在有限温度下的正常扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限温度下准周期变化的布朗扩散系数，可以通过对应零温确定性系统的最大Lyapunov指数精确重构，并提出了一个近似公式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限温度下准周期变化的布朗扩散系数，可以通过对应零温确定性系统的最大Lyapunov指数精确重构，并提出了一个近似公式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但主要新意在于建立了零温Lyapunov指数与有限温布朗扩散系数之间的定量关联，并提出了可重构扩散系数的近似公式。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值模拟计算零温下确定性系统的最大Lyapunov指数，并与有限温度下布朗扩散系数进行对比；提出近似公式并验证其与数值结果的吻合程度。

papers.title: Interface Symmetry and Electrostatic Stabilization of Strain-Resilient Janus Heterobilayers for Flexible Piezotronics
papers.abstract: The electronic structure of conventional two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) is highly sensitive to lattice deformation, often leading to indirect-to-direct band-gap transitions that compromise performance in flexible nanoelectronic applications. Janus TMDs, with their broken mirror symmetry and intrinsic out-of-plane dipoles, offer a promising alternative platform for electrostatic tuning. However, their electronic stability under strain and the role of the chalcogen stacking sequence in their heterostructures remains poorly understood. Here, we study from first principles the strain tolerance and piezoelectric properties of MoSSe/WSSe heterobilayers. By examining different configurations, we demonstrate that the interface chemistry strongly modulates interlayer coupling, dynamic charge redistribution, and dipole interactions. Importantly, the combined effects of intrinsic electric fields and interface electrostatics effectively suppress the strain-induced band-gap transitions typical of conventional TMDs. Moreover, while the in-plane piezoelectric response remains nearly insensitive to the stacking order, the shear piezoelectric coefficient depends heavily on the interfacial symmetry and can be effectively tuned by strain modulation. Our results highlight interfacial engineering as a powerful route to design strain-resilient Janus heterostructures for next-generation flexible optoelectronic, valleytronic, and piezotronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first principles”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：MoSSe/WSSe Janus异质双层（Janus heterobilayers）的应变耐受性、压电性质以及界面化学（硫族元素堆叠顺序）对其电子结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面化学和静电效应能有效抑制传统TMDs中常见的应变诱导带隙转变，并且通过应变调控可以显著改变依赖于界面对称性的剪切压电系数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面化学和静电效应能有效抑制传统TMDs中常见的应变诱导带隙转变，并且通过应变调控可以显著改变依赖于界面对称性的剪切压电系数。；创新点：揭示了Janus异质双层中，界面化学（硫族元素堆叠顺序）对层间耦合、动态电荷重新分布和偶极相互作用的强调制作用，并阐明了这种界面工程在实现应变鲁棒性方面的关键角色。摘要未突出说明与具体实验结果的对比或超越现有计算模型的细节。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first principles calculations）。

papers.title: Microscopic Theory of the Phonon Thermal Hall Effect in Chiral Mott Insulators
papers.abstract: The thermal Hall effect (THE) probes charge-neutral excitations in insulators, where the charge gap blocks electronic transport. Recently, phonons have been shown to induce a THE comparable in magnitude to the spin contribution, underscoring their critical role in thermal transport. Here, we develop a microscopic theory of the phonon thermal Hall effect (PTHE) in chiral Mott insulators. First, we derive the exact analytic form of the effective Raman interaction in half-filled Mott insulators, showing that its strength is directly proportional to the scalar spin chirality. Next, we demonstrate the intrinsic PTHE explicitly on the kagome lattice. Crucially, our formulation reveals a temperature-dependent crossover in the transport behavior under isotopic substitution. Using this result, we establish a scaling law that quantitatively separates the phonon contribution to the THE from other background signals. Our results not only provide the first fully microscopic derivation of the PTHE, but also establish a definitive experimental standard for isolating microscopic heat carriers in chiral Mott insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a microscopic theory、derive the exact analytic form、demonstrate explicitly。；研究对象：手性莫特绝缘体中的声子热霍尔效应（PTHE），具体以kagome晶格为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次从微观理论出发推导了手性莫特绝缘体中声子热霍尔效应的解析形式，发现有效拉曼相互作用的强度与标量自旋手性成正比，并建立了同位素替代下输运行为的温度依赖交叉标度律，可定量分离声子对热霍尔效应的贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次从微观理论出发推导了手性莫特绝缘体中声子热霍尔效应的解析形式，发现有效拉曼相互作用的强度与标量自旋手性成正比，并建立了同位素替代下输运行为的温度依赖交叉标度律，可定量分离声子对热霍尔效应的贡献。；创新点：提供了声子热霍尔效应的首个完全微观理论推导，并建立了在实验上分离手性莫特绝缘体中微观热载体的定量标准。
papers.method_zh: 微观理论推导：从半填充莫特绝缘体出发，推导有效拉曼相互作用的精确解析形式；在kagome晶格上显式展示本征声子热霍尔效应；通过同位素替代分析建立标度律。

papers.title: Voltage-driven transition from steady-state fluctuations to phase-transition noise in nanoscale VO$_2$ devices
papers.abstract: We investigate the electrically driven metal-to-insulator transition (MIT) in nanoscale vanadium dioxide (VO$_2$) Mott memristor through noise spectroscopy and two-dimensional resistor network simulations. Our experiments focus on both the insulating phase as the applied voltage approaches the threshold voltage (set transition) and the metallic phase as the voltage is reduced toward the reset voltage (reset transition). In both regimes, we observe an order of magnitude increase in relative current noise near the transition points. To analyze the origin of this noise enhancement, we use simulations that capture the stochastic dynamics of the phase transition. The simulations indicate that the increased noise stems from amplified phase fluctuations near the percolation threshold, where competing metallic and insulating domains lead to dynamic reconfiguration of the conduction paths. In addition, we show that the precursor current fluctuations observed near the switching threshold are consistent with the threshold voltage variability measured in repeated switching cycles, indicating that the noise sets a lower bound on the achievable variance. These findings offer key insights into the non-equilibrium processes governing phase transitions in nanoscale VO$_2$ devices under electrical stimuli.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算模拟）。关键词：noise spectroscopy（噪声谱）、two-dimensional resistor network simulations（二维电阻网络模拟）。；研究对象：纳米尺度二氧化钒（VO₂）Mott忆阻器中的电致金属-绝缘体相变（MIT），特别是相变点附近的电流噪声行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电压接近阈值（set transition）和复位（reset transition）时，相对电流噪声增大一个数量级；该噪声增强源于渗流阈值附近金属与绝缘体畴的动态重构导致的相位涨落放大，且噪声为开关阈值电压的变异性设定了下限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电压接近阈值（set transition）和复位（reset transition）时，相对电流噪声增大一个数量级；该噪声增强源于渗流阈值附近金属与绝缘体畴的动态重构导致的相位涨落放大，且噪声为开关阈值电压的变异性设定了下限。；创新点：将相变点附近的噪声增强归因于渗流阈值附近的相位涨落，并建立了噪声与开关阈值电压变异性的定量关联，揭示了非平衡相变过程中的噪声下限。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用噪声谱（noise spectroscopy）测量电流涨落；理论上使用二维电阻网络模拟（two-dimensional resistor network simulations）捕捉相变的随机动力学。

papers.title: Noise spectroscopy of two-body loss as a probe of dynamical bulk viscosity in ultracold atomic gases
papers.abstract: We show that the correlated noise of the two-body loss current provides access to the dynamical bulk viscosity in weakly dissipative quantum gases. Starting from the Lindblad equation for weak inelastic losses, we derive the loss-current operator. After subtracting the leading Poissonian shot-noise background, the remaining noise power spectrum of two-body loss current is found proportional to the equilibrium correlation function of the contact operator. Combining this result with the exact relation between contact correlations and bulk viscosity, we demonstrate the correspondence between the measurable loss-current noise and the bulk-viscosity. Our result identifies the higher-order fluctuation of two-body loss as a probe of dynamical bulk viscosity, whose measurement has remained elusive in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Lindblad equation、equilibrium correlation function、exact relation。；研究对象：超冷原子气体中的动力学体粘滞系数（dynamical bulk viscosity），以及通过双体损耗噪声谱对其进行探测的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双体损耗电流的噪声功率谱（扣除泊松散粒噪声背景后）正比于接触算符的平衡关联函数，进而与动力学体粘滞系数直接对应，从而提出通过测量双体损耗的高阶涨落来探测动力学体粘滞系数的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双体损耗电流的噪声功率谱（扣除泊松散粒噪声背景后）正比于接触算符的平衡关联函数，进而与动力学体粘滞系数直接对应，从而提出通过测量双体损耗的高阶涨落来探测动力学体粘滞系数的方法。；创新点：首次指出双体损耗的高阶涨落（噪声谱）可作为探测动力学体粘滞系数的实验探针，而该粘滞系数在实验中一直难以测量。
papers.method_zh: 基于弱非弹性损耗的Lindblad主方程，推导出损耗电流算符；利用接触关联与体粘滞系数之间的精确关系，建立损耗电流噪声与动力学体粘滞系数的对应关系。

papers.title: Dynamical frustration in space-time metamaterials
papers.abstract: From spin ice and crumpled paper to cold atoms lattices and metamaterials, geometrical frustration occurs generically whenever local constraints cannot be satisfied all at once. The result is a ground state degeneracy, where many equivalent states, each of which contains unsatisfied constraints, coexist. Here, we introduce dynamical frustration, where the ground state degeneracy makes way to a non-reciprocal self-oscillating state instead. To create dynamical frustration, we construct metamaterials that are driven parametrically in time and modulated in space. The parametric pumping leads to period doubling and in turn to a discrete symmetry-breaking. This symmetry breaking, together with the spatial modulation enforces the existence of topologically protected phase dislocations, which propagate unidirectionally with a spontaneous phase that breaks a continuous symmetry. Tesselating 1d frustrated loops, one obtains a 2d metamaterial where phase dislocations self-organize into globally synchronized non-reciprocal phase defects. We expect dynamical frustration to be broadly applicable at any scale, from cold atoms and superconducting circuits to acoustics and RF circuits -- anywhere where space-time modulation can be pushed beyond linear stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce、construct、expect（提出概念、构建模型、理论预期）。；研究对象：时空超材料（space-time metamaterials）中的动力学阻挫（dynamical frustration）现象，以及由此产生的非互易自振荡态和拓扑保护相位缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“动力学阻挫”概念：在时空超材料中，基态简并性被非互易自振荡态取代，通过参数泵浦和空间调制，系统自发产生单向传播的拓扑保护相位位错，并在二维中自组织为全局同步的非互易相位缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“动力学阻挫”概念：在时空超材料中，基态简并性被非互易自振荡态取代，通过参数泵浦和空间调制，系统自发产生单向传播的拓扑保护相位位错，并在二维中自组织为全局同步的非互易相位缺陷。；创新点：首次提出“动力学阻挫”概念，将传统几何阻挫中的基态简并替换为动态的非互易自振荡态，并展示了时空调制系统中拓扑缺陷的自组织同步行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建与模型分析：通过时间参数驱动（parametric pumping）导致周期倍增和离散对称性破缺，结合空间调制（spatial modulation）实现拓扑保护相位位错；利用一维阻挫环的拼接（tessellating 1d frustrated loops）构建二维超材料。

papers.title: Iterative Thermodynamic Augmentation of Spatially Resolved Analytic Microscopy for Fast-Diffusing Solutes
papers.abstract: The spatially resolved quantification of fast-diffusing solutes presents several challenges in analytic microscopy. Given the critical role of interstitially alloyed elements in physical metallurgy, we propose a computational framework that addresses this limitation by augmenting spatially resolved composition maps of substitutional elements with computationally derived interstitial distributions. The underlying methodology is an iterative thermodynamic model: exploiting the stark differences in solid-state diffusion kinetics, the model assumes a state of partial chemical equilibrium exclusively for the mobile interstitial species. An optimization scheme iteratively adjusts an uniform interstitial chemical potential across the mapped microstructure until the integrated local concentration converges with an independently measured bulk value. Ultimately, this approach extracts thermodynamically consistent interstitial concentration maps from robust, low-noise microscopy data, yielding quantitative spatial arrays that are otherwise time- and resource-intensive to obtain at best.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“computational framework”、“iterative thermodynamic model”、“optimization scheme”，未提及实验数据采集或新实验手段。；研究对象：快速扩散溶质（如间隙合金元素）在微观结构中的空间分布，具体针对物理冶金学中间隙合金元素（如碳、氮等）的定量成像问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种迭代热力学模型，通过假设间隙元素达到局部化学平衡，并利用替代元素的高质量成分图，可计算得到热力学自洽的间隙元素浓度空间分布图，从而避免耗时耗力的直接实验测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种迭代热力学模型，通过假设间隙元素达到局部化学平衡，并利用替代元素的高质量成分图，可计算得到热力学自洽的间隙元素浓度空间分布图，从而避免耗时耗力的直接实验测量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：将热力学平衡假设与迭代优化相结合，利用低噪声、易获取的替代元素显微数据，间接推导出难以直接测量的快速扩散溶质的高分辨率空间分布图。
papers.method_zh: 迭代热力学模型。该方法利用固态扩散动力学的显著差异，假设仅移动间隙物种处于部分化学平衡状态；通过优化算法迭代调整整个微观结构上的均匀间隙化学势，直至计算得到的局部浓度积分与独立测量的体相浓度值一致。

papers.title: Evolution of the intertwining correlated topological phases in iron-based superconductor Fe(Te,Se)
papers.abstract: Multiple topological electronic phases can coexist within a single quantum material and induce different topological superconducting states, offering deeper insights into interplay of topological superconducting states and Majorana modes, which may also be influenced and modified by correlation effect. Iron-based superconductors, with both topological states and correlation effect, is an ideal platform to study these phenomena. Here, with high resolution angle resolved photoelectron spectroscopy, we directly resolve two distinct intertwining topological states in iron-based superconductor Co-doped Fe(Te,Se), and study their evolution with electron doping. We identify a region where both topological insulator surface states and topological Dirac semimetal states intersect the Fermi level. The topological states are affected by the strong correlation effect and are isolated from trivial bulk states. The evolution between distinct topological phases offers a good opportunity to study various Majorana modes from different superconducting phases according to theoretical analysis. Our findings establish an ideal platform for exploring the interaction between multiple topological superconducting states and the related Majorana modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：high resolution angle resolved photoelectron spectroscopy（高分辨率角分辨光电子能谱）。；研究对象：铁基超导体 Co 掺杂 Fe(Te,Se) 中相互交织的拓扑电子态及其随电子掺杂的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Co 掺杂 Fe(Te,Se) 中直接分辨出两种不同的相互交织的拓扑态（拓扑绝缘体表面态和拓扑狄拉克半金属态），并发现它们受强关联效应影响且与平庸体态分离，其演化有望为研究多种马约拉纳模提供平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Co 掺杂 Fe(Te,Se) 中直接分辨出两种不同的相互交织的拓扑态（拓扑绝缘体表面态和拓扑狄拉克半金属态），并发现它们受强关联效应影响且与平庸体态分离，其演化有望为研究多种马约拉纳模提供平台。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）。

papers.title: Excitonic-Superconducting Coexistence and Emergent Nematic Superconductivity Driven by Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: Excitonic insulating (EI) and superconducting (SC) orders are generally regarded as mutually exclusive electronic instabilities. Within a self-consistent microscopic theory, we study electronic systems hosting an EI phase in the presence of SC pairing and show that an intrinsic mismatch between electron and hole Fermi surfaces fundamentally reshapes this competition. This mismatch stabilizes FFLO-like electron-hole pairing and drives spontaneous symmetry breaking of the EI state. The resulting symmetry breaking reconstructs the pairing phase space for SC and EI state, such that different regions of the Fermi surface complementarily support either EI or SC correlations, leading to a natural coexistence of the two orders. Notably, the emergent SC state consequently breaks rotational symmetry and develops intrinsic nematic superconductivity, even in the absence of explicit symmetry-breaking fields (such as magnetic fields, spin-orbit coupling, or bare band-structure anisotropy). Our results suggest that candidate materials such as monolayer 1T$'$-MoTe$_2$ and the square-net semimetal NaAlSi may provide promising platforms for observing this phenomenon. More broadly, these findings reveal a unique mechanism by which competing many-body orders generate electronic nematicity, suggesting a broader route toward spontaneous anisotropic electronic states in correlated quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“within a self-consistent microscopic theory”、“we study”等理论建模与自洽计算关键词。；研究对象：激子绝缘体（EI）与超导（SC）共存体系，具体关注电子-空穴费米面失配导致的FFLO-like电子-空穴配对，以及由此产生的向列超导态。候选材料包括单层1T’-MoTe₂和方网半金属NaAlSi。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子与空穴费米面的固有失配会稳定FFLO-like的电子-空穴配对，并驱动激子绝缘态的自发对称性破缺，从而重构超导与激子绝缘的配对相空间，使两者在费米面不同区域互补共存，并最终产生内禀的向列超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子与空穴费米面的固有失配会稳定FFLO-like的电子-空穴配对，并驱动激子绝缘态的自发对称性破缺，从而重构超导与激子绝缘的配对相空间，使两者在费米面不同区域互补共存，并最终产生内禀的向列超导电性。；创新点：揭示了激子绝缘与超导两种竞争序通过自发对称性破缺实现自然共存的机制，并指出该机制可在无外加磁场、自旋轨道耦合或能带各向异性等显式对称性破缺场的情况下，内禀地产生向列超导电性。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽微观理论（self-consistent microscopic theory），在存在超导配对的情况下研究激子绝缘相，通过自洽计算分析费米面失配、对称性破缺与配对相空间重构。

papers.title: Polaron Transport in TiO$_{2}$ from Machine Learning Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract: Transition metal oxides have attracted much attention as photo(electrochemical)-catalysts but practical applications are typically hampered by their low and anisotropic charge mobility. A deep understanding of excess charge carrier transport in these materials requires a dynamical treatment of nuclear motion that goes well beyond standard approaches. Here we introduce DeepPolaron, a machine learning framework boosting the accessible time scale of first principles molecular dynamics of adiabatic polaron transport by three orders of magnitude at a virtually negligible loss in accuracy. We apply our method to excess electron and hole transport in titanium dioxide rutile and anatase. We find that the excess electron in rutile relaxes to a polaron predominantly localized on a single Ti atom with hopping occurring only along the [001] direction, associated with an activation energy of 39 meV and a room temperature mobility of $4.4 \times 10^{-2}$ cm$^2$/Vs in good agreement with experiment. In contrast the hole polaron in anatase is localized on a single O atom, and due to poor O 2p orbital overlap with first nearest neighbors charge transport occurs primarily to second nearest neighbors, with a large activation energy of 139 meV resulting in a small room temperature mobility of $1.4 \times 10^{-3}$ cm$^2$/Vs. This work provides a finite temperature first-principles characterization of small polaron transport in rutile and anatase, with a methodology that is directly transferable to other small polaron forming materials and interfacial charge-transfer processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Machine Learning Molecular Dynamics、first principles molecular dynamics、DFT（隐含）。；研究对象：二氧化钛（TiO₂）金红石（rutile）和锐钛矿（anatase）中的极化子（polaron）输运现象，具体为过量电子和空穴的输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金红石中过量电子形成局域在单个Ti原子上的小极化子，仅沿[001]方向跳跃，室温迁移率为4.4×10⁻² cm²/Vs；锐钛矿中空穴极化子局域在单个O原子上，因O 2p轨道与最近邻重叠差而主要向次近邻跳跃，室温迁移率仅1.4×10⁻³ cm²/Vs。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金红石中过量电子形成局域在单个Ti原子上的小极化子，仅沿[001]方向跳跃，室温迁移率为4.4×10⁻² cm²/Vs；锐钛矿中空穴极化子局域在单个O原子上，因O 2p轨道与最近邻重叠差而主要向次近邻跳跃，室温迁移率仅1.4×10⁻³ cm²/Vs。；创新点：利用机器学习分子动力学将第一性原理模拟极化子输运的时间尺度提升三个数量级，首次实现了对金红石和锐钛矿中极化子输运的有限温度第一性原理表征，且该方法可直接迁移至其他小极化子形成材料和界面电荷转移过程。
papers.method_zh: 提出了名为DeepPolaron的机器学习框架，将第一性原理分子动力学（first principles molecular dynamics）对绝热极化子输运的可达时间尺度提升了三个数量级，同时几乎不损失精度。

papers.title: Stress relaxation in fiber networks via force-dependent stochastic severing
papers.abstract: Fiber networks contribute to the mechanical stability of various biological systems, from cells to tissues. Such systems have been modeled by networks of springs or fibers that exhibit rigidity transitions as a function of either connectivity or applied strain. For a fiber network under constant applied strain, severing can reduce the connectivity and destabilize an initially rigid structure. Here, we investigate stress relaxation in spring and fiber networks in the presence of stochastic, force-dependent severing. A computational model to predict stress relaxation with mechanochemical feedback of stress on severing is developed. We also examine the effects of severing on the network topology and onset of rigidity transition. Using 2D triangular lattice-based computer simulations, we explore different limits of the feedback and demonstrate the shift in the onset of rigidity depending on the limit. The limit of tension-suppressed severing delays stress relaxation and shifts the transition into the bending-dominated regime to lower-than-expected connectivity. In contrast, tension-enhanced severing accelerates relaxation and shifts the transition to higher-than-expected connectivity. It is also found that the magnitude of this shift depends on the applied shear strain and the strength of the feedback. Our theoretical approach clarifies some microscopic aspects of these phenomena. Understanding the impact of such feedback mechanisms can provide valuable insights into designing systems by tuning the feedback to the desired response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：computational model、computer simulations、theoretical approach）；研究对象：纤维网络在恒定应变下的应力松弛现象，具体涉及力依赖的随机切断（force-dependent stochastic severing）对网络拓扑和刚性转变的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 张力抑制切断会延迟应力松弛并将刚性转变推向低于预期的连接度，而张力增强切断则加速松弛并将转变推向高于预期的连接度；该偏移幅度依赖于施加的剪切应变和反馈强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：张力抑制切断会延迟应力松弛并将刚性转变推向低于预期的连接度，而张力增强切断则加速松弛并将转变推向高于预期的连接度；该偏移幅度依赖于施加的剪切应变和反馈强度。；创新点：系统研究了力依赖切断反馈的不同极限（张力抑制与张力增强）对纤维网络刚性转变起始点的调控作用，并揭示了反馈强度与剪切应变对转变偏移量的影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于二维三角格点的计算机模拟，开发了包含应力对切断的机械化学反馈的计算模型，用于预测应力松弛。

papers.title: Role of System-Bath Interaction in Non-Markovian Quantum Brownian Otto Cycles
papers.abstract: We study finite-time quantum Otto cycles whose working medium is a harmonic oscillator undergoing a quantum Brownian motion described by the Caldeira-Leggett model when the oscillator is in contact with heat baths in isochoric processes. The time evolution of the Otto cycle is studied by analytically solving the exact Heisenberg-Langevin equations for the system variables and the interaction energy between the system and the bath. This enables us to investigate non-Markovian strong-coupling effects on the quantum Otto cycle. We obtain cyclic steady states and study the thermodynamic properties of the Otto cycle for various values of the parameters describing the heat baths and the coupling between the system and the bath. We compare our results with those obtained in the Markovian limit, where the time evolution is described by the Lindblad equation. We find that the change in the interaction energy during the isochoric process contributes to both work and heat, and plays a crucial role in determining thermodynamic behavior of the cycle. In particular, we find that when the Otto cycle operates as an engine, the effect of the interaction energy is to reduce the work output. We also compare our results with the power-efficiency trade-off relation recently proposed for the Markovian quantum Otto engine. We find that the power of our non-Markovian engine for a given efficiency value falls below the Markovian power-efficiency bound.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically solving、Heisenberg-Langevin equations、non-Markovian strong-coupling effects。；研究对象：量子布朗奥托循环，其工作介质为简谐振子，与热库通过Caldeira-Leggett模型耦合，研究非马尔可夫强耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在等容过程中，系统与热库相互作用能的变化同时贡献于功和热，且当奥托循环作为热机运行时，相互作用能会减少功输出；非马尔可夫热机在给定效率下的功率低于马尔可夫功率-效率界限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在等容过程中，系统与热库相互作用能的变化同时贡献于功和热，且当奥托循环作为热机运行时，相互作用能会减少功输出；非马尔可夫热机在给定效率下的功率低于马尔可夫功率-效率界限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过解析求解系统变量的精确海森堡-朗之万方程以及系统与热库的相互作用能，研究非马尔可夫强耦合效应；与马尔可夫极限下由林德布拉德方程描述的时间演化结果进行对比。

papers.title: Hydrogen trapping and interfacial decohesion at the α-Al2O3(0001)/Fe(110) interface
papers.abstract: Hydrogen embrittlement and tritium leakage pose critical challenges for fusion reactor structural components, rendering α-Al2O3/Fe interfaces vital as tritium permeation barriers. Here, the thermodynamic stability, trapping energetics, and hydrogen-induced decohesion at the α-Al2O3 (0001)/Fe(110) interface were systematically investigated using density functional theory. Single-hydrogen incorporation reveals that the Fe-hollow site is the most stable trapping region, owing to local free volume and heterogeneous interfacial bonding. Multi-hydrogen analysis demonstrates that trapping behavior is concentration-dependent; increasing hydrogen concentration progressively reduces the available free volume and increases local lattice distortion. As a result, simulated cleavage processes show a monotonic decrease in cleavage energy with accumulation. At high hydrogen concentrations, cleavage energy turns negative, indicating spontaneous interfacial exfoliation. These quantitative insights clarify the atomistic degradation mechanisms of protective oxide scales, offering a theoretical framework for optimizing high-performance permeation barriers in fusion-relevant steels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional theory”（密度泛函理论）。；研究对象：α-Al2O3(0001)/Fe(110)界面，具体研究该界面在氢（包括氚）环境下的热力学稳定性、氢捕获行为以及氢致界面脱聚的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现氢原子倾向于占据Fe侧的hollow位点，且随着氢浓度增加，界面解离能单调下降，在高浓度下甚至变为负值，导致界面自发剥离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现氢原子倾向于占据Fe侧的hollow位点，且随着氢浓度增加，界面解离能单调下降，在高浓度下甚至变为负值，导致界面自发剥离。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其创新点在于定量揭示了α-Al2O3/Fe界面在原子尺度上随氢浓度变化的退化机制，特别是发现了高氢浓度下解离能为负值这一导致界面自发失效的关键物理图像。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。具体包括：单氢原子嵌入的稳定性分析、多氢原子浓度依赖的捕获行为研究，以及模拟解理过程的能量计算。

papers.title: Integer quantum Hall effect
papers.abstract: Integer quantum Hall effect, which is the Hall effect quantized into integer times $e^2/h$ ($e$: elementary charge, $h$: Planck's constant) observed first in two-dimensional electron gases in strong magnetic fields, is reviewed from both theoretical and experimental standpoints. Basic physics underlying the phenomenon is explained. Specifically in this new edition we have a fresh look at how the quantum Hall effect is captured in a perspective of topological systems, since, while the quantum Hall effect is historically the first realization of the topological systems, the field has been delved into a much wider realm of physics of topological systems. We also mention diverse advances such as the quantum Hall effect (QHE) in various materials and contexts that include graphene, oxides and narrow-gap semiconductors, a relation with the fractional quantum Hall effect, and the quantum Hall effect as the resistance standard and further roles in the new SI system. We also expound the Floquet topological insulator (a light-matter coupled system) as a new paradigm in nonequilibrium topological systems, where an anomalous quantum Hall effect in zero magnetic field is realized as theoretically predicted to occur in graphene illuminated by a circularly-polarized laser and experimentally verified recently.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验综述）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“从理论和实验角度进行综述”（reviewed from both theoretical and experimental standpoints），并包含对拓扑系统视角、Floquet拓扑绝缘体等理论概念的阐述，以及石墨烯、氧化物等实验进展的提及。；研究对象：整数量子霍尔效应（Integer quantum Hall effect），即在强磁场下二维电子气中观测到的霍尔电导量子化为整数倍 \( e^2/h \) 的现象，并延伸至拓扑系统、非平衡拓扑系统（如Floquet拓扑绝缘体）以及多种材料体系（石墨烯、氧化物、窄带隙半导体）中的量子霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 整数量子霍尔效应是拓扑系统的首个实验实现，其物理本质可从拓扑系统视角重新理解；此外，在零磁场下通过圆偏振激光照射石墨烯可实现反常量子霍尔效应（Floquet拓扑绝缘体），该理论预测已获实验验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：整数量子霍尔效应是拓扑系统的首个实验实现，其物理本质可从拓扑系统视角重新理解；此外，在零磁场下通过圆偏振激光照射石墨烯可实现反常量子霍尔效应（Floquet拓扑绝缘体），该理论预测已获实验验证。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有综述的具体创新点，但指出新版内容新增了从拓扑系统视角审视量子霍尔效应，并引入了Floquet拓扑绝缘体作为非平衡拓扑系统的新范式。
papers.method_zh: 综述性论文，未具体描述单一实验或计算方法。摘要提及的理论框架包括：拓扑系统视角、Floquet拓扑绝缘体（光-物质耦合系统）理论；实验方面涉及二维电子气、石墨烯、氧化物、窄带隙半导体中的量子霍尔效应测量，以及作为电阻标准在新SI单位制中的应用。

papers.title: Microscopic Origin of Emergent Elliptic Flow and Molecule Formation in Strongly Interacting Quasi-Two-Dimensional Few-Body Systems
papers.abstract: Recent experiments simulating two-dimensional few-fermion systems have observed emergent hydrodynamic behavior, i.e., interaction-driven elliptic flow by adding fermions two at a time [S.~Brandstetter et al., Nat. Phys. (2025)]. Due to the curse of dimensionality and strong correlations, capturing such phenomena beyond two particles remains challenging. Here, we use the ab initio time-dependent explicitly correlated Gaussian (TDECG) method to quantitatively reproduce these experimental observations. With only a moderate number of correlated Gaussian basis functions, our approach obtains converged dynamical observables for systems up to six particles. Furthermore, real-time access to the many-body wavefunction and two-point correlation functions enables us to visualize the transformation from a strongly interacting gas to a stream of paired molecules, i.e., a dynamical BCS-BEC crossover.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：ab initio time-dependent explicitly correlated Gaussian (TDECG) method、quantitatively reproduce、converged dynamical observables。；研究对象：强相互作用的准二维少体费米子系统，具体研究其涌现的椭圆流（emergent elliptic flow）和分子形成（molecule formation）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过TDECG方法定量重现了实验观测到的少体费米子系统的涌现流体动力学行为，并实时揭示了从强相互作用气体到配对分子流的动态BCS-BEC渡越过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过TDECG方法定量重现了实验观测到的少体费米子系统的涌现流体动力学行为，并实时揭示了从强相互作用气体到配对分子流的动态BCS-BEC渡越过程。；创新点：首次在少体（最多六粒子）准二维费米子系统中，利用第一性原理含时方法定量重现并可视化解释了实验中观测到的涌现椭圆流和动态BCS-BEC渡越的微观起源。
papers.method_zh: 采用从头算含时显式关联高斯（TDECG）方法，使用中等数量的关联高斯基函数，对最多六个粒子的系统进行收敛的动力学可观测量计算，并通过多体波函数和两点关联函数进行实时可视化分析。

papers.title: Doping- and temperature-dependent electronic structure and spin dynamics in the Hubbard model on a square lattice within cluster perturbation theory
papers.abstract: The doping and temperature dependencies of the electronic structure and the dynamic spin susceptibility of the Hubbard model on a square lattice are studied within cluster perturbation theory (CPT). The most general features of both electronic and spin spectra qualitatively agree with the experimental data on cuprates. Generalized mean-field calculations of the electronic structure using static short-range magnetic correlations from CPT are also implemented and compared with the results of CPT, allowing us to discuss the role of short-range antiferromagnetism in the formation of the pseudogap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：cluster perturbation theory (CPT)、generalized mean-field calculations。；研究对象：正方晶格上的Hubbard模型，具体关联到铜氧化物（cuprates）的电子结构和自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在团簇微扰理论（CPT）框架下，Hubbard模型的电子结构和动态自旋磁化率随掺杂和温度的变化，其最普遍特征与铜氧化物的实验数据定性一致。通过对比CPT与基于静态短程磁关联的广义平均场计算结果，揭示了短程反铁磁序在赝能隙形成中的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在团簇微扰理论（CPT）框架下，Hubbard模型的电子结构和动态自旋磁化率随掺杂和温度的变化，其最普遍特征与铜氧化物的实验数据定性一致。通过对比CPT与基于静态短程磁关联的广义平均场计算结果，揭示了短程反铁磁序在赝能隙形成中的作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用团簇微扰理论（CPT）计算电子结构和动态自旋磁化率；同时利用CPT得到的静态短程磁关联进行广义平均场计算，并与CPT结果进行比较。

papers.title: Negative Interaction Quench Dynamics of Density-Ordered Dipolar Bosons in a One-Dimensional Optical Lattice
papers.abstract: We explore the nonequilibrium dynamics of a density-ordered dipolar Bose gas in a finite one-dimensional optical lattice following a negative interaction quench, using the numerically exact multiconfigurational time-dependent Hartree method for bosons. The interaction sign reversal, effectively driving a crossover from long-range to short-range interactions, generates rich intra- and interwell tunneling dynamics spanning superfluid, Mott-insulating, and fragmented regimes. A striking finding is the robustness of the underlying crystal-state correlations against the quench, despite the strong dynamical response. We identify emergent excitation modes, including local breathing and dipole-like oscillations, via real- and momentum-space observables, and quantify tunneling through site-resolved position variance. One- and two-body Glauber correlation functions further uncover a direct connection between tunneling and correlation dynamics. Moreover, we show that combining interaction quenches with lattice-depth ramping enables controllable dynamical engineering, establishing dipolar lattice systems as a promising platform for nonequilibrium quantum simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically exact multiconfigurational time-dependent Hartree method for bosons（数值精确的多组态含时Hartree方法）。；研究对象：一维光晶格中具有密度有序态的偶极玻色子气体，在负相互作用淬火后的非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管系统在淬火后表现出强烈的动力学响应（包括丰富的阱内和阱间隧穿动力学），但底层晶体态（密度有序态）的关联性对淬火具有鲁棒性。此外，通过结合相互作用淬火与晶格深度斜坡，可以实现可控的动力学工程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管系统在淬火后表现出强烈的动力学响应（包括丰富的阱内和阱间隧穿动力学），但底层晶体态（密度有序态）的关联性对淬火具有鲁棒性。此外，通过结合相互作用淬火与晶格深度斜坡，可以实现可控的动力学工程。；创新点：首次系统研究了相互作用符号反转（从长程到短程相互作用的有效交叉）对密度有序偶极玻色子非平衡动力学的影响，并揭示了晶体态关联的鲁棒性以及通过晶格深度斜坡实现可控动力学工程的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值精确的多组态含时Hartree方法（MCTDHB）对有限一维光晶格中的偶极玻色子进行精确数值模拟。

papers.title: Significance of time-convolutionless mode-coupling theory in capturing the dynamics of glass-forming liquids
papers.abstract: This paper demonstrates the significance of the recently proposed time-convolutionless mode-coupling theory (TMCT) in capturing the dynamics of glass-forming liquids. The origin of the primary differences between ideal MCT and TMCT is comprehensively explored from a unified perspective. First, we review two distinct projection operator methods in the Heisenberg picture: the time-convolution (TC) formulation proposed by Mori and the time-convolutionless (TCL) formulation proposed by Tokuyama and Mori. We show that the appropriate choice between these frameworks fundamentally depends on the space-time scales of the relevant variables. In TMCT, the TC formulation is applied to the current density, whereas the TCL formulation is applied to the number density because the latter operates on a significantly longer space-time scale. In contrast, ideal MCT applies the TC formulation to both densities. Consequently, the governing equation in TMCT is timeconvolutionless, whereas the ideal MCT equation features a time-convolution form. This fundamental difference significantly affects various physical quantities near the glass transition. Finally, the full TMCT equation is transformed into a simplified recursion equation to facilitate numerical analysis, and the key predictions of TMCT are compared with those of ideal MCT
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“projector operator methods”、“governing equation”、“theoretical framework”等理论推导关键词，且未涉及实验或数值模拟结果。；研究对象：玻璃形成液体的动力学行为，特别是接近玻璃转变时的物理量变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时间无卷积模式耦合理论（TMCT）通过分别对电流密度和数密度应用不同的投影算子方法（TC和TCL），能够更准确地捕捉玻璃形成液体的动力学，其与理想MCT的根本差异在于控制方程是否具有时间卷积形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时间无卷积模式耦合理论（TMCT）通过分别对电流密度和数密度应用不同的投影算子方法（TC和TCL），能够更准确地捕捉玻璃形成液体的动力学，其与理想MCT的根本差异在于控制方程是否具有时间卷积形式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于海森堡绘景下的两种投影算子方法——Mori的时间卷积（TC）公式和Tokuyama-Mori的时间无卷积（TCL）公式。TMCT对电流密度使用TC公式，对数密度使用TCL公式；理想MCT则对两者均使用TC公式。最终将TMCT全方程转化为简化递归方程以便数值分析。

papers.title: Resonant Coupling and the Non-Phononic Flat Band in Amorphous Solids
papers.abstract: Recent experiments and simulations provide compelling evidence for the emergence of a non-phononic flat band in the dynamical structure factor of two- and three-dimensional amorphous solids. This feature has been suggested to be connected to the excess in the reduced vibrational density of states of glasses, commonly known as the boson peak, and displays several apparently universal characteristics. First, it is nearly dispersionless, with an energy close to the boson-peak frequency. Second, its intensity is negligible below a critical wave vector of the order of the first diffraction peak. Third, its reduced intensity exhibits a strong correlation with the static structure factor. Here, we revisit the resonant-coupling model, a single-mode harmonic realization of the soft-potential scenario in which acoustic phonons interact with single frequency quasi-localized vibrations. We show that this minimal framework naturally reproduces the main features of the observed flat band and clarifies its connection to the boson peak.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“revisit the resonant-coupling model”、“a single-mode harmonic realization”、“show that this minimal framework”等表述，表明工作核心是理论建模与分析。；研究对象：非晶态固体（amorphous solids）中出现的非声子平带（non-phononic flat band）及其与玻色峰（boson peak）的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作表明，一个简单的谐振耦合模型（声学声子与单频率准局域振动耦合）能够自然地复现非晶固体动力学结构因子中非声子平带的主要特征（近无色散、临界波矢、与静态结构因子的关联），并阐明了该平带与玻色峰之间的内在联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作表明，一个简单的谐振耦合模型（声学声子与单频率准局域振动耦合）能够自然地复现非晶固体动力学结构因子中非声子平带的主要特征（近无色散、临界波矢、与静态结构因子的关联），并阐明了该平带与玻色峰之间的内在联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其创新点在于用一个极简的理论框架（而非复杂数值模拟）统一解释了近期实验和模拟中观测到的非声子平带的多个看似普适的特征，并明确了其与玻色峰的理论联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析。具体采用了“谐振耦合模型”（resonant-coupling model），这是“软势模型”（soft-potential scenario）的一种单模谐振实现，用于描述声学声子与准局域振动之间的相互作用。

papers.title: Universal Right-Hand Chirality of Evanescent Vector Fields
papers.abstract: A locking between propagation direction $\hat{\bf q}$, spin $\hat{\bf S}$, and surface or interface normal $\hat{\bf n}$ -- a phenomenon broadly termed \textit{chirality} -- pervades evanescent or surface waves in optics, magnetism, plasmonics, and acoustics. Yet, it is not known whether the phenomenon is universal or bound to conditions. Here, we unveil that any \textit{source-free} vector field that propagates along $\hat{\bf q}$ and is evanescent along $\hat{\bf n}$, the existence of a spin automatically enforces a rigid, right-handed locking among $\hat{\bf q}$, $\hat{\bf S}$, and $\hat{\bf n}$, that is characterized by a chirality index $C_{\bf q}\equiv \hat{\bf n}\cdot(\hat{\bf S}\times \hat{\bf q})>0$. For an arbitrary propagation direction defined by $\hat{\bf q}\cdot \hat{\bf S}\equiv η\in [-1,1]$, i.e., not necessarily transverse spin, we derive a fundamental upper bound $C_{\bf q}\le \sqrt{1-η^2}$. The universal absence of left-handed evanescent (source-less) vector fields underscores the fundamental physical non-equivalence of mirror-image configurations -- a principle echoed by parity violation, the natural excess of enantiomers in chiral molecules, and the fixed chirality of DNA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“unveil”“derive a fundamental upper bound”等理论推导性表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：倏逝矢量场（evanescent vector fields）中的自旋-传播方向-界面法线之间的手性锁定现象，涵盖光学、磁学、等离激元学、声学等领域的表面波或倏逝波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任何无源矢量场若沿方向 \(\hat{\bf q}\) 传播且沿法线 \(\hat{\bf n}\) 倏逝，其自旋 \(\hat{\bf S}\) 必然导致 \(\hat{\bf q}\)、\(\hat{\bf S}\)、\(\hat{\bf n}\) 三者之间严格的右手锁定，手性指数 \(C_{\bf q}\equiv \hat{\bf n}\cdot(\hat{\bf S}\times \hat{\bf q})>0\)；对于任意传播方向（自旋不必横向），存在上限 \(C_{\bf q}\le \sqrt{1-\eta^2}\)（其中 \(\eta\equiv \hat{\bf q}\cdot \hat{\bf S}\)）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任何无源矢量场若沿方向 \(\hat{\bf q}\) 传播且沿法线 \(\hat{\bf n}\) 倏逝，其自旋 \(\hat{\bf S}\) 必然导致 \(\hat{\bf q}\)、\(\hat{\bf S}\)、\(\hat{\bf n}\) 三者之间严格的右手锁定，手性指数 \(C_{\bf q}\equiv \hat{\bf n}\cdot(\hat{\bf S}\times \hat{\bf q})>0\)；对于任意传播方向（自旋不必横向），存在上限 \(C_{\bf q}\le \sqrt{1-\eta^2}\)（其中 \(\eta\equiv \hat{\bf q}\cdot \hat{\bf S}\)）。；创新点：揭示了倏逝矢量场中右手手性锁定的普适性，证明左手手性的倏逝无源矢量场在物理上不存在，并将该现象与宇称不守恒、手性分子中对映体过量及DNA固定手性等基本物理非等价性联系起来。摘要未突出说明与已有具体理论模型的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。通过分析无源矢量场在界面附近的边界条件与波动方程约束，建立传播方向、自旋与界面法线之间的几何关系，并推导手性指数的数学上限。

papers.title: Tandem Exclusion Process
papers.abstract: We introduce the \emph{tandem exclusion process} (TEP), a one-dimensional stochastic lattice model motivated by tandem running in ants. Particles evolve through two cooperative local transitions, $110\to101$ at rate $α$ (leader advancement) and $101\to011$ at rate $β$ (follower recovery). We prove that the stationary measure on the dynamically active sector is the Gibbs measure $π\propto q^{H(η)}$, where $q=β/α$ and $H(η)$ counts neighboring occupied pairs, and derive exact closed-form expressions for the stationary current and spatial correlations using transfer-matrix methods. The current is asymmetric under particle--hole exchange $ρ\mapsto1-ρ$, with its maximum occurring at densities strictly larger than $1/2$, in contrast to the symmetric current $ρ(1-ρ)$ of the totally asymmetric simple exclusion process (TASEP). For $q>1$, cooperative dynamics enhances the current above the TASEP value and generates strong spatial clustering; in the limit $q\to\infty$, the current approaches $J\toαρ$, corresponding to nearly unconstrained collective transport. These results suggest that tandem coordination alone can substantially enhance collective transport efficiency at moderate and high densities, even without pheromone-mediated long-range communication.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce、prove、derive、transfer-matrix methods。；研究对象：一维随机晶格模型——串联排斥过程（Tandem Exclusion Process, TEP），其动力学受蚂蚁串联奔跑行为启发，研究粒子通过两种合作性局域跃迁（领头前进与跟随恢复）的集体输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TEP的稳态测度是吉布斯测度π ∝ q^{H(η)}，其中q=β/α，H(η)计数相邻占据对数目；其稳态电流在粒子-空穴交换下不对称，最大值出现在密度严格大于1/2处，且当q>1时电流可超过完全不对称简单排斥过程（TASEP）的电流，表明串联协调本身能在中高密度下显著增强集体输运效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TEP的稳态测度是吉布斯测度π ∝ q^{H(η)}，其中q=β/α，H(η)计数相邻占据对数目；其稳态电流在粒子-空穴交换下不对称，最大值出现在密度严格大于1/2处，且当q>1时电流可超过完全不对称简单排斥过程（TASEP）的电流，表明串联协调本身能在中高密度下显著增强集体输运效率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过转移矩阵方法推导稳态电流和空间关联的精确闭式表达式；与TASEP的对称电流ρ(1-ρ)进行对比分析。

papers.title: Altermagnetism in MnF$_2$: Band Splitting and Its Physical Consequences
papers.abstract: MnF$_2$ is widely regarded as a candidate altermagnet, but the magnitude and implications of its altermagnetic band splitting remain debated. Using electronic-structure calculations, we construct minimal models that capture the magnetic and electronic properties of MnF$_2$. These models show that the parameters governing the chiral magnon splitting and the spin splitting of the electronic bands are relatively small. Moreover, the electronic system lies in the strong-coupling regime, where most magnetic properties are controlled by the ratio $t/U$ between the characteristic hopping amplitude $t$ and the large on-site Coulomb repulsion $U$. Consequently, all exchange interactions scale as $1/U$, so a small altermagnetic hopping $δt$ produces only a proportionally small exchange term. Upon doping, the altermagnetic contribution to the anomalous Hall effect is likewise suppressed, being smaller than the conventional (non-altermagnetic) contribution by a factor of order $δt/U$. In contrast, the behavior of the conductivity tensor $\hatσ(ω)$ at $\hbar ω\sim U$ differs qualitatively, because $δt$ enters the energies of interband optical transitions \emph{directly} rather than through the reduced ratio $δt/U$. This contribution strongly reshapes $\hatσ(ω)$, leading to a dramatic enhancement of the magneto-optical response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：使用电子结构计算（electronic-structure calculations）构建模型，分析物理后果。；研究对象：MnF₂ 中的交变磁性（altermagnetism），具体研究其能带劈裂（band splitting）的大小及其物理后果，包括手性磁子劈裂、电子自旋劈裂、反常霍尔效应和磁光响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MnF₂ 中交变磁性的能带劈裂参数较小，且电子系统处于强耦合（strong-coupling） regime，导致交变磁性的交换项和反常霍尔效应贡献被抑制；但光学电导率张量在光子能量 ~U 处因交变磁性参数直接进入跃迁能量而显著增强磁光响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MnF₂ 中交变磁性的能带劈裂参数较小，且电子系统处于强耦合（strong-coupling） regime，导致交变磁性的交换项和反常霍尔效应贡献被抑制；但光学电导率张量在光子能量 ~U 处因交变磁性参数直接进入跃迁能量而显著增强磁光响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用电子结构计算（electronic-structure calculations）构建最小模型（minimal models），分析交变磁性参数（如 δt）与库仑排斥 U、跳跃振幅 t 的关系，并推导交换相互作用、反常霍尔效应及光学电导率张量的标度行为。

papers.title: The Longest Increasing Subsequence Problem revisited
papers.abstract: The Longest Increasing Subsequence problem - a classic combinatorial challenge with deep connections to statistical mechanics- exhibits a rich thermodynamic landscape. Introducing a temperature we identify two distinct energy scales: A Schottky-like crossover at T_cross and a condensation transition at T_cond, below which the number of maximum-length configurations becomes sub-exponential in system size. We also show that despite the existence of polynomial-time dynamic programming algorithms for the ground state, local Monte Carlo dynamics, after sudden quenches at low temperatures, become trapped in metastable state configurations displaying characteristic glassy signatures: two-step relaxation, persistent dynamical overlaps and aging. On the other hand, logarithmic annealing tracks equilibrium down to the ground state. These results establish that thermodynamic sparsity - not energetic barriers - can render local search dynamically intractable, positioning the LIS problem as a bridge between exactly solvable optimization and glassy spin-glass phenomenology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：thermodynamic landscape、temperature、energy scales、Monte Carlo dynamics、statistical mechanics。；研究对象：最长递增子序列（Longest Increasing Subsequence, LIS）问题，将其视为一个具有统计力学与玻璃态物理特征的组合优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LIS问题存在两个不同的能量尺度：一个肖特基型交叉（T_cross）和一个凝聚转变（T_cond），在低温下局域蒙特卡洛动力学陷入亚稳态，表现出玻璃态特征（两步弛豫、持续动力学重叠和老化），而热力学稀疏性（而非能垒）导致局域搜索在动力学上难以处理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LIS问题存在两个不同的能量尺度：一个肖特基型交叉（T_cross）和一个凝聚转变（T_cond），在低温下局域蒙特卡洛动力学陷入亚稳态，表现出玻璃态特征（两步弛豫、持续动力学重叠和老化），而热力学稀疏性（而非能垒）导致局域搜索在动力学上难以处理。；创新点：将经典组合优化问题（LIS）与玻璃态自旋玻璃现象建立桥梁，揭示热力学稀疏性而非能垒是导致局域搜索动力学困难的根本原因。摘要未突出说明与已有统计力学或玻璃态模型的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 引入温度概念构建热力学框架，分析能量尺度；使用局域蒙特卡洛动力学模拟低温淬火过程；采用对数退火方法追踪平衡态。

papers.title: Quantum Statistics and Structural Topology Govern Thermal Transport in Two-Dimensional Monolayer Amorphous Carbon
papers.abstract: We investigate the quantum thermal conductivity (TC) of two-dimensional monolayer amorphous carbon (MAC). We employ three distinct amorphization algorithms to generate various possible MAC configurations, ranging from Zachariasen-type continuous random networks to nanocrystallites embedded in random networks. The local bond order parameter, q3, is used to quantify the amorphousness of the structures, and TC is computed as functions of q3 and temperature. This framework enables us to assess how structural topology, degree of amorphization, and quantum statistics contribute to heat conduction in a two-dimensional amorphous solid. At room temperature, TC values are predicted to range between 3.5 to 10 W/m/K, in agreement with recent experiments. Analysis of vibrational modes reveals that, while the modes of these 2D amorphous structures fall into the usual categories, namely, propagons, diffusons, and locons, their polarization characteristics display distinct behavior. Owing to the fully quantum mechanical framework, we examine both low- and high-temperature characteristics of this 2D amorphous system. By examining the classical limit, we show that classical treatments substantially overestimate the TC of MAC; namely, the quantum TC is less than half of the classical value at room temperature and up to nearly an order of magnitude lower at low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：investigate、compute、quantum thermal conductivity、fully quantum mechanical framework。；研究对象：二维单层非晶碳（two-dimensional monolayer amorphous carbon, MAC）的热输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维单层非晶碳的室温热导率在3.5至10 W/m/K之间，与近期实验吻合；量子统计效应显著降低热导率，室温下量子热导率不到经典值的一半，低温下可低近一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维单层非晶碳的室温热导率在3.5至10 W/m/K之间，与近期实验吻合；量子统计效应显著降低热导率，室温下量子热导率不到经典值的一半，低温下可低近一个数量级。；创新点：首次在完全量子力学框架下系统研究二维非晶碳的结构拓扑、非晶化程度与量子统计效应对热导率的贡献，并揭示了经典处理对热导率的显著高估。
papers.method_zh: 采用三种不同的非晶化算法生成多种MAC构型（从Zachariasen型连续随机网络到嵌入随机网络的纳米晶粒）；使用局域键序参数q₃量化非晶化程度；在完全量子力学框架下计算热导率作为q₃和温度的函数；分析振动模式的极化特性及分类（propagons、diffusons、locons）。

papers.title: Quantized orbital and spin Hall transport: interplay between $sp$-hybridization, altermagnetism and spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: We here explore the emergence of orbital and spin Hall effects, originating beyond the $L$-$S$ coupling, and investigate the interplay between inter-orbit hybridization, relativistic Rashba spin-orbit coupling (SOC), and non-relativistic SOC, namely altermagnetic (AM) order, in a two-dimensional model Hamiltonian. The orbital (spin) Hall responses are remarkably found to be quantized within a window of Fermi energy when the strength of AM order (Rashba SOC) exceeds (falls below) the scale set by $sp$-hybridization. Importantly, orbital and spin Hall quantizations are independent of Rashba SOC and AM order, respectively, while the uniform profiles of finite orbital and vanishingly small spin moments of bands around the Fermi energy. The microscopic origin of such quantization comes from the Fermi surface-activated orbital and spin Berry curvatures. The extent of the quantized regime is strongly controlled by the intra-orbital coupling strength. As the temperature increases, the quantization is significantly compromised in the spin Hall case. We extend our analysis to the orbital and spin Nernst coefficients where the pronounced dip-peak structures signal the existence of the quantization leading to experimental relevance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：模型哈密顿量、理论分析、数值计算。；研究对象：二维模型哈密顿量中，由sp轨道杂化、交变磁序（altermagnetic order）与自旋-轨道耦合（包括相对论性Rashba SOC和非相对论性SOC）共同作用下的轨道霍尔效应和自旋霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当交变磁序强度超过sp杂化标度时，轨道霍尔响应在费米能窗口内出现量子化；当Rashba SOC强度低于该标度时，自旋霍尔响应出现量子化。这两种量子化分别独立于Rashba SOC和交变磁序，且与费米能附近能带的均匀轨道矩和极小自旋矩相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当交变磁序强度超过sp杂化标度时，轨道霍尔响应在费米能窗口内出现量子化；当Rashba SOC强度低于该标度时，自旋霍尔响应出现量子化。这两种量子化分别独立于Rashba SOC和交变磁序，且与费米能附近能带的均匀轨道矩和极小自旋矩相关。；创新点：揭示了超越传统L-S耦合框架的轨道与自旋霍尔效应的量子化机制，并阐明了sp杂化、交变磁序与Rashba SOC三者之间的竞争关系对量子化窗口的控制作用。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 构建二维模型哈密顿量，通过计算轨道和自旋贝里曲率（Fermi surface-activated Berry curvatures）分析霍尔响应，并进一步计算轨道和自旋能斯特系数（Nernst coefficients）以揭示量子化特征。

papers.title: Flat interface between amorphous ices and the role of MDA-like intermediate states in the LDA-HDA transformation
papers.abstract: The pressure-induced transformation between low-density amorphous ice (LDA) and high-density amorphous ice (HDA) is a prototypical polyamorphic transition, yet its microscopic mechanism - and in particular the nature of intermediate amorphous (IA) states - has long remained unresolved. We present the first characterisation of a flat LDA||HDA interface, determining its equilibrium thickness and showing its link to medium-density amorphous ice (MDA). Interestingly, the thickness of the interfacial layer remains constant under compression, while its position shifts reversibly into the LDA region - an elastic response that exhibits kinetic hysteresis upon decompression, reminiscent of memory effects. For high-precision discrimination of amorphous ices, we use a neural network classifier based on SOAP (Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions) descriptors. The systematic description of the local structure emphasizes the importance of orientational information from the hydrogen bond network. Furthermore, this approach enables molecular dynamics analysis of the LDA-to-HDA transformation, directly mapping the spatial distribution of intermediate structures relative to growing HDA domains and the surrounding LDA matrix, and revealing that MDA-like IA configurations are not a distinct bulk phase but rather localise at the LDA-HDA interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（分子动力学模拟、神经网络分类器、SOAP描述符分析）；研究对象：低密度非晶冰（LDA）与高密度非晶冰（HDA）之间的压力诱导多晶型相变，特别是中间非晶态（IA）及平直界面的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次表征了LDA与HDA之间的平直界面，发现其厚度在压缩过程中保持恒定，且界面位置可逆地向LDA区域移动；中间非晶态（IA）并非独立体相，而是局域在LDA-HDA界面处，其结构类似于中等密度非晶冰（MDA）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次表征了LDA与HDA之间的平直界面，发现其厚度在压缩过程中保持恒定，且界面位置可逆地向LDA区域移动；中间非晶态（IA）并非独立体相，而是局域在LDA-HDA界面处，其结构类似于中等密度非晶冰（MDA）。；创新点：首次确定了LDA||HDA平直界面的平衡厚度及其与MDA的关联；揭示了界面在压缩/减压过程中的弹性响应与动力学滞后（记忆效应）；直接证明了MDA-like中间态并非体相，而是界面局域结构。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟；基于SOAP（原子位置平滑重叠）描述符的神经网络分类器用于高精度区分非晶冰结构；通过分析氢键网络的取向信息进行局域结构系统描述。

papers.title: Signatures of Rashba-Cavity-Induced Berry-curvature redistribution in the Spin-Hall Conductivity of Semiconductor Artificial Graphene
papers.abstract: We investigate the combined effect of a far-infrared cavity field and Rashba spin-orbit interac- tion on the band structure and transport properties of artificial graphene composed of quazi-2D InAs/GaAs quantum dots. The coupling to cavity photons is modeled by constructing a complete basis as the tensor product of the electronic Hilbert space and the Fock space. Our calculations for the system embedded in a linear cavity predict the existence of both type-I and type-II Dirac points which can be distinguished by their response to Rashba interaction. Namely, Rashba coupling opens a gap at type-II Dirac points, while type-I Dirac points remain gapless. For both cylindrical and linear cavities, we demonstrate the formation of electron-photon hybrid states and Rabi oscillations between energy minibands. Multiple splittings, crossings, and anticrossings between Dirac-band replicas produce pronounced modifications of the spin-Hall conductivity, including strong anisotropy and oscillatory behavior controlled by cavity geometry and polarization. Our results show that the interplay between Rashba and cavity couplings governs Dirac-point physics and provides a route toward tunable polaritonic transport and topological phases in engineered nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：investigate、modeled、calculations、predict。；研究对象：由准二维InAs/GaAs量子点构成的人工石墨烯，在远红外腔场和Rashba自旋-轨道耦合共同作用下的能带结构与输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 腔场与Rashba耦合共同调控狄拉克点类型（I型与II型），并显著改变自旋霍尔电导率，产生强各向异性和振荡行为，为可调极化激元输运和拓扑相提供途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔场与Rashba耦合共同调控狄拉克点类型（I型与II型），并显著改变自旋霍尔电导率，产生强各向异性和振荡行为，为可调极化激元输运和拓扑相提供途径。；创新点：首次揭示了腔场与Rashba自旋-轨道耦合协同作用下，人工石墨烯中I型与II型狄拉克点的不同响应（Rashba仅打开II型狄拉克点能隙），并展示了腔几何结构和偏振对自旋霍尔电导率的各向异性与振荡行为的调控。
papers.method_zh: 通过将电子希尔伯特空间与福克空间张量积构建完备基，对腔光子耦合进行建模；计算了嵌入线性腔和圆柱腔中的系统能带结构、电子-光子混合态、拉比振荡以及自旋霍尔电导率。

papers.title: Resonant Raman scattering in bilayer 3R-MoS$_{2}$
papers.abstract: Raman scattering is a powerful spectroscopic technique widely employed to investigate light-matter interactions and lattice dynamics in two-dimensional materials. Here, we investigate the temperature-dependent resonant Raman response of bilayer 3R-MoS$_2$. The study combines multi-wavelength Raman spectroscopy, photoluminescence measurements, and density functional theory calculations to track the evolution of excitonic transitions and resonance conditions. We observe contributions from both zone-centre and finite-momentum phonons, a pronounced quenching of the Stokes intensity at low temperatures followed by saturation, the emergence of anti-Stokes scattering above 130~K, and a strong deviation of the effective phonon temperature from the lattice temperature induced by resonance effects. These results demonstrate that the Raman response is governed by the interplay between incoming and outgoing resonance processes, providing deeper insight into exciton-phonon coupling in van der Waals materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“multi-wavelength Raman spectroscopy, photoluminescence measurements”（实验手段）和“density functional theory calculations”（计算方法）。；研究对象：双层3R相二硫化钼（bilayer 3R-MoS₂）中的共振拉曼散射行为，具体涉及激子跃迁、声子响应以及激子-声子耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双层3R-MoS₂的拉曼响应由入射共振和出射共振过程的共同作用主导，表现为低温下斯托克斯强度的显著猝灭与饱和、130 K以上反斯托克斯散射的出现，以及共振效应导致的声子有效温度与晶格温度的强烈偏离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双层3R-MoS₂的拉曼响应由入射共振和出射共振过程的共同作用主导，表现为低温下斯托克斯强度的显著猝灭与饱和、130 K以上反斯托克斯散射的出现，以及共振效应导致的声子有效温度与晶格温度的强烈偏离。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 多波长拉曼光谱、光致发光测量、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: High-quality Nano-patterning of Oxide Interfaces Using Transferred Gold Mask
papers.abstract: Complex oxide interfaces, such as \mathrm{SrTiO_3} and \mathrm{KTaO_3} based heterostructures, host rich correlated phenomena with strong potential for advanced device applications. However, these interfaces are extremely susceptible to contamination and defect formation during nanofabrication, which often compromises device performance. Here, we present a solvent-free method for patterning oxide interfaces by employing high-resolution transferable thin metal masks in conjunction with oxygen-enriched Ar+ milling, which enables a clean and well-controlled nanofabrication process. Transport measurements demonstrate that the fabricated devices preserve their intrinsic properties, including high carrier mobilities, with negligible degradation compared to the pristine interfaces. This technique offers a convenient and robust route for engineering high-performance oxide electronic devices with precisely tailored transport characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：solvent-free method、transport measurements、fabricated devices。；研究对象：复杂氧化物界面，具体为基于 SrTiO₃ 和 KTaO₃ 的异质结构，以及其纳米图案化工艺。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种无溶剂、使用可转移金掩模结合富氧氩离子刻蚀的纳米图案化方法，能够在不显著退化氧化物界面本征输运性质（如高载流子迁移率）的前提下实现高质量器件制备。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种无溶剂、使用可转移金掩模结合富氧氩离子刻蚀的纳米图案化方法，能够在不显著退化氧化物界面本征输运性质（如高载流子迁移率）的前提下实现高质量器件制备。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用高分辨率可转移薄金属掩模（金掩模）与富氧氩离子刻蚀（oxygen-enriched Ar+ milling）相结合的干法纳米加工工艺，并通过输运测量（transport measurements）评估器件性能。

papers.title: Particle Force-Based Continuum Model for Multicomponent Size Segregating Mixtures
papers.abstract: We investigate size difference driven segregation in dense granular flows of multicomponent mixtures down a periodic chute using continuum model and Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulations. A previously developed particle force-based segregation model for binary mixtures is systematically extended to mixtures comprising three or more particle species differing in size. The generalized model accounts for inter-species interactions by computing the net force on each component in the presence of all others, without relying on empirical percolation velocity. This segregation model is coupled with a mixture rheology model and incorporated into the species transport and momentum balance equations to develop a continuum model that predicts the spatial and temporal evolution of species concentration and velocity fields. The continuum model predictions are found to be in agreement with DEM simulation data for ternary and quaternary mixtures over a wide range of mixture compositions and chute inclinations at moderate size ratios for well-mixed and small-near-base configurations. For larger size ratios, the one dimensional model predictions capture the qualitative segregation trend while showing relatively larger quantitative differences from DEM data. For an initial configuration, having large particles near base and small particles near the free surface, a Rayleigh-Taylor like instability at early times is observed. Due to the presence of this instability, two dimensional evolution of the species concentration fields is present for initial part of the flow. Predictions of such features requires the extension of the one dimensional continuum model to two dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：continuum model（连续模型）、Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulations（离散元模拟）、rheology model（流变模型）。；研究对象：多组分颗粒混合物在周期性斜槽中因尺寸差异驱动的分选（segregation）现象，具体为三元和四元混合物的密集颗粒流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于颗粒力的连续模型能成功预测三元和四元混合物在中等尺寸比下的浓度与速度场时空演化，与DEM模拟吻合；在大尺寸比下可捕捉定性趋势但定量偏差较大。初始构型中“大颗粒在下、小颗粒在上”时会出现类似Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性，需二维模型描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于颗粒力的连续模型能成功预测三元和四元混合物在中等尺寸比下的浓度与速度场时空演化，与DEM模拟吻合；在大尺寸比下可捕捉定性趋势但定量偏差较大。初始构型中“大颗粒在下、小颗粒在上”时会出现类似Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性，需二维模型描述。；创新点：将基于颗粒力的分选模型从二元体系系统推广至多组分（三组分及以上）体系，避免了经验渗流速度的引入，并在一维连续模型中实现了对多组分分选动力学的定量预测。
papers.method_zh: 将先前针对二元混合物的颗粒力分选模型系统推广至三组分及以上体系，通过计算每种组分在其他所有组分存在下的净受力（不依赖经验渗流速度）来考虑种间相互作用；将该分选模型与混合物流变模型耦合，纳入物种输运方程和动量平衡方程，构建一维连续模型；并用DEM模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Orbital Hall effect-driven spin-orbit torque enhancement in Ti-based systems via rare-earth interface engineering
papers.abstract: Orbital currents in light metals offer large orbital Hall conductivities, yet translating this into practical spin-orbit torque efficiency is hindered by fundamental limitations. In this work, we introduce a Gd interlayer between a Ti orbital source and a Co ferromagnet to enhance the orbital torque efficiency. Ferromagnetic resonance-based spin (orbital) pumping measurements identify an optimal Gd thickness of around 4 nm, where the orbital-to-spin conversion efficiency reaches its maximum. The Ti-thickness dependence of the inverse orbital Hall effect signal confirms a bulk orbital Hall origin in Ti and yields a qualitative orbital diffusion length exceeding 20 nm. Spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance measurements demonstrate a fivefold enhancement of the SOT efficiency in Ti(20 nm)/Co compared to a Gd(4 nm)/Co reference. Interestingly, the trilayer Ti/Gd/Co architecture exhibits a spin (orbital) torque efficiency greater than 1, which is higher than that of the bilayer Ti/Co and Gd/Co structures, irrespective of Ti thickness. These results establish rare-earth interlayer engineering as a viable route to enhanced orbital torque efficiency for next-generation spin-orbitronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Ferromagnetic resonance-based spin (orbital) pumping measurements、Spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance measurements。；研究对象：Ti/Gd/Co 三明治结构异质结，具体研究其中轨道霍尔效应驱动的自旋轨道力矩增强现象，以及稀土界面工程（Gd插层）对轨道力矩效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ti轨道源与Co铁磁层之间插入约4 nm厚的Gd插层，可将自旋轨道力矩效率提升五倍，且三明治结构Ti/Gd/Co的轨道力矩效率超过1，高于Ti/Co和Gd/Co双层结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ti轨道源与Co铁磁层之间插入约4 nm厚的Gd插层，可将自旋轨道力矩效率提升五倍，且三明治结构Ti/Gd/Co的轨道力矩效率超过1，高于Ti/Co和Gd/Co双层结构。；创新点：首次提出并实验验证了通过稀土（Gd）界面工程来增强轻金属Ti中轨道霍尔效应驱动的自旋轨道力矩效率，实现了超过1的轨道力矩效率，为下一代自旋轨道电子学器件提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于铁磁共振的自旋（轨道）泵浦测量技术、逆轨道霍尔效应信号测量、自旋力矩铁磁共振测量，并结合不同Ti厚度和Gd厚度的系统变化实验。

papers.title: How Can Machine Learning Accelerate CALPHAD Free Energy Modeling?
papers.abstract: The CALPHAD framework provides a rigorous basis for thermodynamic modeling, yet its ability to predict new chemistries is restricted by limited data and by functional forms that rely heavily on composition alone. Here, we show that machine learning (ML) can address these challenges through a hybrid strategy that learns Redlich-Kister (RK) interaction coefficients directly from physically informed elemental descriptors. Using formation energies of 14-element FCC alloys generated by a universal machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP), we benchmark three classes of models: (1) composition-based RK and ML models, (2) descriptor-based ML models, and (3) a combined ML-augmented RK approach (ML4RK). Leave-one-element-out tests highlight complementary strengths. RK models, class (1), remain the most data-efficient when binary information is available, while descriptor-based ML models, class (2), enable genuine zero-shot extrapolation to elements absent from the training set. By embedding elemental descriptors into the RK framework, the hybrid approach unifies these regimes and enables prediction of interaction parameters for otherwise unknown or data-scarce binaries, class (3). This work demonstrates a physically grounded and data-efficient route to extend CALPHAD models by combining the transferability of ML with the physical grounding, interpretability, data efficiency, and robustness of thermodynamic formalisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning、CALPHAD、universal machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP)、benchmark three classes of models。；研究对象：14元素FCC合金的热力学自由能建模，具体针对CALPHAD框架中Redlich-Kister相互作用系数的预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将机器学习与CALPHAD热力学形式结合，混合策略（ML4RK）既能利用RK模型的数据高效性（当二元信息可用时），又能实现描述符基ML模型对训练集中未出现元素的零样本外推能力，从而扩展CALPHAD模型对新化学体系的预测能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将机器学习与CALPHAD热力学形式结合，混合策略（ML4RK）既能利用RK模型的数据高效性（当二元信息可用时），又能实现描述符基ML模型对训练集中未出现元素的零样本外推能力，从而扩展CALPHAD模型对新化学体系的预测能力。；创新点：将物理启发的元素描述符嵌入RK框架，使混合模型能够预测未知或数据稀缺二元体系的相互作用参数，同时保留热力学形式学的物理基础、可解释性、数据效率和鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 使用通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）生成14元素FCC合金的形成能数据；对比三类模型：（1）基于成分的Redlich-Kister（RK）和ML模型；（2）基于物理描述符的ML模型；（3）混合ML增强RK方法（ML4RK）。采用留一元素测试（leave-one-element-out）评估模型性能。

papers.title: Polymer-Regulated Freezing of Water Droplets Revealed by Synchrotron X-ray Imaging and Raman Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Adding a polymer to a sessile water droplet not only lowers its freezing point but also suppresses the tip singularity that forms during its freezing on cold substrates. Here, we employ synchrotron X-ray and Raman imaging to elucidate the spatiotemporal mechanism underlying tip suppression in an aqueous polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) solution, a model polymer solution. As the polymer concentration increases, we observe slower propagation of the freezing front, reduced bubble entrapment, and a progressively more rounded apex across the volumes and molecular weights examined. X-ray tomography reveals that frozen PVA droplets retain low X-ray transmittance domains in their interiors and at the surface, and Raman spectral mapping confirms that these domains correspond to PVA-enriched regions, providing direct evidence of freeze-induced polymer segregation. These findings indicate that PVA is redistributed heterogeneously during water solidification rather than shifting bulk properties homogeneously, providing a spatially resolved framework for interpreting the observed tip blunting and the suppression of discrete bubble entrapment. Our work identifies freeze-induced polymer segregation as a pathway by which a dissolved polymer regulates both the external shape and the internal structure of a freezing droplet, and these findings shed light on potential applications in freezing-based processes such as freeze-casting and cryopreservation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“synchrotron X-ray imaging”、“Raman spectroscopy”、“X-ray tomography”、“Raman spectral mapping”等实验手段。；研究对象：聚合物（聚乙烯醇，PVA）水溶液液滴在冷基底上的冻结过程，特别是冻结过程中液滴尖端形态的演变及内部结构变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 冻结过程中，聚乙烯醇（PVA）会发生冻诱导的聚合物偏析，形成富PVA区域，从而抑制液滴尖端尖锐化并减少气泡俘获，进而调控液滴的外部形状和内部结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：冻结过程中，聚乙烯醇（PVA）会发生冻诱导的聚合物偏析，形成富PVA区域，从而抑制液滴尖端尖锐化并减少气泡俘获，进而调控液滴的外部形状和内部结构。；创新点：通过空间分辨的成像与光谱技术，直接揭示了冻诱导聚合物偏析是调控冻结液滴外部形态和内部结构的微观机制，而非简单地通过改变溶液整体性质来实现。
papers.method_zh: 同步辐射X射线成像、X射线断层扫描、拉曼光谱成像。

papers.title: Stationarity-constrained representative volume elements for image-based homogenization of granular microstructures
papers.abstract: We present an image-based workflow for Representative Elementary Volume (REV) sizing in chemically mapped granular microstructures. The REV is treated as a finite-window convergence scale within approximately stationary material domains, rather than as a global length assigned to a non-stationary image. Full-resolution backscattered-electron (BSE) gray-level maps are screened by local mean and standard-deviation compatibility to identify stationary domains. Candidate windows are sampled only inside these domains, and the representative support is selected using a persistent mean--spectral criterion requiring both the apparent-mean residual and the low-wavenumber covariance-spectrum residual to remain within tolerance over the non-reference tail. Ensemble reproducibility is used as an auxiliary check. Applied to seven full-resolution BSE images of dune-sand microstructures, the strict stationary-domain criterion gives $(L_{\rm REV}=1536~\mathrm{pixels})$, corresponding to $(\ell_{\rm REV}\approx2.01~\mathrm{mm})$ for a BSE pixel size of $(1.31~μ\mathrm{m})$. Property-level homogenization on QEMSCAN-derived numerical maps independently supports this millimetre-scale estimate: the converted support is $(L_{\rm REV}^{\rm prop}=201.2)$ pixels and is snapped to the nearest tested size, $(L_{\rm REV}^{\rm prop}=204)$ pixels $(\ell_{\rm REV}^{\rm prop}=2.04~\mathrm{mm})$. This length lies in the large-window regime of the apparent conductivity, stiffness, and directional Young-modulus curves. The workflow provides a reproducible route for REV sizing while making explicit its dependence on stationarity, image field, window sequence, and target observable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：image-based workflow、homogenization、numerical maps、REV sizing）；研究对象：颗粒微结构（dune-sand microstructures）的代表性体积单元（REV）尺寸确定问题，具体针对化学映射的颗粒材料图像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过严格平稳域筛选，得到REV尺寸为1536像素（约2.01 mm），与基于QEMSCAN数值图的性质均匀化估计（约2.04 mm）一致，该长度位于表观电导率、刚度和方向杨氏模量曲线的大窗口区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过严格平稳域筛选，得到REV尺寸为1536像素（约2.01 mm），与基于QEMSCAN数值图的性质均匀化估计（约2.04 mm）一致，该长度位于表观电导率、刚度和方向杨氏模量曲线的大窗口区域。；创新点：将REV视为有限窗口收敛尺度（而非全局长度），并明确其依赖于平稳性、图像视场、窗口序列和目标可观测量的选择。
papers.method_zh: 基于图像的REV尺寸确定工作流：利用局部均值和标准差兼容性筛选背散射电子（BSE）灰度图的平稳域；在平稳域内采样候选窗口，采用持久均值-谱准则（要求表观均值残差和低波数协方差谱残差在非参考尾部保持在容差内）选择代表性支撑；辅以系综可重复性检查。最后用QEMSCAN数值图进行性质均匀化验证。

papers.title: Interplay between Quantum Metric and Hybridized Collective Modes in Flat-Band Superfluids
papers.abstract: We investigate collective excitations in flat-band superfluids by incorporating the coupled dynamics of pairing (phase and amplitude) and density fluctuations. We demonstrate that for any time-reversal symmetric superfluid system with an isolated flat band, only a single low-energy collective mode emerges in the long-wavelength limit. In contrast to the linearly dispersive Goldstone mode in conventional superfluids, this hybridized mode is gapless at zero momentum but exhibits a quadratic dispersion ($ω\propto q^2$) at small momenta. Analytically, we reveal that the dispersion coefficient of this collective mode is governed by the normal-state quantum metric of the flat band. These analytical predictions are in excellent agreement with numerical calculations. Our results are universally applicable to any generic $s$-wave flat-band superfluid, provided the flat band is energetically well separated from other dispersive bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、demonstrate、reveal、analytical predictions、numerical calculations。；研究对象：平带超流体系中的集体激发，特别是配对（相位和振幅）与密度涨落的耦合动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在时间反演对称的孤立平带超流体系中，长波极限下仅存在一个低能集体模式，该模式在零动量处无能隙但具有二次色散（ω∝q²），其色散系数由正常态平带的量子度量（quantum metric）决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在时间反演对称的孤立平带超流体系中，长波极限下仅存在一个低能集体模式，该模式在零动量处无能隙但具有二次色散（ω∝q²），其色散系数由正常态平带的量子度量（quantum metric）决定。；创新点：首次揭示了平带超流中集体模式的二次色散行为与正常态量子度量之间的解析关系，并证明该模式是相位、振幅和密度涨落混合的单一低能模式，区别于传统超流中的线性色散Goldstone模。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算。具体包括：将配对涨落（相位和振幅）与密度涨落的耦合动力学纳入集体激发分析；通过解析推导揭示色散系数与量子度量的关系；并与数值计算结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Enhanced Spin-to-Charge Conversion in Bi2Se3/NiFe via Interface Engineering with a Ti Spacer Layer
papers.abstract: Topological insulators have attracted significant attention in spintronics due to their topological surface states and spin-momentum-locking-driven spin-to-charge conversion. Among these, Bi2Se3 has been extensively investigated because of its large bulk bandgap and single Dirac cone band structure. However, spin-to-charge conversion strongly depends on the quality of the topological insulator/ferromagnet interface. Here, we investigate spin-to-charge conversion in a sputter-deposited heterostructure comprising a topological insulator (Bi2Se3) and a ferromagnetic NiFe thin film separated by a titanium spacer layer. The Bi2Se3 layer is deposited on a silicon substrate for industrial compatibility. Pure spin current is injected into the Bi2Se3 layer through the titanium spacer via spin pumping induced by spin precession during microwave-driven ferromagnetic resonance of the ferromagnetic film. Spin pumping studies are performed by varying the Bi2Se3 thickness. The Gilbert damping parameter exhibits a significant 55% increase at a Bi2Se3 thickness of 4 nm, indicating a pure surface-state contribution. The spin Hall angle, which quantifies the spin-to-charge conversion efficiency, increases by an order of magnitude upon insertion of the titanium spacer layer. This enhancement is attributed to the suppression of interdiffusion between the Bi2Se3 and NiFe layers by titanium, thereby preserving the topological surface states. These findings highlight the important role of titanium spacer layers in spintronic devices based on topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“sputter-deposited”（溅射沉积）、“spin pumping studies”（自旋泵浦研究）、“microwave-driven ferromagnetic resonance”（微波驱动铁磁共振）等具体实验手段。；研究对象：Bi2Se3/NiFe 异质结，具体研究在两者之间插入钛（Ti）间隔层后，对自旋-电荷转换效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Bi2Se3 与 NiFe 之间插入 Ti 间隔层，可将自旋-电荷转换效率（自旋霍尔角）提升一个数量级。该增强归因于 Ti 层抑制了 Bi2Se3 与 NiFe 之间的元素互扩散，从而保护了拓扑表面态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Bi2Se3 与 NiFe 之间插入 Ti 间隔层，可将自旋-电荷转换效率（自旋霍尔角）提升一个数量级。该增强归因于 Ti 层抑制了 Bi2Se3 与 NiFe 之间的元素互扩散，从而保护了拓扑表面态。；创新点：通过引入 Ti 间隔层进行界面工程，有效解决了拓扑绝缘体/铁磁体界面互扩散导致拓扑表面态退化的问题，从而显著增强了自旋-电荷转换效率。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用溅射沉积法制备 Bi2Se3/NiFe 异质结，并在其中插入 Ti 间隔层。通过微波驱动的铁磁共振（FMR）技术激发 NiFe 层的自旋进动，利用自旋泵浦效应将纯自旋流注入 Bi2Se3 层。通过改变 Bi2Se3 厚度进行自旋泵浦研究，并测量 Gilbert 阻尼参数和自旋霍尔角。

papers.title: Hot carrier diffusion-assisted ideal carrier multiplication in monolayer MoSe2
papers.abstract: Carrier multiplication (CM), the process of generating multiple charge carriers from a single photon, offers an opportunity to exceed the Shockley-Queisser limit in photovoltaic applications. Despite extensive research, no material has yet achieved ideal CM efficiency, primarily owing to significant energy losses from carrier-lattice scattering. In this study, we demonstrate that monolayer MoSe2 can attain the theoretical maximum CM efficiency permitted by energy-momentum conservation principle, using ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy. By resolving the scatter-free ballistic transport of hot carriers and validating our findings with first-principles calculations, we identify the cornerstone of optimal CM in monolayer MoSe2: superior hot-carrier dynamics characterized by suppressed energy dissipation via minimized carrier-lattice scattering, and the availability of abundant CM pathways facilitated by 2Eg band nesting. Comparative analysis with bulk MoSe2 further emphasizes the enhanced CM efficiency in the monolayer, attributed by superior hot-carrier diffusion and access to additional CM pathways. These results position monolayer MoSe2 as a promising candidate for high-performance optoelectronic applications, providing a robust platform for next-generation energy conversion technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（判断依据：ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy、resolving scatter-free ballistic transport、comparative analysis with bulk MoSe2）；研究对象：单层MoSe₂中的热载流子扩散辅助的理想载流子倍增（carrier multiplication, CM）现象。

papers.title: Ground-state phase diagram of Rydberg atoms in a triangular-prism array
papers.abstract: We study the ground-state phase diagram of Rydberg atoms in a triangular-prism optical tweezer array using the density matrix renormalization group. By tuning the detuning-to-Rabi-frequency ratio and the Rydberg blockade radius, the system realizes several density-wave phases with spontaneous breaking of translational and leg-exchange symmetries. Unlike two-leg Rydberg ladders with $\mathbb{Z}_2$ leg-exchange symmetry, the triangular prism has $\mathbb{D}_3$ symmetry, leading to a richer set of ordered phases and transitions. For blockade radius moderately larger than the lattice spacing, a phase with alternating double and single Rydberg occupancy appears at large detuning. It breaks $\mathbb{Z}_2$ translational and $\mathbb{Z}_3$ rotational symmetry while preserving a rung reflection symmetry. Upon decreasing detuning, it melts through two Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transitions with an intermediate critical phase described by a $\mathbb{Z}_6$ clock model. At larger blockade radius, a phase with one Rydberg excitation per triangle and broken $\mathbb{D}_3$ symmetry appears through a first-order transition. When double occupation of neighboring triangles is suppressed, rung-trimerized density waves develop as detuning increases from the disordered phase. Their melting follows the same structure as in Rydberg chains and two-leg ladders: the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ case has Ising critical lines, while the $\mathbb{Z}_3$ and $\mathbb{Z}_4$ cases have chiral critical lines, with Potts and Ashkin-Teller points only on the corresponding commensurate lines. Inside the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ rung-trimerized phase, an entanglement-entropy peak signals a crossover regime with enhanced period-2 density modulation before a first-order transition into a $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{D}_3$ phase. Floating phases with incommensurate quasi-long-range order appear between trimerized states of different periods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）进行数值计算研究。；研究对象：三角棱柱光镊阵列中的里德伯原子系统，具体研究其基态相图。
