papers.title: A literature-grounded scientific reasoning framework for defect-engineered TiO$_{2}$ photocatalysts
papers.abstract: Defect-engineered TiO$_2$ photocatalysts are extensively investigated for photocatalytic hydrogen evolution; however, the highly heterogeneous nature of the literature, including inconsistent descriptors, diverse synthesis protocols, non-uniform activity metrics, and incomplete mechanistic reporting, limits the applicability of conventional machine-learning approaches based solely on statistical regression. Here, we present a literature-grounded large language model (LLM)-assisted scientific reasoning framework for defect-engineered TiO$_2$ photocatalysts integrating curated literature data, mechanistic rule extraction, and retrieval-augmented reasoning. A harmonized database was constructed from experimentally relevant publications specifically selected for hydrogen-evolution-related defect engineering in TiO$_2$, covering polymorph-dependent behavior, hydrogenation conditions, Ti$^{3+}$ defect states, oxygen vacancies, illumination conditions, and photocatalytic activity descriptors. In parallel, mechanistic evidence sentences and publications-defined scientific rules were encoded into a structured reasoning layer enabling explainable inference beyond black-box prediction. The resulting framework combines structured experimental descriptors, semantic literature retrieval, and mechanistic interpretation to generate confidence-aware recommendations for optimal defect-engineering conditions. For example, the AI agent identified a consistent optimal anatase hydrogenation window centered at ~500 $°$C under H$_2$-containing atmospheres for approximately 1 h, supported by mechanistic evidence linking balanced Ti$^{3+}$/oxygen-vacancy populations with enhanced photocatalytic hydrogen evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（文献数据整合 + 大语言模型辅助推理框架）。判断依据：摘要提及“curated literature data”“mechanistic rule extraction”“retrieval-augmented reasoning”，属于基于已有实验文献的数据库构建与AI推理方法，非纯实验或纯计算。；研究对象：缺陷工程化二氧化钛（TiO₂）光催化剂，具体涉及多晶型行为、氢化条件、Ti³⁺缺陷态、氧空位、光照条件及光催化活性描述符。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AI代理识别出一个最优的锐钛矿氢化窗口：在约500°C、含氢气氛下处理约1小时，该条件通过平衡Ti³⁺/氧空位种群增强光催化析氢性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AI代理识别出一个最优的锐钛矿氢化窗口：在约500°C、含氢气氛下处理约1小时，该条件通过平衡Ti³⁺/氧空位种群增强光催化析氢性能。；创新点：提出一种基于文献的、可解释的科学推理框架，克服了传统机器学习仅依赖统计回归的局限性，实现了超越黑箱预测的置信度感知推荐。

papers.title: Topological Surface States and Anisotropic Magnetotransport in SnSb$_6$Te$_{10}$
papers.abstract: We have investigated the electronic structure and magnetotransport properties of SnSb$_6$Te$_{10}$ single crystals using density functional theory (DFT), synchrotron-based angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and quantum transport measurements. Our DFT calculations reveal a clear spin-orbit coupling driven band inversion between the Sb-$p$ and Te-$p$ states together with a non-trivial $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological invariant. The calculated surface-state dispersion and hexagonally warped Fermi surface contours agree well with the ARPES measurements. Temperature-dependent transport measurements indicate dominant electron-phonon scattering, while Hall measurements confirm hole-type carriers with carrier density of the order of $10^{21}$ cm$^{-3}$. Both transverse and longitudinal magnetotransport exhibit weak antilocalization behavior, while Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations observed for $H \parallel c$ yield a Berry phase close to $π$, consistent with Dirac-like surface states. Furthermore, angle-dependent magnetotransport measurements reveal pronounced anisotropy associated with an anisotropic Fermi surface topology and mixed bulk-surface transport behavior. Our combined theoretical and experimental results establish SnSb$_6$Te$_{10}$ as a strong topological insulator and a promising platform for investigating topological transport phenomena in layered telluride systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据关键词：DFT calculations、ARPES、quantum transport measurements。；研究对象：层状碲化物单晶 SnSb₆Te₁₀ 的电子结构、拓扑表面态及磁输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SnSb₆Te₁₀ 是一种强拓扑绝缘体，具有自旋-轨道耦合驱动的能带反转、非平庸 Z₂ 拓扑不变量，以及狄拉克型表面态；其磁输运表现出弱反局域化效应和接近 π 的贝里相位，且具有显著的各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SnSb₆Te₁₀ 是一种强拓扑绝缘体，具有自旋-轨道耦合驱动的能带反转、非平庸 Z₂ 拓扑不变量，以及狄拉克型表面态；其磁输运表现出弱反局域化效应和接近 π 的贝里相位，且具有显著的各向异性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、基于同步辐射的角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）、变温输运测量、霍尔测量、横向与纵向磁输运测量、Shubnikov-de Haas 振荡分析、角度依赖磁输运测量。

papers.title: Wilson Holonomy and Spectral Monodromy in Spin-Orbit Rings: Effective Gauge Connections and Loop Observables
papers.abstract: A spin-orbit Hamiltonian with an effective gauge structure carries two distinct loop objects that are routinely conflated: an energy-independent Wilson holonomy, which organizes interference and internal spin transport, and an energy-dependent monodromy, which quantizes the spectrum. We show that cleanly separating these objects supplies a precise, computable bridge between the loop/holonomy representation of gauge theories and condensed-matter spin-orbit transport. The construction maps a spin-orbit Hamiltonian to an effective $U(1)$ plus internal non-Abelian connection, reduces it to a first-order transport problem, and reads physical predictions from holonomy, monodromy, curvature, and eigenphase data. Two rings make the separation explicit. For a Dirac (graphene) ring with Rashba coupling and Aharonov-Bohm flux, the total holonomy factorizes exactly into a commuting $U(1)$ flux phase times an internal spin/pseudospin holonomy, and the spectrum follows from a holonomy-eigenvalue condition. For a Rashba-Dresselhaus ring, the internal $SU(2)$ transport is genuinely non-Abelian away from the $α=\pmβ$ pure-gauge locus, where curvature controls path ordering; spectral quantization then requires an explicit first-order reduction obtained by phase-space doubling of the second-order Schrödinger problem. A non-Abelian Stokes formulation and Magnus expansion serve as ordering diagnostics rather than spectral tools. Spin-network ideas enter only as historical geometric motivation, not as a dynamical import into spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“construction maps”“reduces to a first-order transport problem”“reads physical predictions”等理论推导与形式化分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合环中的有效规范连接与环路可观测量，具体包括Dirac（石墨烯）环（含Rashba耦合与Aharonov-Bohm磁通）以及Rashba-Dresselhaus环。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道哈密顿量中能量无关的Wilson holonomy（规范环量）与能量依赖的谱单值性（monodromy）是两种不同的环路对象，将它们清晰分离可建立规范理论中环路/环量表示与凝聚态自旋-轨道输运之间的精确可计算桥梁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道哈密顿量中能量无关的Wilson holonomy（规范环量）与能量依赖的谱单值性（monodromy）是两种不同的环路对象，将它们清晰分离可建立规范理论中环路/环量表示与凝聚态自旋-轨道输运之间的精确可计算桥梁。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将自旋-轨道哈密顿量映射为有效U(1)加内部非阿贝尔联络，约化为一阶输运问题，利用holonomy、monodromy、曲率及本征相位数据提取物理预言。具体工具包括：holonomy本征值条件（用于Dirac环）、相空间加倍方法（用于Rashba-Dresselhaus环的非阿贝尔情形）、非阿贝尔Stokes公式与Magnus展开（作为排序诊断工具）。

papers.title: Electronic Hall viscosity: hidden indicator for antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: The antiferromagnets with negligible stray fields and ultrafast spin dynamics play a crucial role in the fields of energy-efficient spintronics and topological electronics. However, the detection and control of the underlying nontrivial Berry curvature become extremely limited by the vanishing magnetization and anomalous Hall conductivity. Here, we show the electronic Hall viscosity is closely related to the quadruple Berry curvature of Bloch bands and is bounded by the $d$-orbit factor modulated second moment of the quantum volume. Moreover, we derive the symmetry requirement for nonzero electronic Hall viscosity that could characterize antiferromagnetic ordering even when the linear anomalous Hall response gets forbidden. We further examine our key findings in two archetypal antiferromagnets: $d$-wave altermagnet $\mathrm{RuO}_{2}$, and noncollinear $\mathrm{Mn_{3}Sn}$ through direct first-principle calculations. Thus, our work reveals a new and fundamental quantum geometry quantity of generic antiferromagnets and offers a broadly applicable way to design antiferromagnetic spintronics devices via unconventional Hall viscosity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有第一性原理计算验证）。判断依据关键词：show、derive、examine、first-principle calculations。；研究对象：反铁磁体中的电子霍尔粘度（electronic Hall viscosity），具体以d波交变磁体RuO₂和非共线反铁磁体Mn₃Sn为范例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子霍尔粘度与布洛赫带的四极贝里曲率（quadruple Berry curvature）密切相关，并由d轨道因子调制的量子体积二阶矩所约束；该物理量可在线性反常霍尔响应被禁止的情况下表征反铁磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子霍尔粘度与布洛赫带的四极贝里曲率（quadruple Berry curvature）密切相关，并由d轨道因子调制的量子体积二阶矩所约束；该物理量可在线性反常霍尔响应被禁止的情况下表征反铁磁序。；创新点：揭示了电子霍尔粘度作为反铁磁体中一种新的、基础的量子几何量，并提出了利用非常规霍尔粘度设计反铁磁自旋电子学器件的普适方法。摘要未突出说明与已有霍尔粘度研究的具体差异。

papers.title: Locality-Induced Hierarchical Backflow Wavefunctions for Correlated Fermions
papers.abstract: We show that locality provides a natural principle to hierarchically organize backflow wavefunctions. This leads us to propose a family of variational fermionic states, termed hierarchical backflow (HB) wavefunctions. The expressive power of HB is systematically improvable, controlled by a path depth $K$ which reflects the range of backflow correlations. At half-filling, the HB with $K=1$ already achieves high energy precision, with an accuracy around $0.5\%$ for system sizes from $4\times 4$ to $10\times 10$. At hole doping $n_h=0.125$, the method scales efficiently to $12\times16$ and $16\times16$ systems, and the energy systematically achieves higher accuracy with $K$ increasing, yielding a clear stripe phase. The HB further enables a local-nonlocal decomposition, naturally bridging to neural quantum states, while featuring compact representations and efficient optimization. Our work reveals locality as a natural organizing principle of backflow wavefunctions, opening a new framework with systematic improvability and interpretability for large-scale simulations of correlated fermion systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：variational fermionic states、backflow wavefunctions、energy precision、stripe phase。；研究对象：关联费米子体系（correlated fermions），具体以半填充（half-filling）和空穴掺杂（hole doping）的晶格模型为测试对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出层级反流（HB）波函数，利用局域性自然组织反流关联，在系统尺寸从4×4到10×10的半填充体系中，K=1时能量精度已达约0.5%；在空穴掺杂n_h=0.125时，可高效扩展至12×16和16×16体系，并清晰得到条纹相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出层级反流（HB）波函数，利用局域性自然组织反流关联，在系统尺寸从4×4到10×10的半填充体系中，K=1时能量精度已达约0.5%；在空穴掺杂n_h=0.125时，可高效扩展至12×16和16×16体系，并清晰得到条纹相。；创新点：揭示局域性作为反流波函数的自然组织原则，构建了具有系统可改进性和可解释性的新框架，适用于大规模关联费米子模拟。
papers.method_zh: 提出层级反流（hierarchical backflow, HB）波函数族，通过路径深度K系统控制反流关联范围，实现可改进的变分波函数；并实现局域-非局域分解，与神经量子态自然衔接。

papers.title: Structure, Composition, and High-Field Superconductivity in Metal-Rich $\mathrmη$-Carbide-Type Compounds
papers.abstract: $\mathrmη$-Carbide-type compounds have recently emerged as a diverse class of materials in the study of superconductivity. These phases contribute to a growing family of metal-rich quantum materials that exhibit unusual superconducting properties emerging from complex metallic bonding. Several members of the $\mathrmη$-carbide-type phases have been found to be bulk superconductors -- such as Nb$_4$Rh$_2$C$_{1-δ}$, Ta$_4$Rh$_2$C$_{1-δ}$, Ti$_4$Ir$_2$O$_{1-δ}$, and Ti$_4$Co$_2$O$_{1-δ}$ -- with transition temperatures up to $T_{\rm c} \approx$ 10 K and upper critical fields as high as $μ_0 H_{\rm c2}(0) \approx$ 30 T. Whereas the transition temperatures may fall within the range typical for intermetallic superconductors, the pronounced violation of the weak-coupling Pauli limit in many of these crystallographically high-symmetry materials is noteworthy. Here, we review recent progress on superconducting $\mathrmη$-carbide-type phases, emphasizing how crystal symmetry, synthetic challenges, transition-metal composition, and electronic structure govern their superconducting properties. Furthermore, we outline open questions and future directions, including the possible discovery of new $\mathrmη$-carbide-type materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“review recent progress”“outline open questions and future directions”等表述。；研究对象：金属富集的η-碳化物型化合物（η-carbide-type compounds），具体包括Nb₄Rh₂C₁₋δ、Ta₄Rh₂C₁₋δ、Ti₄Ir₂O₁₋δ、Ti₄Co₂O₁₋δ等超导相，以及它们的高场超导性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: η-碳化物型化合物是一类新兴的金属富集量子材料，其超导转变温度可达约10 K，上临界场高达约30 T，且许多高对称性晶体材料显著违背弱耦合Pauli极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：η-碳化物型化合物是一类新兴的金属富集量子材料，其超导转变温度可达约10 K，上临界场高达约30 T，且许多高对称性晶体材料显著违背弱耦合Pauli极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该综述系统梳理了η-碳化物型超导相中晶体对称性、合成难度、组分与电子结构对超导性能的调控作用，并指出了未来可能发现新η-碳化物型材料的方向。
papers.method_zh: 综述性总结，未具体说明实验或计算方法。摘要提及通过晶体对称性、合成挑战、过渡金属组成和电子结构分析来理解超导性质，但未列出具体手段（如DFT、ARPES等）。

papers.title: High Resolution Study of the 2D ANNNI Model Using a Two-replica Cluster Algorithm and Population Annealing
papers.abstract: The axial next-nearest-neighbor Ising (ANNNI) model in two dimensions is studied using population annealing combined with a two-replica cluster algorithm. We are able to fully resolve the sequence of sharp specific heat peaks that characterize the finite-size incommensurate floating phase. We also show that the two-replica cluster algorithm is much more effective in equilibrating the system than either single-replica cluster methods or the Metropolis algorithm when these are combined with population annealing. We argue that effectiveness of the new algorithm is due to its ability to move groups of defect lines between replicas combined with resampling in population annealing, which removes replicas from the population that have larger numbers of defect lines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：population annealing、two-replica cluster algorithm、Monte Carlo模拟。；研究对象：二维轴向次近邻伊辛（ANNNI）模型，特别是其有限尺寸非公度浮动相中的比热峰序列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合双副本团簇算法与群体退火，成功完全分辨了二维ANNNI模型中表征有限尺寸非公度浮动相的尖锐比热峰序列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合双副本团簇算法与群体退火，成功完全分辨了二维ANNNI模型中表征有限尺寸非公度浮动相的尖锐比热峰序列。；创新点：双副本团簇算法能够在副本之间移动缺陷线组，结合群体退火中的重采样过程，有效移除含有较多缺陷线的副本，从而显著提高系统平衡效率。
papers.method_zh: 采用群体退火（population annealing）结合双副本团簇算法（two-replica cluster algorithm）进行蒙特卡洛模拟，并与单副本团簇方法及Metropolis算法进行对比。

papers.title: Three- and four-boson systems expanded around the unitarity limit: Application to $^4$He
papers.abstract: The three- and four-boson systems with a large scattering length and a short effective range in the two-body sector are studied in the framework of Short-Range Effective Field Theory. The starting point (leading order) of the EFT is taken to be the universal unitarity limit, where the two-body sector is parameter-free and only one three-body parameter enters. In this limit, physical systems manifests discrete scale invariance. Deviations from universality arising from finite scattering-length and effective-range corrections, as well as a four-body force required by renormalization, are included perturbatively at next-to-leading order. The three-body ground state and its associated four-body ground and first-excited states are studied using the Faddeev-Yakubovsky formalism and a complementary diagrammatic approach. By employing techniques to remove contributions from deep trimers in tetramer calculations, we extend our analysis to larger cutoffs than previously accessible within the FY approach. Our results for binding energies and radii of $^4$He three- and four-atom systems converge well to results obtained with sophisticated phenomenological potentials. These successes suggest that the physics of $^4$He atomic clusters is governed by only small deviations from discrete scale invariance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Short-Range Effective Field Theory”、“Faddeev-Yakubovsky formalism”、“diagrammatic approach”等理论框架和计算方法。；研究对象：三体和四体玻色子系统，具体以$^4$He原子团簇为应用对象，研究其在大散射长度、短有效力程条件下的束缚态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在幺正极限附近，通过微扰引入有限散射长度、有效力程修正以及四体力，可以很好地描述$^4$He三原子和四原子体系的结合能与半径，表明这些团簇的物理仅由离散尺度不变性的微小偏离所主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在幺正极限附近，通过微扰引入有限散射长度、有效力程修正以及四体力，可以很好地描述$^4$He三原子和四原子体系的结合能与半径，表明这些团簇的物理仅由离散尺度不变性的微小偏离所主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用短程有效场论（Short-Range EFT），以幺正极限为领头阶（无参数，仅需一个三体参数），在次领头阶微扰引入有限散射长度、有效力程修正及重整化所需的四体力。使用Faddeev-Yakubovsky形式论和互补的图解方法进行计算，并采用技术去除四体计算中深束缚三聚体的贡献，从而在更大截断下进行分析。

papers.title: Ultrafast formation of a large dynamic magnetic soliton
papers.abstract: Nonlinear magnetization dynamics offers a rich variety of phenomena ranging from bistability to chaos. Here, we report the ultrafast formation of a dynamic magnetic soliton in thin ferrimagnetic garnet films with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, driven by the microwave magnetic field of a microstrip antenna. Using time-resolved Brillouin light scattering microscopy and scanning transmission X-ray microscopy, we directly track the build-up of the large-angle precession state. The observed soliton is distinct from other nonlinear magnetic excitations in two key aspects: (i) it forms inside the linear spin-wave frequency band, and (ii) it is exceptionally large, reaching tens of microns beyond the antenna. We explain the soliton formation by the self-limiting mechanism upon a positive nonlinear frequency shift and the spatial extent of the near-field of the antenna. At large distances from the drive, the soliton collapses and emits short-wavelength spin waves via almost instantaneous spatial wavenumber conversion. Time-resolved measurements further reveal a small finite delay during soliton formation, while coherent long-range oscillations appear essentially simultaneously over distances up to 40 micrometers. These results establish microwave-driven solitons as a robust nonlinear phenomenon in thin-film garnets and suggest opportunities for fast, nonlocal manipulation of magnetic states and for applications in novel computational schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：time-resolved Brillouin light scattering microscopy, scanning transmission X-ray microscopy, 直接实验观测。；研究对象：具有垂直磁各向异性的铁磁性石榴石薄膜（thin ferrimagnetic garnet films）中，由微波磁场驱动的动态磁孤子（dynamic magnetic soliton）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁性石榴石薄膜中，通过微波驱动实现了超大尺寸（数十微米）动态磁孤子的超快形成，该孤子位于线性自旋波频带内，并通过正非线性频移的自限机制形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁性石榴石薄膜中，通过微波驱动实现了超大尺寸（数十微米）动态磁孤子的超快形成，该孤子位于线性自旋波频带内，并通过正非线性频移的自限机制形成。；创新点：该动态磁孤子区别于其他非线性磁激发：（i）在线性自旋波频带内形成；（ii）尺寸异常大（可达数十微米，远超天线尺寸）。摘要还揭示了孤子形成过程中的有限延迟、远距离（40微米）的相干振荡同步出现，以及孤子塌缩时通过瞬时波数转换发射短波长自旋波等新现象。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：时间分辨布里渊光散射显微镜（time-resolved Brillouin light scattering microscopy）和扫描透射X射线显微镜（scanning transmission X-ray microscopy），用于直接追踪大角度进动状态的建立过程；微波磁场由微带天线（microstrip antenna）提供。

papers.title: Quantum control of spin qubits using SOT-driven nanomagnets
papers.abstract: Spin rotation (SR) is an essential capability for realization of single and two-qubit gates in spin quantum computing (SQC) architectures. To perform SR, resonant AC magnetic fields are either generated by microwave current pulses fed to an antenna, or voltage pulses applied to a gate, in presence of an inhomogeneous Zeeman field. While the former approach is limited by gate-speed and site-selectivity of SR, the latter adds to the decoherence of the spin qubits. Here, we propose an alternative technique for driving high-speed SR without compromising the qubit coherence, by employing spin-orbit-torque (SOT)-driven nanomagnets to produce oscillating magnetic fields, locally at the qubit site. The proposed scheme is highly energy-efficient, scalable, and compatible with the CMOS fabrication technology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方案设计文章。判断依据：提出了一种替代技术（propose an alternative technique），未涉及具体实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：基于自旋量子比特（spin qubits）的量子计算架构，具体为利用自旋轨道矩（SOT）驱动的纳米磁体产生局域振荡磁场，以实现自旋旋转（SR）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出利用SOT驱动的纳米磁体在量子比特位置产生局域振荡磁场，可实现高速自旋旋转，同时避免传统方法中门速度受限或退相干加剧的问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出利用SOT驱动的纳米磁体在量子比特位置产生局域振荡磁场，可实现高速自旋旋转，同时避免传统方法中门速度受限或退相干加剧的问题。；创新点：提出一种无需牺牲量子比特相干性即可实现高速自旋旋转的新驱动方式，且该方案具有高能效、可扩展性以及与CMOS工艺兼容的优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案设计：基于自旋轨道矩（SOT）驱动纳米磁体产生交变磁场，替代传统的微波电流脉冲天线或电压脉冲栅极方法。

papers.title: Benchmark Dataset for Catalysis on 2D MXenes
papers.abstract: Merging first-principles calculations with machine learning (ML), we aim to accelerate the exploration of catalytic behaviour in novel materials. We focus on two-dimensional (2D) Ti$_2$CT$_y$ MXenes, whose versatile surface chemistry makes them particularly compelling candidates for catalysis. Resolving their composition and structure under realistic conditions exceeds the reach of standard density functional theory (DFT) due to computational cost. To address this challenge, we generate a comprehensive dataset of 50,000 DFT calculations for training and 10,000 for testing, encompassing both Ti$_2$CT$_y$ MXene configurations and molecular systems, along with an additional test dataset with 1000 genuinely new, larger systems to investigate how well models generalise. We train and validate widely used and competitive machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) models, including EquiformerV2, MACE, MatRIS, and UPET, that accurately predict atomic forces and formation energies -- quantities that DFT must repeatedly compute for structural and catalytic investigations -- for these 2D materials. This combined DFT-ML framework achieves computational acceleration on the order of approximately $1-4 \cdot 10^3$ (on a CPU) while maintaining desired-level accuracy (approximately +/- $10$ meV/A for forces and approximately +/- $1$ meV for per-atom energies), paving the way for more efficient investigations of MXene catalytic behaviour. Moreover, we perform an extensive qualitative evaluation of the trained models, showcasing the importance of comprehensive simulation-based comparison beyond benchmark metrics. The dataset and the trained models with the code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/CatalystAnonymous/catalyst_mxenes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles calculations, machine learning, DFT calculations, machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) models）；研究对象：二维Ti₂CT_y MXene材料的催化行为，及其表面化学构型与分子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合密度泛函理论（DFT）与机器学习（ML），构建了包含5万训练集和1万测试集的大规模DFT数据集，训练了多种机器学习原子间势（MLIP）模型，实现了对Ti₂CT_y MXene原子力和形成能的高精度预测，计算加速比达约10³倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合密度泛函理论（DFT）与机器学习（ML），构建了包含5万训练集和1万测试集的大规模DFT数据集，训练了多种机器学习原子间势（MLIP）模型，实现了对Ti₂CT_y MXene原子力和形成能的高精度预测，计算加速比达约10³倍。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算生成数据集；机器学习原子间势（MLIP）模型包括EquiformerV2、MACE、MatRIS、UPET；额外构建1000个全新更大体系测试泛化能力；在CPU上进行计算加速评估。

papers.title: Pre-failure response spectra predict finite-amplitude fragility
papers.abstract: Failure theories often identify a single leading route to failure: the most unstable mode, weakest link, minimum-action escape path, or optimal perturbation. Yet finite-amplitude susceptibility depends not only on the nearest route but on how much of perturbation space lies near dangerous directions. We cast this distinction as a fragility problem: for each perturbation direction, the failure distance is the smallest amplitude that crosses a prescribed boundary, and the fragility curve is the fraction of directions that fail below a given amplitude. Measuring this curve directly requires nonlinear trials over many directions; instead, we show that it is predicted, before any failure occurs, by the tail of a single pre-failure quantity: the boundary-normalized fragility gain computed from the linearized response. The breadth of the associated response spectrum sets how many near-dangerous pathways coexist beyond the strongest direction. We demonstrate the mechanism in a high-dimensional nonlinear non-normal network with the strongest directional gain held fixed: the system with broader response-channel breadth has a larger nonlinear fragility curve, isolating breadth from the worst direction. An independent scalar test in deterministic traffic breakdown confirms the predicted sign: response breadth lowers calibrated jam thresholds once the strongest response is matched, with residual margins screening but never reversing the effect. Response-spectrum breadth thus emerges as a pre-failure coordinate for finite-amplitude fragility beyond the strongest path.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论理论框架（failure theories, fragility problem, linearized response），并通过数值模型（high-dimensional nonlinear non-normal network）和标量测试（deterministic traffic breakdown）进行验证，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的是复杂系统（如高维非线性非正常网络、确定性交通流）在有限振幅扰动下的失效（failure）或失稳（fragility）问题。核心物理现象是系统对非最危险方向扰动的敏感性，即“脆弱性”（fragility）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，系统在失效前的线性化响应谱的宽度（response-spectrum breadth）可以预测其在有限振幅扰动下的脆弱性曲线。即使最危险方向（最强响应）被固定，更宽的响应谱意味着有更多接近危险的方向共存，从而导致系统在更小的扰动振幅下更容易失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，系统在失效前的线性化响应谱的宽度（response-spectrum breadth）可以预测其在有限振幅扰动下的脆弱性曲线。即使最危险方向（最强响应）被固定，更宽的响应谱意味着有更多接近危险的方向共存，从而导致系统在更小的扰动振幅下更容易失效。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比，但其核心创新在于：传统失效理论通常只关注单一最危险路径（如最不稳定模态、最弱链接），而该工作揭示了系统对有限振幅扰动的整体脆弱性不仅取决于最危险方向，还取决于“有多少扰动方向接近危险方向”。作者通过引入“响应谱宽度”这一预失效坐标，成功预测了这种超越最危险路径的脆弱性。

papers.title: Catalytic precursor dissociation in Hot-Wire CVD and comparing a-Si:H growth under continuous and pulsed silane flow conditions
papers.abstract: Hot-wire Chemical vapor deposition (HWCVD) of hydrogenated amorphous silicon (a-Si:H) thin films utilizes the dissociation of silane (SiH4) precursor over heated tungsten or tantalum filaments (\geq 1600 °C). In this work, assuming catalytic dissociation mechanism, we present kinetic model for SiH4 dissociation and the resulting a-Si:H film growth. Our model calculations showed that for an identical dose of the introduced SiH4 precursor, a-Si:H thickness was considerably higher for the pulsed SiH4 flow as compared to the continuous SiH4 flow. The pulsed SiH4 flow is represented by time intervals t_ON and t_OFF, where the SiH4 flow rate (F_(SiH_4)) is at the set-point and zero, respectively. In agreement with our model calculations for an introduced 75 cm^3 (STP) SiH4 dose, the resulting a-Si:H film thickness was 175 \pm 5 nm under continuous precursor flow, whereas it considerably increased to 425 \pm 8 nm when this SiH4 dose was split into 15 shorter pulses (t_ON =15s ; t_OFF = 60s). Moreover, these a-Si:H films deposited using pulsed SiH4 flow exhibited improved electrical properties, with a dark conductivity ({σ_d}) of 1.1 \times 10^-11 S/cm and a photoconductivity ({σ_ph}) of \sim 5.8 \times 10^-5 S/cm, compared to films deposited under continuous SiH4 flow (σ_d \sim 2.5 \times 10^-10 S/cm and σ_ph \sim 3.5 \times 10^-6 S/cm).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：kinetic model（动力学模型）、model calculations（模型计算）、experimental agreement（实验符合）。；研究对象：氢化非晶硅（a-Si:H）薄膜在热丝化学气相沉积（HWCVD）中的生长，特别是硅烷（SiH₄）前驱体在连续流与脉冲流条件下的催化解离过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相同SiH₄总剂量下，脉冲气流（t_ON=15s, t_OFF=60s）沉积的a-Si:H薄膜厚度（425±8 nm）显著高于连续气流（175±5 nm），且脉冲沉积薄膜的暗电导率更低（1.1×10⁻¹¹ S/cm vs. 2.5×10⁻¹⁰ S/cm）、光电导率更高（~5.8×10⁻⁵ S/cm vs. ~3.5×10⁻⁶ S/cm），表明电学性能更优。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相同SiH₄总剂量下，脉冲气流（t_ON=15s, t_OFF=60s）沉积的a-Si:H薄膜厚度（425±8 nm）显著高于连续气流（175±5 nm），且脉冲沉积薄膜的暗电导率更低（1.1×10⁻¹¹ S/cm vs. 2.5×10⁻¹⁰ S/cm）、光电导率更高（~5.8×10⁻⁵ S/cm vs. ~3.5×10⁻⁶ S/cm），表明电学性能更优。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于催化解离机制建立SiH₄解离及a-Si:H薄膜生长的动力学模型；实验上采用热丝CVD（钨或钽灯丝，≥1600°C），对比连续SiH₄气流与脉冲气流（设定t_ON和t_OFF时间间隔）下的薄膜沉积，并测量薄膜厚度及电学性能（暗电导率σ_d、光电导率σ_ph）。

papers.title: Compressibility and High-Pressure Structure of CaMg$_2$Bi$_2$ and YbMg$_2$Bi$_2$
papers.abstract: Compounds with the formula $AM_2X_2$ in the CaAl$_2$Si$_2$ structure type have garnered increasing interest across various solid-state research domains, such as quantum topological and thermoelectric materials. Prior studies have identified high-pressure phase transitions in several compounds, including Mg$_3$Sb$_2$, Mg$_3$Bi$_2$, CaMn$_2$Bi$_2$, and SrAl$_2$Si$_2$. In this study, we investigate the structural behavior of CaMg$_2$Bi$_2$ and YbMg$_2$Bi$_2$ under varying pressure conditions. We synthesized crystals using the molten metal flux method and examined them through single-crystal synchrotron X-ray diffraction, employing diamond anvil cells to exert pressures up to 20 GPa. Our analysis reveals insights into the anisotropic compressibility of these materials, highlighting the more compressible and flexible octahedral $A$-Bi bonds as the primary contributors to this anisotropy. Moreover, we observed a phase transition in both CaMg$_2$Bi$_2$ and YbMg$_2$Bi$_2$ at pressures above 9.6 GPa and 8.7 GPa, respectively. The newly identified high-pressure phase exhibits a distortion of the original CaAl$_2$Si$_2$ structure with space group $C2/m$. This high-pressure structure is distinct from that of related compounds (e.g., CaMn$_2$Bi$_2$, MgMg$_2$Bi$_2$), the latter exhibiting a square pyramidal coordination for the $M$ site.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“synthesized crystals”、“single-crystal synchrotron X-ray diffraction”、“diamond anvil cells”等实验手段。；研究对象：CaMg₂Bi₂ 和 YbMg₂Bi₂ 两种 CaAl₂Si₂ 结构类型的化合物，重点研究其高压下的结构行为与相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超过 9.6 GPa（CaMg₂Bi₂）和 8.7 GPa（YbMg₂Bi₂）时，两种材料均发生结构相变，新高压相为空间群 C2/m 的畸变 CaAl₂Si₂ 结构，且各向异性压缩主要由八面体 A-Bi 键的柔性贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超过 9.6 GPa（CaMg₂Bi₂）和 8.7 GPa（YbMg₂Bi₂）时，两种材料均发生结构相变，新高压相为空间群 C2/m 的畸变 CaAl₂Si₂ 结构，且各向异性压缩主要由八面体 A-Bi 键的柔性贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用熔融金属助熔剂法合成单晶，利用金刚石对顶砧（DAC）施加最高 20 GPa 的压力，通过同步辐射单晶 X 射线衍射进行结构表征与分析。

papers.title: Autonomous scanning electrochemical cell microscopy enables rapid exploration of large compositionally complex material spaces
papers.abstract: Alloying is a central strategy in electrocatalysis, enabling fine-tuning of electronic structure. In particular, compositionally complex solid solutions (CCSS) often called high-entropy alloys are of high interest as they allow active site design. However, the "combinatorial explosion" in the number of possible compositions poses a critical bottleneck for the discovery of active CCSS electrocatalysts. We present an autonomous scanning electrochemical cell microscopy (SECCM) system for ultrahigh-throughput and large-scale CCSS activity screening. The platform rapidly establishes composition-electrocatalytic activity relationships for large compositional spaces across multiple thin-film CCSS materials libraries via active learning and automated library exchange. Embedding analytical expressions of voltammetry in the algorithm enables the learning of whole voltammograms rather than a single selected metric. As a demonstration, we investigated hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) activities of Au-Ir-Rh, where Ir and Rh exhibit strong metal-hydrogen binding and Au exhibits relatively weak binding as derived from the HER volcano plot. The composition-activity trend was accurately predicted after measuring only 15% of all 966 measurement areas. Au30Ir20Rh50 and Au10Ir35Rh55 exhibit highest activities with standard rate constants of about 0.012 cm/s, demonstrating positive synergistic contributions from elemental mixing. The autonomous robotic SECCM platform is broadly applicable to a wide range of electrocatalytic reactions, providing a general pathway for accelerating CCSS electrocatalyst discovery and optimization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：autonomous scanning electrochemical cell microscopy (SECCM)、active learning、automated library exchange。；研究对象：成分复杂固溶体（CCSS，即高熵合金）电催化剂，具体为Au-Ir-Rh三元合金薄膜材料库。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自主SECCM平台仅测量全部966个测量点中的15%，即可准确预测Au-Ir-Rh体系的成分-活性趋势，并发现Au30Ir20Rh50和Au10Ir35Rh55具有最高析氢反应活性（标准速率常数约0.012 cm/s），表明元素混合存在正协同效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自主SECCM平台仅测量全部966个测量点中的15%，即可准确预测Au-Ir-Rh体系的成分-活性趋势，并发现Au30Ir20Rh50和Au10Ir35Rh55具有最高析氢反应活性（标准速率常数约0.012 cm/s），表明元素混合存在正协同效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 自主扫描电化学池显微镜（SECCM）结合主动学习算法与自动化样品库交换系统；算法中嵌入伏安法的解析表达式以学习完整伏安曲线而非单一指标；采用析氢反应（HER）作为模型反应进行活性筛选。

papers.title: Low-Temperature Suppression of Intertwined Orders in La$_{1/3}$Sr$_{2/3}$FeO$_{3}$ Thin Films
papers.abstract: The strong coupling between spin, charge, and lattice degrees of freedom in perovskite oxides leads to an array of exotic phenomena, giving these materials rich phase diagrams that can include coupled orders. This is exemplified by the A-site doped ferrite La$_{1/3}$Sr$_{2/3}$FeO$_{3}$ (LSFO), which exhibits a coupled paramagnetic-antiferromagnetic and charge ordering phase transition at $\sim$190 K that has been well studied in thin films, bulk, and polycrystalline samples. However, the low temperature behavior of LSFO thin films below $\sim$100 K has not been thoroughly explored. This work uses several X-ray scattering and spectroscopy techniques to directly probe LSFO's magnetic and charge order down to low temperature. Using resonant X-ray scattering, we observe a complete suppression of LSFO's known antiferromagnetic and charge order below $\sim$25 K. Further spectroscopy and coherent scattering measurements provide insight into LSFO's electronic structure and domain dynamics in this new low temperature phase, and we propose possible explanations for the observed order suppression based on reduced dimensionality of domains in our thin films. Our findings provide insight into the effects of competing interactions in strongly correlated materials, particularly those with coupled orders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：X-ray scattering, spectroscopy techniques, resonant X-ray scattering, coherent scattering measurements。；研究对象：A位掺杂铁氧体La₁/₃Sr₂/₃FeO₃（LSFO）薄膜在低温（<100 K）下的磁有序与电荷有序行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在约25 K以下，LSFO薄膜中已知的反铁磁有序和电荷有序被完全抑制，进入一个低温新相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在约25 K以下，LSFO薄膜中已知的反铁磁有序和电荷有序被完全抑制，进入一个低温新相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 共振X射线散射（resonant X-ray scattering）、X射线光谱学（spectroscopy）、相干散射测量（coherent scattering measurements）。

papers.title: Energy spectra and cascade in the spin turbulence of a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate
papers.abstract: We investigate the spin-interaction energy spectrum of spin turbulence in a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate. Continuous spin driving of a spin-1 condensate produces a nonequilibrium steady state with spatially fluctuating magnetization. We observe a power-law scaling consistent with the $-7/3$ exponent predicted for spin-wave turbulence, which persists across our full range of drive strengths despite substantial changes in the spectral anisotropy. After switching off the drive, we track the free-decay evolution and find evidence consistent with a direct cascade of spin-interaction energy toward higher wavenumbers. These results establish an energy-spectral hallmark of spin turbulence and enable quantitative studies of cascade dynamics in spinor superfluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate、spin driving、observe power-law scaling、track free-decay evolution）；研究对象：自旋-1玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的自旋湍流现象，特别是驱动条件下自旋相互作用的能量谱与级联动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在驱动自旋-1玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中，观测到自旋相互作用能量谱呈现与自旋波湍流理论预测的-7/3幂律标度，且该标度在驱动强度变化时保持稳定；关闭驱动后，观测到自旋相互作用能量向高波数直接级联的证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在驱动自旋-1玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中，观测到自旋相互作用能量谱呈现与自旋波湍流理论预测的-7/3幂律标度，且该标度在驱动强度变化时保持稳定；关闭驱动后，观测到自旋相互作用能量向高波数直接级联的证据。；创新点：首次在自旋湍流中建立了能量谱的标度特征（-7/3幂律），并实现了自旋超流体中级联动力学的定量研究。
papers.method_zh: 连续自旋驱动制备非平衡稳态，通过空间涨落磁化测量获取自旋相互作用能量谱，并分析驱动关闭后的自由衰减演化过程。

papers.title: Thermodynamic origin of medium-entropy stabilization in multicomponent rock-salt oxides
papers.abstract: High entropy oxides are commonly associated with high configurational entropy ($ΔS_{conf}\geq$ 1.61R) corresponding to five equimolar cations occupying a crystallographic sublattice. However, recent experimental observations indicate that medium-entropy compositions may also exhibit entropy-stabilized rock-salt phases, raising an important question regarding the minimum entropy required for phase stabilization. In this work, we employ a first-principles thermodynamic framework to investigate the stability of rock-salt oxides containing two to five principal cations components analogous to (Ni$_{0.8}$Cu$_{0.2}$)O, (Ni$_{0.6}$Cu$_{0.2}$Zn$_{0.2}$)O, (Ni$_{0.4}$Cu$_{0.2}$Zn$_{0.2}$Co$_{0.2}$)O, (Ni$_{0.2}$Cu$_{0.2}$Zn$_{0.2}$Co$_{0.2}$Mg$_{0.2}$)O. Density functional theory, MCSQS-based structural modeling, and finite-temperature Gibbs free-energy analysis are combined to quantify the roles of enthalpy mixing ($ΔH_{mix}$), configurational ($ΔS_{conf}$), vibrational ($ΔS_{vib}$), and electronic contributions towards ($ΔS_{elec}$) entropy change in governing phase stability. The results show that $ΔS_{conf}$ alone is not a universal descriptor of phase stability. While the two-cation system is enthalpy-stabilized but three-, four- and five-cation systems become thermodynamically stable at high-temperature due to entropy-driven reduction of the Gibbs free energy. These findings demonstrate that single-phase rock-salt oxides are not restricted to the conventional high-entropy limit and that medium-entropy compositions can also be stabilized under suitable thermodynamic conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要中明确使用了“first-principles thermodynamic framework”“Density functional theory, MCSQS-based structural modeling, and finite-temperature Gibbs free-energy analysis”等关键词。；研究对象：多主元岩盐结构氧化物（含2至5种阳离子组分，如(Ni₀.₈Cu₀.₂)O、(Ni₀.₆Cu₀.₂Zn₀.₂)O、(Ni₀.₄Cu₀.₂Zn₀.₂Co₀.₂)O、(Ni₀.₂Cu₀.₂Zn₀.₂Co₀.₂Mg₀.₂)O）的相稳定性，特别是中熵组分的热力学稳定化机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构型熵（ΔS_conf）并非描述相稳定性的普适指标；二元阳离子体系为焓稳定，而三元、四元和五元阳离子体系在高温下因熵驱动吉布斯自由能降低而热力学稳定。中熵组分（非传统高熵极限）在合适热力学条件下也可形成单相岩盐结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构型熵（ΔS_conf）并非描述相稳定性的普适指标；二元阳离子体系为焓稳定，而三元、四元和五元阳离子体系在高温下因熵驱动吉布斯自由能降低而热力学稳定。中熵组分（非传统高熵极限）在合适热力学条件下也可形成单相岩盐结构。；创新点：揭示了中熵组分（而非仅高熵组分）也能实现熵稳定岩盐相，挑战了传统认为需ΔS_conf≥1.61R（对应五等摩尔阳离子）的高熵稳定判据。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理热力学框架，结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、基于蒙特卡洛特殊准随机结构（MCSQS）的结构建模，以及有限温度吉布斯自由能分析，定量计算混合焓（ΔH_mix）、构型熵（ΔS_conf）、振动熵（ΔS_vib）和电子熵（ΔS_elec）对相稳定性的贡献。

papers.title: Edge Detection Framework Utilizing SOT-MTJ Bit-Cell Arrays
papers.abstract: Traditional edge detection algorithms, foundational to computer vision, face significant challenges in energy efficiency and processing latency on conventional CMOS-based hardware. Existing algorithms, such as Canny, are computationally expensive, posing challenges in resource-constrained hardware where energy efficiency and low latency are critical. This study introduces a novel, hardware-efficient algorithm that leverages the intrinsic characteristics of magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ) devices. We present a detailed device-level analysis of an MTJ-based system for edge detection, outlining its operational cycles, including write, read, and reset methods. The algorithm's efficacy is evaluated against the standard Canny edge detection method. We provide a quantitative performance analysis, including metrics such as energy consumption and latency, which demonstrates that our proposed spintronics-based approach offers a promising solution for achieving low-power, high-speed image processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验/硬件设计文章。判断依据：摘要提及“device-level analysis”“operational cycles, including write, read, and reset methods”以及“quantitative performance analysis, including metrics such as energy consumption and latency”。；研究对象：基于自旋转移矩-磁隧道结（SOT-MTJ）位单元阵列的边缘检测硬件系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种利用MTJ器件固有特性的新型硬件高效边缘检测算法，相比传统Canny算法，在能量消耗和延迟方面具有显著优势，可实现低功耗、高速图像处理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种利用MTJ器件固有特性的新型硬件高效边缘检测算法，相比传统Canny算法，在能量消耗和延迟方面具有显著优势，可实现低功耗、高速图像处理。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 器件级分析与性能评估：对基于MTJ的系统进行写入、读取和复位操作循环分析，并与标准Canny边缘检测方法进行定量性能对比（包括能耗和延迟指标）。

papers.title: Impact of Cu-Mn ratio on Structure and Defects in Layered Multiferroic Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3
papers.abstract: Multiferroic materials exhibit the coexistence of magnetic and ferroelectric order, enabling control of magnetism through electric fields and vice versa. These properties make them attractive for spintronic and memory device applications. Recent studies on Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3 (0.04 \leq x \leq 0.26; 0.03 \leq y \leq 0.15) have revealed strong magnetoelectric coupling, with variations in Mn-to-Cu concentration leading to variations in optical, electronic, and magnetic responses. Despite these findings, the influence of nanoscale structure and defects on the observed properties remains poorly understood. In this study, we investigate the structure and nanoscale defects in Cu-deficient Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3 (Cu:Mn ratio <1, i.e., with 0.04 \leq x \leq 0.26 and 0.03 \leq y \leq 0.15) and Cu-rich Cu1+xMn1-ySiTe3 (Cu:Mn ratio >1, i.e., with 0.04 \leq x \leq 0.3 and 0.13 \leq y \leq 0.31) crystals using scanning/transmission electron microscopy and single-crystal X-ray diffraction. Cu-deficient crystals exhibit extensive stacking faults correlated with chemical inhomogeneity between Mn and Cu, along with variations in Te stacking. In contrast, Cu-rich crystals show fewer stacking faults but contain other local structural variations, such as needle-shaped precipitates and loop-like features. These distinct local structural features between Cu-rich and Cu-deficient crystals can be correlated to variations in their observed properties. Complementary density functional theory calculations confirm that the Cu-rich structure is more polar than the Cu-deficient structure. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive understanding of how subtle changes in chemistry influence the nanoscale structure, defect distribution, and functional properties in Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3, offering guidance for designing multiferroic materials with tailored performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，计算为辅）。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了扫描/透射电子显微镜和单晶X射线衍射等实验手段，并辅以密度泛函理论计算。；研究对象：层状多铁材料Cu₁₋ₓMn₁₊ᵧSiTe₃（及其富铜变体Cu₁₊ₓMn₁₋ᵧSiTe₃）中，Cu-Mn比例变化对纳米尺度结构和缺陷的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cu-Mn比例的不同（富铜 vs. 缺铜）会导致截然不同的纳米尺度缺陷结构：缺铜晶体中存在大量与化学不均匀性相关的堆垛层错，而富铜晶体中堆垛层错较少，但出现针状析出物和环状特征等局部结构变化。这些差异与材料宏观性能的变化相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cu-Mn比例的不同（富铜 vs. 缺铜）会导致截然不同的纳米尺度缺陷结构：缺铜晶体中存在大量与化学不均匀性相关的堆垛层错，而富铜晶体中堆垛层错较少，但出现针状析出物和环状特征等局部结构变化。这些差异与材料宏观性能的变化相关。；创新点：该工作首次系统揭示了Cu₁₋ₓMn₁₊ᵧSiTe₃中，由Cu-Mn比例微小变化引起的纳米尺度结构和缺陷分布的巨大差异，并将这些微观结构特征与宏观性能变化关联起来，为理解该体系的多铁性能提供了结构层面的新见解。摘要未突出说明与以往研究相比的具体理论或方法创新。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验手段**：扫描/透射电子显微镜、单晶X射线衍射。

papers.title: Optically programmable and erasable cryogenic flash memory on an undoped Si/SiGe heterostructure
papers.abstract: Scalable cryogenic memory is a critical yet unresolved requirement for large-scale quantum computing architectures, particularly for computing-in-memory schemes. We exploit the interplay between optical excitation and gate bias in an undoped Si/SiGe heterojunction field-effect transistor (HFET) to realize non-volatile memory functionality. The device exploits a high interface trap density ($D_{it} > 1.6 \times 10^{12}$~eV$^{-1}$cm$^{-2}$), which, in conjunction with the oxide thickness and dielectric constant, enables effective "locking" of the threshold voltage to the applied gate bias over a wide voltage range. Two of these states can be selected for binary operation, while the availability of multiple stable states within the same device enables multibit data storage. Robust cycling endurance ($>~10^3$ cycles) and long-term state retention ($>~10^4$~s) of the memory states at 1.5 K confirm the suitability of this approach for integration into Si/SiGe-based quantum computing architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了器件结构（undoped Si/SiGe HFET）、实验测量（cycling endurance, state retention）以及具体性能参数（1.5 K下的测试结果）。；研究对象：基于未掺杂Si/SiGe异质结的场效应晶体管（HFET）中，利用光激发和栅极偏压的协同作用实现的可编程、可擦除非易失性低温闪存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用未掺杂Si/SiGe异质结场效应晶体管中高密度的界面陷阱态，结合光激发与栅极偏压的协同作用，成功实现了可在1.5 K低温下稳定工作的非易失性存储功能，具备二进制和多比特数据存储能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用未掺杂Si/SiGe异质结场效应晶体管中高密度的界面陷阱态，结合光激发与栅极偏压的协同作用，成功实现了可在1.5 K低温下稳定工作的非易失性存储功能，具备二进制和多比特数据存储能力。；创新点：提出并实验验证了一种在未掺杂Si/SiGe异质结上实现低温非易失性闪存的新方案，该方案利用高界面陷阱密度（$D_{it} > 1.6 \times 10^{12}$ eV$^{-1}$cm$^{-2}$）和光-电协同作用，避免了传统掺杂工艺的复杂性，并展示了多比特存储潜力，为可扩展的低温存储和量子计算存内计算架构提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法。具体为：制备未掺杂的Si/SiGe异质结场效应晶体管（HFET），通过施加光激发和栅极偏压来调控界面陷阱态的电荷状态，从而锁定阈值电压。在1.5 K低温下测试了器件的循环耐久性（>10^3次）和状态保持时间（>10^4秒）。

papers.title: Wasserstein-2 gradient flows and the geometry of entropy production in classical and quantum stochastic thermodynamics
papers.abstract: The second law does more than set the direction of thermodynamic evolution: it endows nonequilibrium transformations with an underlying geometry. In this work, we provide a unified geometric description of entropy production in classical and quantum thermodynamics based on Wasserstein-2 structures arising from gradient flows of free energy. We review how relaxation to equilibrium, in overdamped diffusions, discrete detailed-balanced Markov chains, and dissipative Lindblad dynamics, can be formulated as a gradient flow on the space of states. The associated Wasserstein-2 distance bounds entropy production, yielding a finite-time refinement of the second law. We extend this framework beyond purely dissipative dynamics by introducing generalized Wasserstein-2 metrics that incorporate conservative (Hamiltonian) dynamics in both classical inertial systems and open quantum systems, yielding intrinsic distances that exactly characterize minimal entropy production under fixed dissipative mobilities. We establish equivalence bounds between purely dissipative and Hamiltonian-dissipative geometries, explicitly quantifying how inertial or coherent dynamics can reduce dissipation. Finally, when restricted to equilibrium distributions, we recover the thermodynamic length of linear response-including the quantum thermodynamic length-thereby linking optimal transport, thermodynamic length, and counterdiabatic protocols within a single geometric framework. All in all, our results extend the Riemannian program of thermodynamics further from equilibrium and provide a geometric foundation for optimal protocols beyond the overdamped setting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：gradient flows, geometric description, Riemannian program of thermodynamics。；研究对象：经典和量子随机热力学中熵产生的几何结构，具体包括过阻尼扩散、离散细致平衡马尔可夫链、耗散林德布拉德动力学、经典惯性系统以及开放量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于自由能梯度流产生的Wasserstein-2结构，为经典和量子热力学中的熵产生提供了统一的几何描述，并建立了纯耗散几何与哈密顿-耗散几何之间的等价界限，从而量化惯性或相干动力学如何减少耗散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于自由能梯度流产生的Wasserstein-2结构，为经典和量子热力学中的熵产生提供了统一的几何描述，并建立了纯耗散几何与哈密顿-耗散几何之间的等价界限，从而量化惯性或相干动力学如何减少耗散。；创新点：将热力学的黎曼几何纲领从纯耗散（过阻尼）情形推广到包含惯性或相干动力学的更一般情形，建立了经典与量子系统中熵产生的最小化与最优传输、热力学长度及反绝热协议之间的统一几何联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用Wasserstein-2度量框架，将弛豫到平衡的过程（过阻尼扩散、细致平衡马尔可夫链、耗散林德布拉德动力学）表述为状态空间上的梯度流；通过引入广义Wasserstein-2度量将保守（哈密顿）动力学纳入该框架，并推导出纯耗散与哈密顿-耗散几何之间的等价关系。

papers.title: Magnon bandstructure and topology in a periodically deformed Kagome lattice with DM interaction
papers.abstract: We study the band structure and topology of magnons for a Heisenberg model with DM interaction on a deformed Kagome lattice. For simplicity, we focus on a periodically deformed lattice with hexagonal symmetry and an enlarged unit cell. This enlarged unit cell gives rise to a richer band structure than in the undeformed case. Analyzing band topology, there is a distinction between the topologically trivial case with anti-ferromagnetic coupling and the topologically rich case with ferromagnetic coupling. In the anti-ferromagnetic case, a spin-space symmetry, also present in the classical ground state, enforces these topologically trivial states. In the ferromagnetic case, this symmetry is spontaneously broken by the classical ground state. Consequently, the band structure also hosts rich topological features. Specifically, we observe many topological transitions and bands with Chern numbers ranging from $+2$ to $-2$, which makes the system richer than in the undeformed case. This emergent rich topological structure demonstrates that deformed magnets can host new and exciting physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study、analyzing、band topology、Chern numbers）；研究对象：周期性变形的Kagome晶格中具有DM相互作用的Heisenberg模型的磁振子能带结构与拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁耦合情况下，经典基态自发破缺自旋空间对称性，导致能带出现丰富的拓扑特征，包括多次拓扑相变以及陈数从+2到-2的能带，比未变形Kagome晶格更丰富。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁耦合情况下，经典基态自发破缺自旋空间对称性，导致能带出现丰富的拓扑特征，包括多次拓扑相变以及陈数从+2到-2的能带，比未变形Kagome晶格更丰富。；创新点：通过周期性晶格变形引入扩大原胞，使磁振子能带结构比未变形情况更丰富，并揭示了反铁磁与铁磁耦合下拓扑性质的本质区别（自旋空间对称性的存在与否）。摘要未突出说明与实验或具体材料的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于Heisenberg模型与DM相互作用，对具有六方对称性和扩大原胞的周期性变形Kagome晶格进行能带结构与拓扑性质计算。

papers.title: A Visible-Frequency Excitonic Reststrahlen Band in (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ Slabs
papers.abstract: Layered halide perovskites host exceptionally strong excitons, whose optical signatures are usually interpreted as absorptive resonances on a smooth dielectric background. Strong excitons, however, can also reshape the dielectric response itself and drive the real permittivity negative, opening a reflective band: the visible, excitonic analogue of an infrared Reststrahlen band. Whether bare (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs reach this regime has remained unclear. Here we show that low-temperature transmission of (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs, driven by the intralayer-exciton manifold, evolves with increasing thickness from an excitonic dip into a broad near-zero-transmission interval with compressed Fabry-Pérot-like fringes. Transfer-matrix analysis with an effective Lorentz-oscillator dielectric response reproduces this crossover, reconstructs a finite negative-Re($\varepsilon$) window, and implies near-ultrastrong exciton-photon coupling. Calculated field maps show suppressed in-plane field penetration within this interval and a driven longitudinal response near the high-energy ($\varepsilon=0$) edge. These results identify (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs as a cavity-free visible-frequency excitonic Reststrahlen material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论分析）。判断依据：关键词“low-temperature transmission”、“transfer-matrix analysis”、“calculated field maps”，表明主要基于透射实验数据，并结合传输矩阵模拟与场图计算进行解释。；研究对象：(PEA)₂PbI₄ 薄片中的激子介电响应及其导致的可见光波段激子型Reststrahlen带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: (PEA)₂PbI₄ 薄片在低温下，随着厚度增加，其透射谱从激子吸收谷演变为一个宽的低透射区间（伴随压缩的法布里-珀罗条纹），表明材料在该波段实现了负实部介电常数，从而形成无腔的可见光激子型Reststrahlen带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：(PEA)₂PbI₄ 薄片在低温下，随着厚度增加，其透射谱从激子吸收谷演变为一个宽的低透射区间（伴随压缩的法布里-珀罗条纹），表明材料在该波段实现了负实部介电常数，从而形成无腔的可见光激子型Reststrahlen带。；创新点：首次在无光学腔的裸(PEA)₂PbI₄薄片中实现可见光波段的激子型Reststrahlen带，并揭示其源于层内激子流形驱动的负介电常数窗口，暗示近超强激子-光子耦合。
papers.method_zh: 低温透射光谱测量；基于有效洛伦兹振子介电响应的传输矩阵分析；计算电场分布图以分析场穿透与纵向响应。

papers.title: Manifold Diffusion for Structure Generation of Transition Metal Complexes
papers.abstract: Transition metal complexes are central to catalysis, drug design, and materials science, with relevant properties strongly sensitive to their three-dimensional geometry. However, the electronic diversity and unconventional bonding environments of transition metal complexes pose a major challenge for accurate structure generation. In this work, we introduce TMCgen, a manifold diffusion machine learning model that efficiently and accurately generates geometries of transition metal complexes. By formulating the diffusion process over the metal-ligand coordination angles, combined with torsional and rotational diffusion of the ligands, TMCgen focuses on the key geometric degrees of freedom of transition metal complexes. TMCgen shows strong performance in generating accurate coordination environments on a diverse set of experimentally derived bioinorganic and organometallic complexes while requiring only few inference steps, enabling efficient generation. Our results demonstrate the potential of manifold-based generative modeling for data-efficient geometry generation, paving the way for property-conditioned design of transition metal complexes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：manifold diffusion machine learning model、generative modeling、geometry generation。；研究对象：过渡金属配合物的三维几何结构生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于流形扩散的机器学习模型TMCgen，能够高效且准确地生成过渡金属配合物的几何构型，尤其擅长生成准确的配位环境，且仅需少量推理步骤。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于流形扩散的机器学习模型TMCgen，能够高效且准确地生成过渡金属配合物的几何构型，尤其擅长生成准确的配位环境，且仅需少量推理步骤。；创新点：将生成建模的扩散过程限制在配位角流形上，而非全原子坐标空间，从而高效捕捉过渡金属配合物的关键几何自由度，实现了数据高效的几何生成。摘要未突出说明与已有生成模型（如等变扩散模型）的直接性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 流形扩散机器学习模型（manifold diffusion model）。具体将扩散过程定义在金属-配体配位角流形上，并结合配体的扭转和旋转扩散，聚焦于过渡金属配合物的关键几何自由度。

papers.title: Impact of Disorder Dynamics and Multi-Domain Kinetics on the Sliding Ferroelectricity of CVD-Grown 3R-WSe2 Bilayers
papers.abstract: Sliding ferroelectricity in van der Waals (vdW) layered systems has emerged as a promising route toward non-volatile nanoscale devices, where interlayer displacement in non-centrosymmetric bilayers generates an out-of-plane polarization. In particular, 3R-stacked bilayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) grown via chemical vapor deposition (CVD) have been shown to host such polarization due to broken inversion symmetry. However, a detailed investigation of the 2D ferroelectric (FE) properties of CVD-grown 2D films, particularly the role of intrinsic disorder, such as structural defects and domain structure, remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the FE switching characteristics of CVD-grown 3R-stacked WSe2 using a graphene-based ferroelectric field-effect transistor (graphene-FE-FET) architecture, where graphene serves as a highly sensitive probe of induced charge modulation due to polarization switching of FEs. We show that the growth-induced structural disorder significantly impacts polarization switching, while multi-domain kinetics governs the evolution of the FE response. These findings provide important insights into the design and optimization of FE devices based on vdW materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用“graphene-based ferroelectric field-effect transistor (graphene-FE-FET) architecture”进行实验测量，并分析了实验结果。；研究对象：化学气相沉积（CVD）生长的3R堆叠双层WSe₂中的滑动铁电性，特别是生长诱导的结构无序和多畴动力学对铁电开关特性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 生长诱导的结构无序会显著影响极化开关行为，而多畴动力学则主导了铁电响应的演化过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：生长诱导的结构无序会显著影响极化开关行为，而多畴动力学则主导了铁电响应的演化过程。；创新点：首次详细研究了CVD生长的二维薄膜（特别是3R-WSe₂）中，本征无序（如结构缺陷和畴结构）对滑动铁电性的具体影响，揭示了无序动力学和多畴动力学在其中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于石墨烯的铁电场效应晶体管（graphene-FE-FET）结构，利用石墨烯作为高灵敏度探针，探测由铁电体极化开关引起的电荷调制。

papers.title: Supersymmetric quantum criticality with discrete symmetry
papers.abstract: Supersymmetry, originally proposed in high-energy physics, can emerge as a remarkable low-energy structure in condensed matter systems. While emergent supersymmetry at quantum critical points is widely discussed in models with continuous symmetries, real materials are constrained by microscopic discrete symmetries. To address this, we investigate (2+1)-dimensional Gross-Neveu-Yukawa theories coupling Dirac fermions to a complex order parameter with discrete $Z_n$ anisotropy. Using the functional renormalization group, we find that for $n>3$, the anisotropic perturbations are irrelevant at the fixed point, yielding a $\mathcal{N}=2$ Wess-Zumino supersymmetric critical point. In the ordered phase, this dangerously irrelevant anisotropy gives rise to a second characteristic length scale, $ξ'$, alongside the usual correlation length, $ξ$. By tracking mass thresholds along symmetry-broken renormalization group trajectories, we extract the exponents $ν'$ and $ν$ without imposing prior scaling assumptions. For the $Z_4$, $Z_5$, and $Z_6$ models, our results support the scaling relation $ν'/ν= 1+|y_n|/p$ with $p=2$ in the isotropic framework used here.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional renormalization group（泛函重整化群）、理论模型分析。；研究对象：具有离散 $Z_n$ 各向异性的 (2+1) 维 Gross-Neveu-Yukawa 理论，该理论耦合了狄拉克费米子与复序参量，旨在研究凝聚态体系中受微观离散对称性约束的量子临界点处的超对称涌现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于 $n>3$ 的 $Z_n$ 各向异性，微扰在固定点处是无关的，从而产生一个 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 的 Wess-Zumino 超对称临界点。在有序相中，这种危险无关的各向异性导致出现第二个特征长度尺度 $\xi'$，并且对于 $Z_4$、$Z_5$ 和 $Z_6$ 模型，计算结果支持标度关系 $\nu'/\nu= 1+|y_n|/p$（其中 $p=2$）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于 $n>3$ 的 $Z_n$ 各向异性，微扰在固定点处是无关的，从而产生一个 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 的 Wess-Zumino 超对称临界点。在有序相中，这种危险无关的各向异性导致出现第二个特征长度尺度 $\xi'$，并且对于 $Z_4$、$Z_5$ 和 $Z_6$ 模型，计算结果支持标度关系 $\nu'/\nu= 1+|y_n|/p$（其中 $p=2$）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用泛函重整化群（functional renormalization group）方法进行理论分析，通过追踪对称性破缺的重整化群轨迹上的质量阈值来提取临界指数 $\nu'$ 和 $\nu$。

papers.title: Sliding contact creates universal self-affine fractal surfaces
papers.abstract: Surface roughness evolves during sliding, a process known as run-in, and the resulting topography controls friction, leakage, and failure from machines to geological faults. Yet the physical rule selecting this state remains unclear. We show that metals, rocks, and glasses develop universal self-similar roughness at short wavelengths, while retaining a material-dependent roll-off. A two-process model explains this behavior: junction formation and rupture drive universal roughening, whereas larger-scale deformation and/or fracture limit its growth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及对“金属、岩石和玻璃”的实验观察（“We show that...”），并提出了一个“两过程模型”（“A two-process model explains...”）进行理论解释。；研究对象：滑动接触过程中表面粗糙度的演化（run-in过程），具体材料包括金属、岩石和玻璃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 滑动接触会在短波长范围内产生普适的自相似粗糙表面，而在大尺度上则保留材料依赖的滚降（roll-off）特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：滑动接触会在短波长范围内产生普适的自相似粗糙表面，而在大尺度上则保留材料依赖的滚降（roll-off）特征。；创新点：揭示了滑动接触中表面粗糙度演化的普适物理规律，即短波长下的自仿射分形特征与材料无关，并提出了一个统一的物理模型来解释这一现象。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段或计算方法。仅提及通过观察多种材料（金属、岩石、玻璃）的表面形貌得出结论，并提出了一个“两过程模型”：连接点形成与断裂驱动普适粗糙化，而大尺度变形和/或断裂限制其增长。

papers.title: Non-Hermiticity-induced chirality imbalance of Weyl Landau levels
papers.abstract: Weyl semimetals obey a global chirality constraint: the net chiral topological charge and any associated chiral spectral flow must vanish, as required by the Nielsen-Ninomiya theorem. Under magnetic fields, this constraint manifests through counter-propagating zeroth Landau levels associated with Weyl nodes of opposite chirality. Here, we experimentally demonstrate how non-Hermiticity can reshape this balance in a synthetic photonic Weyl semimetal. Using engineered gauge fields in one-dimensional multilayer structures, we realize both homogeneous and axial magnetic fields and directly probe the resulting Landau-level spectra. While a homogeneous field produces the expected chirality-balanced zeroth Landau levels, an axial field spatially separates the compensating chiral channels: co-propagating bulk pseudo-Landau levels carry one chirality, whereas the opposite chirality resides in boundary-localized surface states. We show that radiative boundary loss selectively suppresses these surface states, removing them from the long-lived observable spectrum and producing an experimentally accessible chirality imbalance. By reducing boundary loss, we recover the hidden chiral channel and reveal its surface-state origin. These results show that non-Hermiticity, present naturally in photonics, can control and relax fundamental chirality constraints in topological systems, enabling access to otherwise forbidden spectral responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally demonstrate”、“directly probe”、“realize”等实验关键词，并描述了在合成光子外尔半金属中的具体实验实现。；研究对象：非厄米性对外尔半金属中手性平衡的调控，具体研究在合成光子外尔半金属中，通过人工规范场实现均匀磁场和轴向磁场，观察外尔朗道能级的手性分布变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米性（辐射边界损耗）可以选择性地抑制轴向磁场中边界局域的表面态，从而打破外尔半金属中零级朗道能级的手性平衡，产生可观测的手性不平衡；通过减少边界损耗可以恢复隐藏的手性通道并揭示其表面态起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米性（辐射边界损耗）可以选择性地抑制轴向磁场中边界局域的表面态，从而打破外尔半金属中零级朗道能级的手性平衡，产生可观测的手性不平衡；通过减少边界损耗可以恢复隐藏的手性通道并揭示其表面态起源。；创新点：首次实验证明非厄米性可以调控并放松拓扑系统中基本的手性约束（尼尔森-二宫定理），使得原本被禁止的手性不平衡光谱响应变得可观测。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用一维多层层状结构构建合成光子外尔半金属，通过工程化人工规范场实现均匀磁场和轴向磁场，直接探测朗道能级谱；利用辐射边界损耗作为非厄米性来源，选择性抑制表面态。

papers.title: Semiflexible Ring Polymers on Active Motor Beds: Nonequilibrium Dynamics and Conformations
papers.abstract: A semiflexible ring polymer on a motor-protein bed exhibits activity- and processivity-dependent rotational and conformational dynamics that are not captured by linear-chain behavior. Using coarse-grained Langevin simulations with bending elasticity, excluded-volume interactions, and stochastic motor attachment, stepping, and detachment, we vary activity (Peclet number), motor processivity, and chain stiffness to map the nonequilibrium response. The mean-squared displacement shows crossover dynamics, with semiflexible rings displaying subdiffusive-to-diffusive behavior at low activity and an intermediate ballistic regime at higher activity, while increasing flexibility shifts the short-time response toward a Rouse-like limit. Diameter autocorrelations exhibit damped oscillations associated with coherent rotation; the rotational frequency increases with activity and processivity, whereas the decorrelation time is non-monotonic at high processivity. Fourier mode analysis identifies competition between the radius (k=0) and elliptic (k=2) modes as the origin of the non-monotonic asphericity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：coarse-grained Langevin simulations（粗粒化朗之万模拟）。；研究对象：置于马达蛋白基底上的半柔性环形聚合物，研究其非平衡动力学与构象行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 半柔性环形聚合物在活性马达蛋白基底上展现出依赖于活性和持续性的旋转与构象动力学，这些行为无法由线性链行为描述；傅里叶模式分析揭示半径模式（k=0）与椭圆模式（k=2）之间的竞争是导致非单调非球性的起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：半柔性环形聚合物在活性马达蛋白基底上展现出依赖于活性和持续性的旋转与构象动力学，这些行为无法由线性链行为描述；傅里叶模式分析揭示半径模式（k=0）与椭圆模式（k=2）之间的竞争是导致非单调非球性的起源。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用粗粒化朗之万模拟，包含弯曲弹性、排除体积相互作用以及随机马达附着、步进和脱离过程。通过改变活性（佩克莱数）、马达持续性和链刚度来映射非平衡响应。

papers.title: Noncollinear spin textures and 90° domain walls in twisted XY magnets
papers.abstract: Twisted moiré magnets are promising in exploring noncollinear magnetic phases, yet current experimental studies have been restricted to uniaxial magnets, limiting the accessible phase space. Here, we demonstrate noncollinear moiré magnetism based on XY magnet CrCl3. The tunneling magnetoconductance of twisted CrCl3 exhibits multiple field-driven transitions in small-twist-angle devices, attributed to the coexisting antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic domains with distinct susceptibilities. The inferred spin configuration depends on the layer number, reflecting the interlayer coupling strength between twisted layers. This moiré magnetism is remarkably robust, persisting up to twisted double nine-layer stacks. Combined with micromagnetic simulations, we identify the ground state as the predicted "twisted-s" phase featuring 90° domain walls. Finally, we demonstrate voltage control of these noncollinear phases, highlighting the electrically tunable twist-spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：tunneling magnetoconductance、micromagnetic simulations、experimental studies、devices）；研究对象：基于XY磁体CrCl3的扭转莫尔磁体中的非共线自旋织构与90°畴壁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭转CrCl3小角度器件中观测到多场驱动转变，归因于反铁磁与铁磁畴共存；基态为预测的“twisted-s”相，具有90°畴壁，且该莫尔磁性可稳定存在于多达扭转双层九层堆叠中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭转CrCl3小角度器件中观测到多场驱动转变，归因于反铁磁与铁磁畴共存；基态为预测的“twisted-s”相，具有90°畴壁，且该莫尔磁性可稳定存在于多达扭转双层九层堆叠中。；创新点：将扭转莫尔磁体的实验研究从单轴磁体拓展至XY磁体（CrCl3），揭示了层数依赖的自旋构型与层间耦合强度的关系，并实现了对非共线相的电学调控。
papers.method_zh: 隧穿磁导测量（tunneling magnetoconductance）、微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）、电压调控实验。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium glassy arrest and discontinuous transitions at avoided quantum critical points
papers.abstract: The non-equilibrium dynamics of an order parameter confined by an external constraint field are investigated within a spatially extended Belitz-Kirkpatrick-Vojta framework. A generic non-monotonic dissipation peak arises at avoided criticality due to the interplay between macroscopic free-energy flattening and microscopic disorder-induced trapping. Near this regime, suppressed deterministic forces enhance activated trapping, leading to an effective violation of the fluctuation-dissipation theorem and ultimate glassy arrest. At higher fields, the system undergoes a discontinuous phase transition that bypasses this flat free-energy region. These explicit analytical scalings establish a generic mechanism for non-equilibrium arrest in disordered condensed matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“Belitz-Kirkpatrick-Vojta框架”、“解析标度关系”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：受外部约束场限制的有序参量的非平衡动力学，具体涉及无序凝聚态物质中在回避量子临界点附近的玻璃态阻滞与不连续相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在回避临界点附近，由于宏观自由能平坦化与微观无序诱导的陷阱效应之间的相互作用，系统会产生一个普适的非单调耗散峰，并最终导致玻璃态阻滞；在更高场下，系统通过一个不连续相变绕过该平坦自由能区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在回避临界点附近，由于宏观自由能平坦化与微观无序诱导的陷阱效应之间的相互作用，系统会产生一个普适的非单调耗散峰，并最终导致玻璃态阻滞；在更高场下，系统通过一个不连续相变绕过该平坦自由能区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用空间扩展的Belitz-Kirkpatrick-Vojta理论框架，通过解析标度分析研究有序参量的非平衡动力学行为。

papers.title: Velocity Resetting of Inertial Run-and-Tumble Particles in Non-Newtonian Media: Velocity Distribution, Diffusion and First-Passage Time
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of an athermal inertial run-and-tumble particle moving through a non-Newtonian medium in $d=1$, where the particle's velocity $v$ is reset to zero at a constant rate $r$. The drag force from the non-Newtonian medium is represented by a nonlinear velocity-dependent function $g(v)$. The run-and-tumble dynamics is modeled by a symmetric dichotomous noise with strength $Σ$ and flipping rate $λ$. We begin with the Fokker-Planck (FP) equation for the velocity distribution $P(v,t)$ of the particle. In the presence of resetting, however, the FP equation does not yield a closed-form solution even in the steady state. We therefore compute the steady-state velocity distribution $P_s(v)$ directly from particle trajectories and compare it with the numerical solution of the FP equation, finding good agreement between the two approaches. For sufficiently large $r$, $P_s(v)$ shows a cusp-like singularity at $v=0$ and the particles display diffusive motion at long times. The effective diffusion coefficient $D_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decays as $r^{-2}$ in the large-$r$ regime. These results hold irrespective of the specific form of $g(v)$ and the values of $λ$ and $Σ$. However, the mean first-passage time exhibits a strong dependence on the nature of the medium as the resetting rate $r$ is varied. In shear-thickening media, there exists an optimal resetting rate that minimizes the time required to reach the target velocity $v_t$. In contrast, no such optimal resetting rate is observed in shear-thinning media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Fokker-Planck方程、数值解、粒子轨迹分析。；研究对象：在非牛顿介质中运动的惯性跑-停粒子（inertial run-and-tumble particle），其速度以恒定速率重置为零，介质阻力由非线性速度依赖函数g(v)描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当重置速率足够大时，稳态速度分布在v=0处出现尖点奇异性，粒子在长时间下表现为扩散运动，有效扩散系数随重置速率增大按r^{-2}衰减；在剪切增稠介质中存在最优重置速率使首次通过时间最小化，而剪切稀化介质中则无此现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当重置速率足够大时，稳态速度分布在v=0处出现尖点奇异性，粒子在长时间下表现为扩散运动，有效扩散系数随重置速率增大按r^{-2}衰减；在剪切增稠介质中存在最优重置速率使首次通过时间最小化，而剪切稀化介质中则无此现象。；创新点：首次在非牛顿介质中引入速度重置机制，并系统研究了重置速率对速度分布、扩散系数及首次通过时间的影响，揭示了介质流变性质（剪切增稠/剪切稀化）对最优重置速率存在性的决定性作用。
papers.method_zh: 从Fokker-Planck方程出发推导速度分布，但稳态下无法得到闭合解；转而直接通过粒子轨迹计算稳态速度分布，并与Fokker-Planck方程的数值解进行对比验证。

papers.title: Giant Thermal-Conductivity Enhancement from Pseudo-Angular Momentum Conservation
papers.abstract: Pseudo-angular momentum (PAM) underlies optical selection rules for chiral phonons, but whether it also constrains thermally populated finite-q phonon-phonon scattering has remained unresolved. We show that rotational or screw eigenphase conservation imposes a PAM residue rule on cubic anharmonic vertices, revealing a hidden selection rule for heat transport. In screw-symmetric helical Te, an exact platform, implementing this rule as a projector in first-principles Boltzmann transport leaves spectra and force constants unchanged but removes roughly two thirds of kinematically allowed triplets, suppresses resistive Umklapp relaxation, and enhances lattice thermal conductivity by a factor of 5.30 at 300 K, remaining above fivefold up to 400 K. A bulk chiral-crystal benchmark further shows that explicit eigenphase organization can increase the calculated lattice thermal conductivity by about 24%, comparable to the reported first-principles underestimation of experiment. These results establish PAM conservation as an anharmonic selection principle for chiral-phonon heat transport and identify symmetry-resolved PAM conservation as a route to predicting and controlling thermal conductivity in chiral crystals and nanoscale phononics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles Boltzmann transport”、“projector”、“calculated lattice thermal conductivity”。；研究对象：手性声子热输运中的赝角动量（PAM）守恒对晶格热导率的调控，具体材料为具有螺旋对称性的碲（Te）以及一种块体手性晶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 赝角动量守恒在三次非谐声子-声子散射顶点中施加了一个隐藏的选择定则，通过抑制电阻性Umklapp弛豫，可将碲在300 K下的晶格热导率提升5.30倍，且在400 K下仍保持五倍以上增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：赝角动量守恒在三次非谐声子-声子散射顶点中施加了一个隐藏的选择定则，通过抑制电阻性Umklapp弛豫，可将碲在300 K下的晶格热导率提升5.30倍，且在400 K下仍保持五倍以上增强。；创新点：首次将赝角动量守恒确立为手性声子热输运的非谐选择定则，并展示了对称性分辨的赝角动量守恒可作为预测和调控手性晶体及纳米尺度声子学中热导率的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理玻尔兹曼输运方程，将赝角动量残差规则作为投影算子（projector）施加于声子散射过程，同时保持声子谱和力常数不变。

papers.title: Synthesis of single-layered fluorographdiyne nanosheets via selective on-surface 2D covalent polymerization
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional conjugated polymers (2DCPs) are significant macromolecular materials with intriguing and tunable physicochemical properties that depend on their geometries. Graphdiyne and its derivatives are exemplary 2DCPs featuring sp-sp2 hybridized skeletons. However, achieving single-layered, large-domain/regular graphdiyne and its derivatives on surfaces remains a formidable challenge due to the lack of selective 2D covalent polymerization methods. Here, we report a selective on-surface 2D covalent polymerization method via the combination of cobalt catalysis and coronene templating, achieving the synthesis of single-layered fluorographdiyne nanosheets up to 60*60 nm2 on Au(111) surface. Using scanning probe techniques, we visualize the sequential polymerization process and characterize cobalt-activated coupling intermediates at the atomic level. Experimental and theoretical analyses suggest that strong d-π coupling between cobalt and alkynyl transforms a robust Csp-Au bond into a weaker Csp2-Au bond, thereby facilitating the demetallization C-C coupling. Besides, the templating effect of coronene suppresses kinetically trapped defects and improves the selectivity of hexagonal-ring formation in the complex 2D covalent polymerization process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：synthesis, scanning probe techniques, visualization, experimental and theoretical analyses）；研究对象：单层氟化石墨炔纳米片（fluorographdiyne nanosheets），一种具有sp-sp2杂化骨架的二维共轭聚合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合钴催化与晕苯模板效应，实现了在Au(111)表面合成尺寸达60×60 nm²的单层氟化石墨炔纳米片，并揭示了钴与炔基之间的强d-π耦合如何促进脱金属C-C偶联反应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合钴催化与晕苯模板效应，实现了在Au(111)表面合成尺寸达60×60 nm²的单层氟化石墨炔纳米片，并揭示了钴与炔基之间的强d-π耦合如何促进脱金属C-C偶联反应。；创新点：提出了一种选择性表面二维共价聚合方法，解决了长期以来缺乏选择性聚合手段导致难以获得单层、大畴/规整石墨炔及其衍生物的难题；通过钴催化与晕苯模板协同作用，实现了对复杂二维共价聚合过程中动力学陷阱的抑制和六元环形成选择性的提升。
papers.method_zh: 扫描探针技术（用于可视化聚合过程及表征钴活化偶联中间体）、实验与理论分析（用于解释d-π耦合机制及模板效应）。

papers.title: The Uhlmann phase of Higher-Order Topological Insulators at Finite Temperature
papers.abstract: We have studied the finite-temperature topology of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs) based on the Uhlmann phase, which is a phase angle of the Uhlmann overlap. As an example of HOTIs, the Hamiltonian of the Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes (BBH) model is constructed from Gamma matrices satisfying the Clifford algebra. This specific algebraic structure underpins the model's higher-order topological properties, including the quantization of the Uhlmann phase to $0$ or $π$. This quantization enables us to treat the abrupt jumps of the Uhlmann phase as an indication of the nontrivial topological phase of the BBH model at finite temperature. From the disappearance of these jumps, we determine the critical temperature at which the topological transition occurs. For a special choice of parameters, the Uhlmann overlap and the critical temperature can be computed analytically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“基于Uhlmann相位”进行理论研究，并涉及解析计算。；研究对象：高阶拓扑绝缘体（HOTIs）在有限温度下的拓扑性质，具体以Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes（BBH）模型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BBH模型中的Uhlmann相位在有限温度下仍可量子化为0或π，其突变可作为非平庸拓扑相的标志；通过突变消失可确定拓扑相变的临界温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BBH模型中的Uhlmann相位在有限温度下仍可量子化为0或π，其突变可作为非平庸拓扑相的标志；通过突变消失可确定拓扑相变的临界温度。；创新点：将Uhlmann相位方法推广到高阶拓扑绝缘体的有限温度拓扑分析，并利用其量子化行为识别有限温度下的拓扑相变。
papers.method_zh: 基于Uhlmann相位的理论框架，利用满足Clifford代数的Gamma矩阵构造BBH模型的哈密顿量，并解析计算特定参数下的Uhlmann重叠及临界温度。

papers.title: Complexity of tensor network simulation for noisy quantum circuits
papers.abstract: We aim to rigorously address how local noise affects classical simulability of quantum dynamics benchmarked by tensor-network methods. Using operator entanglement entropy (OEE), we prove the following: (1) For single-qubit depolarizing noise on arbitrary circuits, tensor networks with $\mathrm{poly}(n)$ bond dimension suffice for fixed absolute Hilbert-Schmidt error after $\order{1}$ depth, while relative error demands $\order{\log n}$ depth; and this bound is optimal. (2) For single-qubit depolarizing noise on 1D local circuits, the existence of whole-trajectory error-bounded matrix product operator (MPO) of $\mathrm{poly}(n)$ bond dimension at all depths. (3) For general single-qubit noise in 1D brickwall circuits, random two-design gates with contraction coefficient $c<1/3$ yield an $\order{1}$ OEE plateau with probability $1-Te^{-Ω(n)}$, while arbitrary gates with $c<1/48$ give $\order{\log n}$ OEE in the worst case. (4) In higher dimensions, these bounds yield uniform-in-depth $\mathrm{poly}(n)$ average boundary-bond dimensions for projected entangled pair operators~(PEPO) across every cut -- under depolarizing noise at either absolute or relative accuracy, and under general noise with strong contraction at absolute accuracy. Our results establish a rigorous connection between certain noise models, circuit types, and their classical simulability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：prove（证明）、bounds（界限）、rigorously address（严格处理）。；研究对象：噪声量子电路在张量网络模拟中的经典可模拟性，具体研究单量子比特退极化噪声对电路动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在特定噪声模型和电路结构下，张量网络方法能以多项式大小的键维数（poly(n) bond dimension）实现经典模拟，并给出了深度与误差类型（绝对误差/相对误差）之间的最优界限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在特定噪声模型和电路结构下，张量网络方法能以多项式大小的键维数（poly(n) bond dimension）实现经典模拟，并给出了深度与误差类型（绝对误差/相对误差）之间的最优界限。；创新点：首次在数学上严格建立了特定噪声模型、电路类型与经典可模拟性之间的定量联系，包括最优深度界限、全深度误差有界MPO的存在性，以及高维情况下均匀深度多项式边界键维数的证明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，主要运用算子纠缠熵（OEE）、矩阵乘积算符（MPO）、投影纠缠对算符（PEPO）以及随机二设计门（random two-design gates）的收缩系数（contraction coefficient）等概念进行严格证明。

papers.title: Surface Reconstruction in Low-Temperature ARPES Spectra of Charge-Ordered EuAl$_4$
papers.abstract: Charge ordering in EuAl$_4$ has been widely discussed in connection with band reconstruction, magnetism,and topological electronic states, yet the microscopic origin of the complex low-temperature ARPES spectra remains unresolved. Here we combine photon-energy-, temperature-, and cleavage-history-dependent ARPES with firstprinciples calculations to separate intrinsic bulk bands from surface-derived spectral weight. Spectra measured on high-temperature-cleaved surfaces, both at 160 K and after cooling to 10 K, are well described by the calculated three-dimensional bulk electronic structure, whereas low-temperature-cleaved surfaces exhibit additional electron-like bands, replica-like Fermi-surface contours, and nearly kz-independent surface-derived features that are absent from the bulk calculations. These extra features are progressively suppressed upon warming, whereas the bulk-derived bands remain largely unchanged across the charge-density-wave transition within the experimental resolution. The combined analysis of photon-energy dependence, temperature evolution, and cleavage history identifies the reconstructed low-temperature spectral weight as arising predominantly from a thermally fragile surface reconstruction rather than from intrinsic bulk CDW-induced band folding. These results resolve an important ambiguity in EuAl$_4$ and provide spectroscopic criteria for distinguishing surface reconstruction from bulk charge-order effects in BaAl$_4$-family correlated semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：ARPES、光子能量依赖、温度依赖、解理历史依赖、第一性原理计算辅助分析）；研究对象：电荷有序化合物EuAl₄，具体关注其低温ARPES谱中表面重构与体相电荷密度波效应的区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低温ARPES谱中出现的额外电子型能带、类复制费米面轮廓及近kz无关的表面特征，主要源于热力学脆弱的表面重构，而非体相电荷密度波诱导的能带折叠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低温ARPES谱中出现的额外电子型能带、类复制费米面轮廓及近kz无关的表面特征，主要源于热力学脆弱的表面重构，而非体相电荷密度波诱导的能带折叠。；创新点：首次通过系统对比高温解理与低温解理表面的ARPES谱，结合光子能量、温度及解理历史的多维度分析，明确区分了表面重构与体相电荷有序效应，解决了EuAl₄中低温ARPES谱复杂起源的长期争议，并为BaAl₄族关联半金属中区分表面与体相效应提供了光谱学判据。
papers.method_zh: 结合光子能量依赖、温度依赖和解理历史依赖的角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）实验，以及第一性原理计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明，但提及“first principles calculations”）。

papers.title: Individually tunable Si/SiGe quantum dot operating voltages via gate-biased illumination
papers.abstract: Semiconductor quantum dot qubits often require very different voltages on each gate to bring them to a correct operating point. Here, we present a method by which one can controllably and repeatably alter the nanoscale trapped charge distribution at an oxide-semiconductor interface. We demonstrate this method on a Si/SiGe quantum dot device, and we find that the operating voltages can be controlled and made much more uniform. The method relies on illumination with near-infrared light in the presence of applied gate voltages, and it enables the tuning of the device operating point on a gate-by-gate basis. We present an explanation of the underlying physics using self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson simulations. As an application of this method, we tune a triple quantum dot to have uniform and small operating voltages in the (1,1,1) charge configuration. Importantly, we show that shifting the operating voltages in this way does not change the measured charge noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、measurement、tuning、charge noise）；研究对象：Si/SiGe量子点器件，具体为三量子点体系中的电荷分布调控与工作电压均匀化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过栅极偏压辅助的近红外光照，可可控且可重复地改变氧化物-半导体界面处的纳米尺度陷阱电荷分布，从而独立调节每个栅极的工作电压，使其更均匀，且不改变测量的电荷噪声。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过栅极偏压辅助的近红外光照，可可控且可重复地改变氧化物-半导体界面处的纳米尺度陷阱电荷分布，从而独立调节每个栅极的工作电压，使其更均匀，且不改变测量的电荷噪声。；创新点：提出了一种基于栅极偏压光照的、可逐栅极独立调节量子点工作电压的方法，并证明该方法不会影响电荷噪声性能。摘要未突出说明与已有调谐方法的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用近红外光照结合施加栅极电压的方法；理论上使用自洽薛定谔-泊松模拟解释物理机制。

papers.title: Design and modelling of compliant mechanisms with invertible Poisson's ratio effect for growing biological cells
papers.abstract: The behaviour of biological cells depends on the mechanical properties, such as Elastic Modulus and Poisson's ratio, of the substrate they adhere to. Tunable materials such as polyacrylamide gels and hydrogels were previously used as substrates to understand this dependence. However, these substrates do not facilitate changing their elastic properties in situ while cells are growing on them. This work presents an alternate approach that enables this--substrates based on tunable compliant micro mechanisms. In particular, the mechanism proposed here has an invertible Poisson's ratio effect. In the first configuration, the effect is positive, and in the second, it is negative, with any desired magnitude. We achieve this by changing the stiffness between two internal points of a mechanism with the shape of a re-entrant structure. An increase in stiffness causes the direction of deformation along the lateral axis to reverse for a given reference load along the horizontal axis. We derive analytical expressions that relate the geometric parameters to the ratio of input and output displacements for both mechanism configurations. The analytical modelling is verified with finite element analysis and experiments on mesoscale design prototypes of both configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中提及“analytical modelling is verified with finite element analysis and experiments on mesoscale design prototypes”。；研究对象：具有可逆泊松比效应的柔性微机构，用于作为生物细胞生长的可调基底材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变机构内部两点间的刚度，可实现泊松比从正值到负值的可逆切换，且可调节至任意所需大小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变机构内部两点间的刚度，可实现泊松比从正值到负值的可逆切换，且可调节至任意所需大小。；创新点：提出了一种可在细胞生长过程中原位改变基底弹性性质（特别是泊松比）的替代方案，克服了传统聚丙烯酰胺凝胶和水凝胶无法原位调节的局限。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 解析建模（推导几何参数与输入/输出位移比的关系）、有限元分析（FEA）、中尺度设计原型的实验验证。

papers.title: Data-Driven Discovery of Unconventional Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Unconventional antiferromagnets combine zero net magnetization with spin-split electronic bands, offering a distinct, important platform for spintronics. Their discovery, however, has so far depended largely on case-by-case studies and on a limited number of compounds with experimentally resolved magnetic structures. Here, we overcome these bottlenecks by resolving magnetic ground states across a broad materials database.
