We narrow down 37163 magnets from the Materials Project to 189 collinear antiferromagnets by combining physics-informed prescreening, high-throughput exchange calculations and Luttinger-Tisza analysis. Among these, symmetry analysis identifies 36 altermagnets and 11 Luttinger-compensated ferrimagnets (LCFs), including 22 altermagnets and 9 LCFs that have not been reported previously. The identified unconventional antiferromagnets can support nonrelativistic spin Hall effects and doping-tunable spin transport with switchable polarization and giant anisotropy. Our framework converts broad structural databases into a curated, symmetry-classified set of experimentally testable compensated spin-split magnets, establishing a scalable route for the efficient discovery of functional antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。关键词：high-throughput exchange calculations、Luttinger-Tisza analysis、symmetry analysis、Materials Project数据库。；研究对象：非常规反铁磁体（unconventional antiferromagnets），具体包括交变磁体（altermagnets）和Luttinger补偿铁磁体（Luttinger-compensated ferrimagnets, LCFs），以及它们在自旋电子学中的非相对论性自旋霍尔效应和可调自旋输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量筛选和对称性分析，从Materials Project数据库中的37163种磁性材料中识别出189种共线反铁磁体，其中包含36种交变磁体和11种Luttinger补偿铁磁体，且22种交变磁体和9种LCF为首次报道。这些材料可支持非相对论性自旋霍尔效应和掺杂可调的自旋输运，具有可切换极化和巨大各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量筛选和对称性分析，从Materials Project数据库中的37163种磁性材料中识别出189种共线反铁磁体，其中包含36种交变磁体和11种Luttinger补偿铁磁体，且22种交变磁体和9种LCF为首次报道。这些材料可支持非相对论性自旋霍尔效应和掺杂可调的自旋输运，具有可切换极化和巨大各向异性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理信息预筛选（physics-informed prescreening）、高通量交换作用计算（high-throughput exchange calculations）和Luttinger-Tisza分析（Luttinger-Tisza analysis）确定磁基态，再通过对称性分析（symmetry analysis）区分交变磁体和Luttinger补偿铁磁体。所有计算基于Materials Project结构数据库。

papers.title: Microscopic origin of polytype-dependent melting in SiC revealed by machine-learning molecular dynamics
papers.abstract: Predicting how crystal structure influences high-temperature stability remains a key challenge in materials modelling and design. Silicon carbide (SiC), one of the most thermally and chemically stable materials known, provides an ideal system for studying this problem because its many polytypes preserve similar local tetrahedral bonding while differing in long-range stacking geometry. Here, we combine phase-coexistence machine-learning molecular dynamics with finite-temperature phonon analysis, enabled by a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential that accurately describes crystalline, high-temperature, and disordered configurations across multiple SiC polytypes. We identify a clear relative stability ordering, 3C > 2H > 9R, reflected consistently in structural disordering, interlayer sliding, and finite-temperature phonon spectra. Across all polytypes, melting initiates through the formation of short C-C contacts and carbon-rich local regions, followed by a progressive loss of tetrahedral Si-C connectivity. The reduced stability of the long-period 9R polytype is traced to low-frequency transverse-acoustic shear modes associated with relative bilayer sliding, which are already present in the 0 K phonon spectra and soften further at high temperature. These modes generate larger lateral bilayer displacements, linking enhanced interlayer sliding to local chemical disordering and ultimately melting. More broadly, our results show that high-temperature stability in polytypic covalent materials is governed not only by local bond strength, but also by stacking-dependent transverse dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learning molecular dynamics、phase-coexistence、finite-temperature phonon analysis、interatomic potential）；研究对象：碳化硅（SiC）的多型体（polytypes），具体包括3C、2H和9R三种堆垛结构，以及它们的高温稳定性与熔化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SiC多型体的高温稳定性顺序为3C > 2H > 9R，熔化起始于短程C-C接触和富碳局域区域的形成，而长周期9R多型体稳定性降低的根本原因在于其0 K声子谱中已存在的低频横向声学剪切模（与双层滑移相关），这些模在高温下进一步软化，导致更大的横向双层位移，从而促进化学无序并最终引发熔化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SiC多型体的高温稳定性顺序为3C > 2H > 9R，熔化起始于短程C-C接触和富碳局域区域的形成，而长周期9R多型体稳定性降低的根本原因在于其0 K声子谱中已存在的低频横向声学剪切模（与双层滑移相关），这些模在高温下进一步软化，导致更大的横向双层位移，从而促进化学无序并最终引发熔化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用微调后的MACE机器学习原子间势（fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential），结合相共存机器学习分子动力学（phase-coexistence machine-learning molecular dynamics）与有限温度声子分析（finite-temperature phonon analysis）。

papers.title: Robust control over polar skyrmion bubble density with a combined optical and electrical approach
papers.abstract: Polar skyrmion bubbles are nanoscale ferroelectric domain configurations with swirling polarization textures, and often emerge in ferroelectric oxide systems. Owing to their inhomogeneous polarization patterns, which endow them with distinct topologies and electrical responses from homogeneous monodomains, polar skyrmion bubbles are envisaged to be promising candidates for non-volatile memory devices. In such device, the recorded information density is directly proportional to the density of bubbles, underscoring the need for precise control over bubble nucleation. Here, using first-principles-based calculations, we demonstrate that when assisted with a DC electric field, twisted light, which has a spatially inhomogeneous field pattern, can robustly tune the density of polar skyrmion bubbles in ferroelectric ultrathin films between $10^2\sim 10^4 \rm{bit}/μm^2$. Moreover, by modulating DC and optical field strengths together with the beam radius, the nucleation rate, which characterizes the creation and annihilation speed of polar skyrmion bubbles, can also be well controlled. These findings highlight the unique response of ferroelectric nanofilms to optical and electric fields, which is crucial for employing polar skyrmion bubbles in the next-generation of ultrahigh-density memory technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles-based calculations。；研究对象：铁电超薄膜中的极性斯格明子气泡（polar skyrmion bubbles），这是一种具有涡旋极化织构的纳米尺度铁电畴构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在直流电场辅助下，具有空间非均匀场分布的扭曲光（twisted light）能够稳健地调控铁电超薄膜中极性斯格明子气泡的密度，使其在 \(10^2 \sim 10^4 \rm{bit}/μm^2\) 范围内可调，同时通过调节直流电场、光场强度和光束半径，还可以有效控制气泡的成核速率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在直流电场辅助下，具有空间非均匀场分布的扭曲光（twisted light）能够稳健地调控铁电超薄膜中极性斯格明子气泡的密度，使其在 \(10^2 \sim 10^4 \rm{bit}/μm^2\) 范围内可调，同时通过调节直流电场、光场强度和光束半径，还可以有效控制气泡的成核速率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的计算方法（first-principles-based calculations）。

papers.title: Magnetic self-frustration from spontaneous structural distortion
papers.abstract: In frustrated magnetism, lattice distortions mediated by magnetoelastic coupling are commonly invoked as an escape route from extensive degeneracy toward an ordered ground state and, in some cases, the onset of multiferroicity. Here we present a minimal classical model that illustrates the converse phenomenon, which we term ``magnetic self-frustration''. Monte Carlo simulations reveal that a kagomé lattice with trivial magnetic interactions -- namely, nearest-neighbor Ising ferromagnetism -- undergoes a magnetostructural transition into a breathing-like phase, characterized by irregular bond dimerization along the three kagomé directions. Structurally, the equilateral triangles belonging to one of the two kagomé sublattices spontaneously distort, expanding into isosceles triangles. An analysis to first order in the magnetoelastic coupling constant $α$ shows that the shape of these triangles is remarkably robust. Acting like rigid building blocks in a puzzle, their vertices determine the geometry of the second sublattice, giving rise to contracted ferromagnetic triangles with a variety of shapes. The magnetic sector can be mapped onto an effective antiferromagnetic triangular lattice, which remains disordered down to low temperatures and retains a finite residual entropy of one third of that of Wannier. This self-frustrated phase takes place at intermediate values of $α$, separating the conventional undistorted ferromagnetic phase at weak coupling from a strongly coupled ordered phase characterized by a regular dimerized up-up-down-down antiferromagnetic pattern along the three kagomé directions, built from ferromagnetic triangles and hexagons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、classical model、analysis to first order）；研究对象：Kagomé晶格上的Ising铁磁模型，以及由磁弹耦合驱动的自发结构畸变导致的“磁性自阻挫”现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有最近邻Ising铁磁相互作用的kagomé晶格中，通过磁弹耦合可自发形成呼吸型结构畸变，产生一种新的“磁性自阻挫”相，该相在低温下保持无序并具有有限残余熵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有最近邻Ising铁磁相互作用的kagomé晶格中，通过磁弹耦合可自发形成呼吸型结构畸变，产生一种新的“磁性自阻挫”相，该相在低温下保持无序并具有有限残余熵。；创新点：提出了与常见“晶格畸变解除阻挫”相反的现象——“磁性自阻挫”，即原本无阻挫的铁磁系统通过自发结构畸变引入阻挫，导致低温无序和残余熵。
papers.method_zh: 构建经典模型，采用蒙特卡洛模拟，并结合磁弹耦合常数α的一阶解析分析。

papers.title: Imaging the Magnetically Driven Reconstruction of the Electronic States in the Antiferromagnetic Topological Insulator EuSn$_2$As$_2$
papers.abstract: The realization of the axion insulator phase in magnetic topological insulators is often hindered by crystalline symmetries that protect gapless surface states, even when time-reversal symmetry is broken. Here, we use variable-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) and spectroscopy (STS), complemented with density functional theory (DFT), to investigate the local electronic structure of the antiferromagnetic (AFM) topological insulator EuSn$_2$As$_2$ across its Néel transition at $T_N = 24$ K. On the (001) surface, we observe a substantial density of intrinsic Sn vacancies that introduce nanoscale electronic inhomogeneity and p-type doping. Upon cooling below $T_N$, we resolve the emergence of two distinct magnetically driven gaps: a $\sim$100 meV gap near the Fermi level and a $\sim$50 meV gap at the ARPES-resolved Dirac point. We attribute the former gap to AFM Brillouin-zone folding and hybridization. The characteristics of the 50 meV gap point toward the lifting of mirror-symmetry protection by Sn vacancies and the consequent mass gapping of the Dirac point, although contributions from AFM-induced folding hybridization cannot be entirely ruled out. Our findings provide real-space evidence for strong coupling between localized moments and itinerant topological states, highlighting exfoliable EuSn$_2$As$_2$ as a potential candidate for realizing axion-insulator-based devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), spectroscopy (STS), density functional theory (DFT)）；研究对象：反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 EuSn₂As₂ 在奈尔温度（T_N = 24 K）附近的局域电子结构及其磁致重构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 EuSn₂As₂ 的 (001) 表面，当温度降至奈尔温度以下时，观测到两个由磁性驱动的能隙：费米能级附近约 100 meV 的能隙（归因于反铁磁布里渊区折叠与杂化）和狄拉克点处约 50 meV 的能隙（归因于锡空位破坏镜面对称保护，导致狄拉克点质量打开）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 EuSn₂As₂ 的 (001) 表面，当温度降至奈尔温度以下时，观测到两个由磁性驱动的能隙：费米能级附近约 100 meV 的能隙（归因于反铁磁布里渊区折叠与杂化）和狄拉克点处约 50 meV 的能隙（归因于锡空位破坏镜面对称保护，导致狄拉克点质量打开）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 变温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）与扫描隧道谱（STS），辅以密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Microstructure-specific mechanisms define multistage relaxation dynamics in a metallic model-glass
papers.abstract: Deciphering complex relaxation pathways in disordered solids is a central challenge across polymeric, oxide, and metallic glasses, which traditionally relies on the interpretation of mechanical spectroscopy and resulting damping modes. Here we demonstrate the direct observation of dominant atomic-scale relaxation mechanisms during isothermal annealing of an as-quenched binary model glass towards incipient crystallization. Assessed via simulated x-ray photon correlation spectroscopy, a multi-state structural decorrelation is uncovered via speckle-pattern analysis of the full three-dimensional diffraction sphere across the first peak of the structure factor. Over a simulation time of up to 10 $μ$s, three distinct and subsequent decorrelation stages of thermal vibration, glassy network evolution, and structural and chemical ordering towards crystallization are identified. These findings promote a picture where specific dynamically-separated mechanisms drive the microstructural evolution during glass relaxation and suggest a much richer multi-mode relaxation behavior of metallic glasses than hitherto identified.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“simulated x-ray photon correlation spectroscopy”（模拟X射线光子相关光谱）、“simulation time”（模拟时间）。；研究对象：金属模型玻璃（metallic model-glass）在等温退火过程中的微观结构弛豫动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了金属玻璃在等温退火至初始晶化过程中，存在三种截然不同且依次发生的结构去相关阶段：热振动、玻璃网络演化以及结构/化学有序化（趋向晶化）。这表明金属玻璃的弛豫行为比以往认知的更为丰富，是由特定且动力学分离的微观机制驱动的多模态过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了金属玻璃在等温退火至初始晶化过程中，存在三种截然不同且依次发生的结构去相关阶段：热振动、玻璃网络演化以及结构/化学有序化（趋向晶化）。这表明金属玻璃的弛豫行为比以往认知的更为丰富，是由特定且动力学分离的微观机制驱动的多模态过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作通过直接观测（模拟）而非传统力学谱学间接推断的方式，首次在原子尺度上直接识别并区分了金属玻璃弛豫过程中多个主导的微观机制，提出了一个由特定机制驱动的多阶段弛豫图像。
papers.method_zh: 通过分子动力学模拟，结合模拟的X射线光子相关光谱（XPCS）技术，对结构因子第一峰对应的完整三维衍射球进行散斑图样分析，以追踪原子尺度的结构去相关过程。

papers.title: Impact of viscoelastic polymer solution droplets on a granular bed
papers.abstract: The impact of polymer solution droplets on granular beds is relevant to powder processing, binder jetting additive manufacturing, and environmental applications involving erosion control or spray deposition, yet most controlled studies of drop--grain interactions have focused on Newtonian liquids. In this study, we experimentally investigate the impact of viscoelastic polyethylene oxide (PEO) droplets on a dry granular bed and compare the resulting cratering dynamics with those of Newtonian liquids over a wide range of impact energies and Ohnesorge numbers. Crater morphology changes with impact energy, and this evolution occurs at lower energies for drops of polymer solution, consistent with their distinct liquid--grain interactions during impact. The crater diameter exhibits two distinct regimes: a low-energy plateau and a power-law growth at higher impact energies. We identify the transition between these regimes and show that, although the plateau size and the power law remain nearly unchanged, viscoelastic droplets reach the transition at lower impact energy than Newtonian droplets. This suggests that viscoelasticity modifies how the impact energy is partitioned between droplet deformation and dissipation in the granular bed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimentally investigate、cratering dynamics、compared with Newtonian liquids。；研究对象：粘弹性聚合物溶液（聚乙烯氧化物，PEO）液滴撞击干燥颗粒床（干颗粒床）的成坑动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 粘弹性液滴的成坑形态随撞击能量的演化在更低能量下发生，且粘弹性液滴从低能平台区向高能幂律增长区转变的临界撞击能量低于牛顿液滴，表明粘弹性改变了撞击能量在液滴变形与颗粒床耗散之间的分配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：粘弹性液滴的成坑形态随撞击能量的演化在更低能量下发生，且粘弹性液滴从低能平台区向高能幂律增长区转变的临界撞击能量低于牛顿液滴，表明粘弹性改变了撞击能量在液滴变形与颗粒床耗散之间的分配。；创新点：首次系统对比粘弹性聚合物溶液液滴与牛顿液滴在颗粒床上的撞击成坑行为，揭示了粘弹性对能量分配和成坑转变阈值的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：通过控制撞击能量和Ohnesorge数范围，对比粘弹性PEO液滴与牛顿液滴撞击干燥颗粒床后的成坑动力学，测量坑直径随撞击能量的变化。

papers.title: Electronic screening of the friction acting on ions and water molecules in narrow carbon nanotubes
papers.abstract: Li, et. al., have observed a larger flow rate, resulting from osmotic pressure, of protons and water molecules in nanometer scale diameter metallic carbon nanotubes compared to that in semiconducting carbon nanotubes. The flow rate of potassium ions, however, under an applied electric field is almost the same in metallic and semiconducting nanotubes. We propose a simple physical picture to understand these experimental results by examining the effects of screening by conduction electrons in electrically conducting carbon nanotubes on the friction experienced by protons, water molecules, and ions flowing through the nanotube.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“simple physical picture”来解释实验结果，属于理论分析，未提及作者自身进行实验或计算。；研究对象：窄碳纳米管中质子、水分子和钾离子在流动时所受的摩擦，以及金属性与半导体性碳纳米管中传导电子的屏蔽效应对摩擦的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金属性碳纳米管中传导电子的屏蔽效应可以降低质子与水分子的摩擦，从而解释实验中观察到的更高渗透压驱动流量；但钾离子在电场驱动下的流量在金属性与半导体性纳米管中几乎相同，表明其摩擦受屏蔽影响不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金属性碳纳米管中传导电子的屏蔽效应可以降低质子与水分子的摩擦，从而解释实验中观察到的更高渗透压驱动流量；但钾离子在电场驱动下的流量在金属性与半导体性纳米管中几乎相同，表明其摩擦受屏蔽影响不同。；创新点：提出了一个简单的物理图像，将传导电子的屏蔽效应与不同粒子（质子、水分子、钾离子）在碳纳米管中的摩擦差异联系起来，从而统一解释Li等人实验中质子/水与钾离子流动行为的差异。摘要未突出说明与已有理论相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 基于物理图像的理论分析，通过考察传导电子屏蔽对摩擦的作用来解释已有实验现象。摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如第一性原理计算、解析模型等）。

papers.title: Localization of Active Particles on Random Arrays of Parallel Filaments
papers.abstract: Quenched disorder in the environment can fundamentally alter transport dynamics in both active and passive systems. We explore how disordered arrays of filaments govern the distribution of intermittently moving particles which switch between diffusive and processive transport. Motivated by the mixed-polarity arrangements of parallel microtubules observed in mammalian dendrites, we show that such arrays tend to result in localization of particles at regions of convergent filament orientation. In the rapid attachment-detachment limit, the disordered system can be described by a noisy one-dimensional effective energy landscape, whose structure is approximated by a random walk. The depth and width of wells on this landscape are expressed as a function of the transport kinetics and system geometry. Localization is shown to be strongest at intermediate run-lengths, where biased transport persists long enough to sense the quenched filament polarity but not so long as to facilitate escape from local traps. These results demonstrate robust localization of particles moving on random filament networks, highlighting the emergent spatial organization that arises from an interplay of active transport and quenched disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“effective energy landscape”、“random walk”等理论建模与数学分析，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：随机排列的平行细丝阵列上间歇运动（在扩散与定向输运之间切换）的活性粒子的局域化行为。具体体系受哺乳动物树突中平行微管混合极性排列的启发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随机排列的细丝阵列倾向于使粒子局域在细丝取向汇聚的区域；在中等运行长度下局域化最强，此时偏向性输运足以感知淬火无序的极性，但又不至于让粒子逃逸局部陷阱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随机排列的细丝阵列倾向于使粒子局域在细丝取向汇聚的区域；在中等运行长度下局域化最强，此时偏向性输运足以感知淬火无序的极性，但又不至于让粒子逃逸局部陷阱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过理论建模，在快速附着-脱离极限下将无序系统映射为含噪声的一维有效能量景观，该景观的结构近似为随机游走，并解析表达了势阱深度和宽度与输运动力学及系统几何参数的关系。

papers.title: Co-adsorption mechanism drives CO oxidation on defective ZnS
papers.abstract: Reactivity on wide-bandgap semiconductor surfaces relies critically on the generation of active sites. In the case of CO oxidation, however, the mere presence of defects is insufficient to drive reactivity. Here, we investigate CO oxidation on a defective ZnS single-crystal surface by combining near ambient pressure X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (NAP-XPS) and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. NAP-XPS measurements reveal CO$_2$-like surface intermediates only under oxygen-rich conditions, consistent with oxygen-assisted CO oxidation. DFT calculations support an oxygen-assisted co-adsorption pathway in which CO interacts preferentially with adsorbed oxygen species stabilized near Zn-deficient sites, forming weakly bound CO$_2$-like structures. These results identify oxygen coverage, rather than defect density alone, as the key factor controlling CO$_2$-like intermediate formation on defective ZnS and establish defective ZnS as a model platform for studying oxygen-assisted surface chemistry on non-oxide semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：近常压X射线光电子能谱（NAP-XPS）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：缺陷硫化锌（ZnS）单晶表面上的CO氧化反应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在缺陷ZnS表面，CO氧化生成CO₂类中间体的关键控制因素是氧覆盖度，而非单纯的缺陷密度；反应遵循氧辅助共吸附机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在缺陷ZnS表面，CO氧化生成CO₂类中间体的关键控制因素是氧覆盖度，而非单纯的缺陷密度；反应遵循氧辅助共吸附机制。；创新点：揭示了在非氧化物半导体（ZnS）上，氧覆盖度而非缺陷密度是驱动CO氧化的决定性因素，并建立了缺陷ZnS作为研究氧辅助表面化学的模型平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：近常压X射线光电子能谱（NAP-XPS）；计算方法：密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Electron vs. hole doping in infinite-layer nickelates: electronic structure, magnetism and correlations
papers.abstract: The observation of superconductivity in undoped infinite-layer nickelates $R$NiO$_2$ ($R$ = rare earth) challenges our current understanding and calls for a re-examination of the underlying electronic structure of this family of materials. In this context, it is particularly important to extend the investigation of $R$NiO$_2$ compounds from the intensively studied hole-doped regime to the almost unexplored electron-doped one. Here, we use a combination of density-functional theory and dynamical mean-field theory to study the evolution of the electronic structure of infinite-layer nickelates in these two doping regimes. We find a striking asymmetry in the self-doping of the Ni-$d_{x^2-y^2}$ band due to the $R(5d)$ states: while this effect is strongly suppressed upon hole doping, electron doping instead leads to an increase in the size of the $R(5d)$ electron pockets, but without effectively hole-doping the Ni-$d_{x^2-y^2}$ band. This asymmetry has an important impact on the magnetic response as antiferromagnetism is rapidly suppressed upon hole doping, whereas it remains the ground state upon electron doping. Despite these differences, electronic correlations on both sides of the phase diagram are dominated by the Ni $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbital, suggesting that a single-band description may be appropriate for infinite-layer nickelates in both the electron- and hole-doped regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了密度泛函理论（DFT）和动力学平均场理论（DMFT）相结合的计算方法。；研究对象：无限层镍氧化物 \(R\)NiO\(_2\)（\(R\) = 稀土元素）在空穴掺杂和电子掺杂两种掺杂方式下的电子结构、磁性和关联效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无限层镍酸盐中，空穴掺杂和电子掺杂导致显著的不对称性：空穴掺杂会强烈抑制Ni-\(d_{x^2-y^2}\)能带的自掺杂效应并迅速压制反铁磁性，而电子掺杂反而增大\(R(5d)\)电子口袋尺寸，但并未有效空穴掺杂Ni-\(d_{x^2-y^2}\)能带，且反铁磁性仍保持为基态。尽管存在这些差异，两种掺杂区域的电子关联均由Ni \(d_{x^2-y^2}\)轨道主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无限层镍酸盐中，空穴掺杂和电子掺杂导致显著的不对称性：空穴掺杂会强烈抑制Ni-\(d_{x^2-y^2}\)能带的自掺杂效应并迅速压制反铁磁性，而电子掺杂反而增大\(R(5d)\)电子口袋尺寸，但并未有效空穴掺杂Ni-\(d_{x^2-y^2}\)能带，且反铁磁性仍保持为基态。尽管存在这些差异，两种掺杂区域的电子关联均由Ni \(d_{x^2-y^2}\)轨道主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）与动力学平均场理论（DMFT）进行第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Extracting central charge from ground-state overlaps of spatially deformed Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: We show that the conformal anomaly of a $(1+1)$-dimensional conformal field theory can be extracted directly from a ground-state wave-function overlap associated with a spatial conformal deformation. Focusing on the $q$-Möbius deformation, we derive an exact overlap formula between the deformed and undeformed ground states, whose exponent depends only on the central charge. Motivated by this result, we construct a lattice estimator based solely on ground-state overlaps and apply it to representative critical quantum chains and the gapless edge modes of a two-dimensional Chern insulator. Numerical results demonstrate that the resulting overlaps provide a simple and robust probe of the central charge in microscopic models. We further demonstrate that the deformed ground states retain universal geometric structures in their entanglement spectra and entanglement entropies. These results provide a simple wave-function-based route to probing conformal data in critical systems and topological edge modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：推导了精确的解析公式（exact overlap formula），并辅以数值计算（Numerical results）验证。；研究对象：研究的是(1+1)维共形场论（CFT）的共形反常（conformal anomaly），具体表现为中心荷（central charge）。应用对象包括临界量子链（critical quantum chains）和二维陈绝缘体的无能隙边缘模（gapless edge modes of a two-dimensional Chern insulator）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过空间共形变形（spatial conformal deformation）前后的基态波函数交叠（ground-state overlap），可以直接提取出共形场论的中心荷。该交叠的指数仅依赖于中心荷，为探测微观模型中的共形数据提供了一种简单且鲁棒的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过空间共形变形（spatial conformal deformation）前后的基态波函数交叠（ground-state overlap），可以直接提取出共形场论的中心荷。该交叠的指数仅依赖于中心荷，为探测微观模型中的共形数据提供了一种简单且鲁棒的方法。；创新点：提出了一种仅通过基态波函数交叠来提取中心荷的新方法，该方法比传统的基于纠缠熵或纠缠谱的方法更简单，并且适用于探测拓扑边缘模的共形数据。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为(1+1)维共形场论，具体使用了q-莫比乌斯变形（q-Möbius deformation）。构建了一个仅基于基态交叠的晶格估计量（lattice estimator），并将其应用于代表性模型进行数值验证。

papers.title: Vestigial Nematic Order at Zero Temperature in Two-Dimensional Frustrated Quantum Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: The phase diagram of the two-dimensional quantum $J_1$-$J_3$ Heisenberg antiferromagnet on a square lattice is a long-standing open problem. Despite recent advances in numerical techniques for quantum spin models, a detailed analytical theory is still lacking. We address this problem using a semiclassical approach based on a continuum nonlinear sigma model effective field theory, applying the nonperturbative large-$N$ technique to map out the phase diagram and determine the magnetic correlations. We show that previously-overlooked interactions are crucial for stabilizing a vestigial nematic phase, both at finite and zero temperature. Our results reveal that the spontaneous breaking of global symmetries in the $J_1$-$J_3$ model is controlled by the strength of infrared quantum fluctuations which are enhanced by proximity to the classical Lifshitz point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：semiclassical approach、nonlinear sigma model effective field theory、large-\(N\) technique。；研究对象：二维正方晶格上阻挫量子反铁磁体 \(J_1\)-\(J_3\) 海森堡模型的相图与零温残余向列相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 此前被忽略的相互作用在有限温度和零温下对稳定残余向列相至关重要；该模型中全局对称性的自发破缺由红外量子涨落的强度控制，而该涨落因靠近经典 Lifshitz 点而被增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：此前被忽略的相互作用在有限温度和零温下对稳定残余向列相至关重要；该模型中全局对称性的自发破缺由红外量子涨落的强度控制，而该涨落因靠近经典 Lifshitz 点而被增强。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于连续非线性 sigma 模型有效场论的半经典方法，并应用非微扰的大-\(N\) 技术来绘制相图并确定磁关联。

papers.title: Aharonov-Casher Chern bands for ultracold dark state atoms
papers.abstract: We consider the Aharonov-Casher (AC) condition for ultracold atoms adiabatically following the dark-state in a $Λ$-type atom-light coupling scheme. The AC condition establishes a relation between the geometric scalar potential and the synthetic magnetic field, resulting in a fully degenerate lowest Landau-level-like band even if the magnetic field is inhomogeneous but has a proper sign. We derive a general requirement for the atom-light coupling under which the AC condition applies. The requirement holds if the Rabi frequencies of the $Λ$ scheme are the superposition of plane waves with the appropriate amplitudes and phases. In particular, the Rabi frequencies made of $N=3,\,4,\,6$ fine tuned plane waves yield a smooth background magnetic field of definite sign, as well as an array of non-measurable Aharonov-Bohm flux singularities. Departing from the fine tuning, the latter singularities broaden into narrow subwavelength patches of the opposite magnetic field, which broaden the lowest energy band. The lowest band is broadened also for the fine tuned situation due to deviation from the adiabatic approach because of the finite atom-light coupling strength. It is shown that a proper combination of the two imperfections (departure from fine tuning and finite atom-light coupling strength) can lead to a completely flat lowest band, which furthermore is characterized by the perfect topology needed for simulating the fractional Hall states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We consider、derive、it is shown。；研究对象：超冷原子在Λ型原子-光耦合方案中绝热跟随暗态时的Aharonov-Casher（AC）条件，以及由此产生的合成磁场和拓扑能带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过适当组合两种非理想因素（平面波精细调谐的偏离和有限原子-光耦合强度），可以实现完全平坦的最低能带，该能带具有模拟分数量子霍尔态所需的完美拓扑性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过适当组合两种非理想因素（平面波精细调谐的偏离和有限原子-光耦合强度），可以实现完全平坦的最低能带，该能带具有模拟分数量子霍尔态所需的完美拓扑性质。；创新点：揭示了通过调控两种非理想因素的组合，可将原本展宽的最低能带变为完全平坦且具有完美拓扑的能带，为模拟分数量子霍尔态提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体包括：推导AC条件对原子-光耦合的一般要求；分析由N=3、4、6个精细调谐平面波叠加构成的拉比频率产生的平滑背景磁场及不可测量的Aharonov-Bohm通量奇点；研究偏离精细调谐和有限耦合强度对能带展宽的影响。

papers.title: Photostationary Lifshitz transition in High Tc superconductor Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ
papers.abstract: To date, controlling the steady-state electronic band structure in high-Tc cuprate superconductors has been achieved primarily through chemical doping or magnetic fields. Here, we present that ultrafast optical excitation can instead drive the electronic band structure of Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ into a photostationary, long-lived excited state. At sufficiently high pump fluences, this state undergoes a Lifshitz transition of the Fermi surface, characterized by a change in topology from hole-like to electron-like. Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, supported by single-band tight-binding calculations, reveals that 1.6 eV photoexcitation induces band-structure evolutions closely analogous to those produced by chemical doping. These results point to an efficient photodoping mechanism involving cooperative effects, including charge transfer, renormalization of effective electronic correlations, and defect-assisted charge trapping. Our findings raise fundamental questions regarding thermalization processes occurring on timescales comparable to the laser repetition period in cuprates. More broadly, ultrafast optical control enables access to otherwise inaccessible regions of the phase diagram by tuning the pump fluence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy、ultrafast optical excitation、pump fluences）；研究对象：高温超导体Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ（BSCCO）的电子能带结构及其光致稳态Lifshitz转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超快光激发，可在Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ中实现光致稳态的Lifshitz转变，使费米面拓扑从空穴型转变为电子型，其效果与化学掺杂高度类似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超快光激发，可在Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ中实现光致稳态的Lifshitz转变，使费米面拓扑从空穴型转变为电子型，其效果与化学掺杂高度类似。；创新点：首次在高温铜氧化物超导体中利用超快光激发实现稳态的Lifshitz转变，提供了一种无需化学掺杂或外加磁场即可调控电子能带结构的新途径。摘要未突出说明该光致掺杂机制中电荷转移、有效电子关联重整化及缺陷辅助电荷俘获等协同效应的具体细节。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES），并结合单带紧束缚模型计算进行理论支持。

papers.title: Advances in electrical contacts to single crystals of emerging materials for transport measurements
papers.abstract: Transport measurements that probe electrical resistivity of a material under varying external stimuli, such as temperature, magnetic field, optical illumination, and gate voltage, are among the most important experimental techniques in condensed matter physics. These measurements provide critical insights into the fundamental electronic properties of materials. In recent years, they have facilitated the discovery and exploration of intriguing physical phenomena (e.g., superconductivity and quantum oscillations) and unique device functionalities (e.g., photoresponse and electrostatic gating effects) in various emerging materials, particularly in the form of single crystals. However, unlike large-scale wafers or thin films, newly synthesized single crystals often pose substantial challenges in establishing reliable electrical contacts due to their irregular geometries, limited dimensions, inherent structural characteristics, and potential susceptibility to degradation. In this review, we highlight recent technological advancements in the fabrication of high-quality, lithographically defined multi-terminal electrodes on both exfoliable and non-exfoliable single crystals for transport measurements. Our work provides a practical guide for researchers seeking to select appropriate contact-fabrication strategies tailored to unique characteristics of emerging crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：review, highlight recent technological advancements, practical guide。；研究对象：新兴材料单晶（包括可剥离和不可剥离的单晶）的输运测量中电接触的制备技术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要聚焦于综述近年来在单晶上制备高质量、光刻定义的多端电极的技术进展。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要聚焦于综述近年来在单晶上制备高质量、光刻定义的多端电极的技术进展。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有综述的具体创新点，但指出该工作为研究者根据新兴晶体的独特特性选择合适的接触制备策略提供了实用指南。
papers.method_zh: 综述了基于光刻（lithographically defined）的多端电极制备技术，针对可剥离和不可剥离单晶的不同特性，提供了接触制备策略的实用指南。

papers.title: Chirality routing non-polaritonic vacuum correlations in Landau polaritons
papers.abstract: Ultrastrong coupling between matter and cavity vacuum fields can turn the electromagnetic vacuum into a structured quantum environment, thereby opening passive routes for modifying and manipulating material properties. Recent work has identified light--matter entanglement as an important ingredient in these property changes, which raises the question of where the relevant vacuum correlations actually reside. Landau polaritons provide chiral ultrastrong coupling systems in which one circular cavity polarization forms the bright polariton branches. Here, using a quantum information approach, we show that an exact chiral charge in a multimode Hopfield model routes the dominant anomalous correlations, squeezing, and cavity--matter entanglement into the opposite polarization. We find that, using parameters extracted from a multimode Landau polariton system, this hidden sector correlates the cyclotron resonance with finite momentum magnetoplasmons through Gaussian discord, while pairwise matter--matter entanglement remains absent. We further predict a polarization anisotropy of dressed vacuum electric field fluctuations as a signature of this chiral routing. These results identify chirality as a symmetry principle for organizing ultrastrong coupling vacua and show that quantum information tools provide a powerful framework for revealing the salient properties of Landau polaritons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“quantum information approach”“show”“predict”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：Landau极化子体系中的手性超强耦合真空关联。具体涉及圆偏振腔与二维电子气（Landau能级）形成的超强耦合系统，以及有限动量磁等离子体激元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多模Hopfield模型中，精确的手性电荷将主导的反常关联、压缩态以及腔-物质纠缠路由到与亮极化子分支相反的圆偏振方向；该隐藏扇区通过高斯失谐关联回旋共振与有限动量磁等离子体激元，而物质-物质纠缠则不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多模Hopfield模型中，精确的手性电荷将主导的反常关联、压缩态以及腔-物质纠缠路由到与亮极化子分支相反的圆偏振方向；该隐藏扇区通过高斯失谐关联回旋共振与有限动量磁等离子体激元，而物质-物质纠缠则不存在。；创新点：首次将手性识别为组织超强耦合真空态的一个对称性原理，并利用量子信息工具揭示Landau极化子中隐藏的真空关联路由机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子信息理论框架（包括高斯失谐、纠缠度量等工具）分析多模Hopfield模型，并从多模Landau极化子系统中提取参数进行数值预测。

papers.title: A Mid-Infrared Platform Based on Strontium Tweezer Arrays
papers.abstract: Subwavelength atomic tweezer arrays, in which atoms can be positioned at distances smaller than their emission wavelength, have been proposed as a versatile platform to study collective emission phenomena, such as superradiance and subradiance. Experimentally, the realization of such arrays has been a challenge as typical emission wavelengths in the visible or near-infrared are short compared to typical tweezer spacings in the micrometer range. Here, we use $^{88}$Sr atoms in optical tweezer arrays to access a mid-infrared transition at 2,923 nm ($5s5p\:^{3}P_{2} \rightarrow\, 5s4d\:^{3}D_{3}$). We identify a magic trapping wavelength at 597.14(3) nm and demonstrate single-atom preparation and imaging with high fidelity. In addition, using 2,923 nm light, we demonstrate resolved-sideband cooling of tweezer-trapped strontium. Beyond enabling studies of collective emission phenomena in flexible arrangements of atoms, our platform opens novel opportunities for dipolar many-body physics and enhanced control over Rydberg dynamics and the strontium fine-structure qubit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用$^{88}$Sr原子在光镊阵列中”、“演示了单原子制备和高保真成像”、“演示了边带冷却”等实验操作。；研究对象：基于锶原子光镊阵列的中红外平台，具体研究原子在亚波长间距下的集体发射现象（如超辐射和亚辐射），以及偶极多体物理、里德堡动力学和锶精细结构量子比特的增强控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用$^{88}$Sr原子光镊阵列实现了对2,923 nm中红外跃迁的操控，找到了一个魔幻捕获波长（597.14(3) nm），并实现了高保真度的单原子制备与成像，以及分辨边带冷却。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用$^{88}$Sr原子光镊阵列实现了对2,923 nm中红外跃迁的操控，找到了一个魔幻捕获波长（597.14(3) nm），并实现了高保真度的单原子制备与成像，以及分辨边带冷却。；创新点：首次在亚波长光镊阵列中利用锶原子的中红外跃迁（2,923 nm）构建实验平台，克服了可见/近红外波长下原子间距难以小于发射波长的挑战，为研究集体发射现象和偶极多体物理提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光学镊子阵列捕获$^{88}$Sr原子，利用中红外跃迁（$5s5p\:^{3}P_{2} \rightarrow\, 5s4d\:^{3}D_{3}$，波长2,923 nm），通过寻找魔幻波长实现原子捕获，并应用分辨边带冷却技术。

papers.title: Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: Strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB) has recently emerged as a useful framework for studying phases of matter in open systems, quantum or classical. Beginning with the simple idea of extending symmetry breaking to general mixed states, and the familiar equivalence between canonical and grand-canonical ensembles in statistical mechanics, the concept has grown into a unifying perspective connecting many different ideas in physics, including topological orders, emergent hydrodynamics, and information-theoretic characterization of phases of matter. This review provides a bird's-eye view of some of these recent developments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“framework”“unifying perspective”“review”，属于理论综述性质，未涉及具体实验或计算手段。；研究对象：开放系统（量子或经典）中混合态的对称性破缺现象，具体为“强到弱自发对称性破缺”（SW-SSB）这一概念框架及其在拓扑序、涌现流体动力学、物相信息论表征等领域的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强到弱自发对称性破缺（SW-SSB）为理解开放系统中的物质相提供了一个统一视角，能够连接拓扑序、涌现流体动力学和物相的信息论表征等多个物理概念。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强到弱自发对称性破缺（SW-SSB）为理解开放系统中的物质相提供了一个统一视角，能够连接拓扑序、涌现流体动力学和物相的信息论表征等多个物理概念。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出该框架将多个不同领域的物理思想（拓扑序、涌现流体动力学、信息论表征）统一到一个视角下，属于概念性综述与整合工作。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建与综述分析。基于将对称性破缺推广到一般混合态的思想，以及统计力学中正则系综与巨正则系综之间的等价关系，进行概念整合与统一视角的梳理。

papers.title: Spatial and particle-particle entanglement in 1D quantum walks of two distinguishable or indistinguishable bosonic particles
papers.abstract: We present entanglement measures between spatially separated regions and between two distinguishable or indistinguishable particles in one-dimensional two-particle continuous-time quantum walks governed by the Hubbard Hamiltonian. The left-right entanglement checks the entropy of coarse-grained states counting the numbers of particles on the left and right halves of the lattice while the particle-particle entanglement is based on the entropy of the singular values of the time-evolved Fock state. With separable, entangled, and doubly occupied initial states, we examine initial entanglement and the following growth in different entanglement measures. While the entanglement measures of the indistinguishable cases resemble those of the distinguishable cases when the initial states are comparable, the long-time limits of the entanglement measures are typically non-monotonic as the onsite repulsion increases. We also discuss possible implications for future research of entanglement in multi-particle quantum dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：entanglement measures（纠缠度量）、continuous-time quantum walks（连续时间量子行走）、Hubbard Hamiltonian（哈伯德哈密顿量）。；研究对象：一维双粒子连续时间量子行走中，可区分与不可区分玻色子之间的空间纠缠和粒子-粒子纠缠。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当初始态可比较时，不可区分玻色子的纠缠度量与可区分粒子的纠缠度量相似；但所有纠缠度量的长时间极限随在位排斥作用的增强通常呈现非单调变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当初始态可比较时，不可区分玻色子的纠缠度量与可区分粒子的纠缠度量相似；但所有纠缠度量的长时间极限随在位排斥作用的增强通常呈现非单调变化。；创新点：系统比较了可区分与不可区分玻色子在不同初始态（可分、纠缠、双占据）下的纠缠演化，并揭示了在位排斥作用对长时间极限纠缠的非单调影响。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于哈伯德哈密顿量描述的一维双粒子连续时间量子行走模型，通过计算左-右半格粗粒化态熵（空间纠缠）和含时福克态奇异值熵（粒子-粒子纠缠）来量化纠缠。

papers.title: Creating and Probing Spin-Squeezed States of Molecules
papers.abstract: Polar molecules are a promising platform for quantum-enhanced sensing and precision tests of fundamental physics, owing to their strong long-range dipolar interactions, broad sensitivity to electromagnetic fields, and sensitivity to potential physics beyond the Standard Model. However, the creation of metrologically useful entangled states in molecular systems has remained elusive. Here, we report the first observation of a class of metrologically useful entangled states - spin-squeezed states - in polar CaF molecules trapped in an optical tweezer array. The spin degree of freedom is encoded in rotational levels which are directly coupled by dipolar exchange interactions. By harnessing appropriate dynamical decoupling schemes we observe up to 3.0(3)dB of metrological gain, (2.2(3)dB without measurement correction) from direct exchange interactions. Using Floquet engineering, we further realize richer Hamiltonians that preserve spin squeezing while enabling the development of longer-range quantum correlations. Using site- and spin-resolved measurements we demonstrate that these entangled states enhance sensitivity to both homogeneous and spatially varying fields, and reveal strong non-classical correlations, including bipartite entanglement and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen steering. Finally, we transfer the spin-squeezed states into long-lived and non-interacting hyperfine states, where the metrological enhancement persists for up to 100ms. Our results establish molecular optical tweezer arrays as a scalable platform for generating, controlling, characterizing, and storing entangled states of molecules, opening new opportunities for quantum-enhanced sensing and precision tests of fundamental physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：report the first observation、experimental demonstration、site- and spin-resolved measurements。；研究对象：极性CaF分子，囚禁在光镊阵列中，利用转动能级编码自旋自由度，实现自旋压缩态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在分子系统中观测到自旋压缩态，实现了最高3.0(3) dB的计量增益，并证明这些纠缠态可增强对均匀和空间变化场的探测灵敏度，且计量增强可转移至长寿命超精细态并持续长达100 ms。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在分子系统中观测到自旋压缩态，实现了最高3.0(3) dB的计量增益，并证明这些纠缠态可增强对均匀和空间变化场的探测灵敏度，且计量增强可转移至长寿命超精细态并持续长达100 ms。；创新点：首次在分子系统中实验实现并表征了计量学有用的自旋压缩态，展示了分子光镊阵列作为可扩展平台用于生成、控制、表征和存储分子纠缠态的能力。
papers.method_zh: 利用光镊阵列囚禁CaF分子，通过偶极交换相互作用直接耦合转动能级；采用动力学去耦方案抑制退相干；使用Floquet工程实现更丰富的哈密顿量以保持自旋压缩并发展长程量子关联；通过位点分辨和自旋分辨测量表征纠缠态，并转移至非相互作用的超精细态进行存储。

papers.title: Speculative Sampling For Faster Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) is a key tool for simulating the dynamical behavior of atomic systems. However, MD is inherently serial, which makes it difficult to increase single-system throughput with concurrent compute. To address this, we introduce Langevin Speculative Dynamics (LSD), a distributed and model-agnostic speculative sampler for accelerating MD without adding relative error. Inspired by speculative methods in language and diffusion modeling, LSD uses a draft model to propose fast simulation steps and verifies them in parallel with a slower target model, applying a transport map from the draft to the target distribution. We extend speculative sampling to second-order Langevin dynamics, derive the achievable speedup as a function of physical parameters, show that LSD generalizes across different systems and draft-target combinations with a 3-9x speedup, and confirm theoretically and empirically that LSD samples trajectories from its target model distribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：speculative sampling、Langevin dynamics、distributed、model-agnostic。；研究对象：分子动力学（MD）模拟中的加速采样问题，具体针对原子系统的动力学行为模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出Langevin Speculative Dynamics（LSD）方法，可在不增加相对误差的前提下，将分子动力学模拟加速3-9倍，且理论上和数值上均证明该方法能从目标模型分布中正确采样轨迹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出Langevin Speculative Dynamics（LSD）方法，可在不增加相对误差的前提下，将分子动力学模拟加速3-9倍，且理论上和数值上均证明该方法能从目标模型分布中正确采样轨迹。；创新点：首次将投机采样思想系统性地应用于分子动力学模拟，并针对二阶朗之万动力学推导了加速比与物理参数的解析关系，同时验证了该方法在不同系统和草稿-目标模型组合下的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 采用受语言模型和扩散模型中的投机采样（speculative sampling）启发的分布式算法：使用一个快速“草稿模型”提出模拟步骤，再通过一个慢速“目标模型”并行验证，并引入传输映射（transport map）将草稿分布校正至目标分布。该方法将投机采样扩展至二阶朗之万动力学。

papers.title: Cumulant dynamics in finite-memory diffusion
papers.abstract: Fluctuations of conserved charges are among the main proposed signatures of the quantum chromodynamics (QCD) critical point, but their interpretation requires a dynamical description of how fluctuation correlators evolve during the finite lifetime of the quark--gluon plasma (QGP) fireball. The standard baseline for this evolution is Fickian diffusion, in which the diffusive current follows the local density gradient instantaneously. This instantaneous-current limit can miss delayed-response effects when the current-relaxation time becomes comparable to the relaxation time of the relevant fluctuation modes. In this work we extend this baseline to Maxwell--Cattaneo diffusion, where the current relaxes on a finite time scale and therefore retains memory. We derive closed evolution equations for multi-point Wigner functions and convert the freezeout correlators into acceptance-dependent cumulants along representative trajectories in the QCD phase diagram. While Fickian diffusion already causes the correlators to lag behind their instantaneous equilibrium values, finite current relaxation introduces an additional memory effect beyond this diffusive lag. As a result, current memory can suppress, shift, and reshape the non-monotonic behavior of the cumulants relative to both instantaneous equilibrium and Fickian diffusion, with the most visible effects appearing in higher-order cumulants and their ratios.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：推导演化方程、理论框架扩展（从Fickian扩散到Maxwell-Cattaneo扩散）。；研究对象：量子色动力学（QCD）临界点附近，夸克-胶子等离子体（QGP）火球中守恒荷涨落的动力学演化，特别是有限记忆扩散过程中的累积量行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限电流弛豫时间（即记忆效应）会抑制、移动和重塑累积量相对于瞬时平衡和Fickian扩散的非单调行为，且该效应在高阶累积量及其比值中最为显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限电流弛豫时间（即记忆效应）会抑制、移动和重塑累积量相对于瞬时平衡和Fickian扩散的非单调行为，且该效应在高阶累积量及其比值中最为显著。；创新点：首次在有限记忆扩散框架下系统研究电流弛豫时间对QCD临界点涨落累积量动力学的影响，揭示了超越Fickian扩散滞后的额外记忆效应。
papers.method_zh: 将标准Fickian扩散基线扩展为Maxwell-Cattaneo扩散模型，推导多点Wigner函数的封闭演化方程，并沿QCD相图代表性轨迹将冻结关联子转换为依赖于接收度的累积量。

papers.title: DPA4: Pushing the Accuracy-Cost Frontier of Interatomic Potentials with EMFA SO(2) Convolution
papers.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials now approach quantum-mechanical accuracy on standard benchmarks, but the training cost of the most expressive equivariant architectures has become a serious bottleneck. We introduce DPA4, an SE(3)-equivariant interatomic-potential architecture with an EMFA (Edge-conditioned, Multi-Focus, Attention) SO(2)-equivariant convolution that combines a low-rank edge-node SO(2)-equivariant product, a multi-focus design for message nonlinearity, and envelope-gated attention for message aggregation. A Lebedev-grid projection further preserves SO(3)-equivariance in the nonlinearity to machine precision. A compiler-friendly conservative energy-gradient training path provides up to $\sim$3 times wall-clock speedup under torch.compile. On the compliant Matbench Discovery benchmark, DPA4-Pro attains the best Combined Performance Score (CPS) on the leaderboard, while the 2.76M-parameter DPA4-Air exceeds the accuracy of the 30.1M-parameter eSEN-30M-MP baseline with 10.9$\times$ fewer parameters and 42.9$\times$ less training compute. On SPICE-MACE-OFF, the 5.4M-parameter DPA4-Plus lowers the aggregate molecular energy and force errors of the 6.5M-parameter eSEN baseline by 29% and 30%, while the 2.7M-parameter DPA4-Air still surpasses that baseline with $\sim$2.4$\times$ fewer parameters. Together these results place DPA4 on a new accuracy-cost Pareto frontier on Matbench Discovery and position it as a strong candidate backbone for future multi-task large atomistic model (LAM) pretraining.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、architecture、benchmark、training compute。；研究对象：论文研究的是机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potentials）的架构设计，具体针对的是等变（equivariant）势函数模型的精度与训练成本之间的权衡。未涉及特定材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DPA4架构通过引入EMFA SO(2)等变卷积、Lebedev网格投影和编译器友好的能量梯度训练路径，在Matbench Discovery基准上取得了最优的综合性能分数（CPS），并以更少的参数和训练计算量超越了现有大模型（如eSEN-30M-MP）的精度，将精度-成本帕累托前沿推向新水平。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DPA4架构通过引入EMFA SO(2)等变卷积、Lebedev网格投影和编译器友好的能量梯度训练路径，在Matbench Discovery基准上取得了最优的综合性能分数（CPS），并以更少的参数和训练计算量超越了现有大模型（如eSEN-30M-MP）的精度，将精度-成本帕累托前沿推向新水平。；创新点：首次将EMFA SO(2)等变卷积与多焦点注意力机制结合，并引入Lebedev网格投影以在非线性操作中精确保持SO(3)等变性，同时通过编译器优化实现约3倍的实际训练加速。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种新的SE(3)-等变原子间势架构DPA4，核心创新包括：EMFA（边条件多焦点注意力）SO(2)等变卷积（含低秩边-节点SO(2)等变乘积、多焦点消息非线性设计、包络门控注意力聚合）、用于保持非线性中SO(3)等变性的Lebedev网格投影，以及基于torch.compile的保守能量梯度训练路径。通过Matbench Discovery和SPICE-MACE-OFF基准测试进行性能评估。

papers.title: Optical Stability and Photophysics of NV Centers in Diamond up to 120 GPa
papers.abstract: The nitrogen vacancy (NV) center has emerged as a powerful quantum sensor in high-pressure research, with the observation of optically detected magnetic resonance at megabar pressures. However, some aspects of NV physics require further investigation to optimize the development of NV-based sensing under pressure. Here, we study both experimentally and theoretically the optical properties of the NV center under hydrostatic pressure. We investigate the evolution of the zero-phonon line (ZPL) position, radiative lifetimes, optical lineshapes, and photoionization thresholds of the NV center under pressures up to ~120 GPa. We also provide spectroscopic guidelines for performing high-pressure optical experiments. Our results confirm that the NV center remains a robust quantum sensor under extreme hydrostatic pressures, especially for magnetic characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。关键词：experimentally and theoretically、optical properties、photoionization thresholds。；研究对象：高压下金刚石中氮空位（NV）中心的光学性质，包括零声子线（ZPL）位置、辐射寿命、光学线形和光电离阈值。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NV中心在高达约120 GPa的静水压下仍保持稳定的光学性质，是一种鲁棒的极端高压量子传感器，尤其适用于磁学表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NV中心在高达约120 GPa的静水压下仍保持稳定的光学性质，是一种鲁棒的极端高压量子传感器，尤其适用于磁学表征。；创新点：系统研究了NV中心在兆巴（megabar）压力范围内的光学稳定性与光物理演化，并提供了高压光学实验的光谱学指导准则。
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量高压下NV中心的光学性质（ZPL、辐射寿命、线形、光电离阈值）；理论上进行相应计算分析。具体实验手段和计算方法摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Boulder Lectures on Thermal Dynamics and Hydrodynamic EFTs
papers.abstract: Fluctuating hydrodynamics emerges in essentially any local many-body system at nonzero temperature. Effective field theory (EFT) approaches enable the quantitative study of this emergence, providing a controlled framework to capture late-time observables. These lectures introduce the organizing principles behind equilibrium and out-of-equilibrium dynamics in these thermalizing systems. A central focus is the modern construction of these EFTs, which frames fluctuating hydrodynamics through the lens of "strong-to-weak" spontaneous symmetry breaking. Drawing examples from both high-energy and condensed matter physics, we show how this paradigm adapts to systems ranging from spin chains to relativistic quantum field theories, including models with generalized symmetries or symmetries with 't Hooft anomalies. Finally, we discuss UV/IR constraints on transport parameters -- viewed as the Wilson coefficients of hydrodynamic EFTs -- both in continuum and on the lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Effective field theory (EFT)、fluctuating hydrodynamics、spontaneous symmetry breaking、UV/IR constraints。；研究对象：热动力学与流体动力学有效场论（EFT）的构建原理，涵盖从自旋链到相对论量子场论等热化多体系统，包括具有广义对称性或't Hooft反常的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将涨落流体动力学重新理解为“强到弱”自发对称性破缺的现代EFT框架，并系统展示了该范式如何统一描述平衡与非平衡动力学，以及如何对输运参数（即流体动力学EFT的Wilson系数）施加UV/IR约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将涨落流体动力学重新理解为“强到弱”自发对称性破缺的现代EFT框架，并系统展示了该范式如何统一描述平衡与非平衡动力学，以及如何对输运参数（即流体动力学EFT的Wilson系数）施加UV/IR约束。；创新点：将涨落流体动力学通过“强到弱”自发对称性破缺的现代视角进行重新框架化，并系统讨论了该框架如何适应具有广义对称性或't Hooft反常的系统。摘要未突出说明与以往流体动力学EFT综述的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效场论（EFT）方法，基于“强到弱”自发对称性破缺的组织原理，结合高能物理与凝聚态物理中的实例（如自旋链、相对论量子场论、广义对称性模型），在连续介质和格点两种情形下分析输运参数的紫外/红外（UV/IR）约束。

papers.title: Co-condensation and multivalency enable acetylation-sensitive, concentration-robust assembly of BRD4 condensates
papers.abstract: Biomolecular condensates must assemble at specific locations and times inside living cells to perform their biological functions. However, it remains unclear how condensate formation achieves high spatiotemporal precision, responding sensitively to local chemical modifications while remaining robust to fluctuations in protein concentration. Here we study chromatin-associated BRD4 condensates to identify a physical mechanism that enables this combination of sensitivity and robustness. Using an ultra-coarse-grained molecular-dynamics model, we show that co-condensation of BRD4 with chromatin enables rapid assembly below the bulk coexistence concentration, thereby suppressing off-chromatin condensation and enhancing spatial selectivity. Multivalent binding between BRD4 and acetylated histone tails sharpens the dependence of co-condensation on acetylation density through combinatorial effects, increasing contrast between highly acetylated regions and weakly acetylated background chromatin. This mechanism explains how co-condensation and multivalent binding jointly enable sensitive yet robust spatiotemporal targeting by chromatin-associated condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：ultra-coarse-grained molecular-dynamics model，即超粗粒化分子动力学模型）；研究对象：BRD4凝聚体与染色质的共凝聚现象，以及乙酰化修饰对其形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BRD4与染色质的共凝聚机制能够同时实现两个看似矛盾的目标：对局部乙酰化修饰的灵敏响应，以及对蛋白质浓度波动的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BRD4与染色质的共凝聚机制能够同时实现两个看似矛盾的目标：对局部乙酰化修饰的灵敏响应，以及对蛋白质浓度波动的鲁棒性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 超粗粒化分子动力学模拟（ultra-coarse-grained molecular-dynamics model）。

papers.title: Information scrambling in all-to-all interacting models
papers.abstract: Information scrambling is a hallmark of quantum chaos and thermalization in isolated quantum many-body systems. We investigate scrambling dynamics in the all-to-all interacting spin Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK)-$q$ model using both pure- and mixed-state entanglement measures. We show that von-Neumann and Rényi entropies exhibit rapid growth followed by saturation near Haar-random values, signaling efficient scrambling. The scrambling rate reveals a nontrivial dependence on the interaction order, system size, and Hamiltonian scaling. We further employ mixed-state entanglement as a powerful probe of information scrambling. We numerically find a universal relation between the Rényi-1/2 mutual information and entanglement negativity for minimal interaction order in the early growth regime. Furthermore, entanglement negativity displays a Page-curve-like behavior under unequal subsystem partitioning, characterized by the birth, spread, and eventual death of quantum correlations. Our results provide a generic description of information scrambling using entanglement dynamics in all-to-all interacting spin systems with multi-body interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、numerically find、provide a generic description（理论分析与数值计算结合）。；研究对象：全连接相互作用自旋模型（all-to-all interacting spin Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK)-q 模型）中的信息扰乱（information scrambling）动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现纠缠熵（von-Neumann熵与Rényi熵）在早期快速增长后趋于Haar随机值，表明高效的信息扰乱；纠缠负性（entanglement negativity）在不等分子系统划分下呈现类似Page曲线的行为，展示了量子关联的诞生、传播与最终消亡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现纠缠熵（von-Neumann熵与Rényi熵）在早期快速增长后趋于Haar随机值，表明高效的信息扰乱；纠缠负性（entanglement negativity）在不等分子系统划分下呈现类似Page曲线的行为，展示了量子关联的诞生、传播与最终消亡。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用纯态与混合态纠缠度量（von-Neumann熵、Rényi熵、Rényi-1/2互信息、纠缠负性）分析SYK-q模型中的扰乱动力学，并数值研究扰乱速率对相互作用阶数、系统尺寸和哈密顿量标度的依赖关系。

papers.title: Information Hierarchy in Many-Body Berry Phase
papers.abstract: Many-body topology is a central concept in modern theories of solids, and identifying effective degrees of freedom that capture it is important both fundamentally and practically. This work studies the extent to which geometric information of an interacting many-body ground state can be inferred from a finite number of local correlations. Starting from the Resta formula, $ z=\left\langle \exp\!\left(\frac{2πi}{L}\hat X\right)\right\rangle$, we view $\log z$ as the cumulant generating function and establish a generic information hierarchy across cumulant orders. We show that, for an $N$-particle system, even complete knowledge of all density correlators up to order $N-1$ does not, in general, uniquely determine the Berry phase $γ=\operatorname{Im}\log z \, (\mathrm{mod}\ 2π)$. In the thermodynamic limit, the statement becomes stronger: no finite set of local correlators suffices to determine the global holonomy. We also identify two exceptional yes-go cases in which the hierarchy is broken. First, for quasi-free models, all cumulants are determined by the particle two-point correlation function. Second, symmetry-enforced constraints can reduce the infinite cumulant sum entering $\log z$ to finite information. The argument is analytic and does not rely on a specific microscopic Hamiltonian. Our results clarify a limitation of approaches based on local degrees of freedom for many-body holonomy and provide a minimal framework for distinguishing when global holonomies are encoded in local correlations and when they are not. We also comment on the possibility of analogous hierarchies in other contexts, such as the quantum marginal problem in quantum information theory and many-body scattering problems. Finally, we discuss implications for future numerical work, including machine-learning approaches to the search for topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytic argument、cumulant generating function、thermodynamic limit、no specific microscopic Hamiltonian。；研究对象：多体贝里相位（many-body Berry phase）中的信息层级结构，具体研究从有限局域关联推断多体基态几何信息的可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于N粒子系统，即使完全知道所有密度关联函数（最高至N-1阶），通常也无法唯一确定贝里相位；在热力学极限下，任何有限局域关联集合都不足以确定全局和乐（holonomy）。仅存在两种例外情况：准自由模型和对称性约束系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于N粒子系统，即使完全知道所有密度关联函数（最高至N-1阶），通常也无法唯一确定贝里相位；在热力学极限下，任何有限局域关联集合都不足以确定全局和乐（holonomy）。仅存在两种例外情况：准自由模型和对称性约束系统。；创新点：首次系统建立了多体贝里相位中局域关联与全局几何信息之间的信息层级关系，严格证明了有限局域关联无法确定全局和乐的一般性结论，并识别了两种例外情况。同时将这一层级结构类比到量子信息中的量子边缘问题与多体散射问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于Resta公式 \( z=\left\langle \exp\!\left(\frac{2πi}{L}\hat X\right)\right\rangle \)，将 \(\log z\) 视为累积量生成函数，通过分析累积量展开的层级结构进行严格解析论证，不依赖具体微观哈密顿量。

papers.title: Ultrafast internal dynamics of chiral domain walls probed by time-resolved XRMS
papers.abstract: We measure picosecond dynamics of labyrinthine stripe domains with chiral Néel-type domain walls using time-resolved x-ray resonant magnetic scattering (XRMS). At the stripe-domain wavevector, the helicity-summed signal shows ultrafast demagnetization, recovery, and a weak oscillatory contribution that we identify as a signature of laser-launched coherent surface phonons. In contrast, the dichroic signal, which is sensitive to the in-plane magnetization inside the Néel walls, shows a strong oscillatory response whose frequency decreases with increasing pump fluence. We attribute this softening to pump-induced changes in the effective anisotropy and saturation magnetization, which modify the restoring field of an internal domain-wall mode. Time-resolved XRMS thus isolates wall-specific dynamics and provides access to internal domain-wall motion in disordered stripe textures on picosecond time scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“time-resolved x-ray resonant magnetic scattering (XRMS)”、“measure”、“probed”。；研究对象：手性Néel型畴壁的迷宫条纹畴（labyrinthine stripe domains with chiral Néel-type domain walls），具体关注其内部超快动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过时间分辨X射线共振磁散射（XRMS）区分了畴壁内部动力学与整体磁化响应，发现手性Néel畴壁中存在一种内禀振荡模式，其频率随泵浦光通量增加而软化，归因于泵浦诱导的有效各向异性和饱和磁化强度变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过时间分辨X射线共振磁散射（XRMS）区分了畴壁内部动力学与整体磁化响应，发现手性Néel畴壁中存在一种内禀振荡模式，其频率随泵浦光通量增加而软化，归因于泵浦诱导的有效各向异性和饱和磁化强度变化。；创新点：利用XRMS的二向色信号直接探测Néel畴壁内部的面内磁化动力学，从而将畴壁特有的振荡模式与整体退磁、声子等背景信号分离，实现了对无序条纹畴中畴壁内部模式在皮秒时间尺度上的观测。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨X射线共振磁散射（time-resolved XRMS），结合泵浦-探测技术，测量皮秒时间尺度上的螺旋度求和信号（helicity-summed signal）与二向色信号（dichroic signal）。

papers.title: Attention-Like Hebbian Learning from Quantum Probability Flow and Quantum-Annealer Tests
papers.abstract: We propose a quantum probability-flow principle for deriving local learning rules in associative memory. A transverse field defines leakage channels from data states, and minimizing the measured survival loss gives stability-driven updates. For imaginary-time, dephased dynamics, the local leakage free energy is the log-sum-exp of energy gaps; its gradient is a softmax-weighted Hebbian rule. Real-time stability instead yields a power-law weighting. D-Wave standard- and fast-anneal tests of a one-hot attention forward map are better fitted by an effective softmax than by a Lorentzian power law.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据：提出量子概率流原理推导局部学习规则，并基于D-Wave量子退火器进行数值测试。；研究对象：联想记忆（associative memory）中的局部学习规则，具体涉及量子概率流驱动的Hebbian学习机制，以及单热注意力前向映射（one-hot attention forward map）的稳定性分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过量子概率流原理，推导出虚时退相动力学下的局部学习规则为软最大化（softmax）加权的Hebbian规则，而实时稳定性则产生幂律加权；D-Wave退火实验表明，单热注意力前向映射更符合有效软最大化模型而非洛伦兹幂律模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过量子概率流原理，推导出虚时退相动力学下的局部学习规则为软最大化（softmax）加权的Hebbian规则，而实时稳定性则产生幂律加权；D-Wave退火实验表明，单热注意力前向映射更符合有效软最大化模型而非洛伦兹幂律模型。；创新点：将量子概率流概念与联想记忆的局部学习规则建立直接联系，并首次在量子退火器上实验验证了软最大化加权Hebbian规则优于幂律加权规则。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于量子概率流原理，引入横向场定义数据态的泄漏通道，通过最小化测量存活损失（measured survival loss）得到稳定性驱动的更新规则。数值测试：使用D-Wave标准退火和快速退火（fast-anneal）对单热注意力前向映射进行实验拟合，比较软最大化与洛伦兹幂律的拟合优度。

papers.title: Successes and challenges of using Semidefinite Programming for the study of Spin Chain Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: We study semidefinite programming (SDP) methods to analyze spin chain Hamiltonians. We examine the ground state energy, the first excited charged states and ground state correlators in two simple models: the Ising model in a transverse magnetic field and the closely related 3-state Potts model. Our goal is to understand precisely what the SDP program is doing and when it works well, why it does so. We focus on the following novel ingredients: using charge constraints to obtain excited states and to see if additional constraints from integrable models are effective at improving the method. At criticality we also explore to what extent we can use approximate Virasoro correlators to extract conformal data: the central charge and some critical exponents of charged states. We also use these to identify the location of the phase transition. In the special case where the system is made of free fermions we prove that the SDP finds the exact energy of the ground state and produces the correct two point functions of the fermions. Away from free fermion theories, the SDP gets progressively worse at estimating data beyond the value of the ground state energy (like correlation functions), although it qualitatively matches these. In order to be effective, the SDP seems to run into scaling issues where the amount of input needed scales poorly with the lattice volume.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：semidefinite programming (SDP)、spin chain Hamiltonians、ground state energy、correlators。；研究对象：自旋链哈密顿量，具体包括横场伊辛模型（Ising model in a transverse magnetic field）和3态波茨模型（3-state Potts model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SDP方法在自由费米子体系中能精确给出基态能量和费米子两点关联函数；但在非自由费米子体系中，除基态能量外，对关联函数等数据的估计质量逐渐变差，且所需输入量随晶格体积增长而扩展性不佳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SDP方法在自由费米子体系中能精确给出基态能量和费米子两点关联函数；但在非自由费米子体系中，除基态能量外，对关联函数等数据的估计质量逐渐变差，且所需输入量随晶格体积增长而扩展性不佳。；创新点：系统评估了SDP在自旋链模型中的表现，特别是：1）利用电荷约束获取激发态；2）检验可积模型附加约束对方法的改进效果；3）在临界点利用近似Virasoro关联函数提取共形数据。摘要未突出说明与已有SDP研究相比的其他具体创新点。
papers.method_zh: 使用半定规划（Semidefinite Programming, SDP）方法分析自旋链哈密顿量。具体包括：利用电荷约束（charge constraints）获取激发态；检验可积模型附加约束的有效性；在临界点使用近似Virasoro关联函数提取共形场数据（中心荷、临界指数）并识别相变位置。

papers.title: Bragg-enhanced time-domain Brillouin scattering from a propagating acoustic grating
papers.abstract: Generation and detection of coherent phonons in semiconductors by femtosecond optical pulses is a powerful tool for high-frequency acoustic control of their electronic properties. Here, we demonstrate a propagating one-dimensional acoustic grating in bulk semiconductors using above-band-gap excitation by a train of laser pulses with high repetition rate of 1 GHz. This approach enables shaping of the coherent acoustic phonon spectrum and leads to a significant enhancement of Brillouin light scattering at selected probe wavelengths in pump-probe configuration. We demonstrate this effect at a cryogenic temperature of 5 K in prototypical semiconductor systems, namely bulk crystalline GaAs and (Cd,Zn)Te, which serve as benchmark materials for the proposed method. The spectral dependence of the time-domain Brillouin light scattering amplitude exhibits resonant peaks at discrete probe wavelengths arising from Bragg reflection of the probe light by the propagating acoustic grating. A 10-30-fold resonant enhancement of the signal amplitude is observed for GaAs and (Cd,Zn)Te, determined by the finite spectral width of the probe pulse. With further spectral narrowing, enhancements of the order ~ 100-150 are expected, set by the number N of strain pulses in the acoustic grating within the sample and ultimately limited by the material parameters and sample thickness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验手段（飞秒光脉冲激发、泵浦-探测配置）和实验观测（布里渊散射增强、共振峰）。；研究对象：体相半导体中的一维传播声学光栅，具体材料为体相晶态GaAs和(Cd,Zn)Te，以及由高重复频率激光脉冲激发的相干声子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用1 GHz高重复频率激光脉冲列在体相半导体中激发传播的一维声学光栅，实现了对相干声子谱的整形，并在特定探测波长下观察到布里渊光散射信号的10-30倍共振增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用1 GHz高重复频率激光脉冲列在体相半导体中激发传播的一维声学光栅，实现了对相干声子谱的整形，并在特定探测波长下观察到布里渊光散射信号的10-30倍共振增强。；创新点：利用高重复频率（1 GHz）激光脉冲列在体相半导体中构建传播的声学光栅，通过布拉格反射机制显著增强特定探测波长下的时域布里渊散射信号，并指出通过进一步窄化探测光谱可实现约100-150倍的增强。
papers.method_zh: 采用飞秒光脉冲的泵浦-探测技术，泵浦光为高于带隙的激发，重复频率为1 GHz；通过时域布里渊散射测量探测光散射振幅的光谱依赖关系，并在5 K低温下进行实验。

papers.title: Coherent Exchange and Decoherence in Dirac-Spin-Liquid Quantum Interconnects
papers.abstract: We develop a susceptibility-based open-system theory for two localized qubits coupled through a candidate two-dimensional $\mathrm{U}(1)$ Dirac-spin-liquid-like bath. The central input is the gauge-invariant retarded physical spin susceptibility $\Chi^R(q,ω)$ of the bath. We show that this single response kernel controls both coherent and dissipative qubit dynamics: its real part generates the nonlocal mediated exchange, while its absorptive part determines relaxation and dephasing through the equilibrium noise spectrum. This gives a unified reduced two-qubit description in which the usefulness of the bath as an entanglement bus is governed by the competition between susceptibility-mediated exchange and bath-induced decoherence. As an analytically transparent benchmark, we evaluate the spinon mean-field Dirac susceptibility and recover the static algebraic exchange $J_{\mathrm{eff}}(R)\propto J_{\rm local}^2/(v_F R^3)$, together with pseudogap-suppressed relaxation $Γ_1\propto J_{\rm local}^2ω_0^3/v_F^4$. We then formulate a beyond-mean-field extension in which gauge-field dressing and other interaction effects are absorbed into a dressed physical susceptibility, without changing the reduced qubit-sector mapping. The resulting framework provides a direct route from the many-body spin response of a correlated two-dimensional bath to reduced-dynamics simulations of entanglement generation, coherence loss, and the operational phase space of a candidate Dirac spin-liquid quantum interconnect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：open-system theory、susceptibility-based、beyond-mean-field extension。；研究对象：两个局域量子比特通过候选二维U(1)狄拉克自旋液体（Dirac spin liquid）作为量子互连（quantum interconnect）的耦合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 狄拉克自旋液体浴的物理自旋磁化率（susceptibility）同时控制量子比特间的相干交换和退相干，其相干交换随距离呈代数衰减（J_eff ∝ 1/R³），而弛豫率被赝能隙抑制（Γ₁ ∝ ω₀³）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：狄拉克自旋液体浴的物理自旋磁化率（susceptibility）同时控制量子比特间的相干交换和退相干，其相干交换随距离呈代数衰减（J_eff ∝ 1/R³），而弛豫率被赝能隙抑制（Γ₁ ∝ ω₀³）。；创新点：建立了从关联二维浴的多体自旋响应直接映射到约化双量子比特动力学的统一框架，揭示了磁化率实部（相干交换）与虚部（退相干）的竞争关系，并提供了可解析计算的狄拉克自旋液体基准模型。
papers.method_zh: 基于磁化率的开放系统理论（susceptibility-based open-system theory），利用规范不变的推迟物理自旋磁化率χ^R(q,ω)作为核心输入；在平均场层面采用自旋子（spinon）狄拉克磁化率解析计算；并发展了超越平均场（beyond-mean-field）的扩展方法，将规范场修饰等相互作用效应吸收进修饰后的物理磁化率中。

papers.title: Smooth velocity shuttling for suppressing valley excitations in disordered Si/SiGe quantum dots
papers.abstract: Coherent electron shuttling is a key requirement for realizing scalable silicon quantum computing architectures. However, in silicon qubits, the existence of nearly degenerate conduction-band valleys poses a significant challenge because non-adiabatic transitions to excited valley states cause spin dephasing via spin-valley mixing. In this paper, we propose a smooth velocity shuttling protocol to suppress these valley excitations. By mapping the time-domain design of the shuttling velocity profile onto the design problem of window functions in signal processing, we establish an analytical and intuitive design guideline that does not require computationally expensive numerical optimization. We demonstrate that the high-frequency sidelobes of the shuttling velocity spectrum can be effectively suppressed by applying a frequency-modulated gate voltage based on the Tukey window. Through numerical simulations incorporating realistic spatial randomness of the valley landscape, we show that the proposed smooth velocity control significantly reduces the average spin infidelity in the moderate-to-low disorder regime ($|Δ_0|/σ_Δ\simeq \mathcal{O}(1)$). Furthermore, we clarify that in devices designed with a large deterministic valley coupling $|Δ_0|$, combining it with this smoothing technique improves robustness against valley disorder. Our results underscore that this simple, control-level velocity shaping provides a robust pathway toward high-fidelity spin transport in large-scale silicon quantum processors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“propose a smooth velocity shuttling protocol”、“mapping the time-domain design...onto the design problem of window functions”、“through numerical simulations”。；研究对象：Si/SiGe量子点中的电子相干输运，具体关注谷激发（valley excitations）对自旋退相干的抑制问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于Tukey窗函数的平滑速度穿梭协议，通过抑制穿梭速度频谱的高频旁瓣，可显著降低中等至低无序度Si/SiGe量子点中的谷激发概率，从而提升自旋输运保真度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于Tukey窗函数的平滑速度穿梭协议，通过抑制穿梭速度频谱的高频旁瓣，可显著降低中等至低无序度Si/SiGe量子点中的谷激发概率，从而提升自旋输运保真度。；创新点：提出一种无需复杂数值优化的解析化速度轮廓设计准则，将信号处理中的窗函数概念引入量子点电子穿梭控制，为大规模硅量子处理器中的高保真自旋输运提供了简单、鲁棒的控制层解决方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟。将穿梭速度轮廓的时域设计映射为信号处理中的窗函数设计问题，采用Tukey窗函数对栅极电压进行频率调制，并结合包含真实空间谷无序度的数值模拟验证效果。

papers.title: Magneto-optical characterization of GeSn and GeSn/SiGeSn heterostructures
papers.abstract: Hole spin qubits in germanium (Ge)-based heterostructures have demonstrated their potential for scalable quantum information processing using all-electrical gate operations. Furthermore, the emerging material platform of germanium-tin (GeSn) can feature a direct bandgap, which makes it promising for establishing spin-photon interfaces for quantum networking. Here, we perform magneto-photoluminescence measurements of a Ge0.88Sn0.12/Si0.02Ge0.89Sn0.09 double quantum well using the double modulation Fourier transform infrared-based photoluminescence spectroscopy. Our measurements reveal theoretically expected diamagnetic shift at low magnetic fields as well as the linear trend of zeroth-level Landau quantization at higher fields and Zeeman-induced polarization-dependent energy shifts at +/- 12 T. We extract an effective g-factor of ~ 2 and an excitonic reduced mass of ~ 0.04 me consistent with previous estimations for heavy-hole Γ-valley excitons. The observation of sizable Zeeman splitting is consistent with strong spin-orbit interaction in Ge-based hole systems, which can enable electrically driven spin control. Our analysis can be adopted for studying and evaluating group-IV semiconductor heterostructures as hosts for hole spin qubits toward scalable quantum information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magneto-photoluminescence measurements、double modulation Fourier transform infrared-based photoluminescence spectroscopy。；研究对象：GeSn/SiGeSn双量子阱异质结构，具体为Ge0.88Sn0.12/Si0.02Ge0.89Sn0.09双量子阱，以及其中的重空穴Γ-谷激子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在GeSn/SiGeSn双量子阱中观测到低磁场下的抗磁位移、高磁场下的零级朗道量子化线性趋势以及±12 T下塞曼分裂导致的偏振依赖能量位移，提取的有效g因子约为2，激子约化质量约为0.04 me，与重空穴Γ-谷激子的理论预期一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在GeSn/SiGeSn双量子阱中观测到低磁场下的抗磁位移、高磁场下的零级朗道量子化线性趋势以及±12 T下塞曼分裂导致的偏振依赖能量位移，提取的有效g因子约为2，激子约化质量约为0.04 me，与重空穴Γ-谷激子的理论预期一致。；创新点：首次在GeSn/SiGeSn双量子阱体系中通过磁光光致发光实验系统表征了重空穴Γ-谷激子的抗磁位移、朗道量子化和塞曼分裂，并提取了关键参数（g因子、约化质量），为评估该体系作为空穴自旋量子比特宿主材料提供了实验依据。摘要未突出说明与已有Ge基量子阱研究的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用双调制傅里叶变换红外光致发光光谱技术进行磁光光致发光测量。

papers.title: Self-Revising Discovery Systems for Science: A Categorical Framework for Agentic Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery is not only answer generation but revision of the representational regime in which evidence, artifacts, operations, and verifiers are typed. We develop a category-theoretic account of agentic discovery for materials science. In a fixed regime b with schema category S_b, the system state is a copresheaf I_t: S_b -> Set, and provenance is the category of elements \int_{S_b} I_t. Fixed-regime operation is an update on such states, endofunctorial only when provenance-preserving refinements are specified and preserved. Discovery is instead a verified regime transition u: S_b -> S_b': old artifacts are preserved, transported by the left Kan extension Lan_u I_t, and compared with the post-transition state to identify residual content beyond functorial transport. This separates retrieval, search, and discovery without subjective novelty. We instantiate the framework in two systems. In Builder/Breaker, a protein-mechanics world model is revised under a Minimum Description Length gate; the accepted law expresses within-chain flexibility as all-mode elastic compliance conditioned by slow collective-mode participation, or mode-conditioned compliance. In CategoryScienceClaw, typed skills, artifacts, open needs, workflow mutation, gates, stress tests, and public discourse become a proof-carrying knowledge-computation graph. A fiber-network example records candidate models, rejected alternatives, an AIC gate, perturbation tests, and an accepted orientation-tensor anisotropic stiffness surrogate over an isotropic fiber-count descriptor. Together, the cases show how category theory can be both a mathematical language for discovery and an engineering specification for self-revising AI discovery systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：category-theoretic account、categorical framework、mathematical language for discovery）；研究对象：材料科学中的自主科学发现系统，具体涉及蛋白质力学世界模型（Builder/Breaker）和纤维网络各向异性刚度代理模型（CategoryScienceClaw）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个基于范畴论的框架，将科学发现形式化为“表征体制的修正”（regime transition），并通过左Kan扩展实现旧人工制品的保真迁移与残差内容的识别，从而区分检索、搜索与发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个基于范畴论的框架，将科学发现形式化为“表征体制的修正”（regime transition），并通过左Kan扩展实现旧人工制品的保真迁移与残差内容的识别，从而区分检索、搜索与发现。；创新点：将范畴论同时作为科学发现的数学语言和自修正AI发现系统的工程规范，通过“体制迁移”而非主观新颖性来定义发现，并提供了两个具体实现案例。
papers.method_zh: 范畴论（copresheaf、category of elements、endofunctor、left Kan extension）；在Builder/Breaker系统中使用最小描述长度（MDL）门控；在CategoryScienceClaw中使用AIC门控、扰动测试、知识计算图。

papers.title: Stabilization of Granovskii-Zhedanov scars of the XYZ quantum spin chain via non-Hermitian spin relaxation
papers.abstract: The Granovskii-Zhedanov (GZ) states are exact scar states of the spin-S XYZ chain for S >= 1. As a result, local quantum information encoded in a GZ state remains preserved under the unitary dynamics of the XYZ Hamiltonian; thus, these states evade thermalization and violate ergodicity despite the system being otherwise nonintegrable and chaotic. However, in realistic experimental settings, the realization of an ideal XYZ Hamiltonian is not possible, as perturbations are inevitable. These perturbations ultimately lead to the decay and thermalization of the GZ state. We study the stability and dynamics of GZ states in the presence of generic perturbations and propose physically realistic mechanisms to stabilize them. We show that the product structure of the GZ state allows its lifetime to be enhanced in the presence of an external helical magnetic field, which slows down thermalization but does not prevent it at long times. We further demonstrate that the inclusion of effective non-Hermitian spin relaxation processes can substantially stabilize the GZ states, leading to a nonequilibrium steady state with finite fidelity with GZ state. Such dissipative processes can naturally originate from mechanisms such as Purcell-enhanced spontaneous emission or spin-lattice relaxation in the presence of the helical magnetic field. Using infinite time-evolving block decimation and exact time evolution, we systematically analyze the dynamics and robustness of the GZ states in the perturbed non-Hermitian XYZ model. To connect with experimental platforms, we introduce a Hubbard model that maps onto the XYZ spin system and propose that ring-shaped optical lattices may provide a viable route for realizing and stabilizing GZ states. Finally, we present an equivalent Lindblad description of the effective non-Hermitian dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算混合型。关键词：非厄米自旋弛豫、无限时间演化块消减（iTEBD）、精确时间演化、Lindblad描述。；研究对象：XYZ量子自旋链中的Granovskii-Zhedanov（GZ）疤痕态，以及其在非厄米自旋弛豫和螺旋磁场下的稳定性与动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在存在一般性微扰时，GZ疤痕态会衰变并热化；但通过引入有效非厄米自旋弛豫过程（如Purcell增强自发辐射或自旋-晶格弛豫），可以显著稳定GZ态，形成具有有限保真度的非平衡稳态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在存在一般性微扰时，GZ疤痕态会衰变并热化；但通过引入有效非厄米自旋弛豫过程（如Purcell增强自发辐射或自旋-晶格弛豫），可以显著稳定GZ态，形成具有有限保真度的非平衡稳态。；创新点：首次提出通过非厄米自旋弛豫机制来稳定XYZ链中的GZ疤痕态，并展示了其在长时间尺度上抵抗热化的能力，同时提供了与冷原子实验平台（环形光晶格）的具体连接方案。
papers.method_zh: 使用无限时间演化块消减（iTEBD）和精确时间演化方法，系统分析了受扰非厄米XYZ模型中GZ态的动力学和鲁棒性；并引入一个可映射到XYZ自旋系统的Hubbard模型，提出环形光晶格作为实验实现平台；最后给出了等效的Lindblad主方程描述。

papers.title: Magnum.np.distributed: Accelerating Finite Difference Micromagnetic Simulations with Multiple GPUs
papers.abstract: Micromagnetic simulations are essential tools in nanomagnetism and spintronics research. Although widely adopted solvers like Mumax3 and the Python-native magnum.np use GPU acceleration to improve performance, these tools are limited to single-device computation. In this work, we present the first Python-native multi-GPU micromagnetic framework by extending magnum.np with PyTorch Distributed. This leverages high-speed communication and computation across multiple GPUs while retaining the benefits of ease of installation, platform-agnostic design, and compatibility with Python. For computationally intensive demagnetisation effective-field calculations, we achieve a 7.0x speedup across 8 GPUs connected via NVLink, whereas Halo exchange required for Heisenberg exchange shows limited scaling due to kernel dispatch latency. We also demonstrated the framework's versatility by achieving a 6.8x speedup in demagnetisation field computation on CPU with NUMA pinning via the MPI backend of PyTorch Distributed. Faster turnaround times will enable researchers to explore larger, more complex systems and accelerate the design cycle for novel spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：micromagnetic simulations（微磁模拟）、GPU acceleration（GPU加速）、multi-GPU framework（多GPU框架）。；研究对象：微磁学模拟中的有限差分方法，具体针对纳米磁学和自旋电子学研究中常用的微磁模拟计算（如退磁场有效场计算和海森堡交换作用计算）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将magnum.np扩展为支持PyTorch Distributed的多GPU框架，在8块NVLink连接的GPU上实现了退磁场有效场计算7.0倍加速；在CPU上通过NUMA绑定和MPI后端实现了6.8倍加速，但海森堡交换作用的Halo交换因内核调度延迟而扩展性有限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将magnum.np扩展为支持PyTorch Distributed的多GPU框架，在8块NVLink连接的GPU上实现了退磁场有效场计算7.0倍加速；在CPU上通过NUMA绑定和MPI后端实现了6.8倍加速，但海森堡交换作用的Halo交换因内核调度延迟而扩展性有限。；创新点：首次实现了Python原生的多GPU微磁模拟框架，突破了现有工具（如Mumax3和magnum.np）仅支持单设备计算的限制，同时保持了易安装、平台无关和Python兼容性。
papers.method_zh: 基于Python原生微磁模拟库magnum.np，利用PyTorch Distributed实现多GPU并行计算，支持NVLink高速通信和MPI后端（用于CPU集群）。具体测试了退磁场有效场计算和海森堡交换作用的Halo交换两种典型计算任务。

papers.title: Property Prediction of Stacked Bilayer Materials: A Multimodal Learning Approach
papers.abstract: AI for materials science is a critical topic within AI for science, aiming to accelerate materials discovery and produce accurate property predictions. Bilayer 2D material stacking is essential for exploring new materials with novel functions and inherent phenomena, enabling the creation of new 2D bilayers for diverse real-world applications. Research on bilayer vdWs materials has made significant progress from experimental and computational perspectives. Various bilayer materials have been successfully synthe sized experimentally and the increasing utilization of high-throughput computing technology has con structed several computational two-dimensional materials databases. However, the use of AI to model bilayer stacking and predict new properties remains underexplored, necessitating further research studies. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal learning approach to study the interfaces between dissimilar materials that jointly enable new or multiple functions, and to predict new properties arising from the vertical integration (stacking) of different functional material layers under given configurations. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach compared to baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/AnVuong123/bimat ml.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“high-throughput computing technology”、“computational two-dimensional materials databases”、“multimodal learning approach”以及提供代码链接，属于AI驱动的计算方法研究。；研究对象：双层二维材料（bilayer 2D materials），特别是通过垂直堆叠（stacking）不同功能材料层形成的异质结界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种多模态学习方法，能够有效预测不同材料层在给定堆叠构型下产生的新性质，且性能优于基线方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种多模态学习方法，能够有效预测不同材料层在给定堆叠构型下产生的新性质，且性能优于基线方法。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：将多模态学习应用于双层材料堆叠性质预测，弥补了AI在该领域应用不足的空白。
papers.method_zh: 多模态学习（multimodal learning）方法，用于建模双层材料堆叠界面并预测性质。具体技术细节摘要未明确说明，但提供了开源代码（GitHub仓库）。

papers.title: Surface Excitations, Energy Loss, and Decoherence in Electron Interferometry
