papers.abstract: We develop a mode-resolved description of decoherence in split-beam electron interferometry near dielectric surfaces, and show how it connects to models from electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS). The central result is that the decoherence rate is a weighted integral over the differential EELS spectrum, with a factor $1-\cos(k_x d)$ encoding the path distinguishability of the two electron trajectories. Incorporating retardation and thermal occupation reproduces the macroscopic QED model of Scheel and Buhmann. We compare non-retarded vs. retarded and non-thermal vs. thermally weighted variants of the model against published results from Kerker et al., finding that both retardation and finite temperature are required for reasonable quantitative agreement. The thermal weighting suggests an application: fringe visibility as a near-field thermometric probe of the substrate, sensitive to the evanescent regime inaccessible to far-field methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“develop a mode-resolved description”、“show how it connects to models”、“reproduces the macroscopic QED model”等关键词，表明工作核心是发展理论模型和进行理论比较。；研究对象：电子干涉测量中，靠近介电表面时发生的退相干现象。具体体系为分束电子干涉仪，物理现象包括表面激发、能量损失和退相干。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子干涉测量中的退相干率可以表示为微分电子能量损失谱（EELS）的加权积分，权重因子 $1-\cos(k_x d)$ 编码了两条电子轨迹的路径可区分性。同时，同时考虑延迟效应和有限温度是定量复现已有实验结果的关键。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子干涉测量中的退相干率可以表示为微分电子能量损失谱（EELS）的加权积分，权重因子 $1-\cos(k_x d)$ 编码了两条电子轨迹的路径可区分性。同时，同时考虑延迟效应和有限温度是定量复现已有实验结果的关键。；创新点：1. 建立了电子干涉测量中退相干率与微分EELS谱之间的直接、定量的解析联系。2. 揭示了延迟效应和有限温度对于定量准确描述该退相干过程的必要性。3. 提出了一个潜在应用：利用干涉条纹可见度作为近场温度计，探测远场方法无法触及的倏逝波区域。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型比较。具体包括：发展了一个基于模式分辨的退相干描述；将该描述与电子能量损失谱（EELS）模型建立联系；通过引入延迟效应和热占据，复现了Scheel和Buhmann的宏观量子电动力学（QED）模型；并将非延迟、非热模型与延迟、热模型与Kerker等人的已发表结果进行了定量比较。

papers.title: A first-order formulation for axisymmetric Willmore surfaces
papers.abstract: We show that axisymmetric Willmore surfaces admit a first-order formulation obtained by combining two independent first integrals. If $ρ$ denotes the distance from the axis of revolution and $Ψ=\sinψ$, where $ψ$ is the tangent angle of the generating curve, then the profile satisfies \begin{equation*} \frac{\left[Ψ(ρΨ'-Ψ)^2+2(ρΨ'-Ψ)+2C_1ρ\right]^2}{1-Ψ^2} +\left[(ρΨ'-Ψ)^2-2\right]^2=C_2, \end{equation*} where $C_1$ and $C_2$ are constants of integration and the prime denotes differentiation with respect to $ρ$. This equation reduces the axisymmetric Willmore equation to a first-order ordinary differential equation and provides a convenient classification scheme for Willmore surfaces of revolution. The sphere and the Clifford torus are discussed as elementary checks of the formulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学推导、守恒量、微分方程降阶等理论分析，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：轴对称Willmore曲面（axisymmetric Willmore surfaces），即旋转曲面中使Willmore能量取极值的曲面，属于微分几何与凝聚态物理中膜形态的交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合两个独立的第一积分，将轴对称Willmore曲面的控制方程降为一阶常微分方程，并给出了生成曲线所满足的显式方程（含两个积分常数C₁和C₂）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合两个独立的第一积分，将轴对称Willmore曲面的控制方程降为一阶常微分方程，并给出了生成曲线所满足的显式方程（含两个积分常数C₁和C₂）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。利用轴对称性引入柱坐标距离ρ、切线角ψ及其正弦Ψ=sinψ，通过守恒量（第一积分）将原二阶Willmore方程降为一阶，得到关于Ψ(ρ)的封闭方程。

papers.title: Solubility enhanced surfactant-induced flow in air-liquid-air sheets
papers.abstract: Liquid interfaces appear throughout nature and engineering and are typically contaminated by surface active agents (surfactants), which are characterized by a wide range of solubility. We demonstrate that solubility enhances by an order of magnitude surfactant-induced flow in air-liquid-air films, in contrast to previously studied geometries where solubility dampens the flow. The enhancement is described by a single parameter comparing the depletion length to the film thickness. Our experiments are well described by an asymptotic theory of the Navier-Stokes equations with surfactant kinetics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。关键词：experiments、asymptotic theory、Navier-Stokes equations。；研究对象：空气-液体-空气薄膜中表面活性剂（surfactants）诱导的流动现象，重点关注表面活性剂溶解度对流动的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在空气-液体-空气薄膜中，表面活性剂的溶解度可将诱导流动增强一个数量级，这与以往研究中溶解度抑制流动的结论相反。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在空气-液体-空气薄膜中，表面活性剂的溶解度可将诱导流动增强一个数量级，这与以往研究中溶解度抑制流动的结论相反。；创新点：揭示了在空气-液体-空气薄膜几何结构中，溶解度对表面活性剂诱导流动的增强效应，并提出了一个单一参数（耗尽层厚度与薄膜厚度之比）来描述该增强机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验观测与基于纳维-斯托克斯方程及表面活性剂动力学的渐近理论分析相结合。

papers.title: Topological Edge States from Molecular Chirality: A General Framework for Dimerized Dipolar Arrays
papers.abstract: We establish a general theoretical framework for realizing topological edge states in dimerized arrays of chiral dipolar molecules and demonstrate that molecular handedness provides a natural and tunable route to SSH-like topology in an interacting one-dimensional setting. Starting from an effective spin-$\tfrac{1}{2}$ model generated by Stark-dressed chiral molecules, we introduce bond dimerization and show that the chirality-induced Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction amplifies the effective hopping amplitudes and enlarges the bulk topological gap relative to an achiral chain of equivalent dipole strength. Using self-consistent mean-field theory with periodic- and open-boundary calculations, we map out the trivial, critical, and topological regimes through bulk spectra, complex-plane winding, and boundary-localized probability densities. A central result is that the two in-gap boundary modes carry \emph{opposite molecular chirality}: the left edge state localizes on a left-handed molecule and the right edge state on a right-handed molecule, a stereochemical labeling with no analogue in conventional SSH implementations. The two-leg ladder extension supports a richer four-band bulk structure and a rung-split edge sector whose robustness is characterized by a continuous sweep of the interchain coupling. All results are expressed in dimensionless units of the reference hopping scale $t_0$, making the framework directly applicable to any dipolar molecular platform -- from bialkali polar molecules at MHz coupling scales to future arrays of ultracold chiral polyatomic species. These findings establish dimerized chiral molecular arrays as a controllable and chirality-addressable platform for quasi-one-dimensional topological quantum matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、effective spin-½ model、self-consistent mean-field theory。；研究对象：手性偶极分子二聚化阵列中的拓扑边缘态，具体为基于Stark修饰手性分子的一维相互作用体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分子手性可自然且可调控地实现SSH类拓扑边缘态，且两个带隙边缘态携带相反的分子手性（左边缘态定域于左手性分子，右边缘态定域于右手性分子）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分子手性可自然且可调控地实现SSH类拓扑边缘态，且两个带隙边缘态携带相反的分子手性（左边缘态定域于左手性分子，右边缘态定域于右手性分子）。；创新点：揭示了分子手性作为拓扑态天然调控自由度，并发现边缘态具有立体化学标记（左右手性区分），这在传统SSH实现中无对应；同时将框架推广至双链梯子结构，展示更丰富的四带体态和梯级分裂边缘态。
papers.method_zh: 从Stark修饰手性分子出发构建有效自旋-½模型，引入键二聚化，利用手性诱导的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用放大有效跃迁振幅；采用自洽平均场理论，结合周期边界和开放边界计算，通过体态能谱、复平面缠绕数及边界局域概率密度映射平庸、临界和拓扑相区。

papers.title: Unified Theory of Quartz Tuning Fork Resonators
papers.abstract: Quartz tuning forks, functioning as electrically driven piezoelectric resonators, have long served as exceptionally stable and widely adopted timing references in diverse domains of research and industry. Yet, electrically measured resonance spectra often exhibit robust features that remain unexplained within existing theoretical descriptions. Here we develop a unified continuum electroelastic framework that combines piezoelectric electrodynamics, variational structural dynamics, and symmetry-selected electromechanical observability. Such a first-principles theory shows quantitative agreement with experimental results, which demonstrates electrical observability emerges not just from the underlying mechanical eigenmodes alone. Our results provide a unified framework for electrically driven piezoelectric resonators as well as a rigorous basis for precision electromechanical characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：continuum electroelastic framework、first-principles theory、variational structural dynamics）；研究对象：石英音叉谐振器（Quartz tuning fork resonators），具体为电驱动压电谐振器中的共振谱特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电学测量的共振谱中出现的稳健特征无法仅由机械本征模解释，电学可观测性来源于压电电动力学、变分结构动力学与对称性选择的机电可观测性的统一耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电学测量的共振谱中出现的稳健特征无法仅由机械本征模解释，电学可观测性来源于压电电动力学、变分结构动力学与对称性选择的机电可观测性的统一耦合。；创新点：首次从第一性原理出发，建立了能够定量解释石英音叉电学共振谱中异常特征（如非机械本征模贡献）的统一理论框架，突破了现有理论仅依赖机械本征模的描述局限。
papers.method_zh: 统一连续介质电弹性框架（unified continuum electroelastic framework），结合压电电动力学（piezoelectric electrodynamics）、变分结构动力学（variational structural dynamics）以及对称性选择的机电可观测性（symmetry-selected electromechanical observability）进行第一性原理理论建模。

papers.title: Tensor gradient flow with quasi-entropy for smectic liquid crystals and discretizations keeping coupled physical constraints
papers.abstract: A gradient flow for the concentration and a $2\times 2$ tensor is constructed to describe smectic liquid crystals. The free energy consists of the entropy term and interaction term involving squared second order spatial derivatives. The entropy term incorporates the concentration in the quasi-entropy originally proposed for the tensor only, which is a strictly convex and lower semicontinuous function imposing coupled constraints between the concentration and the tensor. An evolution equation for the boundary normal derivative of the concentration is proposed in addition to the equations for the concentration and the tensor, giving an energy dissipation system. Numerical schemes are designed with emphases on using the entropy term to keep the coupled constraints, and the discretization of the boundary normal derivatives satisfying summation by parts. Existence, uniqueness, energy dissipation and error estimates are established. Numerical results indicate the efficiency and robustness of the scheme. Configurations of defects different from other layer structures are observed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：构建梯度流模型、提出数值离散方案、进行存在性/唯一性/误差估计等理论分析，并给出数值结果。；研究对象：近晶相液晶（smectic liquid crystals），具体研究浓度场与一个2×2张量场耦合的物理系统，关注其缺陷构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入包含浓度与张量耦合约束的准熵（quasi-entropy）项，构建了描述近晶相液晶的张量梯度流模型，并设计了能保持耦合约束与边界法向导数离散性质的数值格式，观察到不同于其他层状结构的缺陷构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入包含浓度与张量耦合约束的准熵（quasi-entropy）项，构建了描述近晶相液晶的张量梯度流模型，并设计了能保持耦合约束与边界法向导数离散性质的数值格式，观察到不同于其他层状结构的缺陷构型。；创新点：将原本仅针对张量的准熵概念扩展至包含浓度，从而在自由能中实现浓度与张量之间的严格凸且下半连续的耦合约束；同时提出了浓度边界法向导数的演化方程，并设计了保持该约束与边界离散性质的数值格式。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于自由能（含熵项与涉及二阶空间导数平方的相互作用项）构建梯度流方程，并额外提出浓度边界法向导数的演化方程以形成能量耗散系统。数值方法：利用熵项保持耦合约束，采用满足分部求和的边界法向导数离散化方案，并建立了存在性、唯一性、能量耗散与误差估计。

papers.title: Relativistic transformation of temperature revisited
papers.abstract: The relativistic transformation of temperature has long remained controversial, with the classical laws of Planck-Einstein, Ott-Eddington-Moller and Landsberg yielding conflicting results. We reexamine this issue from a relativistic thermodynamic and statistical perspective, starting from the energy-momentum tensor of an isotropic system and defining the effective temperature Teff as that inferred by a moving observer from the transformed energy density. Analyses of a photon gas, a relativistic ideal gas and an electron gas show that Teff consistently increases with velocity, supporting the Ott-Eddington interpretation while depending on the system's equation of state. These results indicate that temperature is not a Lorentz-invariant scalar but an observer-dependent quantity. A consistent relativistic description emerges when temperature is related to the inverse-temperature four-vector beta, linking operational and invariant viewpoints within a unified thermodynamic framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：relativistic thermodynamic and statistical perspective、energy-momentum tensor、analyses of a photon gas, a relativistic ideal gas and an electron gas。；研究对象：相对论框架下温度变换的争议问题，具体涉及光子气体、相对论理想气体和电子气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 温度不是洛伦兹不变的标量，而是依赖于观测者的量；有效温度随速度增加而增加，支持Ott-Eddington解释，且依赖于系统的状态方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：温度不是洛伦兹不变的标量，而是依赖于观测者的量；有效温度随速度增加而增加，支持Ott-Eddington解释，且依赖于系统的状态方程。；创新点：通过将温度与逆温度四矢量β联系起来，在统一的热力学框架内连接了操作定义与不变性观点，从而为长期争议的温度相对论变换问题提供了一致描述。
papers.method_zh: 从各向同性系统的能量-动量张量出发，定义运动观测者从变换后的能量密度推断出的有效温度，并对光子气体、相对论理想气体和电子气体进行解析分析。

papers.title: A passive universal grasping mechanism based on an everting shell
papers.abstract: A passive monolithic compliant grasping mechanism that works based on the eversion of an elastically deformable bistable shell is conceptualized. It comprises grasping arms made of beam segments that work in conjunction with the everting shell. The grasper is capable of picking up a stiff object of any shape up to a maximum size and weight. The bistable shell everts upon contact with the object to enable the grasping arms envelop the object forming an enclosure. The mechanism then stays in that configuration until it is actuated again to turn the shell back to its original configuration and thereby opening the enclosure to release the object. The stiffness of the arms decides the payload of the mechanism. The size of the arms decides the largest object that can be grasped and held. The arms have distributed compliance so that they can conform to the shape of the object without applying undue force on it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验/理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要描述了概念化（conceptualized）的机制设计，涉及弹性变形和双稳态壳结构，但未明确提及具体实验验证或数值计算细节，偏向理论概念与机械设计结合。；研究对象：一种基于可翻转壳（everting shell）的被动式通用抓取机构，属于软体机器人或机械抓取装置领域，涉及弹性双稳态壳的形变与抓取行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该机构利用弹性双稳态壳在接触物体时翻转，驱动抓取臂包裹物体形成封闭结构，从而实现对任意形状刚性物体的被动抓取，且无需持续外部驱动即可保持抓取状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该机构利用弹性双稳态壳在接触物体时翻转，驱动抓取臂包裹物体形成封闭结构，从而实现对任意形状刚性物体的被动抓取，且无需持续外部驱动即可保持抓取状态。；创新点：提出一种完全被动、单片式（monolithic）的柔顺抓取机构，利用双稳态壳的翻转实现自锁紧抓取，无需主动控制或持续能量输入，且能适应任意形状物体。摘要未突出说明与现有抓取机构的具体性能对比或应用场景。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或计算方法，仅描述了机构的概念设计（conceptualized），包括双稳态壳的翻转机制、抓取臂的分布式柔顺性设计，以及通过臂的刚度和尺寸分别控制负载能力和最大抓取物体尺寸。

papers.title: Data-Driven Spectral Prediction for Accelerating Large-Scale Electronic Structure Calculations
papers.abstract: Simulating large molecular systems comprising thousands of atoms requires highly scalable methodologies. While modern Density Functional Theory (DFT) codes exhibit linear scaling, solving the associated large, sparse generalized eigenproblems remains a critical computational bottleneck on exascale architectures. In the context of the LimitX project, we propose a data-driven framework to accelerate these calculations. By shifting the machine learning target from discrete eigenvalues to the coefficients of an interpolating Chebyshev polynomial, and by comparing both all-atom and fragment-based structural representations, we successfully overcome the dimensionality constraints of large-scale spectral prediction. We investigate three machine learning models (Kernel Ridge Regression, Graph Neural Networks, and Random Forests) trained on a novel 2 TB dataset of protein dimers. The predicted spectra provide initial guesses that effectively bypass early Self-Consistent Field (SCF) iterations in BigDFT. Ultimately, these spectral predictors will be deployed to dynamically optimize upcoming rational filter-based eigensolvers, such as FrASE, which is currently in initial development.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：data-driven framework、machine learning models、Density Functional Theory (DFT) codes、spectral prediction。；研究对象：由数千个原子组成的大分子体系，具体为蛋白质二聚体（protein dimers），以及与之相关的大规模电子结构计算中的稀疏广义本征值问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将机器学习目标从离散本征值转移到插值切比雪夫多项式的系数，并比较全原子与基于片段的两种结构表示，成功克服了大尺度谱预测的维度限制；预测的谱可作为初始猜测，有效跳过BigDFT中早期自洽场（SCF）迭代。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将机器学习目标从离散本征值转移到插值切比雪夫多项式的系数，并比较全原子与基于片段的两种结构表示，成功克服了大尺度谱预测的维度限制；预测的谱可作为初始猜测，有效跳过BigDFT中早期自洽场（SCF）迭代。；创新点：将机器学习预测目标从离散本征值改为切比雪夫多项式系数，从而克服大规模谱预测的维度限制；结合全原子与片段表示进行对比；生成的谱直接用于加速DFT计算中的SCF迭代，并计划动态优化下一代本征求解器。
papers.method_zh: 采用数据驱动框架，训练了三种机器学习模型（核岭回归、图神经网络、随机森林），使用一个2 TB的新型蛋白质二聚体数据集；结构表示包括全原子和基于片段两种方式；预测的谱用于加速BigDFT中的SCF迭代，并计划用于优化基于有理滤波的本征求解器（如FrASE）。

papers.title: On the synaptic matrix eigenvalues of sparsely connected neural networks
papers.abstract: The spectral behaviour of the synaptic matrix, representing the neuronal connection strengths, is an important tool to analyze the stability and transient dynamics of a typical brain as well as its learning process and memory capacity. The complexity of the brain due to large number of neurons as well as underlying transient mechanisms e.g. homeostasis, seizure or synaptic plasticity can lead to networks with time-varying degree and type of sparsity. This renders an exact determination of the synaptic matrix not only technically difficult but also meaningless, leaving its statistical analysis as the best available theoretical approach. This motivates us to pursue a spectral analysis of the synaptic matrix models with different type of sparsity and thereby analyze latter's role on various aspects of network dynamics and stability. Our results have potential relevance for detemining the type of synaptic sparsity required to induce a specific brain function or desired transient mechanism e.g for pharmacological effects or physiological modulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spectral analysis（谱分析）、statistical analysis（统计分析）、theoretical approach（理论方法）。；研究对象：稀疏连接神经网络的突触矩阵（synaptic matrix）的谱行为（spectral behaviour），具体关注不同稀疏类型对网络动力学和稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出研究结果对于确定诱导特定脑功能或所需瞬态机制（如药理效应或生理调节）的突触稀疏类型具有潜在意义。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出研究结果对于确定诱导特定脑功能或所需瞬态机制（如药理效应或生理调节）的突触稀疏类型具有潜在意义。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但指出由于大脑中神经元数量庞大及瞬态机制（如稳态、癫痫发作、突触可塑性）导致稀疏度随时间变化，精确确定突触矩阵既困难也无意义，因此本文从统计角度分析不同稀疏类型的作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用统计分析方法对具有不同稀疏类型的突触矩阵模型进行谱分析（spectral analysis），未提及具体数值计算或实验手段。

papers.title: Coupling Language Models with Physics-based Simulation for Synthesis of Inorganic Materials
papers.abstract: Modern generative machine learning (ML) models can propose novel inorganic crystalline materials with targeted properties; however, synthesis planning of these materials remains difficult due to the complexity of the associated physical processes and limited availability of computational tools. We introduce a novel hybrid framework to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) in inorganic synthesis planning by combining thermodynamic databases with simplified kinetics models to approximate realistic synthesis conditions. As a case study, we focus on the niobium-oxygen system, which features multiple industrially relevant oxide phases with well-characterized data. In computational simulations, we compare LLM-generated synthesis routes with classical path-planning algorithms, showing that the implicit priors in LLMs can yield more viable strategies. In our evaluation setting, classical search methods serve primarily as a foil rather than a direct competitor. This illustrates the relative complexity of the problem and highlights where the LLM's implicit priors add value.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（结合机器学习与物理模拟）。判断依据关键词：generative machine learning models、thermodynamic databases、simplified kinetics models、computational simulations。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的合成路径规划，具体以铌-氧体系（niobium-oxygen system）为案例，涉及多个工业相关的氧化物相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在合成路径规划中，大型语言模型（LLMs）隐含的先验知识能够生成比经典路径搜索算法更可行的合成策略，表明LLMs在无机材料合成规划中具有潜在优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在合成路径规划中，大型语言模型（LLMs）隐含的先验知识能够生成比经典路径搜索算法更可行的合成策略，表明LLMs在无机材料合成规划中具有潜在优势。；创新点：首次将大型语言模型（LLMs）与基于物理的模拟（热力学+动力学）相结合，用于无机材料合成路径规划，并系统比较了LLM隐含先验与经典搜索算法的表现差异。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种混合框架：将热力学数据库与简化动力学模型结合，近似模拟真实合成条件；使用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成合成路线，并与经典路径规划算法进行对比评估。

papers.title: Geometric Instability and Self-Limitation in Driven Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: We develop a unified geometric framework for local non-adiabaticity in driven quantum systems. We show that the previously introduced AMT non adiabaticity parameter arises as a special realization of a more general geometric instability criterion governed by the normalized Fubini Study distinguishability speed. The local geometric evolution speed is identified as the physically relevant quantity controlling the onset of non-adiabatic instability. We introduce a universal dimensionless instability parameter measuring the competition between quantum-state evolution speed and spectral-gap protection. This quantity provides a local, gauge-invariant, and basis-independent criterion for arbitrary driven Hamiltonians. Near quantum critical points, the instability parameter diverges through inverse gap amplification, recovering the Kibble Zurek freeze-out condition directly from local geometric data. We prove that monotonic occupation-dependent nonlinear regulators geometrically compress the quantum metric, establishing a self-limitation theorem in which nonlinear spectral deformation confines the accessible region of projective Hilbert space under strong driving. The multimode extension yields a matrix-valued instability criterion that identifies collective instability channels invisible to scalar descriptions. The framework naturally extends to open quantum systems through the Bures metric and quantum Fisher geometry, where thermal mixing and Lindblad decay increase the instability threshold through geometric suppression of state distinguishability. The instability threshold further implies a universal geometric lower bound on coherent control time and quantum gate duration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：geometric framework、theorem、proof、extension。；研究对象：驱动量子系统中的非绝热动力学，特别是量子态演化速度与能隙保护之间的竞争关系，以及由此引发的几何不稳定性与自限效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个统一的几何框架，证明非绝热不稳定性由归一化的Fubini-Study可区分性速度控制，并引入一个普适的无量纲不稳定性参数；同时证明单调依赖布居的非线性调节器会几何压缩量子度规，形成自限定理，在强驱动下限制投影希尔伯特空间的可达区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个统一的几何框架，证明非绝热不稳定性由归一化的Fubini-Study可区分性速度控制，并引入一个普适的无量纲不稳定性参数；同时证明单调依赖布居的非线性调节器会几何压缩量子度规，形成自限定理，在强驱动下限制投影希尔伯特空间的可达区域。；创新点：将先前提出的AMT非绝热参数推广为更一般的几何不稳定性判据；证明非线性光谱变形可几何压缩量子度规并导致自限；将框架自然扩展到开放量子系统，并推导出相干控制时间和量子门持续时间的普适几何下界。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子几何张量（Fubini-Study度规）和量子信息几何（Bures度规、量子Fisher几何）的理论推导，结合Kibble-Zurek冻结条件的几何重构，以及多模扩展为矩阵值不稳定性判据。

papers.title: Symmetry-Protected Quantum Computing using Metamaterials
papers.abstract: We propose a new architecture for practical quantum computing that combines three established principles: symmetry protection of relative-motion qubits via the generalized Kohn theorem, control via twisted-light orbital angular momentum, and metamaterial nanofocusing (e.g. using Weyl-semimetal plasmonics). Crucially, the core mechanism is generic: it applies to any current or future quantum computing system involving parabolic confinement, including cold atoms, ions, and semiconductor dots.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a new architecture（提出新架构）、combines three established principles（结合已有原理）、generic（普适性理论）。；研究对象：基于超材料的对称性保护量子计算架构，具体涉及抛物型约束下的相对运动量子比特系统（包括冷原子、离子和半导体量子点）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种结合广义Kohn定理的对称性保护、扭曲光轨道角动量控制以及超材料纳米聚焦（如外尔半金属等离激元）的通用量子计算新方案，该方案适用于任何具有抛物型约束的量子计算系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种结合广义Kohn定理的对称性保护、扭曲光轨道角动量控制以及超材料纳米聚焦（如外尔半金属等离激元）的通用量子计算新方案，该方案适用于任何具有抛物型约束的量子计算系统。；创新点：首次将对称性保护、轨道角动量操控与超材料纳米聚焦三种独立原理整合为统一的量子计算架构，且强调该机制对冷原子、离子、半导体量子点等不同物理平台的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：广义Kohn定理（对称性保护相对运动量子比特）、扭曲光轨道角动量（控制手段）、超材料纳米聚焦（如外尔半金属等离激元技术）。摘要未提及具体数值计算或实验手段。

papers.title: Experimental observation of strong field stabilization
papers.abstract: Strong oscillating fields are expected to tear apart bound quantum states. Theoretical studies predict a striking reversal: that as the field intensity is raised above some threshold, bound states like atoms can become increasingly stable, accompanied by a spatial bifurcation of the bound state wavefunction. This strong field stabilization was predicted decades ago in the context of atoms in pulsed laser fields, but has resisted experimental observation due to extreme intensity requirements and theoretical controversy. Here we report the experimental observation of strong-field stabilization of a ground state, using trapped neutral atoms to emulate the dynamics of bound electrons in an extremely strong laser field. We image the predicted wavepacket bifurcation, measure an ionization rate non-monotonic in field amplitude, and map out the regime of stabilization. Stabilization persists down to surprisingly low drive frequencies, on the order of the lowest-energy excitations. These results confirm a long-standing prediction in extreme quantum dynamics, and showcase a complementary tool for probing strong-field phenomena near and beyond the frontier of current laser technology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimental observation”、“report the experimental observation”、“image”、“measure”。；研究对象：强场稳定化现象（strong field stabilization），具体为基态原子在极强激光场中的动力学行为，使用 trapped neutral atoms（囚禁中性原子）进行模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验首次观测到基态在极强激光场中的稳定化现象，包括波包空间分叉、电离率随场强非单调变化，并绘制出稳定化区域。稳定化效应在低至最低激发能量级的驱动频率下依然存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验首次观测到基态在极强激光场中的稳定化现象，包括波包空间分叉、电离率随场强非单调变化，并绘制出稳定化区域。稳定化效应在低至最低激发能量级的驱动频率下依然存在。；创新点：首次实验证实了数十年前关于强场稳定化的理论预言，克服了此前因极端强度要求和理论争议而无法实验观测的困难，并发现稳定化在远低于预期频率下依然存在。摘要未突出说明与已有实验方案的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 使用囚禁中性原子模拟束缚电子在极强激光场中的动力学，通过成像技术观测波包分叉，测量电离率随场强的变化。

papers.title: AI-Guided Design and Optimization of Graphite-Based Anodes via Iterative Experimental Feedback
papers.abstract: This study presents an iterative AI-guided workflow that accelerates graphite-based anode development by improving both formulation feasibility and process robustness. Sequential learning via AI/ML-guided multiobjective inverse design for anode optimization was implemented using the Citrine Platform. Starting from a noisy, incomplete dataset, the Citrine Platform was used to generate early surrogate models, which despite low predictive certainty highlighted missing process constraints. By iteratively adding feasibility labels and boundary condition failures, the workflow rapidly converged toward manufacturable, higher-performing formulations. Fabrication reliability improved from frequent process failures to 100% successful cell production, while the fraction of cells delivering $\geq$ 350 mAh g$^{-1}$ increased from 28.4% to 84.8%, with capacity retention rising from 42.1% to 97.3%. These results demonstrate that structured, feedback-driven AI workflows can transform imperfect industrial data into actionable guidance, enabling faster, more reproducible optimization of battery electrode manufacturing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：iterative AI-guided workflow、experimental feedback、fabrication reliability、cell production）；研究对象：石墨基负极材料（graphite-based anodes）及其电池电极制造工艺优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过迭代式AI引导工作流，将电池制造成功率提升至100%，高容量（≥350 mAh g⁻¹）电池比例从28.4%提高到84.8%，容量保持率从42.1%提升至97.3%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过迭代式AI引导工作流，将电池制造成功率提升至100%，高容量（≥350 mAh g⁻¹）电池比例从28.4%提高到84.8%，容量保持率从42.1%提升至97.3%。；创新点：将结构化、反馈驱动的AI工作流应用于工业级不完美数据，实现从频繁工艺失败到100%成功生产的快速收敛，显著提升了电极制造的再现性和优化效率。
papers.method_zh: 采用Citrine平台进行AI/ML引导的多目标逆向设计，结合顺序学习（sequential learning），从噪声大、不完整的数据集出发，通过迭代添加可行性标签和边界条件失败案例，逐步优化配方。

papers.title: Phase separation seeded by Z2 and U(1) topological defects from holography
papers.abstract: We study the interaction between spontaneous symmetry breaking and phase separation dynamics in holography. Using a double-quench protocol, the system first rapidly crosses the critical point and generates topological defects, while a second quench drives the system into a nonlinear unstable regime with spinodal decomposition. We investigate both $\mathbb{Z}_2$ and $U(1)$ symmetric systems, where different types of topological defects emerge during symmetry breaking. We show that topological defects dynamically determine the nucleation sites of phase separation. As the instability grows, the defect cores expand into macroscopic phase-separated domains. Despite the distinct symmetries and topological properties of these defects, both systems exhibit the same universal dynamical behavior, indicating that topological defects can universally serve as dynamical seeds for subsequent phase separation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“holography”（全息对偶）、“double-quench protocol”（双淬火协议）、“spinodal decomposition”（旋节线分解），属于全息引力对偶框架下的理论计算研究。；研究对象：全息对偶框架下具有Z₂对称性和U(1)对称性的系统中，自发对称性破缺与相分离动力学之间的相互作用，特别是拓扑缺陷（畴壁、涡旋等）如何影响相分离的成核过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拓扑缺陷（Z₂和U(1）两类缺陷）能够动态地决定相分离的成核位置：随着不稳定性增长，缺陷核心会膨胀成为宏观的相分离畴区。尽管两类缺陷具有不同的对称性和拓扑性质，但两者表现出相同的普适动力学行为，表明拓扑缺陷可以普遍地作为后续相分离的动力学种子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拓扑缺陷（Z₂和U(1）两类缺陷）能够动态地决定相分离的成核位置：随着不稳定性增长，缺陷核心会膨胀成为宏观的相分离畴区。尽管两类缺陷具有不同的对称性和拓扑性质，但两者表现出相同的普适动力学行为，表明拓扑缺陷可以普遍地作为后续相分离的动力学种子。；创新点：首次在全息对偶框架中揭示了拓扑缺陷（而非传统热涨落或杂质）可以作为相分离的动力学种子，并且发现不同对称性（Z₂与U(1)）下的缺陷尽管拓扑性质不同，却展现出相同的普适成核行为。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用全息对偶（holography）框架，通过双淬火协议（double-quench protocol）模拟动力学过程：第一次快速淬火使系统跨越临界点产生拓扑缺陷，第二次淬火驱动系统进入非线性不稳定区（旋节线分解区），从而研究缺陷与相分离的耦合动力学。

papers.title: Decomposition of Anomalous Diffusion in two-state random walks
papers.abstract: Two-state stochastic models, where motion alternates between distinct dynamical modes, are widely observed in complex systems. Here we study the Two-State Random Walk (TSRW), which switches between a continuous-time random walk (CTRW) rest state and a standard L'evy walk (LW) motion state, each with power-law distributed sojourn times. Using anomalous diffusion decomposition, we show that TSRWs exhibit a generic coexistence of Joseph (correlation), Noah (heavy-tailed increments), and Moses (aging) effects. Strikingly, although classical L'evy walks alone possess only the Joseph effect, both Noah and Moses effects emerge in TSRWs solely due to stochastic switching with the CTRW phase. Our results demonstrate that coupling between dynamical states can fundamentally reshape the mechanisms driving anomalous diffusion, offering a minimal yet powerful framework for transport in heterogeneous and intermittently switching environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：stochastic models、anomalous diffusion decomposition、theoretical framework。；研究对象：两态随机游走（Two-State Random Walk, TSRW）模型，该模型在静止态（CTRW rest state）与运动态（Lévy walk motion state）之间随机切换，用于描述复杂系统中的间歇性输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TSRW模型会同时表现出约瑟夫效应（相关性）、诺亚效应（重尾增量）和摩西效应（老化），而经典的Lévy walk单独只具有约瑟夫效应。诺亚效应和摩西效应完全源于与CTRW静止态的随机切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TSRW模型会同时表现出约瑟夫效应（相关性）、诺亚效应（重尾增量）和摩西效应（老化），而经典的Lévy walk单独只具有约瑟夫效应。诺亚效应和摩西效应完全源于与CTRW静止态的随机切换。；创新点：揭示了动力学状态之间的耦合（即静止态与运动态的随机切换）能够从根本上重塑驱动反常扩散的机制，为异质性和间歇性切换环境中的输运提供了一个极简但强大的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用反常扩散分解方法（anomalous diffusion decomposition），对两态随机游走模型进行理论分析，其中两态各自具有幂律分布的驻留时间。

papers.title: Photooxidative ageing of 3D printed polymers PLA, ABS, PET, HIPS and PC induced by long-term UV radiation
papers.abstract: This article focuses on the influence of long-term UV radiation exposure on mechanical and structural properties of selected polymeric materials (PLA, ABS, PC, PETG, HIPS) prepared using 3D-print based Fused Filament Fabrication (FFF) method. Existing research in the field of polymers weathering has been focused more on the combined effects so far, moreover on time scales not exceeding units of months. However, it is important to separate individual effects to understand the dynamics of material changes and design strategies to improve material resistance. Our research thus focuses on UV-affected ageing of the selected polymers for time duration exceeding 10 months (7744 consecutive hours, i.e. 322 days), performed in an environmental cell with controlled humidity and temperature. Mechanical properties were evaluated by a locally sensitive nanoindentation method. Surface properties, depth property profiles, and creep were studied as well. Hardness and modulus of elasticity data were obtained for a wide range of samples. Based on our analysis of mechanical properties, the highest UV resistances are characteristic for PLA and PC. On the contrary, noticeable changes of mechanical properties occur in the ABS and HIPS samples (even at greater depths), leading to an embrittlement of the former material. Changes in mechanical properties even in strongly affected samples (PETG) were only evident to depths <10 um. For the selected samples (PLA, ABS, PETG), vibrational spectroscopies (Raman scattering and infrared absorption) were exploited to gain a deeper insight into polymers structural changes. Vibrational spectra supported the results of mechanical properties tests: while PLA revealed no significant changes from the structural viewpoint; ABS and PETG showed differences in characteristic as well as deformation vibrations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：nanoindentation、Raman scattering、infrared absorption、environmental cell。；研究对象：3D打印聚合物材料（PLA、ABS、PC、PETG、HIPS）在长期紫外辐射下的光氧化老化行为，重点关注力学性能与结构变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PLA和PC具有最高的抗紫外辐射能力；ABS和HIPS在紫外辐射后力学性能显著劣化（甚至在大深度处发生脆化），而PETG的变化仅局限于表面10微米以内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PLA和PC具有最高的抗紫外辐射能力；ABS和HIPS在紫外辐射后力学性能显著劣化（甚至在大深度处发生脆化），而PETG的变化仅局限于表面10微米以内。；创新点：现有聚合物老化研究多关注多种因素（如温湿、紫外）的联合效应且时间尺度不超过数月，本工作将紫外辐射作为单一变量，在超过10个月的时间尺度上系统研究其独立影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用熔丝制造（FFF）3D打印制备样品；在可控温湿度的环境箱中进行超过10个月（7744小时）的紫外辐射老化；使用局部敏感纳米压痕法评估力学性能（硬度、弹性模量、蠕变及深度剖面）；对PLA、ABS、PETG样品采用拉曼散射和红外吸收振动光谱分析结构变化。

papers.title: Beyond Text and Tables: Vision-Language Model Integration in ComProScanner for Extracting Materials Data from Scientific Figures with High Accuracy
papers.abstract: Automated extraction of materials composition-property data from scientific literature has advanced considerably with the development of large language model-based pipelines; however, existing frameworks remain limited to textual and tabular content, overlooking the substantial proportion of quantitative property data reported exclusively in scientific figures. Here, we extend ComProScanner, a fully end-to-end multi-agent framework for automated composition-property database construction, with a native vision-language model (VLM) based figure extraction capability. The extension introduces a FigureExtractor utility for caption-keyword-based figure filtering across all supported publishers, and a GraphExtractorTool agent that passes extracted figures to a configurable VLM to recover composition-property pairs from scientific charts and plots. Four VLMs are selected for evaluation on the basis of the LMArena Diagram leaderboard with an input cost criterion of less than \$1.50 per million tokens. Benchmarking on 50 piezoelectric ceramic articles from the established $d_{33}$ test corpus demonstrates that Gemini-3-Flash-Preview achieves the highest performance with a composition accuracy of 0.97 and a normalised F1 score of 0.97, whilst remaining the most cost-effective model among the four evaluated. We additionally introduce a range-based value error threshold parameter into the evaluation framework, providing a more physically meaningful assessment of numeric property values extracted from figures than exact value matching. These contributions establish VLM-integrated ComProScanner as the first materials-specific, fully automated, multimodal literature mining platform capable of extracting structured composition-property data from text, tables, and figures within a single unified pipeline.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（关键词：multi-agent framework、VLM-based figure extraction、benchmarking on experimental articles）；研究对象：材料科学中的成分-性质数据自动提取，具体以压电陶瓷（piezoelectric ceramics）的d33测试语料为基准测试对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 集成视觉语言模型（VLM）的ComProScanner框架能够从科学图表中高精度提取成分-性质数据，其中Gemini-3-Flash-Preview模型在压电陶瓷数据集上达到成分准确率0.97、归一化F1分数0.97，且成本最低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：集成视觉语言模型（VLM）的ComProScanner框架能够从科学图表中高精度提取成分-性质数据，其中Gemini-3-Flash-Preview模型在压电陶瓷数据集上达到成分准确率0.97、归一化F1分数0.97，且成本最低。；创新点：首次将VLM集成到材料专用的全自动多模态文献挖掘平台中，实现从文本、表格和图表中统一提取结构化成分-性质数据，突破了现有框架仅处理文本和表格内容的局限。
papers.method_zh: 基于多智能体框架ComProScanner，引入FigureExtractor工具（基于图表标题和关键词过滤）和GraphExtractorTool智能体（将图表传递给可配置的VLM以恢复成分-性质对）；评估了四种VLM（依据LMArena Diagram排行榜和输入成本低于每百万token 1.50美元的标准选择）；引入基于范围的值误差阈值参数用于数值评估。

papers.title: 19 GHz Single-Ended-to-Balanced Modified Ladder-Lattice Filters Realized Using Periodically Polarized AlScN BAW Resonators
papers.abstract: We present a single-ended to balanced modified ladder-lattice filter topology, realized with periodically polarized piezoelectric (P3F) AlScN resonators, for single-ended to differential filtering applications. This filter topology eliminates the need for baluns or other passive components and can interface, for instance, directly between differential antennas and single-ended power and low noise amplifiers. Two filter designs operating at 19 GHz were implemented. The first design exhibited a minimum insertion loss of 1.3 dB, a 6.26% fractional 3-dB bandwidth, an average out-of-band rejection of 30 dB and occupied a 348 um x 476 um footprint, while the second higher-selectivity filter achieved 1.58 dB of minimum insertion loss, 5.11% fractional 3-dB bandwidth, 33 dB of average out-of-band rejection, and occupied a 392 um x 476 um footprint - Making them highly competitive for wireless communications filters. The working principle of the modified ladder-lattice topology is discussed, the design of the filters are presented, and the linearity of the filters is explored through intermodulation and power handling measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：filters were implemented、measurements、exhibited、occupied footprint。；研究对象：基于周期性极化压电（P3F）AlScN体声波（BAW）谐振器的单端转差分滤波器，工作频率为19 GHz。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用改进型梯形-晶格拓扑结构，实现了无需巴伦等无源元件的单端转差分滤波功能，在19 GHz下获得1.3 dB最小插入损耗、6.26%分数带宽及30 dB平均带外抑制，性能具有竞争力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用改进型梯形-晶格拓扑结构，实现了无需巴伦等无源元件的单端转差分滤波功能，在19 GHz下获得1.3 dB最小插入损耗、6.26%分数带宽及30 dB平均带外抑制，性能具有竞争力。；创新点：提出了一种无需巴伦即可实现单端转差分滤波的改进型梯形-晶格拓扑结构，并利用周期性极化AlScN BAW谐振器在19 GHz频段实现。
papers.method_zh: 通过周期性极化AlScN压电薄膜制备BAW谐振器，设计并制备了两种改进型梯形-晶格滤波器，采用插损、带宽、带外抑制、芯片面积等射频指标表征性能，并通过互调失真和功率处理实验测量线性度。

papers.title: Observing conformal Floquet dynamics on a digital quantum processor
papers.abstract: Quantum simulations are traditionally confined to exploring dynamics starting from unentangled or low-entanglement states due to severe bottlenecks in protocol design, hardware performance, and classical verification. Here, we report the first experimental observation of non-equilibrium dynamics initiated directly from a many-body critical state. Using a fully-connected trapped-ion processor, we prepare the critical ground state of a transverse-field Ising model via a hardware-tailored, logarithmic-depth quantum circuit based on multi-scale entanglement renormalization. Following this initialization, we apply a deep Floquet drive that maintains emergent conformal symmetry, enabling us to benchmark the lattice dynamics against analytical results from continuum theory. In the resulting conformal heating phase, we extract a central charge consistent with the Ising universality class ($c=1/2$) from the universal decay of the Loschmidt echo and observe spatial energy localization predicted by field theory. Conversely, the non-heating phase exhibits global finite-time revivals. This work establishes a scalable and versatile framework for exploring critical quantum dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimental observation、trapped-ion processor、quantum circuit。；研究对象：非平衡量子动力学，具体是从多体临界态（transverse-field Ising model的临界基态）出发，在Floquet驱动下的演化行为，特别是共形加热相与非加热相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实验观测到从多体临界态直接出发的非平衡动力学，在共形加热相中提取到与Ising普适类一致的中心荷（c=1/2），并观察到场论预言的局域能量分布；在非加热相中观测到全局有限时间回复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实验观测到从多体临界态直接出发的非平衡动力学，在共形加热相中提取到与Ising普适类一致的中心荷（c=1/2），并观察到场论预言的局域能量分布；在非加热相中观测到全局有限时间回复。；创新点：首次在实验上实现了从多体临界态（而非低纠缠态）直接启动的量子模拟，并利用共形Floquet动力学将晶格动力学与连续场论分析进行基准对比。
papers.method_zh: 使用全连通离子阱量子处理器，通过基于多尺度纠缠重整化（MERA）的对数深度量子电路制备横场Ising模型的临界基态，然后施加深度Floquet驱动（保持涌现共形对称性），通过测量Loschmidt回波的普适衰减提取中心荷。

papers.title: Twin Algebras: Condensable Algebras beyond Anyons
papers.abstract: Condensable algebras in 2+1d non-chiral topological orders characterize gapped boundary conditions and interfaces. Applied to the Symmetry Topological Field Theory, they allow classification of symmetric gapped phases and impose sharp constraints on possible phase transitions. A condensable algebra is specified not only by its underlying set of anyons, which end on the boundary or interface, but also by its algebra structure. We introduce the concept of twin condensable algebras, which have the same anyon decomposition, but inequivalent algebra structure. We revisit the classification of condensable algebras in $\mathcal{Z}(\text{Vec}_G^ω)$, i.e. in group-theoretical topological orders for finite groups $G$ with anomaly $ω$. In this context we are able to identify twin algebras that arise from different mechanisms, such as subgroup data, SPT cocycles, and symmetry actions. In particular, we construct infinite families of examples of twins from so-called Gassmann triples, and exhibit cases in which the reduced topological orders are inequivalent despite having identical anyon content. Physically, twin algebras describe distinct symmetric phases that have isomorphic spaces of ground states, but inequivalent order parameters. Such twin phases never exhibit relative spontaneous symmetry breaking, and can be used to construct phase transitions without hidden symmetry breaking, which are intrinsically beyond Landau transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：condensable algebras, Symmetry Topological Field Theory, classification, theoretical framework。；研究对象：2+1维非手征拓扑序中的可凝聚代数（condensable algebras），特别是群论拓扑序 $\mathcal{Z}(\text{Vec}_G^\omega)$ 中的可凝聚代数及其在对称性拓扑场论（SymTFT）中的应用，用于描述对称性破缺相和相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了“孪生可凝聚代数”（twin condensable algebras）——具有相同任意子分解但代数结构不等价的可凝聚代数。这些孪生代数描述了具有相同基态空间但不等价序参量的不同对称性相，且这些相之间不会发生相对自发对称性破缺，可用于构造超越朗道相变理论的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了“孪生可凝聚代数”（twin condensable algebras）——具有相同任意子分解但代数结构不等价的可凝聚代数。这些孪生代数描述了具有相同基态空间但不等价序参量的不同对称性相，且这些相之间不会发生相对自发对称性破缺，可用于构造超越朗道相变理论的相变。；创新点：首次提出并系统研究了“孪生可凝聚代数”概念，揭示了即使任意子内容完全相同，可凝聚代数的代数结构不等价性仍可导致不同的约化拓扑序和不同的对称性相。这为理解超越朗道自发对称性破缺机制的相变提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性拓扑场论（SymTFT）框架，对有限群 $G$ 及其反常 $\omega$ 的群论拓扑序 $\mathcal{Z}(\text{Vec}_G^\omega)$ 中的可凝聚代数进行分类。通过分析子群数据、SPT上同调类以及对称性作用等不同机制来识别孪生代数，并利用Gassmann三元组构造了无穷族孪生代数实例。

papers.title: Twin Phases: Phase Transitions Without Hidden Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: We introduce the concept of twin phases for a symmetry $\mathcal{S}$, defined as inequivalent phases, whose order parameters are part of the same generalized charge under $\mathcal{S}$. Stable, direct transitions between such twin phases are never spontaneous-symmetry-breaking transitions, even after (partially) gauging the initial symmetry $\mathcal{S}$: they are phase transitions without hidden symmetry breaking. We illustrate this with an (anomalous) finite group symmetry in 1+1d, which exhibits such intrinsically beyond Landau transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“introduce the concept”“we illustrate with”等理论构建和论证性表述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：凝聚态物理中的相变现象，具体为一种新型的“孪生相”（twin phases）及其之间的相变，涉及对称性、序参量和广义荷的概念，并以1+1维有限群对称性（含反常）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“孪生相”概念：对于同一对称性S，存在不等价的相，其序参量属于S下的同一广义荷。这类孪生相之间的稳定直接相变并非自发对称性破缺相变，即使在部分规范初始对称性S后也是如此——这是一种没有隐藏对称性破缺的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“孪生相”概念：对于同一对称性S，存在不等价的相，其序参量属于S下的同一广义荷。这类孪生相之间的稳定直接相变并非自发对称性破缺相变，即使在部分规范初始对称性S后也是如此——这是一种没有隐藏对称性破缺的相变。；创新点：首次提出“孪生相”概念，并证明其间的相变本质上不涉及任何（隐藏的）对称性破缺，即使在部分规范对称性后依然如此，从而揭示了一类全新的、内在超越朗道范式的相变类型。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于对称性、广义荷、序参量等概念，结合1+1维反常有限群对称性模型进行论证，属于超越朗道相变理论的内在理论分析。

papers.title: Floquet Engineering of Quantum Transport through two Driven Impurities
papers.abstract: Floquet engineering offers powerful tools to manipulate quantum states by periodically driving physical parameters. In this work, we investigate the quantum transport through two periodically driven impurities in a mesoscopic one-dimensional channel. By mapping the time-dependent Hamiltonian into an effective multichannel scattering problem, we unveil a rich landscape of transport phenomena arising from the interplay between Fabry-Perot cavity modes and Fano interference. We demonstrate that the inter-impurity distance acts as a critical control parameter, allowing for the formation of Bound States in the Continuum (BICs). Furthermore, we identify Quasi-BICs, extremely narrow resonances with finite lifetimes, that can be dynamically tuned by the drive amplitude. We show that these states enable a robust coherent trapping mechanism, allowing the system to switch from perfect transparency or reflection to strong localization with giant Wigner time delays. Our results suggest possible applications for tunable delay lines and quantum memories, with feasible experimental realizations in the context of cold atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“mapping the time-dependent Hamiltonian into an effective multichannel scattering problem”（将含时哈密顿量映射为有效多通道散射问题），属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：一维介观通道中两个受周期性驱动的杂质构成的量子输运系统。具体物理现象包括：法布里-珀罗腔模与法诺干涉的相互作用、连续谱中的束缚态（BICs）以及准束缚态（Quasi-BICs）的形成与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节两个驱动杂质之间的距离，可以形成连续谱中的束缚态（BICs）和准束缚态（Quasi-BICs），后者具有极窄的共振峰和有限寿命，且可通过驱动振幅动态调控。这些态能够实现从完美透明/反射到强局域化的鲁棒相干俘获，并伴随巨大的维格纳时间延迟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节两个驱动杂质之间的距离，可以形成连续谱中的束缚态（BICs）和准束缚态（Quasi-BICs），后者具有极窄的共振峰和有限寿命，且可通过驱动振幅动态调控。这些态能够实现从完美透明/反射到强局域化的鲁棒相干俘获，并伴随巨大的维格纳时间延迟。；创新点：揭示了驱动杂质间距作为关键控制参数在形成BICs和准束缚态中的作用，并展示了通过驱动振幅动态调控准束缚态寿命和输运特性的可能性，为可调延迟线和量子存储器提供了新机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将含时周期驱动哈密顿量映射为有效多通道散射问题，分析法布里-珀罗腔模与法诺干涉的耦合效应。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法（如散射矩阵计算或格林函数方法），但属于解析与数值结合的理论散射分析。

papers.title: Recovering the Shape of a Contact Line
papers.abstract: We study the conditions for a three-phase contact line to return to a previous position. We drive a water-air-glass contact line between two horizontal plates, by slowly adding and removing water with a constant volume amplitude. For the first several cycles, the contact line ends each cycle with a different shape, in contrast with previously published work. Eventually the shapes begin to repeat, and the system has memory: a cycle with a smaller amplitude ends in a different shape, but even one cycle at the original amplitude recovers the steady-state shape. After a cycle at a larger amplitude, the steady-state shape is erased. We find that our tight control of the enclosed volume creates a global interaction, wherein only the least stable part of the contact line can move. Using theory and minimal models, we show that this interaction gives rise to the transient behaviors. Our study sheds light on the origins of reversibility and memory in a system where neither is guaranteed, and shows that the physics of contact line motion changes in a confined environment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：slowly adding and removing water, experimental setup, minimal models）；研究对象：三相接触线（水-空气-玻璃体系）在受限环境（两平行板之间）中的形状恢复与记忆行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 接触线在恒定体积振幅的循环驱动下，经过若干周期后形状开始重复，表现出记忆效应：小振幅循环后形状不同，但一次原振幅循环即可恢复稳态形状；大振幅循环则会擦除记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：接触线在恒定体积振幅的循环驱动下，经过若干周期后形状开始重复，表现出记忆效应：小振幅循环后形状不同，但一次原振幅循环即可恢复稳态形状；大振幅循环则会擦除记忆。；创新点：揭示了在封闭体积的严格约束下，接触线运动产生全局相互作用，导致只有最不稳定的部分能够移动，从而产生瞬态行为和记忆效应。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过缓慢加水和排水控制封闭体积，驱动两平行板之间的水-空气-玻璃接触线运动；理论上使用最小模型分析全局相互作用对接触线运动的影响。

papers.title: Migdal-Eliashberg and SUS-$Y^2$-SYK
papers.abstract: This note addresses a number of subtle issues pertaining to the long-standing problem of strong phonon-like fermion-boson coupling. Among the central topics are the customary Migdal-Eliashberg approximation in the pertinent Schwinger-Dyson gap equation and its solutions. The previously gained insight is assessed by contrasting it against the various (non-)supersymmetric variants of the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model. Also, some previously discussed (pseudo-)holographic aspects of fermion pairing in such models are commented upon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Migdal-Eliashberg approximation、Schwinger-Dyson gap equation、supersymmetric variants、Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model。；研究对象：强声子型费米子-玻色子耦合问题，具体涉及Migdal-Eliashberg近似及其在Schwinger-Dyson方程中的解，以及Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SUS-$Y^2$-SYK）模型的各种（非）超对称变体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将传统Migdal-Eliashberg理论的结果与Yukawa-SYK模型的（非）超对称变体进行对比，评估了此前对强耦合问题的理解，并评论了此类模型中费米子配对的（赝）全息方面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将传统Migdal-Eliashberg理论的结果与Yukawa-SYK模型的（非）超对称变体进行对比，评估了此前对强耦合问题的理解，并评论了此类模型中费米子配对的（赝）全息方面。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，包括对Migdal-Eliashberg近似的Schwinger-Dyson方程求解，以及与Yukawa-SYK模型（含超对称变体）的对比研究。

papers.title: Nonperturbative renormalization of Haldane pseudopotentials from the exact two-electron spectrum
papers.abstract: Haldane pseudopotentials $V_{|m|}$ provide the effective interaction parameters governing correlated states in the fractional quantum Hall regime. In conventional formulations, these quantities are obtained by projecting the Coulomb interaction onto relative-angular-momentum states within the lowest Landau level, thereby neglecting virtual transitions to higher Landau levels. Here, we formulate a nonperturbative description of effective interactions directly from the exact two-electron spectrum in a magnetic field. By solving the relative-motion problem beyond the lowest-Landau-level approximation, we define renormalized pseudopotentials $V^*_{|m|}$ from the exact eigenenergies and introduce dynamical corrections $Δ_{|m|}=V^*_{|m|}-V_{|m|}$. The corrections remain systematically negative and depend strongly on both interaction strength and relative angular momentum, reflecting dynamical correlation effects associated with higher-state virtual admixture. The exact results reproduce the perturbative Landau-level-mixing limit at weak coupling while exhibiting substantial deviations in the strong-mixing regime, signaling the breakdown of low-order perturbative expansions. In particular, the short-range interaction channels relevant to Laughlin-type correlations undergo strong renormalization, leading to substantial modification of the effective interaction hierarchy in strongly interacting systems such as ZnO/MgZnO heterostructures. The present formulation establishes a microscopic framework for incorporating nonperturbative Landau-level-mixing effects into effective interaction theories of quantum Hall systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非微扰重整化、有效相互作用理论、Landau能级混合。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔效应体系中的Haldane赝势，特别是ZnO/MgZnO异质结等强相互作用系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解两电子相对运动问题，发现非微扰重整化后的Haldane赝势修正始终为负，且强烈依赖于相互作用强度和相对角动量；短程相互作用通道（与Laughlin关联相关）在强耦合区发生显著重整化，导致有效相互作用层级发生实质性改变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解两电子相对运动问题，发现非微扰重整化后的Haldane赝势修正始终为负，且强烈依赖于相互作用强度和相对角动量；短程相互作用通道（与Laughlin关联相关）在强耦合区发生显著重整化，导致有效相互作用层级发生实质性改变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰方法：直接求解磁场中两电子相对运动问题的精确本征能量，超越最低朗道能级近似，从而定义重整化赝势V*_{|m|}，并计算动力学修正Δ_{|m|}。

papers.title: Discovering Thermodynamically Admissible Dissipation Potentials via Grammar-Based Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract: Constitutive laws for inelastic materials must satisfy strict thermodynamic admissibility requirements, yet current data-driven approaches sacrifice interpretability, even when formal guarantees are provided by physics-encoded architectures. We propose a symbolic regression framework for the data-driven discovery of dissipation potentials governing the evolution of internal variables within the Generalized Standard Materials (GSM) formalism. Starting from the Clausius--Duhem inequality, we enforce the thermodynamic requirements, convexity and non-negativity, that the dual dissipation potential must satisfy to guarantee non-negative mechanical dissipation. These requirements are formulated in the general subdifferential setting, encompassing rate-dependent (viscoelastic) and viscoplastic dissipative mechanisms, including potentials with genuine elastic domains, within a unified framework. Candidate potentials are generated by a composition-extended convexity-preserving grammar that guarantees thermodynamic admissibility \emph{by construction}. The framework is validated on synthetic datasets spanning Newtonian, power-law, and Bingham viscoplastic ground truths under process and measurement noise, and on experimental oscillatory shear measurements of a synthetic elastomer across multiple strain amplitudes and frequencies, where the discovered potentials reproduce the amplitude-dependent softening of the dynamic moduli and outperform a calibrated linear Zener baseline.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：symbolic regression（符号回归）、data-driven discovery（数据驱动发现）、thermodynamic admissibility（热力学容许性）。；研究对象：非弹性材料的耗散势函数，具体涵盖率相关（粘弹性）和粘塑性耗散机制，包括具有弹性域的本构模型（如牛顿流体、幂律流体、宾汉粘塑性体），以及合成弹性体的实验振荡剪切数据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于语法的符号回归框架，能够自动发现满足热力学容许性（凸性和非负性）的对偶耗散势，在合成数据和实验数据上均成功复现了粘弹性/粘塑性行为，并优于线性Zener模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于语法的符号回归框架，能够自动发现满足热力学容许性（凸性和非负性）的对偶耗散势，在合成数据和实验数据上均成功复现了粘弹性/粘塑性行为，并优于线性Zener模型。；创新点：通过语法约束保证生成的耗散势函数“天生”满足热力学容许性（凸性和非负性），无需后验验证或物理编码架构，同时保持模型的可解释性。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义标准材料（GSM）形式体系，基于Clausius-Duhem不等式推导热力学约束；使用组合扩展的凸性保持语法（composition-extended convexity-preserving grammar）生成候选耗散势函数，通过符号回归从数据中自动发现解析表达式。

papers.title: Multiplet-Selective Photoelectron Diffraction from an Altermagnet
papers.abstract: Direct real-space probes of altermagnetic order remain scarce. Here we introduce multiplet-selective photoelectron diffraction (PED), a methodology in which different regions of a transition-metal core-level multiplet act as distinct photoemission source waves. Using multiple-scattering calculations for the metallic altermagnet candidate CrSb, we show that selected Cr $3p$ multiplet features with predominantly $Y_1^{+1}$ and $Y_1^{-1}$ character generate robust diffraction asymmetries sensitive to altermagnetic domains. We demonstrate that both circularly and linearly polarized light provide access to the effect, while suitable combinations of domains, light polarizations, and multiplet-energy windows suppress nonmagnetic diffraction backgrounds. The proposed approach can be implemented using standard momentum-resolved photoemission instrumentation and establishes core-level PED as a practical route toward domain-resolved studies of altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用多重散射计算”（using multiple-scattering calculations），未提及实验数据采集。；研究对象：金属性交变磁体候选材料 CrSb，具体研究其 Cr 3p 芯能级多重态的光电子衍射现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过选择 Cr 3p 多重态中具有主要 Y₁⁺¹ 和 Y₁⁻¹ 特征的特定峰，可以产生对交变磁畴敏感的稳健衍射不对称性，从而实现交变磁序的实空间探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过选择 Cr 3p 多重态中具有主要 Y₁⁺¹ 和 Y₁⁻¹ 特征的特定峰，可以产生对交变磁畴敏感的稳健衍射不对称性，从而实现交变磁序的实空间探测。；创新点：提出了“多重态选择性光电子衍射”（multiplet-selective PED）这一新方法，利用过渡金属芯能级多重态中不同区域作为不同的光电子发射源波，从而实现对交变磁畴的区分，而无需依赖自旋分辨探测。
papers.method_zh: 多重散射计算（multiple-scattering calculations），结合动量分辨光电子发射谱（momentum-resolved photoemission instrumentation）的模拟分析，并考虑了圆偏振和线偏振光激发。

papers.title: Kohn-Luttinger Superconductivity of Weyl Fermi Arcs in PtBi$_2$
papers.abstract: Recent experimental observations in the noncentrosymmetric Weyl semimetal PtBi$_2$ indicate unconventional superconductivity hosted by topological surface states -- Weyl Fermi arcs -- with a node at the center of each arc. Focusing on these Fermi arcs, we calculate the electronically mediated pairing interaction using a Kohn-Luttinger approach and find that, in a large region of the phase diagram, the leading superconducting instability has an $i$-wave symmetry featuring precisely such an intra-arc node. We study the dependence of the leading superconducting instabilities on electronic interaction parameters and chemical potential and show that the $i$-wave state is robust to changes in the model parameters. Our results provide a possible mechanism for the observation of topological $i$-wave superconductivity on the surface of PtBi$_2$ and may have implications for the broader landscape of superconducting instabilities arising from repulsive interactions on the surfaces of Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“calculate”、“Kohn-Luttinger approach”、“find that...the leading superconducting instability”。；研究对象：非中心对称Weyl半金属PtBi₂表面的拓扑表面态——Weyl费米弧，以及由这些费米弧承载的非常规超导性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Kohn-Luttinger方法计算发现，在相图的大片区域中，由Weyl费米弧主导的电子配对相互作用会导致一种具有i波对称性的超导失稳，该i波态在每个费米弧中心恰好有一个节点，且该态对模型参数变化具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Kohn-Luttinger方法计算发现，在相图的大片区域中，由Weyl费米弧主导的电子配对相互作用会导致一种具有i波对称性的超导失稳，该i波态在每个费米弧中心恰好有一个节点，且该态对模型参数变化具有鲁棒性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Kohn-Luttinger理论框架，计算由电子间排斥相互作用介导的配对相互作用，并分析超导失稳的主导通道及其对称性。研究了电子相互作用参数和化学势对主导超导失稳的影响。

papers.title: General-purpose LLMs as Constrained Crystal Composition Generators
papers.abstract: The targeted discovery of inorganic materials remains challenging due to the vastness of compositional design spaces and the high cost of exhaustive screening. Task-specific generative artificial intelligence represents a particularly efficient alternative to screening, yet demands tedious collection of training data before providing real benefit. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) have recently shown tremendous potential for the targeted generation of single, optimal materials compositions without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. However, it is unclear whether LLMs generally pose an advantage compared to specialized generative models, in particular in large design spaces. Here, we demonstrate that such models are capable of covering entire regions of the targeted property space effectively and systematically. Using Elpasolite materials as an established benchmark for generative tasks in large chemical spaces, we find that an iterative prompt-and-response framework is able to recover on average 96% of all low-energy Elpasolites in the target region. This performance, driven mainly by iterative in-context learning, surpasses the generative abilities of previous, task-specific models. Our results establish general-purpose LLMs as flexible and accessible components for inverse materials design workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“generative artificial intelligence”、“large language models (LLMs)”、“iterative prompt-and-response framework”等，属于利用机器学习模型进行材料生成与性能预测的计算研究。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的成分生成，具体以Elpasolite（埃尔帕索石）材料体系作为基准测试对象，研究其低能量构型的覆盖能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通用大语言模型（LLMs）无需任务特定微调，即可有效且系统地覆盖目标性质空间中的整个区域，在Elpasolite材料生成任务中平均恢复96%的低能量构型，性能超越此前任务特定的生成模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通用大语言模型（LLMs）无需任务特定微调，即可有效且系统地覆盖目标性质空间中的整个区域，在Elpasolite材料生成任务中平均恢复96%的低能量构型，性能超越此前任务特定的生成模型。；创新点：证明了通用大语言模型在无需专门训练数据收集和微调的情况下，能够在大化学空间中有效生成目标材料成分，且性能优于此前任务特定的生成模型，为逆向材料设计提供了灵活且易用的新工具。
papers.method_zh: 采用通用大语言模型（LLMs）结合迭代式提示-响应框架（iterative prompt-and-response framework），通过上下文学习（in-context learning）进行约束条件下的晶体成分生成，并以Elpasolite材料作为基准测试任务。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium scaling of drag forces in counterdriven fluid mixtures
papers.abstract: We address the effective nonequilibrium drag force field that emerges from the microscopic interparticle interactions in steady states of counterdriven binary fluid mixtures. Using power functional scaling arguments for adaptive Brownian dynamics computer simulation results, we establish quantitatively the crossover between near-equilibrium linear response and far-nonequilibrium square root asymptotics. An algebraic expression captures both limiting cases and remains applicable in the crossover regime. Using simulation results as benchmarks, we verify that a local power functional approximation based on the scaling law reproduces the spatial nonequilibrium structure formation in inhomogenously driven systems. The crossover scenario transcends dynamical density functional theory and it sheds light on general nonequilibrium scaling of driven fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：使用“power functional scaling arguments”和“adaptive Brownian dynamics computer simulation”进行理论推导与数值模拟验证。；研究对象：对向驱动二元流体混合物中由微观粒子间相互作用产生的非平衡拖曳力场，以及其从近平衡到远非平衡的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了拖曳力从近平衡线性响应到远非平衡平方根渐近行为的定量交叉，并提出了一个代数表达式统一描述这两种极限及交叉区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了拖曳力从近平衡线性响应到远非平衡平方根渐近行为的定量交叉，并提出了一个代数表达式统一描述这两种极限及交叉区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用功率泛函标度论证（power functional scaling arguments）结合自适应布朗动力学计算机模拟（adaptive Brownian dynamics computer simulation），并通过模拟结果作为基准验证局部功率泛函近似的有效性。

papers.title: Ab Initio Spinor Kadanoff-Baym Approach to Nonequilibrium Electron, Phonon and Magnon Dynamics in Itinerant Ferromagnets
papers.abstract: This work introduces a theoretical framework based on the Kadanoff-Baym equations in spinor space to study ultrafast magnetization dynamics in itinerant ferromagnetic systems from first principles. By incorporating spin-orbit coupling into the ab initio Hamiltonian and generalizing the self-energies to include terms beyond the charge sector, I derive scattering integrals within the Markov approximation and quasiparticle renormalizations for electrons and phonons in the presence of spin-dependent effective interactions within a many-body perturbation theory approach. I explicitly discuss how magnons emerge in this framework, and derive, through suitable approximations, a close and tractable set of equations for coupled electron,phonon and magnon dynamics that can be solved from first principles. This approach allows to treat coherent and incoherent magnetic dynamics on an equal footing, paving the way for a first principles understanding of ultrafast magnetic dynamics and demagnetization, and opening to a truly predictive theory of femtomagnetism in periodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical framework”、“derived”、“first principles”、“many-body perturbation theory”。；研究对象：巡游铁磁体系中的超快磁化动力学，具体涉及电子、声子和磁振子的非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于自旋空间的Kadanoff-Baym方程，从第一性原理出发推导了一套可求解的耦合电子-声子-磁振子动力学方程，能够统一处理相干与非相干磁动力学，为理解超快退磁和飞秒磁学提供了预测性理论框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于自旋空间的Kadanoff-Baym方程，从第一性原理出发推导了一套可求解的耦合电子-声子-磁振子动力学方程，能够统一处理相干与非相干磁动力学，为理解超快退磁和飞秒磁学提供了预测性理论框架。；创新点：首次在自旋空间中将Kadanoff-Baym方程推广至包含自旋-轨道耦合和自旋依赖相互作用的完整第一性原理框架，并明确展示了磁振子如何在该框架中自然涌现，实现了相干与非相干磁动力学的统一处理。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理Kadanoff-Baym方程（自旋空间形式），结合自旋-轨道耦合的ab initio哈密顿量，在马尔可夫近似下推导散射积分和准粒子重整化，并通过多体微扰理论引入自旋依赖的有效相互作用，最终导出电子、声子、磁振子的耦合动力学方程。

papers.title: Cooperative Conformational Transitions in Macromolecules under Mechanical Stretching. An Exactly Solved Model for Single Molecule Experiments
papers.abstract: The stretching behavior of linear macromolecules undergoing conformational transitions is investigated. An exact solution is provided for a two-state system within the elastic freely jointed chain model. This minimal framework contains the smallest set of parameters required to describe such transitions: two Kuhn lengths, two elastic force constants, a free energy difference between both states and a nearest-neighbor interaction energy accounting for cooperativity. Explicit analytical expressions are derived for the chain extension and the probabilities of each state as functions of the applied force.The approach accurately reproduces the experimental force-extension curves of poly(ethylene-glycol) (PEG) and hyaluronic acid (HA), revealing no cooperativity for PEG and negative cooperativity for HA. It also describes the B-DNA to S-DNA conformational transition, a process that exhibits positive cooperativity.We analyze the mathematical conditions required for a transition and identify two fundamental driving mechanisms: differences in Kuhn lengths and differences in force constants.Extensions of the model to systems with more than two conformational states per Kuhn segment are also discussed. The results presented here apply equally to transitions that are intrinsic to the macromolecular structure or induced by ligand-receptor interactions, unifying both cases within a single thermodynamically consistent framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：exact solution, analytical expressions, model）；研究对象：线性大分子在机械拉伸下的构象转变行为，具体包括聚乙二醇（PEG）、透明质酸（HA）以及B-DNA到S-DNA的构象转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该两态弹性自由连接链模型能精确再现PEG、HA和B-DNA到S-DNA的力-延伸曲线，并揭示PEG无协同性、HA呈负协同性、B-DNA到S-DNA转变呈正协同性；构象转变的两种基本驱动力为Kuhn长度差异和力常数差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该两态弹性自由连接链模型能精确再现PEG、HA和B-DNA到S-DNA的力-延伸曲线，并揭示PEG无协同性、HA呈负协同性、B-DNA到S-DNA转变呈正协同性；构象转变的两种基本驱动力为Kuhn长度差异和力常数差异。；创新点：在最小参数集（两个Kuhn长度、两个弹性力常数、两态自由能差、最近邻相互作用能）下，为单分子实验中大分子构象转变提供了精确可解的理论框架，并统一描述了结构本征转变和配体-受体诱导转变。
papers.method_zh: 基于弹性自由连接链模型，构建两态系统并给出精确解析解；推导链延伸和状态概率作为外加力函数的显式解析表达式；通过拟合实验力-延伸曲线验证模型。

papers.title: What controls the superconducting dome of electron-doped FeSe?
papers.abstract: Superconducting domes are conspicuous features of the phase diagrams of most unconventional and high-temperature superconductors. The superconducting transition temperature ($T_{c}$) of FeSe can be dramatically enhanced with electron doping, but unlike all other high-temperature and unconventional superconductors, its full phase diagram and superconducting dome have yet to be fully explored. Here, we employ a combination of molecular beam epitaxy synthesis, alkali surface doping, in-vacuum electrical transport, and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to investigate the entire superconducting dome of electron-doped FeSe, achieving a fully metallic state where superconductivity is suppressed in the heavily overdoped regime. We discover a robust scaling between $T_{c}$ and the residual resistivity ($ρ_{0}$) which holds across the entire superconducting dome, suggesting that the evolution of $T_{c}$ is heavily influenced by the evolution of the elastic scattering rate in the high-$T_{c}$ electron-doped phase. This in turn suggests that the superconducting dome in electron-doped FeSe appears to be fundamentally different than that of other unconventional superconductors where doping plays the primary role, and may be driven primarily by the sensitivity of the superconductivity to disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“分子束外延合成”、“碱金属表面掺杂”、“真空电输运”和“角分辨光电子能谱”等实验手段。；研究对象：电子掺杂的FeSe（铁硒）超导体，具体研究其整个超导穹顶（superconducting dome）的相图及超导转变温度（Tc）的控制因素。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现电子掺杂FeSe的超导穹顶中，超导转变温度（Tc）与残余电阻率（ρ₀）之间存在稳健的标度关系，表明Tc的演化主要受弹性散射率（即无序程度）的影响，而非传统意义上的载流子掺杂量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现电子掺杂FeSe的超导穹顶中，超导转变温度（Tc）与残余电阻率（ρ₀）之间存在稳健的标度关系，表明Tc的演化主要受弹性散射率（即无序程度）的影响，而非传统意义上的载流子掺杂量。；创新点：首次完整绘制了电子掺杂FeSe从欠掺杂到过掺杂（超导被抑制的完全金属态）的整个超导穹顶，并揭示了该体系中超导穹顶的物理机制与其它非常规超导体（如铜氧化物）不同，其主导因素可能是超导对无序的敏感性，而非单纯的掺杂效应。
papers.method_zh: 结合了分子束外延（MBE）薄膜生长、碱金属（如钾、钠）表面掺杂、原位真空电输运测量以及角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）技术。

papers.title: Solving models with generalized free fermions II: Path-product expansion and conserved charges
papers.abstract: Free-fermion solvability in quantum spin systems is increasingly understood to be governed by a graph Clifford algebra defined from the frustration graph of the Hamiltonian. When the frustration graph belongs to certain classes, such as the even-hole-free and claw-free (ECF) class, the Hamiltonian is solvable by hidden free fermions: it admits a free-fermion solution although it does not reduce to a Majorana bilinear under the Jordan-Wigner transformation. However, unlike in the Jordan-Wigner case, where each mode is a linear combination of single Majorana fermions, the explicit operator structure of the hidden free-fermion modes -- and that of the local conserved charges -- has remained obscure. In this work, we derive a path-product expansion that expresses each free-fermion mode as a linear combination of path products along induced paths in the extended frustration graph. The expansion is obtained from the generating function of the Krylov basis and yields the modes directly, without using the transfer matrix or the nonlocal conserved charges as input. As an application, the mode decomposition computes infinite-temperature dynamical correlation functions for arbitrary ECF frustration graphs. We further obtain explicit expressions for local conserved charges as linear combinations of path products along induced paths; these charges apply beyond the free-fermion (ECF) class to more general claw-free frustration graphs. We also identify a unified family of generalized conserved charges that contains both the previously known nonlocal conserved charges and these local conserved charges as special cases. For Fendley's original FFD chain with homogeneous couplings and periodic boundary conditions, in a suitable basis, the structure of these local conserved charges exhibits the same Catalan-tree pattern as in the spin-$1/2$ XXX chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：free-fermion solvability、graph Clifford algebra、path-product expansion、generating function、Krylov basis。；研究对象：量子自旋系统中隐藏自由费米子可解模型，特别是具有偶空穴自由且无爪（ECF）类受挫图的哈密顿量，以及更一般的无爪受挫图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出路径积展开，将每个自由费米子模式表示为扩展受挫图中诱导路径的线性组合，并获得了局域守恒荷的显式表达式；这些局域守恒荷适用于更一般的无爪受挫图，且与已知非局域守恒荷统一于一个广义守恒荷家族。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出路径积展开，将每个自由费米子模式表示为扩展受挫图中诱导路径的线性组合，并获得了局域守恒荷的显式表达式；这些局域守恒荷适用于更一般的无爪受挫图，且与已知非局域守恒荷统一于一个广义守恒荷家族。；创新点：首次直接给出了隐藏自由费米子模式（而非约旦-维格纳变换下的马约拉纳双线性）的显式算符结构，并得到了局域守恒荷的路径积表达式；揭示了在Fendley的FFD链中，局域守恒荷的结构与自旋1/2 XXX链中的Catalan树模式相同。
papers.method_zh: 基于受挫图的图克利福德代数，利用Krylov基的生成函数直接导出自由费米子模式的路径积展开，无需使用转移矩阵或非局域守恒荷作为输入；通过模式分解计算了任意ECF受挫图的无限温度动力学关联函数。

papers.title: Strain-Engineered s-C$_3$N$_6$ Monolayer for Efficient Water Splitting: A first-principles study
papers.abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting offers a sustainable route for solar-to-hydrogen energy conversion, yet identifying stable, metal-free semiconductors with suitable electronic, optical, and band-alignment properties remains challenging. Here, we investigate the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, and photocatalytic properties of the two-dimensional s-C$_3$N$_6$ monolayer using first-principles calculations. Ab initio molecular dynamics and elastic constant analysis confirm its thermal and mechanical stability. Hybrid HSE06 calculations reveal pristine s-C$_3$N$_6$ is a direct-band-gap semiconductor (2.62 eV). However, its conduction-band minimum lies below the hydrogen reduction potential, preventing spontaneous hydrogen evolution. To overcome this limitation, we employ biaxial and uniaxial strains (-10% to +10%) to modulate its electronic structure. We find that compressive biaxial strains of -8% and -10% uniquely tune the band edges to straddle the redox potentials, enabling spontaneous overall water splitting. Crucially, these photocatalytically active states remain mechanically and thermally stable. Optical properties calculations show the fundamental gap in both pristine and strained structures is optically dark, with the primary absorption peak in the UV region. Furthermore, a strain-induced mobility mismatch between electrons and holes facilitates efficient charge separation. However, thermodynamic modeling of surface kinetics reveals that the s-C$_3$N$_6$ surface binds intermediates strongly, necessitating a co-catalyst to overcome kinetic barriers. Our results establish strain engineering as an effective strategy to tailor band-edge alignment, carrier dynamics, and optical transitions in s-C$_3$N$_6$, highlighting its potential for stable 2D photocatalytic water splitting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations、HSE06、ab initio molecular dynamics。；研究对象：二维s-C₃N₆单层材料的光催化水分解性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原始s-C₃N₆单层是直接带隙半导体（2.62 eV），但其导带底低于析氢电位，无法自发产氢；通过施加-8%和-10%的双轴压缩应变，可使其能带边缘跨越氧化还原电位，实现自发全解水。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原始s-C₃N₆单层是直接带隙半导体（2.62 eV），但其导带底低于析氢电位，无法自发产氢；通过施加-8%和-10%的双轴压缩应变，可使其能带边缘跨越氧化还原电位，实现自发全解水。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（基于杂化泛函HSE06）、从头算分子动力学（AIMD）、弹性常数分析、光学性质计算、表面动力学热力学建模。

papers.title: Optimization of multisite reactions in complex compartmentalized media
papers.abstract: In complex media, transport and geometric properties deeply influence the kinetics of random encounters between reactants. Here, we consider the situation where a random walker, moving in a regularly diffusing medium, has to reach and activate a target located inside a compartment characterized by fractal (obstructed) sub-diffusion. We focus on dual-site reactions, which end when two activation events occur within a given time window. Each activation event happens with a finite probability whenever the random walker visits the target. For weakly reactive targets, we demonstrate that the reaction time can be minimized for an optimal compartment size and can even be accelerated when compared to the same system without compartment. Our analytical predictions are validated through simulations of a random walker on a cubic lattice, where some sites inside the compartment are obstructed at the critical percolation threshold. Our theory illustrates the fact that adding a crowded compartment around a target, even if it slows down the motion in its vicinity, can accelerate the kinetics of complex reactions, especially for weakly reactive targets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含模拟验证）。判断依据：关键词“analytical predictions”“simulations of a random walker on a cubic lattice”。；研究对象：复杂介质中多位置反应（dual-site reactions）的动力学，具体为随机游走者在规则扩散介质中需激活位于分形（受阻）亚扩散隔室内的靶点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于弱反应性靶点，存在一个最优隔室尺寸可使反应时间最小化，且与无隔室系统相比，反应动力学可被加速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于弱反应性靶点，存在一个最优隔室尺寸可使反应时间最小化，且与无隔室系统相比，反应动力学可被加速。；创新点：揭示了在靶点周围添加拥挤隔室（即使局部运动变慢）可加速复杂反应动力学，尤其对弱反应性靶点有效。摘要未突出说明与已有理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值模拟。采用随机游走模型在立方晶格上进行模拟，隔室内部分布有处于临界逾渗阈值下的受阻位点，以模拟分形亚扩散环境。

papers.title: Odd-Parity Magnons
papers.abstract: Magnons, as charge-neutral spin excitations, can transport spin information without Joule heating and therefore offer a promising platform for low-power spintronics. However, in collinear magnets, the effective time-reversal symmetry forbids odd-parity magnon band splitting. Here we propose odd-parity magnons and establish a general mechanism for realizing them in collinear antiferromagnets. We provide a complete spin-point-group classification of odd-parity magnon splitting in two-dimensional collinear antiferromagnets by identifying the leading splitting types and their symmetry-allowed basis functions. This classification serves as a practical guide for searching for odd-parity magnons. We show that breaking effective time-reversal symmetry, for example by circularly polarized light or loop currents, can induce highly tunable $p$- and $f$-wave magnon splitting. In bilayer systems, the dynamical modulation can drive a topological magnon phase transition, accompanied by chiral edge modes and an abrupt jump in the magnon thermal Hall conductivity. Material-specific first-principles calculations further demonstrate the feasibility of this mechanism in real van der Waals antiferromagnets. Our study identifies the odd-parity magnons as a new class of spin excitations and provides a theoretical foundation for odd-parity magnons and ultrafast optically controlled topological magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算）。判断依据：提出理论机制、对称性分类、模型计算、材料计算。；研究对象：奇宇称磁振子（odd-parity magnons），具体在二维共线反铁磁体中的实现，以及其在范德华反铁磁材料中的可行性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出在共线反铁磁体中实现奇宇称磁振子的一般机制，并给出二维共线反铁磁体中奇宇称磁振子劈裂的完整自旋点群分类。通过打破有效时间反演对称性（如圆偏振光或环电流），可诱导高度可调的p波和f波磁振子劈裂，并在双层体系中驱动拓扑磁振子相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出在共线反铁磁体中实现奇宇称磁振子的一般机制，并给出二维共线反铁磁体中奇宇称磁振子劈裂的完整自旋点群分类。通过打破有效时间反演对称性（如圆偏振光或环电流），可诱导高度可调的p波和f波磁振子劈裂，并在双层体系中驱动拓扑磁振子相变。；创新点：首次提出“奇宇称磁振子”这一新概念，并建立了在共线反铁磁体中实现该自旋激发的普适对称性框架，为超快光控拓扑磁振子器件提供了理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 自旋点群对称性分析、对称性允许的基函数分类、动力学调制（圆偏振光/环电流）模型、第一性原理计算（针对具体范德华反铁磁材料）。

papers.title: Crystallisation kinetics of supercooled liquid palladium
authors: Robert W. E. van de Kruijs
papers.abstract: In this study, we employ classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the crystallisation kinetics of supercooled liquid palladium and relate the results to time-resolved X-ray diffraction measurements on rapidly quenched Pd thin films. Crystal nucleation and growth rates are determined over the temperature range $700$--$1150~\mathrm{K}$ ($0.38$--$0.65 T_{\mathrm{m}}$) by analysing the evolution of the microstructure during the liquid-to-crystal transition. The self-diffusion coefficient of Pd, obtained from the atomic mean-squared displacement, follows Arrhenius behaviour over the investigated temperature range, with an activation energy of $467(6)~\mathrm{meV/atom}$, consistent with available data for supercooled liquid metals. The steady-state homogeneous nucleation rate exhibits a maximum of approximately $4 \times 10^{35}~\mathrm{m^{-3} s^{-1}}$ near $0.5 T_{\mathrm{m}}$. Crystal growth occurs at velocities of the order of metres per second, with a temperature dependence consistent with diffusion-limited Wilson-Frenkel kinetics rather than the collision-limited regime. Based on multiple statistically independent simulations, a time-temperature-transformation (TTT) diagram for crystallisation onset is constructed. The TTT curve exhibits a nose near $0.5 T_{\mathrm{m}}$ and $100~\mathrm{ps}$, corresponding to a critical cooling rate for vitrification on the order of $10^{13}~\mathrm{K s^{-1}}.$ The simulations reproduce the crystallisation onset time and temperature observed in time-resolved X-ray diffraction experiments on optically molten Pd thin films quenched at $5 \times 10^{11}~\mathrm{K s^{-1}}.$ These results indicate that homogeneous, rather than heterogeneous, nucleation governs the achievable supercooling in the experimentally studied films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations、simulations、statistically independent simulations）；研究对象：过冷液态钯（supercooled liquid palladium）的结晶动力学，具体包括晶体成核与生长速率、自扩散系数、时间-温度-转变（TTT）图等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过冷液态钯的稳态均匀成核速率在约0.5 Tm（熔点）附近达到最大值约4×10³⁵ m⁻³ s⁻¹；晶体生长速度达米/秒量级，受扩散限制的Wilson-Frenkel动力学支配而非碰撞限制；模拟得到的结晶起始时间与温度与时间分辨X射线衍射实验观测一致，表明实验薄膜中可达到的过冷度由均匀成核而非异质成核主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过冷液态钯的稳态均匀成核速率在约0.5 Tm（熔点）附近达到最大值约4×10³⁵ m⁻³ s⁻¹；晶体生长速度达米/秒量级，受扩散限制的Wilson-Frenkel动力学支配而非碰撞限制；模拟得到的结晶起始时间与温度与时间分辨X射线衍射实验观测一致，表明实验薄膜中可达到的过冷度由均匀成核而非异质成核主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 经典分子动力学（MD）模拟，通过分析液-晶转变过程中微观结构的演化确定成核与生长速率；利用原子均方位移计算自扩散系数；构建时间-温度-转变（TTT）图；与时间分辨X射线衍射实验（对快速淬火Pd薄膜）结果进行对比。

papers.title: Direct Observation of Chemical Short-Range Order in CoCrNi Alloy Using Neutron Diffraction
papers.abstract: This study provides experimental evidence of chemical short-range order (CSRO) in the equiatomic CoCrNi alloy, identified through neutron diffraction. The phenomenon manifests as a distinct diffuse peak at Q = 1.85 A-1, the intensity increases under thermodynamically favorable conditions for CSRO development such as prolonged aging (100 h and 240 h) at 748 K or shorter aging (24 h) at slightly higher temperature (798 K). The degree of ordering was measured by integrating the diffuse scattering intensity, revealing that the gas-atomized sample, i.e. the sample with the least amount of CSRO, still displays approximately 70% of the CSRO level observed in the sample subsequently aged for 240 h at 748 K, i.e. the sample with the highest amount of CSRO produced in this study. Predictive atomistic simulations reproduced both the presence and position of the diffuse peak, while two-dimensional fast Fourier transform (FT-2D) analyses indicated that reflections at (1 1/2 0) within the <001> zone axis originate from some structural projections associated with like D022, Pt2Mo and D1a motifs. Complementary small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) measurements identified Ni-rich, disk-shaped domains with radii of approximately 11 A and thicknesses of about 1 A, consistent with nanoscale CSRO characteristic length scale. These findings demonstrate that CSRO is an intrinsic and energetically favorable feature of the CoCrNi system, remaining stable even under rapid solidification and further enhanced by low-temperature aging. Combined use of neutron diffraction and atomistic modeling provides a framework for probing local ordering phenomena in multi-principal element alloys (MPEAs).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：neutron diffraction（中子衍射）、SANS（小角中子散射）为主要实验手段，同时包含predictive atomistic simulations（预测性原子模拟）和FT-2D分析。；研究对象：等原子比CoCrNi合金中的化学短程有序（CSRO）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中子衍射直接观测到CoCrNi合金中CSRO对应的弥散峰（Q=1.85 Å⁻¹），证实CSRO是该体系内禀且能量上有利的特征，即使在快速凝固条件下仍稳定存在，低温时效可进一步增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中子衍射直接观测到CoCrNi合金中CSRO对应的弥散峰（Q=1.85 Å⁻¹），证实CSRO是该体系内禀且能量上有利的特征，即使在快速凝固条件下仍稳定存在，低温时效可进一步增强。；创新点：首次通过中子衍射直接提供CoCrNi合金中CSRO的实验证据，并定量比较了不同热处理条件下CSRO的相对程度（快速凝固样品仍保有约70%的最高有序度）。摘要未突出说明与以往间接证据或理论预测相比的具体突破。
