papers.method_zh: 中子衍射（neutron diffraction）测量弥散散射峰强度；小角中子散射（SANS）表征纳米尺度有序畴的形貌与尺寸；预测性原子模拟（predictive atomistic simulations）复现弥散峰位置；二维快速傅里叶变换（FT-2D）分析识别与D0₂₂、Pt₂Mo、D1ₐ结构基元相关的衍射特征。

papers.title: Spontaneous flows and interfacial instabilities in oxygen-sensitive living active matter
papers.abstract: Active fluids generate motion and stress internally, but in living systems this activity is often regulated by environmental fields that the organisms consume or produce. Here we show that oxygen gradients organise and destabilise dense suspensions of the flagellated microswimmer \textit{Euglena gracilis}. In circular chambers open to air at the periphery, oxygen exchange and cellular consumption generate a radial chemical gradient. An initially homogeneous suspension spontaneously forms a dense cellular ring through oxygen-dependent motility and bidirectional oxytaxis. The ring then develops collective rotation and destabilises into a long-lived corona of protrusions. We reproduce this sequence with an oxygen-coupled polar active-fluid model in which oxygen controls both the direction and speed of cell motion, while dipolar active stresses drive the instability of the dense interface. The simulations show that oxygen taxis creates the annular active interface, but the subsequent corona is an activity-driven interfacial instability. Our results reveal how a self-generated chemical gradient can position and activate a living fluid, providing a route to environmental control of active-matter flows and interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验观察（“In circular chambers...”）和数值模拟（“We reproduce this sequence with an oxygen-coupled polar active-fluid model”）。；研究对象：氧敏感活性物质中的自发流动与界面不稳定性，具体体系为鞭毛微生物 *Euglena gracilis*（眼虫）的密集悬浮液，在开放至空气的圆形腔室中受氧气梯度调控的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧气梯度通过调控微生物的趋氧运动（oxytaxis）和运动速度，使初始均匀悬浮液自发形成致密细胞环，随后该环产生集体旋转并失稳为长寿命的冠状突起结构；该冠状结构是由活性偶极应力驱动的界面不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧气梯度通过调控微生物的趋氧运动（oxytaxis）和运动速度，使初始均匀悬浮液自发形成致密细胞环，随后该环产生集体旋转并失稳为长寿命的冠状突起结构；该冠状结构是由活性偶极应力驱动的界面不稳定性。；创新点：揭示了自生化学梯度（氧气）如何定位并激活活性流体，提供了一种通过环境场控制活性物质流动和界面的途径；具体展示了氧气趋氧性（oxytaxis）与活性应力驱动的界面不稳定性之间的协同作用。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用圆形腔室（周边开放至空气），通过氧气交换和细胞消耗产生径向化学梯度，观察 *Euglena gracilis* 悬浮液的自组织行为；理论上构建了氧耦合的极性活性流体模型，其中氧气同时控制细胞运动的方向和速度，偶极活性应力驱动致密界面的失稳。

papers.title: Co-optimization of spin coherence and valley splitting in Si/SiGe heterostructures
papers.abstract: Single electron spins can be used to encode and process information in semiconductor quantum devices. Progress has been hindered by materials challenges, such as the small energy splitting between low-lying valley states and hyperfine coupling to nuclear spins. Here we use density functional theory to optimize the valley splitting and spin dephasing time in realistic Si/SiGe heterostructures. Reductions in the Si quantum well width generally increase the valley splitting. However, in narrow quantum wells, a larger fraction of the electronic wavefunction resides in the SiGe buffer layers, which increases the hyperfine coupling with spinful $^{73}$Ge. Our work shows that Si/SiGe heterostructures with 3~--~4~nm wide quantum wells and $^{73}$Ge and $^{29}$Si concentrations of 50 ppm should support average valley splittings $E_{v}$~$>$~500~$μ$eV and spin dephasing times $T_2^*$ exceeding 15~$μ$s assuming an effective quantum dot area of 700 nm$^2$. In addition, sharper Si/SiGe interfaces in general result in larger valley splittings and longer spin dephasing times.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、optimize（优化）、realistic Si/SiGe heterostructures（实际Si/SiGe异质结构）。；研究对象：Si/SiGe异质结构中的单电子自旋量子比特，具体关注量子阱宽度、界面陡峭度、同位素浓度对谷分裂（valley splitting）和自旋退相位时间（spin dephasing time）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化量子阱宽度（3~4 nm）并控制⁷³Ge和²⁹Si浓度至50 ppm，可在有效量子点面积700 nm²下实现平均谷分裂>500 μeV且自旋退相位时间超过15 μs；更陡峭的Si/SiGe界面通常同时提升谷分裂和自旋退相位时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化量子阱宽度（3~4 nm）并控制⁷³Ge和²⁹Si浓度至50 ppm，可在有效量子点面积700 nm²下实现平均谷分裂>500 μeV且自旋退相位时间超过15 μs；更陡峭的Si/SiGe界面通常同时提升谷分裂和自旋退相位时间。；创新点：首次在真实Si/SiGe异质结构模型中同时优化谷分裂和自旋相干性，揭示了窄量子阱中波函数渗入SiGe缓冲层导致⁷³Ge超精细耦合增强这一关键权衡机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）对实际Si/SiGe异质结构进行第一性原理计算，系统扫描量子阱宽度、同位素浓度和界面形貌等参数。

papers.title: Feasibility study of continuous electronic Pomeranchuk cooling with a flavor-degenerate Wigner crystal
papers.abstract: Achieving sub-millikelvin electron temperatures in nanoelectronic devices could unveil new transport phenomena, extend quantum coherence times, and enhance the precision of quantum metrology. However, maintaining such low temperatures continuously remains a long-standing challenge. Here, we propose and simulate an on-chip cooling cycle that harnesses the entropy difference between an electron liquid (EL) and a Wigner crystal (WC) in flavor-degenerate flat-band materials. Cooling is driven by a current through a device with a locally gated region. Within this region, the charge carrier density is tuned such that a WC forms beneath the gate. As carriers transition from an EL to WC phase, their entropy increases, extracting heat and the sliding WC advects this heat along the device. The heat is then released when carriers transition back to the EL phase, which establishes distinct hot and cold regions and a steady temperature gradient over the device. Simulations show net cooling for sufficiently low current densities, typically below $1~\mathrm{nA}/μ\mathrm{m}$, whereas Joule heating dominates at higher currents. Within the gated region, we estimate cooling powers of up to $8.4~\mathrm{aW}/μ\mathrm{m}$ at a bath temperature of $4~\mathrm{mK}$. Our approach can achieve electron temperatures well below $1~\mathrm{mK}$ under suitable conditions, promising a route towards continuous on-chip cooling in this temperature regime. Our approach applies to any flat-band material with low-energy flavor degeneracy (valley and/or orbital) and low disorder, including gapped Bernal-stacked bilayer graphene, rhombohedral-stacked multilayer graphene, and magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“propose and simulate”（提出并模拟），属于理论设计与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是“味简并平带材料”中的电子液体（EL）与维格纳晶体（WC）之间的熵差，并利用该熵差实现片上连续冷却。具体材料包括：带隙的伯纳尔堆叠双层石墨烯、菱面体堆叠多层石墨烯、魔角扭曲双层石墨烯等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并模拟了一种基于电子液体与维格纳晶体之间熵差的片上连续冷却循环，在足够低的电流密度（通常低于1 nA/μm）下可实现净冷却，在4 mK浴温下栅极区域冷却功率可达8.4 aW/μm，有望将电子温度持续冷却至远低于1 mK。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并模拟了一种基于电子液体与维格纳晶体之间熵差的片上连续冷却循环，在足够低的电流密度（通常低于1 nA/μm）下可实现净冷却，在4 mK浴温下栅极区域冷却功率可达8.4 aW/μm，有望将电子温度持续冷却至远低于1 mK。；创新点：提出了一种利用平带材料中味简并维格纳晶体的熵变实现片上连续冷却的新机制，区别于传统脉冲式或单次冷却方案，可实现稳态温度梯度与持续低温运行。摘要未突出说明与已有冷却方案（如核绝热去磁、电子制冷等）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论设计与数值模拟。具体包括：构建一个带有局部栅极的器件结构，通过调节栅极下方载流子密度使维格纳晶体形成；利用电子液体与维格纳晶体之间的熵差驱动冷却循环；模拟电流驱动下滑动维格纳晶体的热输运过程，并分析焦耳热与净冷却的竞争关系。

papers.title: A Practical Guide for Diagnosing Imaginary Phonon Modes in Metal--Organic Frameworks: The Case of MOF-5
papers.abstract: Assessing the dynamical stability of computationally predicted metal--organic frameworks (MOFs) is essential to distinguish synthetically feasible structures from dynamically unstable ones. However, reliable first-principles phonon calculations on these systems remain challenging: their large, flexible unit cells and soft collective modes make the vibrational spectrum highly sensitive to the numerical settings. Using MOF-5 as a representative case study, we establish a finite-displacement workflow to identify and isolate the origins of imaginary phonon modes. We demonstrate how numerical force convergence thresholds, real-space grid resolutions, symmetry-standardization protocols, and alternative unit-cell representations can qualitatively and spuriously alter the predicted lattice stability. Once numerical noise is confidently excluded, the remaining imaginary modes can be analyzed through mode mapping or stochastic Monte Carlo symmetry-breaking distortions to locate lower-energy local minima. This protocol provides a robust, transferable strategy for the reliable assessment of dynamical stability and lattice vibrations in flexible porous frameworks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles phonon calculations、finite-displacement workflow、DFT（隐含）。；研究对象：金属有机框架（MOFs）的动力学稳定性，具体以MOF-5为案例，研究其声子谱中虚频模式的诊断方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 数值设置（如力收敛阈值、实空间网格分辨率、对称性标准化协议及原胞表示）会定性且虚假地改变MOF-5的晶格稳定性预测；排除数值噪声后，剩余虚频可通过模式映射或蒙特卡洛对称性破缺畸变找到更低能量的局域极小值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：数值设置（如力收敛阈值、实空间网格分辨率、对称性标准化协议及原胞表示）会定性且虚假地改变MOF-5的晶格稳定性预测；排除数值噪声后，剩余虚频可通过模式映射或蒙特卡洛对称性破缺畸变找到更低能量的局域极小值。；创新点：系统揭示了数值噪声如何导致MOF-5声子谱中虚频的虚假出现，并建立了从识别数值伪影到分析物理虚频的完整诊断协议，为柔性多孔框架的动力学稳定性评估提供了可迁移的稳健策略。
papers.method_zh: 有限位移法（finite-displacement workflow）进行第一性原理声子计算，结合模式映射（mode mapping）和随机蒙特卡洛对称性破缺畸变（stochastic Monte Carlo symmetry-breaking distortions）分析虚频模式。

papers.title: Limits of the Non-Linear Generalized Langevin Equation: Cross-Correlations, Irreversibility and Desynchronization
papers.abstract: The generalized Langevin equation (GLE) is widely used to model complex soft-matter systems, including biomolecular dynamics, by incorporating memory effects and colored noise into coarse-grained descriptions. However, recent results suggest that combining memory with non-linear forces, ubiquitous in soft matter, introduces fundamental analytical inconsistencies. Here, using a simplified model, we investigate the practical numerical consequences of these analytical results. We show that non-linear forces generate cross-correlations with the noise, modifying the fluctuation-dissipation theorem and rendering the noise position-dependent and irreversible. This implies that the commonly assumed reversible Gaussian noise in GLE simulations fails to capture essential features of the microscopic fluctuations. For weak non-linearities, these issues can be partially resolved either by using an iterative optimization of memory or by using microscopically consistent noise, which unexpectedly synchronizes GLE trajectories with the underlying microscopic dynamics. For stronger non-linearities like high barriers or shoulders in the external potential, however, iterative reconstruction fails and we observe desynchronization, indicating that the non-linear GLE no longer correctly reproduces the microscopic dynamics. Our results show in which situations non-linear GLEs can be accurately applied and when they fail, thus providing practical guidance for their application to coarse-grain soft-matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical inconsistencies、numerical consequences、model、simulations）；研究对象：非线性广义朗之万方程（non-linear GLE）在软物质粗粒化建模中的适用性，特别是生物分子动力学等复杂软物质系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性力会引入与噪声的交叉关联，破坏涨落-耗散定理，导致噪声位置依赖且不可逆；在强非线性（如高势垒或势能肩）下，非线性GLE无法正确再现微观动力学，出现去同步化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性力会引入与噪声的交叉关联，破坏涨落-耗散定理，导致噪声位置依赖且不可逆；在强非线性（如高势垒或势能肩）下，非线性GLE无法正确再现微观动力学，出现去同步化。；创新点：系统揭示了非线性GLE在弱非线性下可通过特定方法部分修复，但在强非线性下必然失效，为实际应用提供了明确的适用边界。
papers.method_zh: 通过简化模型进行数值模拟，对比迭代优化记忆函数与使用微观一致噪声两种策略，分析非线性GLE与微观动力学轨迹的同步/去同步行为。

papers.title: Valley-polarized Orbital and Spin Magnetism Induced by Femtosecond Optical Pulses in Two-Dimensional Semiconductors
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the ultrafast generation of spin and orbital magnetism in a two-dimensional gapped Dirac system with spin-orbit coupling. This system is representative of two-dimensional hexagonal semiconductors, such as transition-metal dichalcogenides that exhibit valley-selective optical selection rules arising from the valley-contrasting magnetic texture of their band structure. Using a time-dependent density-matrix formalism, we demonstrate that circularly polarized laser pulses generate nonequilibrium magnetization under both resonant and multiphoton resonant conditions. We show that the induced spin and orbital magnetic moments can be distinctly controlled via the photon energy and polarization of the driving field. Furthermore, spin and orbital dynamics originate from fundamentally different light-matter coupling mechanisms, leading to qualitatively dissimilar temporal behaviors. The orbital magnetic moment couples directly to the external electric field, resulting in faster dynamics and pronounced Rabi-like oscillations, whereas the spin response develops gradually through spin-orbit coupling. Consequently, orbital dynamics is significantly more sensitive to electron-hole dephasing than the spin response. Our results highlight the importance of properly accounting for orbital contributions in future technologies that utilize femtosecond control of magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“time-dependent density-matrix formalism”。；研究对象：二维带隙狄拉克系统（具有自旋-轨道耦合），代表材料为过渡金属二硫化物（TMDs）等二维六角半导体，具体研究飞秒光脉冲诱导的谷极化轨道磁性和自旋磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 圆偏振激光脉冲可在共振及多光子共振条件下产生非平衡磁化，且轨道磁矩和自旋磁矩可通过光子能量和偏振独立调控；两者源于不同的光-物质耦合机制，导致截然不同的时间演化行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：圆偏振激光脉冲可在共振及多光子共振条件下产生非平衡磁化，且轨道磁矩和自旋磁矩可通过光子能量和偏振独立调控；两者源于不同的光-物质耦合机制，导致截然不同的时间演化行为。；创新点：揭示了轨道磁矩与自旋磁矩在超快时间尺度上的动力学差异：轨道磁矩直接耦合外电场，表现出更快的动力学和明显的拉比振荡，而自旋响应通过自旋-轨道耦合缓慢发展；同时指出轨道磁矩对电子-空穴退相更加敏感。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时密度矩阵形式（time-dependent density-matrix formalism）进行理论计算，分析光脉冲与能带结构的相互作用。

papers.title: Droplets sitting on thin elastic sheets: A study with the boundary element method
papers.abstract: Elasto-capillarity of a droplet wetting an elastic sheet provides an interesting system, both for fundamental and applied research. The droplet sinks into the sheet and assumes the shape of a lens. To determine the equilibrium shape in simulations, we formulate a boundary element method (BEM) extending our earlier approaches, and apply the BEM to three specific protocols for the boundary conditions of the sheet. For a clamped elastic sheet, we use various morphological metrics to demonstrate that the lens shape crucially depends on the sheet thickness. Stretching the sheet isotropically, allows for an additional control parameter to influence the droplet shape and the tension in the sheet, which we quantify by radial profiles of the azimuthal and radial elastic stresses. We further demonstrate how the focal length of a liquid lens can be tuned by varying the applied tension. Finally, stretching the sheet along one direction, elongates the droplet, and the sheet shows folds and dimples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：boundary element method (BEM)、simulations。；研究对象：液滴浸润弹性薄片时的弹性-毛细耦合现象，具体研究液滴在薄片上形成的透镜状平衡形态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴透镜形状关键依赖于薄片厚度；通过各向同性拉伸薄片可调控液滴形状和薄片张力，进而调节液体透镜的焦距；沿单一方向拉伸薄片会使液滴拉长，并在薄片上产生褶皱和凹陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴透镜形状关键依赖于薄片厚度；通过各向同性拉伸薄片可调控液滴形状和薄片张力，进而调节液体透镜的焦距；沿单一方向拉伸薄片会使液滴拉长，并在薄片上产生褶皱和凹陷。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 边界元方法（BEM），扩展了作者先前的方法，用于模拟液滴在弹性薄片上的平衡形态。针对薄片边界条件采用了三种具体协议（如夹持、各向同性拉伸、单向拉伸）。

papers.title: Charged Bose polarons at finite momentum
papers.abstract: Charged impurities in quantum fluids have unveiled new classes of strongly correlated many-body states across condensed matter, ultracold gases, and hybrid atom-ion platforms. While previous studies have primarily focused on their ground-state and static properties, much less is known about their finite-momentum behavior, which governs transport, dissipation, and quasiparticle stability. Here, we investigate the momentum-dependent properties of a charged Bose polaron using a diagrammatic approach within second-order perturbation theory, explicitly accounting for the finite-range nature of the ion-atom interaction. We show that the interaction range introduces a characteristic momentum scale at which many-body dressing and dissipation are maximized, leading to a non-monotonic behavior of the damping rate and quasiparticle energy. In the high-momentum regime, we uncover a scaling law $Γ_p \sim 1/p$, signaling the suppression of many-body dressing and the recovery of quasi-free impurity dynamics, in stark contrast to the divergent behavior predicted by contact-interaction perturbative treatments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：diagrammatic approach, second-order perturbation theory。；研究对象：有限动量下的带电玻色极化子（charged Bose polaron），具体为离子在玻色量子流体中的准粒子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 离子-原子相互作用的有限程特性引入了一个特征动量尺度，在该尺度下多体修饰和耗散达到最大，导致阻尼率和准粒子能量呈现非单调行为；在高动量区域，阻尼率遵循标度律 Γ_p ∼ 1/p，表明多体修饰被抑制并恢复准自由杂质动力学，这与接触相互作用微扰理论预测的发散行为形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：离子-原子相互作用的有限程特性引入了一个特征动量尺度，在该尺度下多体修饰和耗散达到最大，导致阻尼率和准粒子能量呈现非单调行为；在高动量区域，阻尼率遵循标度律 Γ_p ∼ 1/p，表明多体修饰被抑制并恢复准自由杂质动力学，这与接触相互作用微扰理论预测的发散行为形成鲜明对比。；创新点：首次系统研究了带电玻色极化子在有限动量下的动量依赖性质，揭示了有限程相互作用导致的非单调阻尼行为和高动量下的标度律，突破了以往仅关注基态和静态性质的局限。
papers.method_zh: 采用二阶微扰理论下的图解方法（diagrammatic approach），明确考虑了离子-原子相互作用的有限程性质。

papers.title: Magnetic domains reconfiguration on the Fe3O4(110) surface across the Verwey transition by Spin-Polarized Low-Energy Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract: We have studied the (110) surface of Fe$_3$O$_4$ single crystals by means of spin-polarized low-energy electron microscopy (SPLEEM). After preparation by sputtering and annealing a well defined reconstructed surface was achieved, composed of rows aligned in the [010] direction. By acquiring SPLEEM images along different spin directions the vector magnetization was mapped on the surface, both at room temperature and at a temperature well below the Verwey transition. At room temperature, domains were observed with their magnetization aligned along the two <111> bulk easy axes which are in the (110) surface plane. They presented 180$^\circ$, 71$^\circ$ and 109$^\circ$ Néel-type domain walls. Below the Verwey transition, the magnetization directions changed to regions where the magnetization was oriented along the in-plane [100] and [001] directions. Those observations can be interpreted as the presence of magnetized regions on the surface where the monoclinic $c$ axis is in-plane in the former, and regions where the $c$ is out-of-plane in an oblique direction in the latter. However, the magnetization was at all times within the surface plane, with no out-of-plane component detected.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“spin-polarized low-energy electron microscopy (SPLEEM)”、“studied”、“acquiring SPLEEM images”。；研究对象：Fe₃O₄(110)单晶表面在Verwey相变前后的磁畴结构重排。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下，表面磁畴的磁化方向沿面内<111>体易轴排列，呈现180°、71°和109° Néel型畴壁；在Verwey相变温度以下，磁化方向转变为沿面内[100]和[001]方向，且始终无面外分量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下，表面磁畴的磁化方向沿面内<111>体易轴排列，呈现180°、71°和109° Néel型畴壁；在Verwey相变温度以下，磁化方向转变为沿面内[100]和[001]方向，且始终无面外分量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 自旋极化低能电子显微镜（SPLEEM），结合溅射和退火制备表面，通过沿不同自旋方向获取图像来映射矢量磁化。

papers.title: Emergence of spin entanglement with the pseudogap onset in the Fermi-Hubbard model
papers.abstract: Despite decades of intense theoretical and experimental investigation, the two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model still resists a complete microscopic understanding. Conventional approaches typically probe global observables and locally resolved correlation functions. Here, we develop a complementary perspective based on the measurement of entanglement. Using both an ultracold-atom quantum simulator and numerical simulations based on the dynamical vertex approximation, we find that entanglement is closely tied to the onset of the enigmatic pseudogap regime: spin-singlet entanglement emerges only as the pseudogap sets in and, in contrast to classical correlations, remains confined to nearest-neighbour sites in this regime. Our results, therefore, disfavour purely classical-fluctuation theories of the pseudogap and constrain microscopic models to those that develop nearest-neighbour spin-singlet entanglement at the pseudogap onset.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：使用了“ultracold-atom quantum simulator”（超冷原子量子模拟器）进行实验，同时结合了“numerical simulations based on the dynamical vertex approximation”（基于动力学顶点近似的数值模拟）。；研究对象：二维费米-哈伯德模型（two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model）中的赝能隙（pseudogap）态与自旋纠缠（spin entanglement）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋单态纠缠（spin-singlet entanglement）仅在赝能隙出现时产生，且在该区域内仅局限于最近邻格点之间。这一结果排除了纯经典涨落理论对赝能隙的解释，并将微观模型限制为那些在赝能隙出现时发展出最近邻自旋单态纠缠的模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋单态纠缠（spin-singlet entanglement）仅在赝能隙出现时产生，且在该区域内仅局限于最近邻格点之间。这一结果排除了纯经典涨落理论对赝能隙的解释，并将微观模型限制为那些在赝能隙出现时发展出最近邻自旋单态纠缠的模型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用超冷原子量子模拟器；理论上采用基于动力学顶点近似（dynamical vertex approximation）的数值模拟。

papers.title: Global thermodynamics for heat-conducting fluids under weak gravity
papers.abstract: We study liquid-gas coexistence under gravity and heat conduction from the viewpoint of global thermodynamics. We construct a variational free-energy function for the fixed-global-temperature description and decompose it into two parts. The first has the same configurational form as the equilibrium weak-gravity free energy with gravity replaced by the effective gravity, and it determines the first-order configurational transition between the two separated liquid-gas arrangements. The second is a residual excess-latent-heat contribution that vanishes without heat conduction. Although it does not decide which separated liquid-gas arrangement is thermodynamically favored, this residual part is needed to derive the fundamental relation in the laboratory variables and to recover thermodynamic observables such as the spatially averaged pressure. The same residual contribution reshapes the barrier geometry, ridge/valley structure, and interfacial anomalies of the fixed-global-temperature free-energy landscape. Numerical examples based on the van der Waals model illustrate the resulting landscape structure, and estimates of experimental scales suggest a setup for detecting the effective-gravity inversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：global thermodynamics, variational free-energy function, theoretical framework。；研究对象：在弱重力场和热传导共同作用下的液-气共存系统。具体研究了两种分离的液-气空间排列（即液体在上/气体在下，或反之）的热力学稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建了一个固定全局温度下的变分自由能函数，该函数可分解为两部分：第一部分决定了两种液-气排列之间的一级构型转变，其形式与平衡态弱重力自由能相同，但重力被替换为“有效重力”；第二部分是残余的过剩潜热贡献，它不决定哪种排列更稳定，但对于推导实验室变量的基本关系和恢复热力学可观测量（如空间平均压力）是必要的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建了一个固定全局温度下的变分自由能函数，该函数可分解为两部分：第一部分决定了两种液-气排列之间的一级构型转变，其形式与平衡态弱重力自由能相同，但重力被替换为“有效重力”；第二部分是残余的过剩潜热贡献，它不决定哪种排列更稳定，但对于推导实验室变量的基本关系和恢复热力学可观测量（如空间平均压力）是必要的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，创新点在于将全局热力学方法应用于非平衡态（存在热传导）的液-气共存系统，并揭示了自由能景观中由热传导引起的有效重力反转（effective-gravity inversion）以及残余潜热项对自由能势垒和界面异常的重塑作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用全局热力学（global thermodynamics）框架，通过构造变分自由能函数进行分析。该函数被分解为构型部分和残余潜热部分。使用范德瓦尔斯模型（van der Waals model）进行数值计算，以展示自由能景观的结构，并对实验尺度进行估计。

papers.title: Cover time statistics of one-dimensional Brownian motion under stochastic resetting
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of stochastic resetting on the statistics of the cover time of a one-dimensional Brownian motion with a diffusion constant $D$, confined to a finite interval of length $L$. The cover time $t_c$, defined as the minimum time required for the particle to visit every point of the interval at least once, exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on the scaled reset rate $ρ= rL^2/4D$. The scaled mean cover time $4D\langle t_c\rangle/L^2$ initially decreases with increasing $ρ$, attains a minimum at an optimal value $ρ^*$, and then increases with $ρ$, indicating an optimal resetting rate that minimizes the search duration. Furthermore, we derive an exact analytical expression for the cover time distribution, including its asymptotic limits, which agree well with numerical simulations. These results demonstrate that stochastic resetting serves as an efficient mechanism for optimizing cover-time processes in confined geometries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate”、“derive an exact analytical expression”、“numerical simulations”，表明主要采用理论分析和数值模拟方法。；研究对象：一维有限区间内具有随机重置（stochastic resetting）的布朗运动，具体研究其覆盖时间（cover time）的统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随机重置率对一维布朗运动的平均覆盖时间具有非单调影响：存在一个最优重置率，使平均覆盖时间最小化；同时，推导出了覆盖时间分布的精确解析表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随机重置率对一维布朗运动的平均覆盖时间具有非单调影响：存在一个最优重置率，使平均覆盖时间最小化；同时，推导出了覆盖时间分布的精确解析表达式。；创新点：首次系统研究了随机重置对一维有限区间内布朗运动覆盖时间统计的影响，发现了平均覆盖时间随重置率的非单调行为及最优重置率的存在，并给出了覆盖时间分布的精确解析解。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合。具体包括：对扩散常数D、区间长度L下的布朗运动，引入随机重置率r，定义无量纲重置率ρ = rL²/4D；推导了平均覆盖时间及覆盖时间分布的精确解析表达式，并分析了其渐近极限；通过数值模拟验证理论结果。

papers.title: In-situ operation of amorphous circuits under heavy-ion irradiation
papers.abstract: Radiation-hardened electronics using semiconductors beyond silicon are essential for computation and control in extreme environments. Yet complex digital circuits based on such material platforms operating in situ under heavy-ion irradiation remain largely unexplored. Here, we show a timing circuit based on amorphous thin-film semiconductors at the 100-transistor scale, and demonstrate its robust operation through a functional "Hello World" ASCII output sequence. Beyond static device characterization, we evaluate the circuit under powered heavy-ion irradiation using tantalum ions, providing an operationally relevant assessment of radiation tolerance at the system level. Under a high particle flux of 2.5 x 10^3 ions cm^-2 s^-1, the circuit maintains stable operation during the irradiation test, achieving a total fluence of 1 x 10^6 ions cm^-2, establishing a milestone of prolonged powered digital operation under extreme conditions. Our work expands the design space of radiation-tolerant electronics, highlighting amorphous semiconductors as a promising foundation for digital circuits deployed in harsh environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：in-situ operation、heavy-ion irradiation、demonstrate、evaluate、irradiation test。；研究对象：基于非晶薄膜半导体的数字时序电路（约100晶体管规模），在重离子辐照下的原位运行性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在2.5×10³离子/cm²/s的高通量钽离子辐照下，该非晶半导体时序电路仍能稳定运行，并成功输出功能性的“Hello World”ASCII序列，总注量达到1×10⁶离子/cm²，实现了极端条件下长时间加电数字运行的里程碑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在2.5×10³离子/cm²/s的高通量钽离子辐照下，该非晶半导体时序电路仍能稳定运行，并成功输出功能性的“Hello World”ASCII序列，总注量达到1×10⁶离子/cm²，实现了极端条件下长时间加电数字运行的里程碑。；创新点：首次在重离子辐照原位条件下，展示了基于非晶薄膜半导体的复杂数字电路（百晶体管级）的稳健运行，超越了传统的静态器件表征，提供了系统级、操作相关的辐射耐受性评估。
papers.method_zh: 采用非晶薄膜半导体构建百晶体管级时序电路；使用钽离子进行加电重离子辐照实验，评估系统级辐射耐受性；通过输出“Hello World”ASCII序列验证电路功能。

papers.title: Surface lone-pair polarization probed by quantum-geometric transport in tellurium
papers.abstract: Stereochemically active lone pairs are ubiquitous microscopic sources of polarity in molecules and solids, but their collective behavior in crystals is often hidden by symmetry or confined to surfaces. Here we show that quantum-geometry transport provides a sensitive probe of surface lone-pair polarization in trigonal tellurium. This surface polarization appears microscopically as an inversion-odd dipolar component of the crystal potential, which shifts the center of mass of Bloch wavepackets and produces quantum-geometric corrections to their velocity. We describe this lone-pair polar texture through a minimal three-component lattice model, and we show that the resulting linear and nonlinear transport coefficients probe, respectively, the second and first moments of the net polarization field. Because rectified voltages in tellurium flakes are directly proportional to the surface lone-pair polarization, our results provide a microscopic route to understanding and engineering polarization-driven, quantum-geometric electronic devices based on tellurium allotropes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“通过量子几何输运提供灵敏探测”、“通过最小三组分晶格模型描述”、“计算输运系数”等，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：碲（tellurium）晶体中的表面孤对电子极化（surface lone-pair polarization）及其量子几何输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碲晶体表面的孤对电子极化会产生反演奇偶性的偶极势场分量，导致布洛赫波包质心偏移并产生量子几何速度修正；整流电压与表面孤对电子极化直接成正比，从而为基于碲同素异形体的极化驱动量子几何电子器件提供了微观理解与设计途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碲晶体表面的孤对电子极化会产生反演奇偶性的偶极势场分量，导致布洛赫波包质心偏移并产生量子几何速度修正；整流电压与表面孤对电子极化直接成正比，从而为基于碲同素异形体的极化驱动量子几何电子器件提供了微观理解与设计途径。；创新点：首次将量子几何输运作为表面孤对电子极化的灵敏探针，并建立了表面极化与整流电压之间的直接比例关系，为利用碲材料中的极化效应设计量子几何电子器件提供了微观理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析计算：构建最小三组分晶格模型描述孤对电子极化织构；通过量子几何输运理论计算线性和非线性输运系数，分别对应极化场的二阶矩和一阶矩。

papers.title: Topological Interstitial-Electron Conductor
papers.abstract: Electron transport in solids arises primarily from two mechanisms: freely moving bulk electrons in metals, and gapless boundary states in topological insulators. Here, we report a new mechanism discovered in electrides. The topological interstitial-electron conductors (TIECs) proposed here are insulating electrides, but host interstitial electrons (IEs) distributed within crystal voids that traverse the entire unit cell. Without being tightly bound to real ions, the IEs generally experience low periodic potential barrier along the void channels. As a consequence, by applying a weak electric field sufficient to overcome the IE barriers but far below the system's dielectric breakdown threshold, one can expect that the TIECs would generate a persistent current contributed by the IEs and propagating along the void channels. We identify a family of realistic altermagnetic electrides, $A_5X_3$ ($A$ = Ca, Sr, Ba, Yb; $X$ = As, Sb), as TIECs. Remarkably, for $A_5X_3$ materials, the periodic potential barrier of the IEs along the void channels are ultralow, ranging from 13.43 to 67.96 meV per formula unit. This renders our proposal readily accessible to experimental verification. We further demonstrate that when the IEs of $A_5X_3$ undergo periodic motion along the channels, topological surface states will emerge at the boundary perpendicular to the channel direction, and continuously move across the bulk band gap. This pumping-like behaviour not only corroborates the topological nature of TIECs, but also rationalizes the finite-electric-field induced electronic transport within the band theory. Our findings expand the classification of electronic conductors, uncover unexplored transport properties of electrides, and establish a new material platform for low-power electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据关键词：proposed、identify、demonstrate、band theory、DFT（隐含于能带分析）。；研究对象：拓扑间隙电子导体（TIECs），具体材料为反铁磁电子化合物家族 \(A_5X_3\)（\(A\) = Ca, Sr, Ba, Yb; \(X\) = As, Sb）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在绝缘性电子化合物中，分布于晶格空隙中的间隙电子（IEs）沿空隙通道仅受极低周期势垒（13.43–67.96 meV/分子式单元），施加弱电场即可驱动其产生持续电流，并在垂直于通道方向的边界上出现拓扑表面态，形成一种新的电子输运机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在绝缘性电子化合物中，分布于晶格空隙中的间隙电子（IEs）沿空隙通道仅受极低周期势垒（13.43–67.96 meV/分子式单元），施加弱电场即可驱动其产生持续电流，并在垂直于通道方向的边界上出现拓扑表面态，形成一种新的电子输运机制。；创新点：首次提出“拓扑间隙电子导体”这一新概念，将电子化合物中的间隙电子输运与拓扑边界态联系起来，揭示了在绝缘体内部通过弱电场驱动间隙电子实现导电的新机制，并预言了可实验验证的具体材料家族。
papers.method_zh: 基于能带理论的第一性原理计算（摘要未明确指定具体软件或泛函，但提及能带分析、周期势垒计算、拓扑表面态分析）。

papers.title: A charge qubit on solid neon in a spin-qubit compatible circuit QED platform
papers.abstract: Electrons floating in vacuum provide a clean platform for quantum information processing due to their isolation from material defects; electrons on solid neon have emerged as a promising qubit platform for its long coherence times. Here, toward spin-qubit realization, we couple a single electron on solid neon to a magnetic-field-compatible superconducting NbTiN nanowire resonator. We realize a charge qubit and demonstrate microwave readout and coherent control, with Rabi frequencies up to 76 MHz, an order of magnitude larger than in previous studies. Under strong driving, we observe a qubit frequency shift from nonlinear interactions with the intense microwave field. Deterministic electron trapping at an intended position remains challenging due to solid neon surface roughness; we characterize the electron's position from its differential coupling to distinct electrodes. Although not trapped at an intended position, our estimates indicate that spin-qubit demonstrations remain feasible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验平台搭建、微波读出、相干控制等实验操作，并给出了Rabi频率等实验数据。；研究对象：基于固态氖上单个电子的电荷量子比特，该体系与自旋量子比特兼容的电路QED平台耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了固态氖上单个电子的电荷量子比特，其Rabi频率高达76 MHz，比此前研究高一个数量级；尽管电子无法被确定性捕获在预定位置，但自旋量子比特的演示仍然可行。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了固态氖上单个电子的电荷量子比特，其Rabi频率高达76 MHz，比此前研究高一个数量级；尽管电子无法被确定性捕获在预定位置，但自旋量子比特的演示仍然可行。；创新点：首次在自旋量子比特兼容的电路QED平台上实现了固态氖上的电荷量子比特，并获得了比此前研究高一个数量级的Rabi频率。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：将固态氖上的单个电子与兼容磁场的超导NbTiN纳米线谐振器耦合，通过微波读出和相干控制实现电荷量子比特操作，并利用电子与不同电极的差分耦合来表征其位置。

papers.title: The geometry of the CISS effect
papers.abstract: Using scanning tunneling microscopy, and a careful selection of chiral molecules and anchoring groups, we systematically carried out a series of magnetoresistance experiments. We observed a reversal of the signal upon changing the magnetization direction, the molecular chirality, and the molecular orientation. The orientation of the molecules and the magnetization of the substrate are vectors, and by associating an axial vector with the molecule, the observations can be explained. Other recent experiments, among them null experiments showing no CISS related magnetoresistance can be explained using our framework. The physical interpretation is, that the polar electrical polarization of the molecule cannot play a direct role, while the axial magnetic polarization vector operator is a much more realistic candidate. This vector plays an important role in the creation of a magnetic moment in the interface between molecule and metallic lead.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用扫描隧道显微镜（scanning tunneling microscopy）进行磁阻实验（magnetoresistance experiments）。；研究对象：手性分子（chiral molecules）与金属基底构成的界面体系，具体研究手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应中的几何因素。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变磁化方向、分子手性和分子取向，观察到磁阻信号的翻转；提出分子关联的轴矢量（axial vector）可解释这些现象，并指出分子的电极化不能直接起作用，而轴磁极化矢量是更合理的候选。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变磁化方向、分子手性和分子取向，观察到磁阻信号的翻转；提出分子关联的轴矢量（axial vector）可解释这些现象，并指出分子的电极化不能直接起作用，而轴磁极化矢量是更合理的候选。；创新点：将分子取向和基底磁化视为矢量，并引入与分子关联的轴矢量来解释CISS效应中的信号反转，同时该框架也能解释近期未观察到CISS相关磁阻的零结果实验。摘要未突出说明与以往理论模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）结合磁阻测量，系统改变分子手性、分子取向和基底磁化方向进行对比实验。

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Machine-Learning-Based Kinetic Monte Carlo Method for Modelling Thin-Film Growth
papers.abstract: We present a kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) simulation framework parameterized by automatically sampling machine-learning (ML) for modeling thin-film growth atom by atom. Given an interatomic potential energy function, the KMC algorithm builds an ML-based regression model for rate parameters on runtime, being trained on the local atomic environments encountered during the system evolution. New environments are continuously added to the training set in a self-evolving manner at points where the ML model estimates high uncertainty. As the simulation progresses, the ML model gains confidence, and the quick estimation of rates increasingly overtakes the relatively-expensive nudged elastic band calculations, promoting computational efficiency while retaining high fidelity description of the atomic diffusion kinetics. As a test case, we simulate the sub-monolayer growth of Ag on Ag {111}, where we demonstrate adatom islands forming in shapes and densities in accordance with the underlying atomistic interaction model, the theoretical framework, and available experimental results related to thin-film nucleation and growth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC)、machine-learning (ML)、simulation framework、nudged elastic band calculations。；研究对象：薄膜生长过程，具体以Ag在Ag{111}表面的亚单层生长为测试案例，研究原子岛的形状和密度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种自演化的机器学习参数化动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）框架，能够在模拟过程中自动训练速率参数模型，在保持原子扩散动力学高保真描述的同时，显著提升计算效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种自演化的机器学习参数化动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）框架，能够在模拟过程中自动训练速率参数模型，在保持原子扩散动力学高保真描述的同时，显著提升计算效率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于机器学习回归模型的动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）模拟框架。利用原子间势能函数，在模拟运行时自动采样局部原子环境，训练速率参数的ML回归模型；通过自演化方式在ML模型估计高不确定性的区域持续添加新环境到训练集；用快速ML估计替代昂贵的微动弹性带（NEB）计算。

papers.title: Interplay of Cl Substitution and He$^{+}$ Irradiation in CrSBr$_{1-x}$Cl$_{x}$
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional magnetic semiconductors provide a promising platform for exploring the interplay between disorder, lattice dynamics, and resonant light--matter interactions. Among them, CrSBr exhibits strong in-plane anisotropy and pronounced resonance-enhanced Raman scattering. Here, we investigate the effects of Cl substitution and He$^{+}$ irradiation on the vibrational response of CrSBr using polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy. Cl substitution activates additional phonon modes associated with local symmetry breaking, while He$^{+}$ irradiation introduces distinct defect-related scattering channels and enhanced phonon broadening. The combined effects of alloy disorder and externally introduced defects lead to strong anisotropic reconstruction of the Raman spectra and modification of the nonlinear Raman response under near-resonant 1.96 eV excitation. Power-dependent measurements reveal robust superlinear scaling of both intrinsic and substitution-induced phonon modes, indicating persistent resonance-enhanced electron--phonon coupling even in defect-engineered samples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用偏振分辨拉曼光谱”（polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy）和“功率依赖测量”（power-dependent measurements）等实验手段。；研究对象：二维磁性半导体 CrSBr 及其 Cl 取代合金 CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ，以及 He⁺ 辐照引入缺陷后的体系。具体研究 Cl 取代和 He⁺ 辐照对晶格振动（声子）响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cl 取代激活了与局域对称性破缺相关的新声子模式，He⁺ 辐照引入了缺陷相关的散射通道并增强了声子展宽。两者共同作用导致拉曼光谱出现强各向异性重构，并改变了近共振激发下的非线性拉曼响应，但缺陷工程化样品中仍保持共振增强的电子-声子耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cl 取代激活了与局域对称性破缺相关的新声子模式，He⁺ 辐照引入了缺陷相关的散射通道并增强了声子展宽。两者共同作用导致拉曼光谱出现强各向异性重构，并改变了近共振激发下的非线性拉曼响应，但缺陷工程化样品中仍保持共振增强的电子-声子耦合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨拉曼光谱（polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy），近共振 1.96 eV 激发，功率依赖测量（power-dependent measurements）。

papers.title: Complex Magnetic Behavior of the Ce sawtooth chains in CeRhSn$_2$
papers.abstract: Conflicting reports exist on the ground state of the intermetallic compound CeRhSn$_2$. This can be rooted in the sawtooth-like arrangement of two inequivalent Ce sites in the unit cell, which suggests potential geometric magnetic frustration. To resolve, we conducted a comprehensive study on high-quality single crystals of CeRhSn$_2$ by means of magnetization ($M$), specific heat ($C_p/T$), and resistivity ($ρ$). The system exhibits strong magnetic anisotropy, confirming the $b$-axis as the easy magnetic axis. We establish three successive transitions, an AFM order at $T_{N} = 3.65$K, a first-order FM order at $T_{C} = 1.7$K and final transition, at $T = 1.5$K. The transition temperatures are highly field-directional dependent: in a magnetic field, the lowest transition is immediately suppressed while $\mathbf{H} \parallel b$ rapidly merges $T_{C}$ and $T_{N}$ into a single second-order transition. Conversely, $\mathbf{H}\parallel c$ suppresses the FM order and reduces $T_{N}$. Additional ab initio calculations affirm the FM ground state of CeRhSn$_2$. The observation of an enhancement of the Sommerfeld coefficient ($γ= 76.5$mJ/mol$\cdot$K$^2$) may arise from geometric frustration, but it is most consistently attributed to weak Kondo hybridization as frustration cannot be conclusively established through our data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“magnetization, specific heat, resistivity”（实验手段）以及“ab initio calculations”（辅助计算）。；研究对象：金属间化合物CeRhSn₂中的Ce锯齿链（sawtooth chains）及其导致的复杂磁性行为，包括几何磁阻挫、反铁磁（AFM）与铁磁（FM）序的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CeRhSn₂在零场下依次经历三个磁相变：3.65 K的反铁磁序、1.7 K的一级铁磁序以及1.5 K的最终转变；磁场方向强烈影响相变行为，且系统表现出增强的索末菲系数（γ=76.5 mJ/mol·K²），该增强最可能源于弱近藤杂化而非几何阻挫。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CeRhSn₂在零场下依次经历三个磁相变：3.65 K的反铁磁序、1.7 K的一级铁磁序以及1.5 K的最终转变；磁场方向强烈影响相变行为，且系统表现出增强的索末菲系数（γ=76.5 mJ/mol·K²），该增强最可能源于弱近藤杂化而非几何阻挫。；创新点：通过高质量单晶的综合测量，首次清晰揭示了CeRhSn₂中三个连续的磁相变及其强各向异性场依赖性，解决了此前关于其基态的矛盾报道。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用磁化率（M）、比热（C_p/T）和电阻率（ρ）测量高质量单晶；理论上采用ab initio计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明）确认铁磁基态。

papers.title: Functional methods for quantum thermodynamics
papers.abstract: The functional renormalization group provides a nonperturbative and systematically improvable route to constructing density functionals for quantum many-body systems from microscopic Hamiltonians. Here we advance this program by benchmarking functional-renormalization-group density functional theory (FRG-DFT) against the exact thermodynamics of the single-site Bose-Hubbard model. This model provides an ideal testing ground because it is analytically solvable, yet remains subtle in the imaginary-time coherent-state path integral, where a naive continuum treatment generates a spurious self-interaction. We show that a careful Hubbard-Stratonovich derivation identifies the self-interaction correction term that must be included in the FRG-DFT flow to recover the exact thermodynamics. We then systematically compare several closures of the resulting hierarchy of flow equations for the free energy, chemical potential, and connected density correlators over broad ranges of density, temperature, and interaction strength. The benchmark shows that the free energy is comparatively robust, whereas the chemical potential and fluctuation observables provide much sharper diagnostics of the hierarchy closure. A maximum-entropy closure gives the most accurate overall description and reproduces even the low-temperature oscillatory structure of the connected two-density correlator. These results identify two general requirements for functional approaches to quantum thermodynamics: the renormalization group flow equation must retain the equal-time contact subtraction to avoid spurious self-interactions, and any closure of the hierarchy must preserve the statistical consistency of density correlators. This work provides a controlled foundation for deriving ab initio density functionals for quantum many-body systems across condensed-matter, ultracold-atom, and nuclear physics, as well as quantum chemistry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“functional renormalization group”“density functional theory”“path integral”等理论框架，并通过解析求解和数值基准测试（benchmarking）进行研究，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：单点Bose-Hubbard模型（single-site Bose-Hubbard model）的量子热力学性质，包括自由能、化学势、密度关联函数等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过功能重整化群密度泛函理论（FRG-DFT）对单点Bose-Hubbard模型进行基准测试，发现必须包含等时接触相减项（equal-time contact subtraction）以避免虚假自相互作用，且最大熵截断（maximum-entropy closure）能最准确地再现包括低温振荡结构在内的热力学量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过功能重整化群密度泛函理论（FRG-DFT）对单点Bose-Hubbard模型进行基准测试，发现必须包含等时接触相减项（equal-time contact subtraction）以避免虚假自相互作用，且最大熵截断（maximum-entropy closure）能最准确地再现包括低温振荡结构在内的热力学量。；创新点：首次将FRG-DFT方法精确基准测试于可解析求解的单点Bose-Hubbard模型，揭示了避免虚假自相互作用的等时接触修正项的必要性，并明确了密度关联函数统计一致性对层次截断的严格要求。
papers.method_zh: 功能重整化群密度泛函理论（FRG-DFT），结合Hubbard-Stratonovich变换推导自相互作用修正项，并系统比较了自由能、化学势、连接密度关联函数在流方程层次截断下的多种闭合方案（如最大熵截断）。

papers.title: Clustering in atom probe tomography data: coordination number metric, percolation-based parameter scaling, and size effects
papers.abstract: The ability to identify nanometer-scale nuclei of new phases in atom probe tomography (APT) is often limited by the sensitivity of clustering algorithms to user-defined control parameters. Conventional approaches typically rely on the Euclidean distance metric and consider only solute atoms, thereby discarding the solvent atoms that contain most of the spatial information. Here, we introduce a coordination-number metric based on the composition and apply it to higher-order clustering. Using various metrics, we investigate percolation in typical APT structures. By scaling clustering properties to the corresponding percolation thresholds, we define a self-similar variable that is almost invariant with respect to metrics, clustering parameters, and structural disorder. This variable provides a relevant description of clustering and enables the formal transfer of optimal parameters between clustering methods. We also study the characteristic clustering behavior in small precipitates and quantify how the precipitate-matrix interface alters the composition spectrum and broadens the clustering curve. Finally, using simulations that incorporate finite spatial resolution, detection efficiency, and other APT reconstruction artifacts, we show that the approach based on coordination numbers effectively compensates for heterogeneous dilations and outperforms solute-density-based methods in all tested scenarios.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入度量”、“研究逾渗”、“使用模拟”等关键词，未涉及具体实验操作。；研究对象：原子探针层析技术（APT）数据中的纳米尺度新相形核（团簇）识别问题，具体研究团簇分析中的配位数度量、基于逾渗的参数标度以及尺寸效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于成分的配位数度量能有效补偿APT重建中的非均匀膨胀，在所有测试场景中均优于基于溶质密度的方法；通过将团簇性质标度至对应的逾渗阈值，可定义一种几乎不依赖于度量、聚类参数和结构无序的自相似变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于成分的配位数度量能有效补偿APT重建中的非均匀膨胀，在所有测试场景中均优于基于溶质密度的方法；通过将团簇性质标度至对应的逾渗阈值，可定义一种几乎不依赖于度量、聚类参数和结构无序的自相似变量。；创新点：提出一种基于配位数的团簇识别度量，并建立基于逾渗阈值的参数标度方案，实现了不同聚类方法间最优参数的正式传递。摘要未突出说明与已有方法的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 引入基于成分的配位数度量，并将其应用于高阶聚类分析；利用多种度量研究典型APT结构中的逾渗行为；通过模拟（包含有限空间分辨率、探测效率及其他APT重建伪影）验证方法有效性。

papers.title: Finite-inertia effects in Langevin dynamics of a lopsided elastic dumbbell using exponential-time differencing schemes
papers.abstract: Inertia effects in the Langevin dynamics of a lopsided elastic dumbbell are investigated using exponential-time-differencing (ETD) integrators for the corresponding stiff stochastic equations at small mass limit. Starting from the bead-level underdamped Langevin model, we formulate the dynamics in modal coordinates, highlighting two distinct friction scales: an additive friction $ζ_{\rm trans}=ζ_1+ζ_2$ controlling translation ($ζ_i, i=1,2$ are the friction factor on bead $i$), and an effective internal friction $1/ζ_{\rm eff}=1/ζ_1+1/ζ_2$ controlling configurational relaxation, with relaxation time $τ_R=ζ_{\rm eff}/H$ for a Hookean spring of stiffness $H$. We benchmark ETD against Euler--Maruyama and overdamped Brownian dynamics using equilibrium statistics, time-domain autocorrelations, and frequency-domain power spectra of the end-to-end vector. When time is rescaled by $τ_R$, configurational and orientational relaxation curves collapse across asymmetry ratios, showing that the dominant long-time structural dynamics remains close to the overdamped description. Inertial signatures are instead confined to short-time transients, high-frequency modifications of the configurational spectrum, and a transient coupling between translational and internal modes. This study provides a practical and accurate route for lopsided dumbbells across overdamped and weakly underdamped regimes, and clarify how mass and friction asymmetry affect the translational and internal dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Langevin dynamics（朗之万动力学）、exponential-time-differencing schemes（指数时间差分格式）、benchmark（基准测试）。；研究对象：一个不对称的弹性哑铃模型（lopsided elastic dumbbell）的朗之万动力学，具体研究其在小质量极限下的有限惯性效应（finite-inertia effects）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当时间用构象弛豫时间τ_R重新标度后，不同不对称比下的构象和取向弛豫曲线会重合，表明主导的长时结构动力学仍接近过阻尼描述。惯性效应仅局限于短时瞬态、构象谱的高频修正以及平动与内禀模式之间的瞬态耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当时间用构象弛豫时间τ_R重新标度后，不同不对称比下的构象和取向弛豫曲线会重合，表明主导的长时结构动力学仍接近过阻尼描述。惯性效应仅局限于短时瞬态、构象谱的高频修正以及平动与内禀模式之间的瞬态耦合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，创新点在于：1）针对不对称哑铃模型，系统性地研究了有限惯性效应，并阐明了质量与摩擦不对称性对平动和内禀动力学的影响；2）展示了ETD方法在跨越过阻尼和弱欠阻尼区间时，是一种实用且精确的数值方案。
papers.method_zh: 使用指数时间差分（ETD）积分器求解对应的刚性随机方程。从珠子级别的欠阻尼朗之万模型出发，在模态坐标下构建动力学方程。将ETD方法与欧拉-丸山（Euler–Maruyama）方法和过阻尼布朗动力学方法进行基准比较，比较内容包括平衡态统计、时域自相关函数和频域功率谱。

papers.title: Spin-Spiral Enhancement of Ultrafast Light-Polarization-Robust Magnetization
papers.abstract: Ultrafast light-driven magnetization, a frontier in quantum magneto-optics, has traditionally relied on circularly polarized lasers to provide external angular momentum. While increasing efforts have aimed to achieve light-polarization-robust (LPR) magnetization that is insensitive to the form of external light excitation, the underlying mechanism remains largely unclear. Here, we establish the symmetry-constrained rule for LPR magnetization in antiferromagnetic systems. Through real-time time-dependent density functional theory calculations, we observe the strong LPR magnetization in spin-spiral magnets and its suppression in collinear antiferromagnets, confirming our theory. Strikingly, laser excitation induces real-space demagnetization, rotation, and oscillation of atomic spins in spin-spiral monolayer NiI$_2$, whereas rotation is largely suppressed in conventional collinear antiferromagnets. Our work reveals a novel microscopic pathway for ultrafast magnetization that is independent of light polarization, paving the way for advanced femtosecond spin control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：real-time time-dependent density functional theory calculations，第一性原理计算）；研究对象：自旋螺旋磁体（spin-spiral magnets）中的超快光致磁化现象，具体材料为单层NiI₂，并与共线反铁磁体进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋螺旋磁体中，激光激发可产生与光偏振无关的强磁化（light-polarization-robust magnetization），而在共线反铁磁体中该效应被抑制；激光激发在自旋螺旋磁体中引起实空间的自旋退磁、旋转和振荡，而共线反铁磁体中自旋旋转被大幅抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋螺旋磁体中，激光激发可产生与光偏振无关的强磁化（light-polarization-robust magnetization），而在共线反铁磁体中该效应被抑制；激光激发在自旋螺旋磁体中引起实空间的自旋退磁、旋转和振荡，而共线反铁磁体中自旋旋转被大幅抑制。；创新点：揭示了自旋螺旋磁体中光偏振鲁棒磁化的微观机制，并建立了对称性约束规则，为不依赖光偏振的超快自旋控制提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实时含时密度泛函理论（real-time time-dependent density functional theory, rt-TDDFT）计算，并结合对称性分析建立光偏振鲁棒磁化的约束规则。

papers.title: Dimensionality of a strongly interacting 2D-3D Fermi-Fermi mixture from the perspective of superfluid instability and excitation properties
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate strong-coupling properties of an attractively interacting Fermi atomic gas, where the Cooper-pair formation occurs between atoms belonging to different dimensional bands. Including pairing fluctuations within the framework of the self-consistent $T$-matrix approximation (SCTMA), we examine how the BCS-type superfluid phase transition temperature $T_\mathrm{c}$ varies as one moves from the 3D-3D to the 2D-3D system, in the wide parameter region with respect to the strength of the pairing interaction. In the 2D-3D limit, we find that, while the mean-field BCS theory predicts $T_\mathrm{c}>0$ in the strong-coupling regime, $T_\mathrm{c}$ is remarkably suppressed down to zero by pairing fluctuations that are strongly enhanced by the mixed-dimensionality of the system. As the origin of this, we clarify that the lower-dimensional (2D) component dominates the superfluid instability, so that the vanishing $T_\mathrm{c}$ is the same phenomenon as that in the 2D-2D case. We also point out that this can already be seen in the mean-field level, when one examines the propagation of the Goldstone mode. On the other hand, we find that the pseudogap phenomenon, which is known as a precursor of Cooper-pair formation, exhibits a 3D character of the 2D-3D system. These results indicate that the dimensionality of a strongly interacting Fermi gas depends on what we observe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“self-consistent T-matrix approximation (SCTMA)”、“mean-field BCS theory”。；研究对象：强相互作用的费米原子气体，具体为不同维度能带（2D与3D）之间形成库珀对的2D-3D费米-费米混合体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合区域，混合维度（2D-3D）体系的超流相变温度Tc被配对涨落强烈抑制至零，这与2D-2D体系中的现象相同；但该体系的赝能隙现象却表现出3D特征，表明强相互作用费米气体的维度取决于所观测的物理量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合区域，混合维度（2D-3D）体系的超流相变温度Tc被配对涨落强烈抑制至零，这与2D-2D体系中的现象相同；但该体系的赝能隙现象却表现出3D特征，表明强相互作用费米气体的维度取决于所观测的物理量。；创新点：揭示了混合维度体系中超流不稳定性由低维（2D）组分主导，导致Tc被涨落完全抑制；同时指出赝能隙现象仍保持3D特征，从而提出“维度取决于观测视角”这一概念。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽T矩阵近似（SCTMA）理论框架，考虑配对涨落效应，计算并比较了从3D-3D到2D-3D体系转变过程中BCS型超流相变温度Tc的变化，并分析了Goldstone模的传播行为。

papers.title: Parity-induced generalized Brillouin zone without non-Hermitian skin effect
papers.abstract: Acute spectral sensitivity to boundary conditions and the formation of a generalized Brillouin zone associated with complex quasimomenta are features frequently attributed to systems with non-trivial non-Hermitian topology, showcasing the non-Hermitian skin effect. We show that, away from the thermodynamic limit, these features themselves are not uniquely tied to this phenomenon; they can similarly arise as parity-induced even-odd effects in non-Hermitian systems without skin effect. Despite an underlying generalized Brillouin zone description, wavefunctions remain delocalized. In addition, the effect can arise in skin-effect models as entirely separate distinguishable feature
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, description, effect, models。；研究对象：非厄米系统中由宇称（parity）诱导的广义布里渊区（generalized Brillouin zone）现象，以及其与非厄米趋肤效应（non-Hermitian skin effect）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远离热力学极限时，广义布里渊区的形成和对边界条件的敏感响应并非非厄米趋肤效应的独有特征；它们可以纯粹由宇称导致的奇偶效应（even-odd effects）产生，且波函数仍保持离域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远离热力学极限时，广义布里渊区的形成和对边界条件的敏感响应并非非厄米趋肤效应的独有特征；它们可以纯粹由宇称导致的奇偶效应（even-odd effects）产生，且波函数仍保持离域化。；创新点：揭示了广义布里渊区与非厄米趋肤效应之间的非唯一对应关系，指出宇称诱导的奇偶效应可以独立于趋肤效应产生类似特征，且该效应在趋肤效应模型中可作为完全独立的可区分特征存在。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于广义布里渊区描述框架，对比非厄米趋肤效应模型与无趋肤效应模型中的边界条件敏感性及波函数行为。

papers.title: Competing heterogeneities shape ordering via higher-order interactions
papers.abstract: Higher-order interactions admit richer structural heterogeneity than pairwise networks. To understand how heterogeneity impacts collective phenomena we develop a framework based on the cavity method and apply it to the simplicial Ising model on heterogeneous hypergraphs. Unlike in homogeneous structures, group size and node degree play fundamentally different roles: size heterogeneity sharpens the transition via large-group unanimity, while degree heterogeneity softens it as hubs cooperatively seed ordering with non-hubs. Under either type of heterogeneity, continuous--discontinuous double transitions can arise, where the symmetry-breaking continuous transition is driven by pairs or by hubs, respectively. When both heterogeneities coexist, cross-order degree correlations further modulate the phase diagram, with anticorrelation delaying the group-driven discontinuous jump and broadening the hysteretic region. Our results reveal the intricate interplay between size and degree heterogeneities in collective phenomena beyond pairwise interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a framework based on the cavity method”（基于空穴法发展理论框架），并应用于“simplicial Ising model”（单纯复形伊辛模型），属于统计物理与复杂系统的理论建模。；研究对象：高阶相互作用（higher-order interactions）下的异质超图（heterogeneous hypergraphs）上的单纯复形伊辛模型（simplicial Ising model），具体研究群体大小异质性（group size heterogeneity）和节点度异质性（node degree heterogeneity）如何影响集体有序化（ordering）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 群体大小异质性和节点度异质性对相变行为起相反作用：大小异质性通过大群体的“一致投票”效应使相变更尖锐，而度异质性则通过枢纽节点与非枢纽节点的协同成核使相变软化。两种异质性共存时，交叉阶度关联（cross-order degree correlations）会进一步调控相图，例如反关联会延迟群体驱动的非连续跳变并扩大滞后区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：群体大小异质性和节点度异质性对相变行为起相反作用：大小异质性通过大群体的“一致投票”效应使相变更尖锐，而度异质性则通过枢纽节点与非枢纽节点的协同成核使相变软化。两种异质性共存时，交叉阶度关联（cross-order degree correlations）会进一步调控相图，例如反关联会延迟群体驱动的非连续跳变并扩大滞后区域。；创新点：揭示了在超越成对相互作用（beyond pairwise interactions）的集体现象中，群体大小异质性与节点度异质性之间的复杂相互作用，并发现两种异质性可各自诱导连续-非连续双重相变（continuous–discontinuous double transitions），且交叉阶度关联对相图有显著调制作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于空穴法（cavity method）的理论框架，应用于异质超图上的单纯复形伊辛模型，分析高阶相互作用下的相变行为。

papers.title: Finite-time Scaling with Arbitrary Driving Rates: Bridging the Kibble-Zurek and De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov Limits
papers.abstract: The pursuit of a universal description for nonequilibrium critical dynamics in quantum many-body systems stands as a central frontier in modern statistical physics. For driven critical dynamics starting far from the critical point, the well-known Kibble-Zurek (KZ) scaling holds only when the driving rate lies below an upper bound. Here we study driven dynamics restricted to the critical region, and show that robust dynamic scaling behavior exists for arbitrary driving rates. We develop a generalized finite-time scaling (FTS) framework, which provides a unified understanding on the driven dynamics for the full range of quench rates, bridging the KZ scaling in the slow-driving regime and the De~Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov (DGP) scaling in the sudden-quench limit. We verify this unified FTS form through numerical simulations in both quantum critical and tricritical points. The good agreement between theoretical predictions and numerical results confirms the generality of our theory. Our work establishes a universal theory for nonequilibrium critical dynamics spanning the full range of driving rates, with broad implications for quantum quench experiments and out-of-equilibrium statistical mechanics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a generalized finite-time scaling framework、theoretical predictions、numerical simulations。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的非平衡临界动力学，具体针对从临界区域开始的驱动动力学，涵盖量子临界点和三临界点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于限制在临界区域内的驱动动力学，存在适用于任意驱动速率的鲁棒标度行为；作者建立了统一的有限时间标度（FTS）框架，将慢驱动下的Kibble-Zurek标度与突然淬火极限下的De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov标度联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于限制在临界区域内的驱动动力学，存在适用于任意驱动速率的鲁棒标度行为；作者建立了统一的有限时间标度（FTS）框架，将慢驱动下的Kibble-Zurek标度与突然淬火极限下的De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov标度联系起来。；创新点：提出了一个统一的有限时间标度理论，能够描述从慢驱动到突然淬火极限的整个驱动速率范围内的非平衡临界动力学，填补了KZ标度与DGP标度之间的空白。
papers.method_zh: 广义有限时间标度（FTS）理论框架，并通过量子临界点和三临界点的数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Pure Spin Photocurrent in Altermagnetic Photovoltaic Battery
papers.abstract: Altermagnets, featuring momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, provide a promising platform for spintronic functionalities beyond conventional ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Here, we propose an altermagnetic spin photovoltaic battery consisting of a nonmagnetic semiconducting layer sandwiched between two altermagnetic electrodes. Using first-principles quantum-transport simulations, we show that a V2Te2O/ZnSe/V2Te2O junction supports a pure spin photocurrent for opposite Néel vectors in the two altermagnetic electrodes, with spin-up and spin-down photocurrents equal in magnitude and opposite in sign. The effect persists under both linearly and circularly polarized light and remains tunable with photon energy and polarization angle. Our results establish a realistic route toward light-driven pure spin-current generation in altermagnetic junctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles quantum-transport simulations”（第一性原理量子输运模拟）。；研究对象：一种由非磁性半导体层（ZnSe）夹在两个交变磁电极（V₂Te₂O）之间构成的交变磁自旋光伏电池（altermagnetic spin photovoltaic battery）异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在V₂Te₂O/ZnSe/V₂Te₂O结中，当两个交变磁电极的奈尔矢量相反时，可产生纯自旋光电流（自旋向上和自旋向下的光电流大小相等、符号相反），且该效应在线偏振光和圆偏振光下均存在，并可通过光子能量和偏振角进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在V₂Te₂O/ZnSe/V₂Te₂O结中，当两个交变磁电极的奈尔矢量相反时，可产生纯自旋光电流（自旋向上和自旋向下的光电流大小相等、符号相反），且该效应在线偏振光和圆偏振光下均存在，并可通过光子能量和偏振角进行调控。；创新点：提出了一种利用交变磁体（altermagnet）实现光驱动纯自旋电流产生的现实路径，区别于传统铁磁或反铁磁体系。摘要未突出说明与已有交变磁体光电流研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理量子输运模拟（first-principles quantum-transport simulations）。

papers.title: Activity-Enhanced Ordering in Fluctuation-Induced First-Order Transitions
papers.abstract: Fluctuations can drive otherwise continuous phase transitions to first order through the Brazovskii mechanism. We study how these fluctuation-induced transitions are modified in active systems by introducing nonequilibrium spatiotemporally correlated noise. We show that, while the transition remains fluctuation-induced first order, activity systematically suppresses these fluctuation effects, shifting the transition to higher temperatures and rendering it increasingly weakly first order. As a result, ordering is enhanced without inducing a spinodal instability of the isotropic phase, as confirmed by direct numerical simulations. In the strong-activity limit, fluctuation effects disappear and mean-field behavior is recovered. Our results identify activity as a generic control parameter for tuning the strength of fluctuation-induced first-order transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Brazovskii mechanism、nonequilibrium spatiotemporally correlated noise、mean-field behavior、direct numerical simulations）；研究对象：活性系统中由涨落诱导的一级相变，具体研究非平衡时空关联噪声如何改变Brazovskii机制下的相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性（非平衡噪声）会系统性地抑制涨落效应，使原本由涨落诱导的一级相变向更高温度移动，并变得弱一级；在强活性极限下，涨落效应消失，恢复平均场行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性（非平衡噪声）会系统性地抑制涨落效应，使原本由涨落诱导的一级相变向更高温度移动，并变得弱一级；在强活性极限下，涨落效应消失，恢复平均场行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合直接数值模拟。采用非平衡时空关联噪声引入活性，基于Brazovskii机制框架研究涨落诱导相变的修正。

papers.title: Spin Hall effect in two-dimensional materials with inverted bands and Mexican-hat dispersion
papers.abstract: We study the spin Hall effect in two-dimensional topological insulators with "Mexican hat" dispersion and a ring-shaped Fermi surface which are formed due to the band inversion. Electron transitions between different isoenergetic contours and the quantum metric of band states play an important role in the transport properties of such materials, since they largely determine the spatial distribution of the electron charges screening the impurity potential and the scattering probability [Phys.B, 719, 417942 (2025)]. Here we study a spin-dependent skew scattering, which is enabled by the second-order scattering processes, and show that the extrinsic spin-Hall current (SHC) can significantly exceed the intrinsic SHC arising from the Berry curvature. Furthermore, due to Mexican-hat dispersion, the SHC exhibits a very unusual dependence on the Fermi energy ($E_F$). The extrinsic SHC reaches a maximum at some $E_F$, then decreases with increasing $E_F$ and can even change a sign. This complicated behavior reflects an interplay of energy dependencies of such important factors as probabilities of inter- and intra-contour transitions, as well as different electron velocities in two contours.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we study”“we show”，且未提及实验或计算模拟手段，属于理论分析。；研究对象：具有“墨西哥帽”色散和环形费米面的二维拓扑绝缘体中的自旋霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有墨西哥帽色散和能带反转的二维材料中，由二阶散射过程引起的外禀自旋霍尔电流可显著超过由贝里曲率引起的内禀自旋霍尔电流；且由于墨西哥帽色散，外禀自旋霍尔电流随费米能级的变化呈现非常规行为，包括先增后减甚至改变符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有墨西哥帽色散和能带反转的二维材料中，由二阶散射过程引起的外禀自旋霍尔电流可显著超过由贝里曲率引起的内禀自旋霍尔电流；且由于墨西哥帽色散，外禀自旋霍尔电流随费米能级的变化呈现非常规行为，包括先增后减甚至改变符号。；创新点：揭示了在墨西哥帽色散体系中，外禀自旋霍尔电流可主导内禀贡献，并表现出随费米能级非单调变化甚至符号反转的奇特行为，反映了等能轮廓间/内跃迁概率与电子速度等因子的复杂能量依赖关系。
papers.method_zh: 基于二阶散射过程的自旋依赖斜散射理论分析，结合能带反转形成的墨西哥帽色散和环形费米面结构，考虑不同等能轮廓间的电子跃迁、量子度量以及电荷屏蔽对散射概率的影响。

papers.title: Living Helices in Fluctuating Polymer Chains: Cooperative Nucleation, Dynamics, and Lifetime
papers.abstract: Helical segments in polymer chains are often transient, finite, and dynamically evolving, yet their origin and stability remain incompletely understood. Here we develop a minimal coarse-grained statistical-mechanical theory that explains how such living helices emerge in fluctuating polymer systems. Using a three-state model with cooperative interactions, we show that helix formation proceeds through a multistep nucleation mechanism. An initial constrained pre-nucleus forms first, followed by cooperative stabilization that promotes the growth of finite helical segments. The resulting free-energy landscape naturally favors marginally stable helices whose size is determined by a competition between cooperative gains and nonlinear penalties arising from stiffness, torsional strain, and solvent fluctuations. By formulating the dynamics as a stochastic process in segment size, we derive analytical expressions for both formation times and lifetimes within a mean first-passage framework. For representative parameters relevant to flexible polymers and peptide segments, the theory predicts characteristic timescales in the nanosecond to sub-microsecond range. The present analysis supports a view of living helices as finite, mobile excitations whose stability is controlled by cooperativity, boundary motion, and solvent-induced fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：coarse-grained statistical-mechanical theory、three-state model、stochastic process、mean first-passage framework。；研究对象：聚合物链中瞬态、有限且动态演化的螺旋片段（living helices），具体涉及柔性聚合物和肽段中的螺旋成核、生长与寿命。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发展了一个最小粗粒化统计力学理论，揭示了聚合物链中“活螺旋”通过多步成核机制形成：先形成受约束的前核，再通过协同稳定化生长为有限螺旋段。螺旋的尺寸由协同增益与刚度、扭转应变及溶剂涨落导致的非线性惩罚之间的竞争决定，其寿命在纳秒至亚微秒量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发展了一个最小粗粒化统计力学理论，揭示了聚合物链中“活螺旋”通过多步成核机制形成：先形成受约束的前核，再通过协同稳定化生长为有限螺旋段。螺旋的尺寸由协同增益与刚度、扭转应变及溶剂涨落导致的非线性惩罚之间的竞争决定，其寿命在纳秒至亚微秒量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三态模型（three-state model）描述聚合物构象，引入协同相互作用；通过自由能景观分析螺旋稳定性；将螺旋尺寸演化建模为随机过程，利用平均首通时间（mean first-passage）框架解析推导形成时间与寿命。

papers.title: Terahertz Electrodynamics and Kinetic Inductance of Disordered Titanium-Vanadium Alloy Thin Films
papers.abstract: Disordered superconductors represent an important area in modern condensed matter physics, where superconductivity survives even in the presence of strong electron scattering and localization effects. Understanding how disorder modifies the high-frequency electrodynamic response is not only important from physics point of view, but is also essential for developing next-generation quantum detectors and superconducting devices. In this work, we investigate the terahertz electrodynamics of disordered Ti40V60 alloy thin films using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) to understand the relationship between disorder, quasiparticle dynamics, and kinetic inductance. By analysing the complex conductivity, penetration depth and superfluid response, we show that structural disorder can be systematically used to tune the inductive response while maintaining a robust superconducting phase. Unlike conventional nitride superconductors that require tightly controlled reactive growth conditions, Ti40V60 alloys provide a simpler and more adaptable route for tuning the superconducting energy scales directly through the deposition conditions. These findings establish Ti40V60 alloys as a promising material for kinetic inductance detectors and provide useful insights into the electrodynamics of strongly disordered superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS)、complex conductivity、penetration depth、superfluid response。；研究对象：无序Ti₄₀V₆₀合金薄膜的太赫兹电动力学响应，特别是无序对准粒子动力学和动感电感的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统调控结构无序，可以在保持超导相稳定的前提下有效调节薄膜的动感电感响应；Ti₄₀V₆₀合金为动感电感探测器提供了一种比传统氮化物超导体更简单、更灵活的材料路线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统调控结构无序，可以在保持超导相稳定的前提下有效调节薄膜的动感电感响应；Ti₄₀V₆₀合金为动感电感探测器提供了一种比传统氮化物超导体更简单、更灵活的材料路线。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）技术，通过分析复电导率、穿透深度和超流体响应来研究无序合金薄膜的电动力学性质。

papers.title: Using graph neural networks to predict many-body interactions in amorphous materials
papers.abstract: Many-body interactions govern the complex behavior of many amorphous materials, from metallic glasses to biological tissues, yet are often replaced by pairwise additive frameworks for computational efficiency. Here, we use classical density functional theory (DFT) to study a model soft glass of solvent-free polymer-grafted nanoparticles (PGNs), where the absence of solvent forces grafted chains to uniformly fill the interstitial space, generating strong angular-dependent many-body interactions between the cores. We show that NequIP, an equivariant message-passing graph neural network (GNN), learns the high-dimensional, rugged potential energy landscape of the system and reproduces classical DFT energies across a range of PGN design parameters at four orders of magnitude lower cost. Systematic analysis of GNN hyperparameters offers physical insights into the range, anisotropy, and effective body order of interactions. GNN-driven Monte Carlo simulations reveal locally favored icosahedral-like structures at equilibrium, and strikingly, recover equilibrium structures in agreement with experiments, despite the network being trained only on high-energy, out-of-equilibrium configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用经典密度泛函理论（DFT）和等变图神经网络（NequIP）进行模拟与预测，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：无溶剂聚合物接枝纳米颗粒（PGNs）形成的软玻璃体系，重点研究其多体相互作用及势能面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 等变图神经网络NequIP能以四个数量级更低的计算成本，准确学习并重现经典DFT计算的高维势能面；其驱动的蒙特卡洛模拟能恢复与实验一致的平衡态结构，尽管训练数据仅来自高能非平衡构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：等变图神经网络NequIP能以四个数量级更低的计算成本，准确学习并重现经典DFT计算的高维势能面；其驱动的蒙特卡洛模拟能恢复与实验一致的平衡态结构，尽管训练数据仅来自高能非平衡构型。；创新点：首次将等变图神经网络应用于无溶剂聚合物接枝纳米颗粒体系，以极低计算成本精确预测多体相互作用，并证明仅用非平衡构型训练即可恢复实验平衡结构。
papers.method_zh: 经典密度泛函理论（DFT）计算模型软玻璃体系；等变消息传递图神经网络（NequIP）学习势能面；图神经网络超参数系统分析；图神经网络驱动的蒙特卡洛模拟。

papers.title: Saturated and Anisotropic Magnetostriction in an Altermagnet
papers.abstract: Magnetostriction, a fundamental phenomenon bridging magnetism and mechanics, has enabled a broad spectrum of applications. For almost two centuries, it has been mainly investigated for ferromagnets. Regarding the magnetostriction of antiferromagnets (AFMs), limitedly known examples for both conventional collinear AFMs and noncollinear AFMs predominantly exhibit non-saturating magnetic-field dependence. Herein, we report an easily saturated magnetostriction effect in a prototypical altermagnet - MnTe, which is an emerging class of collinear AFMs with special crystal symmetries. For high-quality MnTe single crystals, the magnetostriction saturates under a moderate field of ~0.7 T with an intriguing two-fold-symmetry anisotropy. First-principles calculations reveal that the saturated and anisotropic magnetostriction originates from symmetry-allowed coupling between elastic strain and its Néel order parameter. These findings break the traditional wisdom on antiferromagnetic magnetostriction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：文中同时提及“high-quality MnTe single crystals”的实验测量和“First-principles calculations”的第一性原理计算。；研究对象：反铁磁材料MnTe单晶中的磁致伸缩效应，具体为一种新型共线反铁磁体——交变磁体（altermagnet）的磁致伸缩行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原型交变磁体MnTe中，磁致伸缩在约0.7 T的适中磁场下即可饱和，并表现出奇特的两重对称性各向异性，打破了传统反铁磁磁致伸缩难以饱和的认知。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原型交变磁体MnTe中，磁致伸缩在约0.7 T的适中磁场下即可饱和，并表现出奇特的两重对称性各向异性，打破了传统反铁磁磁致伸缩难以饱和的认知。；创新点：首次在交变磁体（而非传统共线或非共线反铁磁体）中观察到易于饱和且具有两重对称各向异性的磁致伸缩效应，颠覆了“反铁磁磁致伸缩通常不饱和”的传统观念。
papers.method_zh: 高质量MnTe单晶的磁致伸缩实验测量（具体技术摘要未明确说明）；第一性原理计算（用于揭示饱和与各向异性磁致伸缩的微观起源）。

papers.title: Crystal Dislocations as Atomic Scale Ratchets
papers.abstract: The symmetry of a system's response to external stimuli is a fundamental concept in physics and materials science. At the microscopic scale, breaking this symmetry to achieve a rectified response is exceptionally difficult to engineer and remains rare in nature. Conventional micromechanics models of crystalline solids assume a symmetric response to applied stress, where reversing the load simply inverts the direction of defect velocity without altering its magnitude. In this work, we report an atomic-scale, geometry-rooted mechanism that breaks this symmetry. Molecular dynamics simulations of face-centered cubic nickel reveal that dislocations containing atomic-scale jogs exhibit asymmetric mobility under opposite applied stresses, reversing the loading direction triggers significantly higher drag. This asymmetry arises from an unconventional coupling between an atomic displacement vector and the second-order tensorial eigenstrain of the jog motion mechanism. Because jogs are ubiquitous structures in plastic deformation, this discovery challenges classical descriptions of plastic deformation mechanisms, with direct implications to cyclic creep, and opens new pathways for defect engineering to enhance fatigue resistance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Molecular dynamics simulations）；研究对象：面心立方（FCC）镍晶体中的位错，具体是含有原子尺度割阶（jogs）的位错在应力下的非对称运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现含有原子尺度割阶的位错在相反方向应力作用下表现出非对称迁移率，即反转加载方向会显著增加位错运动的阻力，打破了经典微力学模型中应力响应的对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现含有原子尺度割阶的位错在相反方向应力作用下表现出非对称迁移率，即反转加载方向会显著增加位错运动的阻力，打破了经典微力学模型中应力响应的对称性。；创新点：揭示了一种基于几何结构的原子尺度棘轮机制，该机制通过原子位移矢量与割阶运动机制的二阶张量本征应变之间的非传统耦合，打破了位错运动对加载方向的对称响应。摘要未突出说明与具体实验结果的对比验证。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（Molecular dynamics simulations）

papers.title: Bending-like stress induced by solder joint under uniaxial tensile testing in 2G-HTS tapes: Impact and optimization approach
papers.abstract: The reversible stress limit (\mathit{R}_{rev}) of second-generation high-temperature superconducting (2G-HTS) tapes is a critical performance indicator, typically characterized through uniaxial tensile testing. In practice, the accuracy of the measured Rrev value is often compromised by stress concentration induced by the voltage tap solder joint. The present study investigates the underlying interference mechanism using integrated experimental and numerical methods. Mechanistic analysis reveals that under uniaxial tensile loading, the local geometric inhomogeneity introduced by the solder joint induces an external, bending-like stress in the vicinity of the solder joint, transitioning from additional tensile stress in the zone adjacent to the joint to additional compressive stress in the zone remote from it. When the solder joint is attached to the front surface of the tape (the side closer to the superconducting layer), the superconducting layer experiences localized additional tensile stress, triggering premature damage and early \mathit{I}_{c} degradation. Consequently, an optimized back-surface soldering approach is proposed, which positions the superconducting layer in a localized compressive zone. Experimental validation demonstrates that the proposed approach effectively mitigates testing errors for various tape configurations. Notably, for the tape with a copper layer thickness of 5 μm, the measured \mathit{R}_{rev} increased from 546 MPa to 734 MPa, corresponding to a 42% increase, and moved closer to the actual value. The findings provide essential insights for the precision characterization of the electromechanical performances (EMPs) of 2G-HTS tapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与数值模拟结合）。判断依据关键词：integrated experimental and numerical methods、experimental validation、mechanistic analysis。；研究对象：第二代高温超导（2G-HTS）带材在单轴拉伸测试中，由电压引线焊点引起的应力集中及其对可逆应力极限（Rrev）测量精度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 焊点引入的局部几何不均匀性会在超导层附近产生类似弯曲的附加应力，导致超导层提前损伤和临界电流退化；通过将焊点置于带材背面（远离超导层一侧），可使超导层处于局部压应力区，从而显著提高Rrev的测量准确性（例如铜层厚度5 μm的带材，Rrev从546 MPa提升至734 MPa，增幅42%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：焊点引入的局部几何不均匀性会在超导层附近产生类似弯曲的附加应力，导致超导层提前损伤和临界电流退化；通过将焊点置于带材背面（远离超导层一侧），可使超导层处于局部压应力区，从而显著提高Rrev的测量准确性（例如铜层厚度5 μm的带材，Rrev从546 MPa提升至734 MPa，增幅42%）。；创新点：首次揭示了焊点引起的弯曲类应力（从附加拉应力过渡到附加压应力）对2G-HTS带材Rrev测量的干扰机制，并提出背面焊接的优化方案以消除该干扰。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：单轴拉伸测试、临界电流（Ic）退化测量；数值方法：有限元分析（用于模拟焊点引起的应力分布）；优化方法：背面焊接方案。

papers.title: Ni-O hybridization-driven electronic reconstruction across the superconducting dome in an infinite-layer nickelate
papers.abstract: Superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelates has drawn wide interest as a cuprate analogue, yet how the electronic structure evolves with hole doping remains unsettled. Here we map the doping- and temperature-dependent unoccupied states of the La-based infinite-layer nickelate La1-xCaxNiO2 using O K-edge and Ni L-edge x-ray absorption spectroscopy. Superconductivity occurs for 0.18<=x<=0.27. Near x~0.20-0.23, low-energy spectral weight redistributes: Ni3d-dominated states decrease while O2p-hybridized states increase, indicating an orbital-selective crossover in Ni-O covalency. This crossover coincides with a sign reversal of the Hall coefficient and precedes the reduction of the superconducting critical temperature at higher doping. By directly linking transport anomalies and the superconducting dome to a measurable Ni-O orbital reorganization, our results provide a key step toward a unified, orbital-resolved phase diagram for infinite-layer nickelates and a practical route to engineer superconductivity via hybridization control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：x-ray absorption spectroscopy（X射线吸收谱）、Hall coefficient（霍尔系数）、transport anomalies（输运异常）。；研究对象：无限层镍氧化物超导体La₁₋ₓCaₓNiO₂，具体研究其电子结构随空穴掺杂（x）和温度（T）的演化，以及超导穹顶（superconducting dome）与电子重构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在掺杂区间x~0.20-0.23附近，Ni-O杂化发生轨道选择性交叉：Ni 3d主导的态减少，而O 2p杂化态增加。这一电子重构与霍尔系数符号反转同时发生，并先于更高掺杂下超导临界温度的下降，表明Ni-O轨道重组直接关联输运异常和超导穹顶。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在掺杂区间x~0.20-0.23附近，Ni-O杂化发生轨道选择性交叉：Ni 3d主导的态减少，而O 2p杂化态增加。这一电子重构与霍尔系数符号反转同时发生，并先于更高掺杂下超导临界温度的下降，表明Ni-O轨道重组直接关联输运异常和超导穹顶。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用O K边和Ni L边X射线吸收谱（XAS），测量掺杂依赖和温度依赖的未占据态电子结构，并结合霍尔系数测量。

papers.title: Defect-engineered scaling of lead-free ferroelectrics with ultralow-voltage switching
papers.abstract: Scaling ferroelectrics to nanometer thicknesses remains a central challenge for low-power, nonvolatile electronics, as leakage currents increasingly dominate with reduced dimensions. Alkali-based, lead-free ferroelectrics offer an environmentally sustainable alternative to lead-based systems, yet their scaling is severely limited by leakage arising from volatile alkali constituents. Here, we show that this intrinsic limitation can be transformed into an advantageous degree of freedom through defect engineering. By precisely modulating alkali deficiency during thin-film synthesis, we engineer clustered defect complexes that function as deep trap states, strongly suppressing leakage and enabling robust ferroelectric operation in ultrathin films down to the sub-10 nm regime at voltages below 100 mV. Our results establish defect-enabled scaling as a viable pathway for advancing environmentally benign ferroelectrics toward ultra-low-power, non-volatile electronic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“thin-film synthesis”（薄膜合成）、“modulating alkali deficiency”（调控碱金属缺失）等实验操作，以及“sub-10 nm regime”（亚10纳米尺度）、“below 100 mV”（低于100毫伏）等具体实验指标。；研究对象：基于碱金属的无铅铁电薄膜材料（alkali-based, lead-free ferroelectrics），具体研究其厚度缩减至纳米尺度时的铁电开关特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过缺陷工程（defect engineering），即精确调控薄膜合成过程中的碱金属缺失，可以形成深能级陷阱态的缺陷团簇，从而有效抑制漏电流，使得无铅铁电薄膜在亚10纳米厚度下仍能实现低于100毫伏的超低电压开关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过缺陷工程（defect engineering），即精确调控薄膜合成过程中的碱金属缺失，可以形成深能级陷阱态的缺陷团簇，从而有效抑制漏电流，使得无铅铁电薄膜在亚10纳米厚度下仍能实现低于100毫伏的超低电压开关。；创新点：将无铅铁电材料中由挥发性碱金属组分引起的漏电这一“固有局限性”（intrinsic limitation），通过缺陷工程转化为一个“有利的自由度”（advantageous degree of freedom），从而突破了该类材料在纳米尺度下的缩放瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法为薄膜合成与缺陷调控。具体手段包括：在薄膜生长过程中精确调制碱金属的缺失量（precisely modulating alkali deficiency），以工程化地形成缺陷团簇（clustered defect complexes）。

papers.title: Superconductor-"Metal" Transition of One-dimensional Interacting Bosons with Ohmic Quantum Dissipation
papers.abstract: The phase diagram of a system of interacting bosons (Cooper pairs) hoping on a one-dimensional (1D) lattice with onsite phase dissipation describing the Josephson tunneling to a nearby diffusive normal-metal electrode is studied. Starting from the system at commensurate lattice filling, it is shown by a combination of analytical techniques that the phase diagram contains two quantum phases: A dissipative Bose-Einstein condensate (D-BEC) or superconductor with long-range phase coherence, and a dissipative Mott insulator (D-Mott) or "metal" with exponentially decaying phase correlations in space and local imaginary-time correlations decaying as the local pairing correlations of the electrode. The D-Mott/metal phase can be described as a 1D array of dissipative boson puddles, weakly coupled by Josephson tunneling. The puddle size roughly corresponds to the length scale beyond which phase slips suppress phase coherence. The dissipative time-dependent Ginsburg-Landau theory phenomenologically used by Sachdev, Werner, and Troyer [Phys. Rev. Lett. {\bf 92} 237003 (2004)] for the superconductor-metal transition in quasi-1D wires is derived from this microscopic puddle picture. Thus, the criticality of the D-Mott/D-BEC transition is shown to belong to the Wilson-Fisher universality class with dynamical exponent $z\approx 2$. At small doping, the D-Mott/metal phase remains stable due to its finite compressibility, which is computed to leading order in a perturbation expansion of the dissipation strength and the inter-puddle Josephson coupling. At larger doping, using a mapping to a pseudospin chain combined with bosonization, the D-BEC/superconductor phase is the ground state for non-vanishing but arbitrarily small dissipation. Similarities and differences with deconfinement transition of an array 1D bosonic Mott insulators in anisotropic optical lattices are also discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical techniques、mapping、bosonization、phenomenologically used。；研究对象：一维相互作用玻色子（库珀对）在存在欧姆量子耗散（通过约瑟夫森隧穿耦合到扩散正常金属电极）下的超导体-“金属”相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系的相图包含两个量子相：具有长程相位相干的耗散玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（D-BEC）/超导体，以及具有指数衰减相位关联的耗散莫特绝缘体（D-Mott）/“金属”。D-Mott/D-BEC相变属于动力学指数z≈2的Wilson-Fisher普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系的相图包含两个量子相：具有长程相位相干的耗散玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（D-BEC）/超导体，以及具有指数衰减相位关联的耗散莫特绝缘体（D-Mott）/“金属”。D-Mott/D-BEC相变属于动力学指数z≈2的Wilson-Fisher普适类。；创新点：从微观“耗散玻色子液滴”图像出发，推导了Sachdev等人先前唯象用于准一维线超导体-金属转变的耗散含时金兹堡-朗道理论，并明确了相变的临界普适类。摘要未突出说明与一维玻色莫特绝缘体阵列退禁闭转变的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 结合解析技术（微扰展开、玻色化、映射到赝自旋链）从微观模型出发推导出耗散含时金兹堡-朗道理论，并计算了D-Mott相的压缩率。

papers.title: A Padding Method for Enhanced Encoding of Inorganic Structures with Varying Chemical Compositions
