papers.abstract: Designing novel inorganic materials through generative models remains an important challenge for material science, driven by the complexity and diversity of inorganic structures across expansive chemical compositions and structural landscape. The vast combinatorial space of inorganic compounds demands innovative, AI-driven approaches to overcome limitations in generative accuracy and efficiency. To address this, we introduce a novel method that redefines the encoding and generation of inorganic materials by utilizing domain-specific symmetry-aware representation. Our approach not only refines the representation of intricate inorganic structures but also contributes to the field of material discovery by enhancing the precision and stability of generated candidates. Central to our methodology is a novel padding technique that exploits crystal symmetry information to enhance the encoding process. By integrating Wyckoff position length-aware padding into an encoder architecture, we achieve a more robust informed representation of inorganic materials. This symmetry-driven enhancement improves deep learning models to generate stable, previously unexplored inorganic structures with superior accuracy and computational efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce an end-to-end system that leverages the machine learning potential models to seamlessly generate novel, even those unseen in the training data, and stable inorganic materials from initial data to validated output. This pipeline integrates advanced generative models with stability analysis, marking a significant leap forward in the automated exploration and design of next-generation inorganic materials. Our method improved reconstruction accuracy 5.3% in proton conductor data, and generated 63.5% more novel stable inorganic material to baseline model on the perov-5 dataset.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：generative models、encoding、machine learning potential models、deep learning models。；研究对象：无机晶体材料，特别是具有不同化学成分和对称性的无机结构（如质子导体、钙钛矿材料）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于晶体对称性（Wyckoff位置长度感知填充）的编码方法，显著提升了无机材料生成模型的精度和稳定性，在质子导体数据上重建精度提升5.3%，在perov-5数据集上生成的新颖稳定无机材料比基线模型多63.5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于晶体对称性（Wyckoff位置长度感知填充）的编码方法，显著提升了无机材料生成模型的精度和稳定性，在质子导体数据上重建精度提升5.3%，在perov-5数据集上生成的新颖稳定无机材料比基线模型多63.5%。；创新点：首次将Wyckoff位置长度感知填充技术引入编码器，利用晶体对称信息增强对无机材料结构的表征，从而提升生成模型的准确性和计算效率。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于对称性感知的编码器架构，结合Wyckoff位置长度感知填充（padding）技术，并集成机器学习势模型（machine learning potential models）构建端到端生成系统，用于从初始数据到验证输出的全流程无机材料自动生成与稳定性分析。

papers.title: Tensor gradient flow for rod-like liquid crystals from molecular model with closure approximation by quasi-entropy
papers.abstract: In tensor dynamics for liquid crystals derived from molecular models, a common problem is closure approximation. For rod-like molecules, the Bingham closure has proved to outperform other methods because it inherits the gradient flow structure of the molecular model, but is difficult to achieve efficient computations maintaining the gradient flow structure. We propose a closure approximation by the quasi-entropy that has been successfully applied to the free energy, based on which we construct the tensor gradient flow. The quasi-entropy closure has the same symmetry properties as the Bingham closure. The resulting tensor gradient flow is able to constrain the eigenvalues of the tensor within the physical range, guaranteeing the positive definiteness of the dissipation operator given by the higher-order tensors. The quasi-entropy closure is easy to implement since it can be reduced to minimizing an elementary function of three variables. As a result, we construct a numerical scheme preserving the eigenvalue constraints and energy dissipation, with the closure approximation decoupled from solving the scheme. Numerical simulations are carried out for the interface between the isotropic and the uniaxial nematic phase, as well as the defect evolutions, where the higher-order tensors indeed make a difference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tensor gradient flow、closure approximation、numerical scheme、numerical simulations。；研究对象：棒状液晶（rod-like liquid crystals）的分子模型，具体涉及从分子模型推导的张量动力学中的闭合近似问题，以及各向同性-单轴向列相界面和缺陷演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于准熵（quasi-entropy）的闭合近似方法，构建了能够将张量特征值约束在物理范围内、保证耗散算子正定性的张量梯度流，且该闭合近似易于数值实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于准熵（quasi-entropy）的闭合近似方法，构建了能够将张量特征值约束在物理范围内、保证耗散算子正定性的张量梯度流，且该闭合近似易于数值实现。；创新点：提出准熵闭合近似，兼具Bingham闭合的对称性优势，同时更易于高效计算（可简化为三元初等函数的最小化），并首次实现张量梯度流中特征值约束与能量耗散的同时保持。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：从分子模型出发，利用准熵构造闭合近似，建立张量梯度流。数值方法：设计保持特征值约束和能量耗散的数值格式，将闭合近似与求解格式解耦，并通过数值模拟验证各向同性-单轴向列相界面及缺陷演化。

papers.title: A Convenient Sealing Method Using Boron Nitride Capping for Reactive Reactions
papers.abstract: While quartz (SiO2) ampule sealing is commonly used in laboratories to prevent sample oxidation during synthesis, its application is limited for reactions involving highly reactive elements such as alkali, alkaline-earth, and rare-earth metals. These elements can react with SiO2 at elevated temperatures, causing compositional loss, tube failure, and experimental inconsistencies. Here, we introduce an inexpensive boron nitride (BN) cap sealing technique. This approach is readily adaptable to centrifugal separation and flux transport growth and yields superior sample quality. We demonstrate its efficacy by growing KFe2As2 and CsCr6Sb6 single crystals, the former exhibiting record-high quality, with a residual resistivity ratio (RRR) exceeding 2500, and the latter achieving significantly larger crystal dimensions than other methods. This accessible and economical method promises to accelerate the discovery of novel materials that contain reactive elements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验操作（石英管密封、BN帽密封）、样品生长（KFe2As2和CsCr6Sb6单晶）以及性能表征（RRR、晶体尺寸）。；研究对象：针对含有碱金属、碱土金属、稀土金属等高活性元素的材料合成，提出一种新的密封方法。具体演示体系为KFe2As2和CsCr6Sb6单晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种廉价且简便的氮化硼（BN）帽密封技术，可替代传统石英管密封，用于高活性元素参与的化学反应，成功生长出高质量KFe2As2单晶（RRR>2500）和更大尺寸的CsCr6Sb6单晶。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种廉价且简便的氮化硼（BN）帽密封技术，可替代传统石英管密封，用于高活性元素参与的化学反应，成功生长出高质量KFe2As2单晶（RRR>2500）和更大尺寸的CsCr6Sb6单晶。；创新点：针对高活性元素与石英管反应导致实验失败的问题，提出一种低成本、易操作的BN帽密封方案，并证明其在提高样品质量和晶体尺寸方面优于传统方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用BN帽密封技术替代传统石英管密封，结合离心分离和助熔剂输运生长方法，进行单晶生长。通过残余电阻比（RRR）和晶体尺寸评估样品质量。

papers.title: Non-Perturbative Renormalization Group for Ising-Nematic Criticality: A Closed-Form Nonlocal Ansatz
papers.abstract: The two-dimensional metallic quantum critical problem is a long-standing puzzle that is widely believed to hold the key to resolving ubiquitous non-Fermi liquid behavior in strongly correlated electronic systems. In this study, we present a non-perturbative renormalization group (RG) analysis of the metallic Ising-nematic quantum critical point in two dimensions, formulated directly around an intrinsically nonlocal infrared (IR) boson propagator. Rather than treating the anomalous dynamical critical exponent $a$ as a fixed phenomenological parameter, we regard it as an intrinsic component of the fixed-point data to be determined from the internal consistency of the low-energy patch field theory under highly anisotropic scaling dimensions ($[k_0]=a+1$, $[k_x]=2$, $[k_y]=1$). While the leading two-loop diagrammatics vanish identically due to kinematic pole configurations, our three-loop evaluation reveals a profound structural asymmetry between the sectors: the fermion self-energy and Yukawa vertex receive non-vanishing logarithmic corrections, whereas the corresponding bosonic counter-term remains strictly zero. Consequently, we find that no self-consistent, intersecting fixed-point solution for the exponent $a$ exists within the three-loop truncation, failing to reproduce the physical value of $a \approx 1.85$ observed in quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We conjecture that the cross-linked topology of the four-loop boson self-energy diagrams is exactly marginal and yields the minimal, mandatory bosonic counter-term required to restore multi-sector self-consistency. Our framework establishes a rigid multi-loop matching scheme necessary to uniquely pin down the critical exponent, and uncovers a stable phase space for field anomalous dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非微扰重整化群、解析计算、多圈图分析。；研究对象：二维金属中Ising向列型量子临界点，即电子系统中由向列序参量涨落驱动的非费米液体量子临界现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三圈截断下，不存在自洽的临界指数a的固定点解，无法复现量子蒙特卡洛模拟给出的物理值a≈1.85；四圈玻色子自能图的交叉拓扑结构可能是恢复自洽性的关键。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三圈截断下，不存在自洽的临界指数a的固定点解，无法复现量子蒙特卡洛模拟给出的物理值a≈1.85；四圈玻色子自能图的交叉拓扑结构可能是恢复自洽性的关键。；创新点：将反常动力学临界指数a视为固定点内禀数据而非唯象参数，通过多圈自洽性条件确定其值；发现两圈图因运动学极点结构严格为零，三圈图揭示费米子自能和Yukawa顶点存在对数修正而玻色子反项严格为零的结构不对称性。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰重整化群分析，基于非局域红外玻色子传播子构建低能patch场论，采用高度各向异性标度维度（[k₀]=a+1, [k_x]=2, [k_y]=1），进行三圈图计算。

papers.title: Nonlinear Schrodinger Equations for Dense Bose Fluid and He4 Film at Low Temperatures
papers.abstract: We have derived the nonlinear Schrodinger equation generalizing the Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) equa tion for dilute Bose gas. The derivation is based on the Hartree-Fock time-dependent mean-field theory with an arbitrary intermolecular interaction potential. It is shown that obtained nonlinear Schrodinger equation with appropriate redefinition of coefficients can be used for description of dense Bose fluid at low temperatures. We also present the Schrodinger type equation describing the superfluid component of helium in two fluid hydrodynamics. This approach leads to quantum correction for superfluid component of velocity in two fluid hydrodynamics. We also have derived the nonlinear Schrodinger equation for superfluid He4 film at low temperatures. It is shown that this Schrodinger type equation for superfluid He4 film leads to phonon-roton dispersion relation for elementary excitation at low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derived、mean-field theory、nonlinear Schrodinger equation。；研究对象：稠密玻色流体（dense Bose fluid）以及低温下超流氦4薄膜（superfluid He4 film）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出适用于稠密玻色流体的非线性薛定谔方程，并进一步得到描述超流氦4薄膜的非线性薛定谔方程，该方程在低温下可导出声子-旋子（phonon-roton）色散关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出适用于稠密玻色流体的非线性薛定谔方程，并进一步得到描述超流氦4薄膜的非线性薛定谔方程，该方程在低温下可导出声子-旋子（phonon-roton）色散关系。；创新点：将通常用于稀薄玻色气体的Gross-Pitaevskii方程推广到稠密玻色流体，并给出了超流氦4薄膜的薛定谔型方程及其与两流体流体力学中声子-旋子激发的联系。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时哈特里-福克平均场理论（Hartree-Fock time-dependent mean-field theory），采用任意分子间相互作用势，推广了稀薄玻色气体的Gross-Pitaevskii方程。

papers.title: Simulations of dislocation dynamics on an atomic lattice: the effect of collision rules
papers.abstract: The stochastic dynamics of dislocations on a one-dimensional periodic lattice domain are considered. Two models are studied: one without a collision rule, and one which annihilates colliding dislocations if they have opposite orientation. The behaviour of both models is investigated by means of a series of numerical simulations exploring the asymptotic behaviour of these models as the number of dislocations increases. From these simulations, evidence is obtained that the discrete model with annihilation tends to a PDE for the dislocation density that accounts for annihilation. However, the discrete model without a collision rule does not appear to exhibit consistent convergence behaviour; instead, it appears that the expected PDE with conserved dislocation density appears in the limit for some parameters, but that for other parameters the density appears to follow to the evolution of the PDE with annihilation. These findings provide evidence that a careful treatment of dislocation collisions is important in discrete dislocation dynamics models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：数值模拟、离散模型、随机动力学。；研究对象：一维周期晶格上位错的随机动力学，具体研究两种模型：一种无碰撞规则，另一种使相反取向的碰撞位错湮灭。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 带湮灭的离散模型趋于描述位错密度演化的偏微分方程（PDE）；而无碰撞规则的模型收敛行为不一致，在某些参数下趋于位错密度守恒的PDE，在其他参数下却趋于带湮灭的PDE，表明碰撞规则的处理对离散位错动力学模型至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：带湮灭的离散模型趋于描述位错密度演化的偏微分方程（PDE）；而无碰撞规则的模型收敛行为不一致，在某些参数下趋于位错密度守恒的PDE，在其他参数下却趋于带湮灭的PDE，表明碰撞规则的处理对离散位错动力学模型至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过一系列数值模拟，研究两种离散模型随位错数目增加时的渐近行为，并与相应的偏微分方程（PDE）进行对比。

papers.title: Wetting as an emergent property of water: reformulating Young equation on molecular grounds
papers.abstract: Young equation provides a remarkably successful macroscopic description of wetting, yet its molecular origin (particularly for water) has remained elusive for over two centuries. Here we make the molecular basis of aqueous wetting explicit by reformulating it in terms of a molecular wetting coefficient, omega m, which quantifies how an interface compensates the intrinsic energetic cost of hydrogen-bond defects relative to bulk water. Across a broad and continuous spectrum of hydrophilicities, spanning chemically diverse experimental and model surfaces, macroscopic contact angles collapse onto a single universal master curve when expressed through omega m. This molecular reformulation closes Young and Young-Dupre relations on energetic grounds, establishing a unified and predictive physical link between wetting, adhesion, cavitation, and nanoconfined filling. By anchoring interfacial behavior to waters intrinsic hydrogen-bond energetic scales, our results reveal wetting as an emergent property of water itself, rather than a surface-specific attribute and provide a transferable molecular framework that recalibrates energetic intuition and guides the rational design of aqueous interfaces. (This document is the unedited Author version of a Submitted Manuscript subsequently accepted for publication in J. Am. Chem. Soc. For the published version, which includes a more complete molecular-thermodynamics grounding of the method see the published version)
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：reformulating、molecular reformulation、energetic grounds、molecular framework）；研究对象：水在固体表面的润湿现象，具体涉及水分子氢键缺陷与界面能量补偿的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过定义分子润湿系数ωm，发现不同化学性质表面的宏观接触角可统一为一条通用主曲线，表明润湿是水本身的涌现性质，而非表面特异性属性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过定义分子润湿系数ωm，发现不同化学性质表面的宏观接触角可统一为一条通用主曲线，表明润湿是水本身的涌现性质，而非表面特异性属性。；创新点：将杨氏方程从宏观描述重新表述为基于水分子氢键能量尺度的分子框架，建立了润湿、粘附、空化和纳米受限填充之间的统一预测性物理联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型分析：基于分子热力学重新表述杨氏方程，引入分子润湿系数ωm量化界面如何补偿水分子氢键缺陷相对于体相水的固有能量成本，并在连续亲水性谱上对实验和模型表面数据进行标度分析。

papers.title: Deterministic fabrication of large-area, high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices
papers.abstract: Oxide twistronics extends moire engineering beyond van der Waals materials, offering a promising platform for accessing emergent interfacial phenomena arising from the strong coupling of lattice, charge, and orbital degrees of freedom in complex oxides. However, deterministic fabrication of high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices over large lateral dimensions remains challenging due to the three-dimensional bonding network of oxides. Here, we demonstrate a scalable, generalized fabrication strategy that enables the formation of high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices with clean, chemically bonded interfaces and precisely controlled twist angles down to nominal values of 0.1 degree, achieving sub-degree twist-angle accuracy across large contiguous lateral dimensions approaching the millimeter scale. Using NaNbO3 as a model system, we show that the resulting interlayer coupling drives pronounced structural reconstruction that modifies both the phase structure and ferroelectric domain configuration. Synchrotron-based X-ray 3D reciprocal space mapping reveals the emergence of a single-phase state in twisted bilayers, in contrast to the mixed-phase structure observed in single-layer membranes prior to twist assembly. The structural signatures are further consistent with gradual lattice rotation distributed along the thickness direction that may accommodate interfacial shear strain, distinct from reconstruction observed in van der Waals moire systems, which primarily occurs through in-plane stacking rearrangement. This collective lattice response is correlated with twist-dependent nanoscale electromechanical modulations observed by piezoresponse force microscopy. These results establish a scalable materials platform for oxide twistronics and open new pathways towards integrating twist-engineered complex oxides into practical, macroscale device architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、fabrication、X-ray 3D reciprocal space mapping、piezoresponse force microscopy。；研究对象：氧化物莫尔超晶格，具体以 NaNbO₃ 为模型体系，研究其通过扭转工程实现的高结晶度、大面积的超晶格结构及其界面耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过可扩展的制备策略，实现了大面积、高结晶度、扭转角精确可控（精度达0.1度）的氧化物莫尔超晶格，并发现层间耦合驱动了显著的结构重构，包括单相态的出现和沿厚度方向的晶格旋转，这与范德华莫尔体系的面内堆垛重构不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过可扩展的制备策略，实现了大面积、高结晶度、扭转角精确可控（精度达0.1度）的氧化物莫尔超晶格，并发现层间耦合驱动了显著的结构重构，包括单相态的出现和沿厚度方向的晶格旋转，这与范德华莫尔体系的面内堆垛重构不同。；创新点：首次实现了大面积（接近毫米尺度）、高结晶度、化学键合界面且扭转角精度达亚度（0.1度）的氧化物莫尔超晶格的可控制备，并揭示了其与范德华莫尔体系不同的三维结构重构机制（沿厚度方向的晶格旋转而非面内堆垛重排）。
papers.method_zh: 采用可扩展的通用制备方法实现氧化物莫尔超晶格；使用同步辐射X射线三维倒易空间映射（3D reciprocal space mapping）分析结构重构；利用压电力显微镜（piezoresponse force microscopy）观测纳米尺度的电机械调制。

papers.title: Symmetry-Resolved Second Harmonic Generation in Quantum and Functional Materials
papers.abstract: Second harmonic generation (SHG) has evolved from a probe of noncentrosymmetric crystals into a symmetry-resolved optical method for identifying order parameters in quantum and functional materials. In particular, polarization-resolved rotational anisotropy (RA) measurements of SHG can connect nonlinear susceptibility tensors to the crystallographic and magnetic point groups of the underlying materials. This capability is especially powerful when the ordered state is weak, spatially confined, multipolar, magnetic, or hidden from conventional linear probe techniques. In this review article, we provide a comprehensive overview of RA-SHG studies across a broad range of condensed matter systems. We begin with basic theoretical background for the multipole origins of SHG radiation, the construction of nonlinear susceptibility tensors, and group-theoretical framework connecting tensor components to order parameters. We then review the applications of RA-SHG to polar materials, magnetic orders, and other hidden electronic materials. Finally, we outline challenges and future research directions for using SHG to reveal, image, and control hidden, intertwined, and nonequilibrium phases in quantum and functional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：review article, comprehensive overview。；研究对象：量子材料与功能材料中的对称性分辨二次谐波产生（SHG）现象，特别是极化分辨旋转各向异性（RA）测量方法及其在探测有序相（如极性、磁性、多极序）中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 极化分辨的旋转各向异性二次谐波（RA-SHG）是一种强大的光学方法，能够通过连接非线性磁化率张量与材料的晶体和磁点群，来识别弱、空间受限、多极、磁性或对传统线性探测技术“隐藏”的有序参量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：极化分辨的旋转各向异性二次谐波（RA-SHG）是一种强大的光学方法，能够通过连接非线性磁化率张量与材料的晶体和磁点群，来识别弱、空间受限、多极、磁性或对传统线性探测技术“隐藏”的有序参量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该综述相对于已有综述的具体创新点，但其核心价值在于对RA-SHG方法在从极性材料到磁性材料及隐藏电子态等广泛凝聚态体系中的应用，进行了全面、系统的梳理和总结，并指出了未来的挑战与方向。
papers.method_zh: 主要综述了极化分辨旋转各向异性二次谐波（RA-SHG）测量技术。理论框架包括：SHG辐射的多极起源、非线性磁化率张量的构建、以及将张量分量与有序参量联系起来的群论方法。

papers.title: Observation and Control of the Magnetic Photogalvanic Effect from Strongly Bound Excitons
papers.abstract: Photogalvanic effects arising from the quantum geometry of noncentrosymmetric materials are promising for next-generation light-harvesting devices that do not require a built-in electric field. Recent theories predict photogalvanic currents generated in magnetic systems with spin-dependent symmetry breaking as well as by bound exciton states, allowing for potential magnetic field control of the photoresponse and enhanced detection of deep sub-gap signals, respectively. We demonstrate the magnetic photogalvanic effect in a bilayer CrI3 tunnel junction with both magnetic field switching and electric field tuning of interlayer symmetry. By controlling for the polarization and energy of light illumination, we disentangle the shift and injection current contributions and find that the peak response occurs under resonant excitation of strongly bound excitons in CrI3. Our results can be captured within a many-body framework of the photogalvanic effect, while our devices function as tunable, multispectral helicity- and polarization-sensitive detectors that highlight the potential of 2D magnets for future optoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（判断依据：demonstrate、tunnel junction、control、disentangle、devices function等实验操作与器件表征关键词）；研究对象：双层CrI₃隧道结中的磁光电流效应（magnetic photogalvanic effect），具体涉及强束缚激子（strongly bound excitons）的光激发与电流响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双层CrI₃隧道结中实现了磁光电流效应，通过磁场切换和电场调控层间对称性，并在强束缚激子共振激发下观察到峰值光电流响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双层CrI₃隧道结中实现了磁光电流效应，通过磁场切换和电场调控层间对称性，并在强束缚激子共振激发下观察到峰值光电流响应。；创新点：首次在实验上观测并调控磁性体系中的光电流效应（磁光电流效应），同时利用强束缚激子实现深亚带隙信号增强，并展示了二维磁体在可调谐、多光谱手性与偏振敏感探测器中的应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建双层CrI₃隧道结，通过控制光照偏振和能量区分位移电流（shift current）与注入电流（injection current）贡献；理论分析采用多体光电流效应框架（many-body framework of the photogalvanic effect）进行解释。

papers.title: Entanglement entropy of an acoustic black hole
papers.abstract: We introduce a method to numerically compute the entanglement entropy of an acoustic black hole. It is shown that the entanglement entropy of sufficiently large subregions scales linearly with size and thus shows a volume law instead of an area law. The origin of this scaling can be traced back to the non-separable long-distance correlations due to the production of phonon pairs at the horizon. The system is shown to be locally thermal, such that the part of the entanglement entropy scaling with volume is well approximated by the thermal entropy of the outgoing Hawking radiation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：numerically compute、shown、approximated）；研究对象：声学黑洞（acoustic black hole）中的纠缠熵（entanglement entropy）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 足够大子区域的纠缠熵随尺寸线性增长，呈现体积律而非面积律；该体积律部分可被出射霍金辐射的热熵很好地近似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：足够大子区域的纠缠熵随尺寸线性增长，呈现体积律而非面积律；该体积律部分可被出射霍金辐射的热熵很好地近似。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数值计算（numerically compute）纠缠熵，分析声学黑洞中声子对产生导致的非可分离长程关联，并利用局域热平衡近似将体积律部分与霍金辐射热熵关联。

papers.title: Kinetic phase transition modeling for metals
papers.abstract: We present a new phenomenological model for phase transformation (PT) kinetics in metals, the "Fermi Kinetic Phase Transition (KPT) Model". It is designed such that it captures the main macroscopic features of our previously developed micro-structure dependent model, but at a fraction of the computational cost of the latter. Using four model parameters, the Fermi KPT model performs better than other phenomenological PT kinetics models in the literature, as shown by our present comparisons to experimental data for iron and tin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：phenomenological model、modeling、computational cost）；研究对象：金属中的相变动力学（phase transformation kinetics），具体以铁和锡为实验对比材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个名为“Fermi Kinetic Phase Transition (KPT) Model”的新唯象模型，该模型能以远低于微观结构依赖模型的计算成本，捕捉其主要宏观特征，并在与铁和锡的实验数据对比中优于文献中其他唯象相变动力学模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个名为“Fermi Kinetic Phase Transition (KPT) Model”的新唯象模型，该模型能以远低于微观结构依赖模型的计算成本，捕捉其主要宏观特征，并在与铁和锡的实验数据对比中优于文献中其他唯象相变动力学模型。；创新点：提出了一种计算效率更高的唯象相变动力学模型，在保持宏观特征描述能力的同时，显著降低了计算成本，且与实验数据的吻合度优于现有同类模型。
papers.method_zh: 基于唯象建模（phenomenological modeling），使用四个模型参数构建“Fermi KPT Model”，并与已有实验数据（铁和锡）进行对比验证。

papers.title: Harnessing diamond surface features for dense and aligned NV ensembles
papers.abstract: Controlling nitrogen doping in diamond is key to advancing nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center devices. We harness the hillock, a typically undesirable surface feature, to incorporate high densities of grown-in, aligned NV-centers on a (001)-oriented substrate. Enhanced cathodoluminescence at hillock sidewalls is correlated via nanoSIMS to up to 1000x greater nitrogen incorporation compared to the planar film. We find that these hillocks are associated with stacking faults and edge-type dislocations, consistent with an origin in surface preparation rather than substrate screw dislocations. Yet, the growth is orderly enough that each of the four hillock sidewalls hosts a distinct NV orientation. A 1.7-2% grown-in NV/substitutional nitrogen (P1) ratio, 4x higher than typical (001)-oriented growth, is measured via NV decoherence analysis. By revealing that spontaneously formed hillocks act as natural laboratories for dense, aligned NV formation, this work motivates systematic investigation of facet-dependent nitrogen incorporation and preferential NV alignment in (001) diamond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验观测（增强的阴极发光）、表征手段（nanoSIMS）和样品制备（生长）。；研究对象：金刚石（001）衬底上生长的氮-空位（NV）色心。具体研究了金刚石表面自发形成的“hillock”（小丘）这一表面特征，及其对NV色心密度和取向的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金刚石（001）表面自发形成的hillock结构，其侧壁的氮掺入量比平坦薄膜区域高出高达1000倍，并且每个侧壁只生长一种特定取向的NV色心，从而实现了高密度、取向一致的NV色心集合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金刚石（001）表面自发形成的hillock结构，其侧壁的氮掺入量比平坦薄膜区域高出高达1000倍，并且每个侧壁只生长一种特定取向的NV色心，从而实现了高密度、取向一致的NV色心集合。；创新点：揭示了通常被认为是不良表面特征的hillock，实际上可以作为天然“实验室”，用于生长高密度且取向一致的NV色心。这一发现将表面形貌与NV色心的形成和取向控制联系起来，为在（001）金刚石中实现高质量NV色心阵列提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法。具体包括：在（001）取向的金刚石衬底上进行外延生长；利用阴极发光（CL）进行空间分辨的光学表征；利用纳米二次离子质谱（nanoSIMS）进行元素分布分析；通过NV退相干分析（NV decoherence analysis）测量生长引入的NV与替代位氮（P1中心）的比例。

papers.title: Mean-squared displacements of rough particles in polydisperse granular gases
papers.abstract: We investigate the diffusion coefficients and mean-squared displacements in a polydisperse granular gas in a homogeneous cooling state by considering the roughness of the particles. We study their dependence on the normal and tangential restitution coefficients. We show that the motility of particles is strongly affected by their mechanical properties and surface characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、show（理论推导与数值分析）。；研究对象：多分散颗粒气体中粗糙颗粒的扩散系数与均方位移，重点关注颗粒粗糙度对冷却态动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 颗粒的迁移率（扩散行为）强烈依赖于其力学性质（法向与切向恢复系数）及表面粗糙特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：颗粒的迁移率（扩散行为）强烈依赖于其力学性质（法向与切向恢复系数）及表面粗糙特性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于均匀冷却态假设，通过理论分析研究多分散颗粒气体中粗糙颗粒的均方位移与扩散系数，并考察法向与切向恢复系数对结果的影响。

papers.title: Topological Phenomena Protected by Diabolical Textures
papers.abstract: We present a new class of topological phenomena in inhomogeneous systems arising from the adiabatic spatial embedding of parametrized families of quantum states such as charge pumps and their generalizations. We demonstrate that each topologically distinct class of these "diabolical textures" gives rise to distinct gapped states that are separated by "trap-scaling" critical points. When the texture varies sufficiently rapidly in space, the critical line terminates abruptly, producing an "unnecessary critical" surface. We demonstrate our results using a microscopic model of non-interacting fermions with a spatially embedded Thouless pump. We study its phase diagram comprehensively and establish its stability to arbitrary perturbations, including interactions, in the vicinity of the critical regions. For systems in arbitrary spatial dimensions and global symmetries, we present a framework to systematically classify diabolical textures using Kitaev's $Ω$ spectrum conjecture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“提出新类拓扑现象”、“建立框架”、“使用Kitaev Ω谱猜想”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：非均匀系统中的拓扑现象，具体为通过绝热空间嵌入参数化量子态族（如电荷泵及其推广）形成的“diabolical textures”（魔鬼纹理）所保护的拓扑态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一类由“魔鬼纹理”空间变化产生的新型拓扑现象，每个拓扑不等价类对应不同的有能隙态，并由“陷阱-标度”临界点分隔；当纹理空间变化足够快时，临界线突然终止，形成“非必要临界”表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一类由“魔鬼纹理”空间变化产生的新型拓扑现象，每个拓扑不等价类对应不同的有能隙态，并由“陷阱-标度”临界点分隔；当纹理空间变化足够快时，临界线突然终止，形成“非必要临界”表面。；创新点：首次提出“魔鬼纹理”这一新概念，并系统揭示了其产生的拓扑现象、临界行为及分类方法，特别是发现了“非必要临界”表面这一新现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用无相互作用费米子的微观模型，其中空间嵌入Thouless泵，通过全面研究其相图，并在临界区域附近分析其对任意微扰（包括相互作用）的稳定性；同时利用Kitaev的Ω谱猜想，建立适用于任意空间维度和全局对称性的魔鬼纹理系统分类框架。

papers.title: Richardson-Gaudin states of non-zero seniority III: The Perfect-Pairing limit
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated electrons can be treated with a configuration interaction of Slater determinants grouped by number of unpaired electrons with exponential cost. The first two papers in this series demonstrated that single reference methods built from Richardson-Gaudin states gave results of similar quality at polynomial cost. In this contribution, the states are simplified substantially yielding the perfect-pairing state as a reference along with its low-lying excitations. The states are much simpler, the computational cost is substantially reduced, and there is no sacrifice in numerical accuracy. Second-order Epstein-Nesbet perturbative corrections for the valence electrons are similar in quality to the complete active space self-consistent field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：configuration interaction（组态相互作用）、Richardson-Gaudin states（理查森-高丁态）、perturbative corrections（微扰修正）。；研究对象：强关联电子体系，具体关注其电子组态相互作用问题，特别是基于非零辛（seniority）的理查森-高丁态在完美配对极限下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在完美配对极限下，基于理查森-高丁态的方法可以简化为以完美配对态为参考态及其低能激发态的形式。这种简化在保持数值精度的同时，显著降低了计算成本，其二阶微扰修正的质量可与完全活性空间自洽场（CASSCF）方法相媲美。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在完美配对极限下，基于理查森-高丁态的方法可以简化为以完美配对态为参考态及其低能激发态的形式。这种简化在保持数值精度的同时，显著降低了计算成本，其二阶微扰修正的质量可与完全活性空间自洽场（CASSCF）方法相媲美。；创新点：将前两篇论文中复杂的理查森-高丁态在完美配对极限下大幅简化，得到了一个更简单、计算成本更低但精度相当的参考态（完美配对态）及其激发态框架。摘要未突出说明与其它简化方法（如传统完美配对方法）的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值计算。具体使用了基于理查森-高丁态的单参考方法，并将其在完美配对极限下进行简化。采用二阶 Epstein-Nesbet 微扰理论对价电子进行修正，并与完全活性空间自洽场（CASSCF）方法的结果进行对比。

papers.title: Can dents and gouges compromise the structural integrity of hydrogen transport pipelines?
papers.abstract: Repurposing natural gas pipelines for hydrogen transport requires understanding how external defects, like dents and gouges, affect structural integrity under H$_2$ exposure. To address this, we combine experiments with a new hydrogen embrittlement model aimed at large plastic straining scenarios, which integrates: (i) multi-trap hydrogen transport, (ii) finite-strain plasticity, and (iii) a hydrogen- and triaxiality-dependent damage law. Each constituent of the model is validated with experiments on X65 pipeline steel: (i) hydrogen permeation, (ii) full-scale pipe-indentation, and (iii) mechanical testing at different hydrogen and triaxiality levels. The validated model is used to study \textit{passive} (indent before H$_2$ exposure) and \textit{active} (indent with H$_2$) dents and gouges. Results reveal that hydrogen does not significantly increase the damage severity of those defects, unless hydrogen egress is completely precluded at the outer surface of a pipeline that is being pressurised internally and contains a pre-existing \textit{passive} dent with a gouge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combine experiments with a new hydrogen embrittlement model”，并分别进行了氢渗透、全尺寸压痕和力学测试实验，以及基于模型的数值研究。；研究对象：X65管线钢在氢气环境下的结构完整性，具体研究外部缺陷（凹痕和划痕）对氢气输送管道的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氢气并不会显著增加凹痕和划痕缺陷的损伤严重程度，除非在内部加压且外表面完全阻止氢气逸出的情况下，预先存在的被动凹痕（含划痕）才会因氢气暴露而显著恶化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氢气并不会显著增加凹痕和划痕缺陷的损伤严重程度，除非在内部加压且外表面完全阻止氢气逸出的情况下，预先存在的被动凹痕（含划痕）才会因氢气暴露而显著恶化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：氢渗透实验、全尺寸管道压痕实验、不同氢浓度和应力三轴度下的力学测试。理论/计算方面：建立了一个针对大塑性应变场景的氢脆模型，该模型整合了（i）多陷阱氢输运、（ii）有限应变塑性、（iii）氢与应力三轴度相关的损伤判据。

papers.title: (Non-)Traversable Quantum Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Quantum phase transitions manifest as an abrupt change in the ground state of a many-body system; yet it is an open question whether this sudden change necessarily precludes a continuous dynamical connection between the two phases. We introduce a classification of quantum phase transitions based on this geometric aspect of the ground-state manifold, that differs from known classifications. By leveraging the framework of counterdiabatic driving, we explicitly construct schedules that dynamically connect one phase to another. This strategy allows us to uncover a large class of quantum phase transitions, where the states on both sides are separated only by a finite geometric distance in the thermodynamic limit. We term such transitions traversable, since exact counterdiabatic driving links the two phases via a finite dynamical protocol in the thermodynamic limit. We show that multiple known transitions fall into this class -- e.g., symmetry-breaking transitions obeying hyperscaling and discontinuous transitions with an enhanced continuous symmetry. We further show the existence of quantum phase transitions that cannot be crossed dynamically even with the help of nonlocal counterdiabatic driving, as they would require divergent amplitudes and frequencies. Geometrically, these nontraversable transitions correspond to an infinite distance separating the two phases of matter; we show that the class comprises continuous transitions exhibiting mean-field universality, and discontinuous transitions arising from the competition between metastable minima. Our geometric classification goes beyond the known taxonomy, is independent of local order parameters and renormalization group fixed points, and has direct implications for the complexity of state preparation and adiabatic quantum computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入分类”、“利用框架”、“构造协议”等理论推导与分类方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子相变（quantum phase transitions）的几何分类，具体研究相变是否可被动态穿越（traversable vs. non-traversable），涉及对称性破缺相变、平均场普适类相变、亚稳态竞争导致的非连续相变等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于基态流形的几何距离，将量子相变分为“可穿越”与“不可穿越”两类：可穿越相变在热力学极限下可通过有限的反向绝热驱动协议动态连接两相；不可穿越相变即使借助非局域反向绝热驱动，也需要发散振幅和频率，对应两相间无限几何距离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于基态流形的几何距离，将量子相变分为“可穿越”与“不可穿越”两类：可穿越相变在热力学极限下可通过有限的反向绝热驱动协议动态连接两相；不可穿越相变即使借助非局域反向绝热驱动，也需要发散振幅和频率，对应两相间无限几何距离。；创新点：提出一种独立于局域序参量和重整化群不动点的几何分类方法，超越了已知的相变分类体系，并直接关联到态制备复杂度与绝热量子计算。
papers.method_zh: 利用反向绝热驱动（counterdiabatic driving）框架，显式构造动态连接两相的协议，并基于基态流形的几何距离（finite vs. infinite distance）对量子相变进行分类。

papers.title: Multi-point functions of a full-plane two-state fuzzy $4$-Potts model
papers.abstract: We study the full-plane two-state fuzzy $4$-Potts model, obtained by assigning independent balanced $\{\pm1\}$ spins to the open clusters of a critical $q=4$ random-cluster configuration. This model corresponds exactly to the single-spin projection of the isotropic Ashkin-Teller model at its Potts point. We prove that, after proper normalization, all even multi-point spin correlation functions converge to explicit conformally covariant Coulomb-gas type neutral charge sums. As a consequence, we prove convergence in law of the rescaled magnetization field and identify the moments of the limiting field. The proof combines the Baxter-Kelland-Wu coupling, convergence of the six-vertex height function to the Gaussian free field, and a charge-completion mechanism: an enlarged discrete sum over charge assignments with total charge in $4\mathbb Z$ produces a combinatorial cancellation of connection patterns, while only the neutral charge sector survives in the scaling limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：prove（证明）、convergence（收敛）、Coulomb-gas type（库仑气体类型）、scaling limit（标度极限）。；研究对象：全平面两态模糊4-Potts模型，该模型通过给临界q=4随机团簇构型的开放团簇分配独立平衡的{±1}自旋得到，等价于各向同性Ashkin-Teller模型在Potts点的单自旋投影。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了所有偶数多点自旋关联函数在适当归一化后收敛到显式的共形协变库仑气体型中性电荷和；进而证明了重整化磁化场的分布收敛，并确定了极限场的矩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了所有偶数多点自旋关联函数在适当归一化后收敛到显式的共形协变库仑气体型中性电荷和；进而证明了重整化磁化场的分布收敛，并确定了极限场的矩。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合Baxter-Kelland-Wu耦合、六顶点高度函数向高斯自由场的收敛性，以及一种“电荷完备机制”：通过一个扩大的离散电荷分配和（总电荷为4Z）产生连接模式的组合对消，使得在标度极限下仅中性电荷扇区存活。

papers.title: Optimisation and Precision Tuning of Localised Surface Plasmon Resonance in AuFON Systems
papers.abstract: Metal film on nanosphere (MFON) plasmonic systems have emerged as nanostructures with useful properties for molecular detection. This work presents the optimisation and discussion of the characterisation results of Au-film on nanosphere (AuFON) systems. Through experiments and numerical simulations, the resonance energies of localised surface plasmon modes and the spatial distribution of light on the nanostructured surface were identified. The results highlight the dependence of these modes on changes in nanostructure dimensions and the optical conditions of the incident radiation, thereby optimising the amplification of optical signals for applications in molecular detection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过实验和数值模拟”（experiments and numerical simulations）。；研究对象：Au膜覆盖纳米球（AuFON）体系中的局域表面等离激元共振（LSPR）特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AuFON体系的局域表面等离激元共振能量和光场空间分布强烈依赖于纳米结构尺寸和入射光光学条件，通过优化这些参数可增强分子检测中的光学信号放大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AuFON体系的局域表面等离激元共振能量和光场空间分布强烈依赖于纳米结构尺寸和入射光光学条件，通过优化这些参数可增强分子检测中的光学信号放大。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备Au膜覆盖纳米球（AuFON）体系并进行表征；数值模拟用于计算共振能量和光场分布。摘要未明确说明具体模拟方法（如FDTD、FEM等）或实验表征手段（如SEM、光谱等）。

papers.title: $q$-Exponential Random Graphs: higher-order networks from simple constraints
papers.abstract: Exponential Random Graphs (ERGs) are among the most widely used network models, derived as principled least-bias graph ensembles that maximize Shannon entropy under constraints on the expected values of given structural properties. However, it has been recently (re)discovered that, in the absence of additional information privileging Shannon entropy, the most agnostic inferential construction should maximize the broader class of Uffink entropies. The resulting entropy-maximizing distribution changes from the exponential (Boltzmann-Gibbs) to the so-called q-exponential one. Since maximizing Shannon entropy may produce an unjustified independence between degrees of freedom, here we investigate how the most popular ERGs with independent edges (namely, the Erdos-Renyi and configuration models) generalize to higher-order q-Exponential Random Graphs with dependent edges in the non-Shannon case, while keeping their defining constraints (number of links and degree sequence, respectively) unchanged. We find features, such as a phase transition between sparse and dense regimes, that are absent in the original ERGs but typical of higher-order networks, plus novel phenomena such as richer assortativity and clustering profiles, which allow for the coexistence of link sparsity and triadic closure. These results show that higher-order networks do not necessarily require higher-order constraints, as they naturally arise from simpler ones in a framework that is even more agnostic than Shannon's.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：entropy-maximizing distribution、inferential construction、phase transition。；研究对象：随机图网络模型，具体为q-指数随机图（q-Exponential Random Graphs），属于复杂网络与统计物理交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非香农熵（Uffink熵）最大化框架下，仅通过保持与经典ERGs相同的简单约束（如链接数、度序列），即可自然产生高阶网络特征（如稀疏-稠密相变、丰富的同配性与聚类共存），表明高阶网络不一定需要高阶约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非香农熵（Uffink熵）最大化框架下，仅通过保持与经典ERGs相同的简单约束（如链接数、度序列），即可自然产生高阶网络特征（如稀疏-稠密相变、丰富的同配性与聚类共存），表明高阶网络不一定需要高阶约束。；创新点：揭示了在比香农熵更无偏的推断框架下，简单约束即可自发产生高阶网络行为，挑战了“高阶网络必须依赖高阶约束”的传统认知。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型分析：基于Uffink熵最大化原理，将经典指数随机图（ERGs）推广为q-指数随机图，并分析其相变行为、同配性与聚类特性。

papers.title: Rigorous extension of semilocal collinear functionals to noncollinear DFT using $SU(2)$ rotations
papers.abstract: In the presence of spin-orbit coupling and in geometrically frustrated materials, a noncollinear treatment the magnetization density is essential. However, in density functional theory most exchange--correlation functional approximations were originally developed for locally collinear magnetization. Many practical approaches to noncollinear DFT have emerged over the past decade. However, a first-principles connection between widely used semilocal collinear functionals and their noncollinear generalizations remains lacking. In this work, a locally exact relation between collinear and noncollinear exchange--correlation functionals is derived at the level of gradient expansions within a $u(2)$ matrix representation of the energy functional. Within this framework, collinear semilocal variables naturally acquire distinct dependencies on transverse and longitudinal magnetization gradient components. The widely used Scalmani--Frisch scheme emerges as a first-order approximation. The transformation of collinear functional derivatives to noncollinear space is implemented through numerically robust $SU(2)$ rotations. A consistent description of local magnetic torques is demonstrated for the prototypical spin-frustrated Cr$_3$ cluster. The approach further extends to fully nonlocal functionals and provides a direct route towards numerically stable relativistic response calculations. The influence on magnetic properties in presence of spin-orbit coupling is illustrated through calculations of hyperfine couplings in the high-spin ground states of uranium and the uranium ion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、gradient expansions（梯度展开）、$SU(2)$ rotations（SU(2)旋转）。；研究对象：非共线磁化密度体系，具体包括自旋-轨道耦合体系（如铀原子及铀离子的高自旋基态）和几何阻挫材料（如原型自旋阻挫Cr₃团簇）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出局域共线交换-关联泛函与非共线泛函之间的局域精确关系，证明广泛使用的Scalmani-Frisch方案是该关系的一阶近似，并通过SU(2)旋转实现了共线泛函导数到非共线空间的数值稳定变换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出局域共线交换-关联泛函与非共线泛函之间的局域精确关系，证明广泛使用的Scalmani-Frisch方案是该关系的一阶近似，并通过SU(2)旋转实现了共线泛函导数到非共线空间的数值稳定变换。；创新点：首次在梯度展开层次上建立了共线半局域泛函与非共线泛函之间的局域精确解析关系，揭示了共线半局域变量在非共线情形下自然获得对横向和纵向磁化梯度分量的不同依赖。
papers.method_zh: 基于u(2)矩阵表示的能量泛函梯度展开理论框架，利用SU(2)旋转实现共线泛函到非共线空间的严格扩展，并通过Cr₃团簇的局域磁矩计算和铀/铀离子的超精细耦合计算进行验证。

papers.title: Explicit Turn Resolution with Anisotropic Homogenisation for Efficient 3D Magneto-Thermal Finite-Element Simulation of Large-Scale No-Insulation HTS Magnets
papers.abstract: No-insulation (NI) and metal-insulation (MI) high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets require three-dimensional (3D) models to describe the current distribution around critical current defects. In this work, we design and validate the EXTRA homogenisation method, standing for explicit turn resolution with anisotropic homogenisation method. It allows 3D magneto-thermal finite-element (FE) simulations of large-scale magnets to be performed with high accuracy at a reasonable computational cost. The method combines the anisotropic homogenisation of turn-to-turn contact layers (T2TCLs) and their neighbouring winding turns with the explicit resolution of specific T2TCLs. In particular, the inner- and outermost winding turns and adjacent contact layers are explicitly resolved to properly describe the current distribution near current leads. In addition, the method is able to simulate local $J_{\textrm{c}}$ defects for a broad range of turn-to-turn contact resistances, provided the winding turns and T2TCLs next to the defect are explicitly resolved. For efficiency, the resolved T2TCLs are modelled using the surface contact approximation. The consistency of the proposed method is first verified on a 50-turn single pancake benchmark. It is shown to reproduce AC losses and temperature distributions obtained with a turn-resolved FE reference model, for both nominal operation and during thermal runaway. The computational efficiency of the EXTRA method is demonstrated with the simulation of a stack of three 150-turn pancake coils, for which computation time is reduced by a factor of up to 13 with respect to a turn-resolved FE reference model. Finally, the results of a large-scale 3D FE simulation, currently out of reach of turn-resolved models, are provided for an insert HTS magnet with 10,000 turns. The EXTRA method is open-source and input files to reproduce all results are made available.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：finite-element simulation、homogenisation method、3D magneto-thermal FE simulation。；研究对象：无绝缘（NI）和金属绝缘（MI）高温超导（HTS）磁体，特别是其三维电流分布与热行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并验证了EXTRA均匀化方法，能够在合理计算成本下实现大规模（如10,000匝）无绝缘HTS磁体的高精度三维磁热有限元模拟，计算时间相比匝解析模型最多可减少13倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并验证了EXTRA均匀化方法，能够在合理计算成本下实现大规模（如10,000匝）无绝缘HTS磁体的高精度三维磁热有限元模拟，计算时间相比匝解析模型最多可减少13倍。；创新点：提出了一种混合均匀化策略，在保持对关键区域（如电流引线附近、局部临界电流缺陷附近）高精度解析的同时，通过均匀化处理其余区域大幅降低计算复杂度，使得原本无法实现的万匝级超导磁体三维模拟成为可能。
papers.method_zh: 采用显式匝解析与各向异性均匀化相结合的方法（EXTRA方法）。具体包括：对匝间接触层（T2TCLs）及其相邻绕组匝进行各向异性均匀化，同时对特定匝间接触层（如最内/最外匝及邻近电流引线的匝）进行显式解析；显式解析的匝间接触层采用表面接触近似建模；基于有限元（FE）方法进行三维磁热耦合模拟。

papers.title: Eigenstate chaos in the presence of non-Abelian symmetries
papers.abstract: The eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) posits that energy eigenstates encode local properties of the microcanonical ensemble. Motivated by recent interest in the physics of non-commuting conserved charges and the non-Abelian ETH, we study chaotic eigenstates in the presence of symmetries described by general compact Lie groups, such as SU(2). By applying non-Abelian symmetry resolution, we develop a non-Abelian microcanonical entropy and relate this entropy to the entanglement entropy of chaotic eigenstates. We find that microcanonical entropy is closely related to the symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy, which differs from conventional entanglement entropy by a universal logarithmic correction. Our results depend on the global Casimir charge, e.g. total spin. At finite charge density, we find a logarithmic enhancement to conventional entanglement entropy. At zero density, we find no such correction to entanglement entropy, but a logarithmic reduction to microcanonical entropy and symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy. We discuss the implications of our approach for non-Abelian eigenstate thermalization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：posits、develop、relate、discuss（理论推导与概念构建）。；研究对象：具有非阿贝尔对称性（如SU(2)）的混沌本征态，以及非阿贝尔本征态热化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非阿贝尔微正则熵与对称性分辨的纠缠熵密切相关，且两者均与常规纠缠熵存在普适的对数修正；修正行为依赖于全局卡西米尔荷（如总自旋）的密度：有限密度下常规纠缠熵出现对数增强，零密度下微正则熵和对称性分辨纠缠熵出现对数减少。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非阿贝尔微正则熵与对称性分辨的纠缠熵密切相关，且两者均与常规纠缠熵存在普适的对数修正；修正行为依赖于全局卡西米尔荷（如总自旋）的密度：有限密度下常规纠缠熵出现对数增强，零密度下微正则熵和对称性分辨纠缠熵出现对数减少。；创新点：将非阿贝尔对称性分辨引入微正则熵的定义，并揭示了对称性分辨纠缠熵与常规纠缠熵之间普适的对数修正关系，为非阿贝尔本征态热化假设提供了新的熵学视角。
papers.method_zh: 通过非阿贝尔对称性分辨方法，推导非阿贝尔微正则熵，并将其与混沌本征态的纠缠熵建立联系；分析全局卡西米尔荷（如总自旋）对熵修正的影响。

papers.title: Geometric dependence of critical-current variation in Al/AlO${\rm _x}$/Al Josephson junctions: a model-based analysis
papers.abstract: Achieving uniform critical current across Josephson junctions is essential for the large-scale integration of superconducting quantum circuits. In this work, we statistically analyzed the variation of the critical current of Al/AlO${\rm _x}$/Al junctions using room-temperature tunnel resistance statistics, and identified the dominant contribution among the modeled sources of the variation based on their dependence on geometry and deposition conditions of junctions. Our model-based analysis reveals that fluctuations in the Al film thickness play the dominant role among the modeled contributing factors. Based on this analysis, we found that, in Dolan-bridge double-angle deposition, adopting a deposition angle of 30-degree for bilayer junctions significantly improves uniformity, yielding a relative standard deviation of 1.2% (0.5%) across a 9.75 mm (1.5 mm) square region.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：statistically analyzed、room-temperature tunnel resistance statistics、model-based analysis）；研究对象：Al/AlOₓ/Al 约瑟夫森结中临界电流的几何依赖性及其均匀性
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Al膜厚度波动是导致临界电流变化的主导因素；在Dolan桥双角度沉积中，采用30°沉积角可显著提高双层结的均匀性，在9.75 mm（1.5 mm）方形区域内相对标准偏差降至1.2%（0.5%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Al膜厚度波动是导致临界电流变化的主导因素；在Dolan桥双角度沉积中，采用30°沉积角可显著提高双层结的均匀性，在9.75 mm（1.5 mm）方形区域内相对标准偏差降至1.2%（0.5%）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于室温隧道电阻统计数据的统计分析，结合模型分析，研究临界电流变化对结几何形状和沉积条件的依赖性。

papers.title: A mathematical framework for dynamic emergent constraints in climate science
papers.abstract: Emergent constraints in climate science are empirical relations that link the response to a forcing of a physical observable to the properties of other observables, with the aim of reducing climate change projection uncertainties. Here we use recent results in linear response theory to develop a mathematical framework for dynamic emergent constraints, a class of emergent constraints linking the response of different observables to the same forcing. We show how traditional dynamic emergent constraints are a special case of more general relations, that we call integral dynamic emergent constraints. These relations allow to compute the response of a predictand as the convolution of the response of a predictor and the proxy Green's function of the predictand-predictor pair. The conditions for the existence of integral emergent constraints are related to the causality of the proxy Green's function and the time scales at which the system is observed. We apply this framework to global warming simulations with the MPI-ESM climate model, to study dynamic emergent constraints between different observables. These results allow to put the theory of dynamic emergent constraints on firm mathematical ground, and suggest a protocol to identify necessary conditions for the existence of such relations in climate data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mathematical framework, linear response theory, theoretical framework）；研究对象：气候科学中的动态涌现约束（Dynamic Emergent Constraints），具体指将不同可观测物理量对同一强迫的响应联系起来的经验关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统的动态涌现约束是更一般的“积分动态涌现约束”的特例。后者允许通过预测因子的响应与预测因子-预测对象对的代理格林函数的卷积来计算预测对象的响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统的动态涌现约束是更一般的“积分动态涌现约束”的特例。后者允许通过预测因子的响应与预测因子-预测对象对的代理格林函数的卷积来计算预测对象的响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作首次为动态涌现约束理论提供了坚实的数学基础，并提出了一个识别气候数据中存在此类关系的必要条件的协议。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性响应理论（linear response theory）构建数学框架，并应用于MPI-ESM气候模型的全球变暖模拟数据中，以研究不同可观测物理量之间的动态涌现约束。

papers.title: Search at bounded speed with immigration
papers.abstract: Many biophysical search processes employ searchers which enter or "immigrate" into the domain progressively over time. Existing search time estimates can become unphysical for fast immigration since they imply that searchers move at infinite speed. In this paper, we investigate search times of immigrating searchers that move at bounded speed. In the fast immigration limit, we determine the full probability distribution and all the moments of the $k$th search time in terms of the early time probability distribution of a single searcher. We apply these rigorous mathematical results to several canonical models of stochastic search. We further analyze different models of "diffusion" and use these results to investigate when and how the minutiae of searcher dynamics affect search times. We compare our theory to numerical simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、determine、apply rigorous mathematical results、analyze models、compare to numerical simulations。；研究对象：生物物理搜索过程中，以有限速度移动且随时间逐步进入（“移民”）搜索域的搜索者（searcher）的搜索时间问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在快速移民极限下，第k次搜索时间的完整概率分布及其所有矩可由单个搜索者的早期时间概率分布完全确定；不同“扩散”模型的细节对搜索时间的影响取决于具体动力学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在快速移民极限下，第k次搜索时间的完整概率分布及其所有矩可由单个搜索者的早期时间概率分布完全确定；不同“扩散”模型的细节对搜索时间的影响取决于具体动力学特征。；创新点：解决了现有搜索时间估计在快速移民时因隐含搜索者无限速度而导致的非物理问题，首次系统研究了有限速度移动的移民搜索者的搜索时间。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格数学分析，推导快速移民极限下搜索时间的概率分布与矩的解析表达式，并将其应用于多个经典随机搜索模型（如不同扩散模型），最后通过数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Dually tunable YBCO coplanar waveguide resonators based on helium-ion-generated Josephson inductances
papers.abstract: Superconducting microwave circuits with and without Josephson inductances are the Swiss Army knife for many experiments and technologies from quantum information science to astrophysical particle detectors. Despite a large variety of existing circuit types, thin film materials and Josephson junction technologies, a flexible and reliable platform for high-magnetic-field and high-temperature applications is yet to be found. In this manuscript, we investigate coplanar waveguide cavities made of the high-temperature cuprate superconductor YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_7$ (YBCO), integrated with Josephson inductances and quantum interferometers that are generated by the controlled local irradiation of the YBCO with a focused helium ion beam. We obtain strongly flux-tunable microwave resonators, which not only display periodic interferometer oscillations of resonance frequency and decay rate, but also a superimposed Fraunhofer-like modulation pattern. The latter originates from the magnetic field tuning of the individual Josephson junction critical currents due to the out-of-plane junction barriers. It allows adjusting resonance frequency and flux responsivity independently of each other, potentially enabling tunable microwave circuits with low sensitivity to external magnetic-field noise over a broad range of frequencies. Finally, we investigate the temperature dependence of the cavities, show that they have promising characteristics up to 14$\,$K, and present a model for the junction-induced cavity losses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的器件制备（聚焦氦离子束辐照YBCO）、测量（微波谐振、磁场调谐、温度依赖）和建模（结诱导损耗模型）。；研究对象：基于高温铜氧化物超导体YBa₂Cu₃O₇（YBCO）的共面波导谐振腔，集成了由聚焦氦离子束辐照产生的约瑟夫森电感和量子干涉仪。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了强磁通可调的微波谐振器，其谐振频率和衰减率不仅呈现周期性干涉仪振荡，还叠加了类似夫琅禾费调制的图案，该图案源于面外结势垒对单个约瑟夫森结临界电流的磁场调谐，从而允许独立调节谐振频率和磁通响应度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了强磁通可调的微波谐振器，其谐振频率和衰减率不仅呈现周期性干涉仪振荡，还叠加了类似夫琅禾费调制的图案，该图案源于面外结势垒对单个约瑟夫森结临界电流的磁场调谐，从而允许独立调节谐振频率和磁通响应度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：聚焦氦离子束局部辐照YBCO薄膜以生成约瑟夫森结；微波测量表征共面波导谐振腔的磁通调谐特性；温度依赖测量（最高至14 K）。理论框架：建立了结诱导腔损耗的模型。

papers.title: Experiments on Settling of Granular and Cohesive Material in Low Gravity
papers.abstract: The regolith of rocky bodies, such as planets or asteroids, generally settles under gravity conditions different from those of Earth. The behavior of granular material is not easily scalable for different gravities. To predict these highly complex systems where cohesive inter particle forces can be comparable to gravitational forces, we need simulations and experiments. We did experiments on settling of three different granular samples in varying reduced gravities and examined their packing densities. We used a high precision linear stage to artificially induce reduced gravities inside the zero $g$ environment provided by the ZARM drop tower and observe the settling of our samples. The three samples were fine basalt with particle diameters of $1\text{-}200\,μ$m, coarse basalt with $2\text{-}5\,$mm and glass beads with $750\text{-}1000\,μ$m. The artificial gravities were $150,\,250,\,500,\,750$ and $1000\,$mm/s$^2$ and therefore ranged from large asteroid gravity to almost moon gravity. We saw the granular samples have higher volumes in lower gravities and therefore lower packing densities, we also saw the fine basalt be the most sensitive to changes in gravity, up to $+19.6\,\%$ in volume for $250\,$mm/s$^2$, followed by the coarse basalt particles, up to $+12.2\,\%$ for $150\,$mm/s$^2$ and the glass beads packing density being the least sensitive to changes in gravity, up to $+4.25\,\%$ for $250\,$mm/s$^2$. With these experiments we show change in volume is not solely dependent of particle size but also roughness and uniformity, we provide real life experimental data to validate theoretical works and highlight the role of cohesive forces in low gravity environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“We did experiments on settling of three different granular samples”，并详细说明实验装置（ZARM drop tower、高精度线性平台）和测量结果。；研究对象：颗粒与黏性材料（granular and cohesive material）在低重力环境下的沉降行为。具体材料包括：细玄武岩（粒径1–200 μm）、粗玄武岩（2–5 mm）和玻璃珠（750–1000 μm）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低重力下，颗粒样品体积增大、堆积密度降低；细玄武岩对重力变化最敏感（在250 mm/s²下体积增加+19.6%），玻璃珠最不敏感（+4.25%）。体积变化不仅取决于粒径，还与颗粒粗糙度和均匀性有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低重力下，颗粒样品体积增大、堆积密度降低；细玄武岩对重力变化最敏感（在250 mm/s²下体积增加+19.6%），玻璃珠最不敏感（+4.25%）。体积变化不仅取决于粒径，还与颗粒粗糙度和均匀性有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用ZARM落塔提供的零重力环境，结合高精度线性平台人工诱导不同减重力（150、250、500、750、1000 mm/s²），观测三种颗粒样品的沉降过程并测量其堆积密度。

papers.title: Emerging Trends in Intelligent Sensing
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of artificial intelligence, connected devices, and high speed mobile networks is driving unprecedented computational demands that challenge traditional sensor architectures. This article explores the shift toward edge computing, where computation is performed directly at the data source, and highlights the key architectures and performance metrics that may define the next generation of intelligent sensor systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述/前瞻性文章）。判断依据：关键词“explores the shift”（探讨转变）、“highlights the key architectures”（强调关键架构），表明文章是对现有趋势和未来方向的讨论，而非单一实验、计算或理论工作。；研究对象：智能传感器系统，特别是面向边缘计算架构的下一代传感器。具体物理现象或体系未明确说明，摘要聚焦于计算架构和性能指标。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。文章主要观点是：人工智能、互联设备及高速移动网络的快速发展对传统传感器架构提出了挑战，而将计算移至数据源头的边缘计算是应对这一挑战的关键趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。文章主要观点是：人工智能、互联设备及高速移动网络的快速发展对传统传感器架构提出了挑战，而将计算移至数据源头的边缘计算是应对这一挑战的关键趋势。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体创新点。文章的主要贡献可能在于系统性地梳理了智能传感领域向边缘计算演进的趋势，并指出了定义下一代系统的关键架构与性能指标。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未提及具体的实验手段、计算方法或理论框架。文章内容可能涉及对现有传感器架构、边缘计算平台及性能指标（如延迟、带宽、功耗）的综述与分析。

papers.title: Visualizing orbital magnetism in electron doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Electron doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene at high displacement field features an exceptionally flat band minimum with near-ideal quantum geometry. Experiments in this regime observe the formation of a 'quarter metal,' in which the electron liquid condenses into a single spin- and valley flavor. Remarkably, recent experiments have found a zero resistance state in the same region of the density- and displacement-field-tuned parameter space, attributed to the formation of a chiral superconductor characterized by a finite-momentum Cooper pair condensate. Here, we use nanoSQUID-on-tip magnetometry to map the orbital magnetization of electron-doped rhombohedral graphene devices ranging in thickness between 3 and 13 layers. Magnetization within the quarter metal phases peaks at finite density, consistent with concentration of the Berry curvature in a finite-momentum 'ring of fire'. Correlating transport and local magnetometry data in a tetralayer sample reveals that the superconducting state has a finite orbital magnetic moment, providing direct evidence of its chiral nature. We further show that widely observed stochastic switching of the resistivity in the metallic regime arises from a density-tuned sign change in the valley-resolved total magnetic moment. This leads to the formation of metastable magnetic domains under typical gate control sequences and can also be harnessed for electric-field controlled switching of orbital moment across the entire device. Unexpectedly, we find magnetic inhomogeneity specific to the apparent normal state of the chiral superconductor, suggestive of a strain-tuned competition between magnetic and non-magnetic ground states. Our results point to a subtle energetic competition underlying the observation of chiral superconductivity in a narrow range of layer numbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了 nanoSQUID-on-tip 磁强计进行磁化率成像，并将局域磁测量与输运数据相关联。；研究对象：电子掺杂的菱面体多层石墨烯（3至13层），具体研究了其中的轨道磁性、四分之一金属态以及手性超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在四层菱面体石墨烯中，超导态具有有限的轨道磁矩，直接证明了其手性本质。此外，金属态中广泛观察到的电阻随机切换源于密度调控的谷分辨总磁矩符号变化，导致亚稳态磁畴的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在四层菱面体石墨烯中，超导态具有有限的轨道磁矩，直接证明了其手性本质。此外，金属态中广泛观察到的电阻随机切换源于密度调控的谷分辨总磁矩符号变化，导致亚稳态磁畴的形成。；创新点：首次通过直接测量轨道磁矩为菱面体石墨烯中的手性超导态提供了实验证据。同时，揭示了金属态电阻随机切换的微观磁学起源（谷分辨磁矩符号变化），并发现了手性超导体正常态特有的磁不均匀性，暗示了应变调制的磁性与非磁性基态之间的竞争。
papers.method_zh: 实验上主要采用纳米超导量子干涉器件（nanoSQUID-on-tip）磁强计，对电子掺杂的菱面体石墨烯器件进行轨道磁化率的空间成像，并结合输运测量进行关联分析。

papers.title: Electron Doping of $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ Thin Films: Candidate Metal Dopants and Their Potential Impact on Superconductivity
papers.abstract: The bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelate $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ has emerged as a promising platform for exploring and understanding high-temperature superconductivities. While most prior doping studies have focused on hole doping via strontium (Sr) substitution or by tuning oxygen content, electron doping remains largely unexplored. In this work,we systematically investigate electron doping in $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ thin films through tetravalent element substitution, employing first-principles density functional theory calculations. Our results reveal that, unlike in cuprates, $\mathrm{cerium}$ (Ce) doping is difficult to effectively introduce electron carriers into the low-energy bands. In contrast, zirconium (Zr), hafnium (Hf), and thorium (Th) can act as efficient electron dopants. These element substitutions can significantly increase the interlayer hopping $t_{\perp}$ between $d_{z^2}$ orbitals, which may lead to enhanced superexchange coupling $J_{\perp}$ , and thereby potentially elevated superconducting $T_c$. We evaluate the interaction parameters using constrained random phase approximation. Our results identify candidate dopants for achieving electron-doped $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$, offering a route to clarify the ongoing debate on pairing mechanisms in this system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles density functional theory calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）和“constrained random phase approximation”（约束随机相位近似）。；研究对象：电子掺杂的双层Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐薄膜 $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$。具体研究通过四价元素（如Ce、Zr、Hf、Th）替代进行电子掺杂的可能性及其对超导电性的潜在影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ 中，铈（Ce）掺杂难以有效引入电子载流子，而锆（Zr）、铪（Hf）和钍（Th）是有效的电子掺杂剂。这些掺杂能显著增强 $d_{z^2}$ 轨道间的层间跳跃 $t_{\perp}$，可能提升超交换耦合 $J_{\perp}$，从而潜在提高超导转变温度 $T_c$。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ 中，铈（Ce）掺杂难以有效引入电子载流子，而锆（Zr）、铪（Hf）和钍（Th）是有效的电子掺杂剂。这些掺杂能显著增强 $d_{z^2}$ 轨道间的层间跳跃 $t_{\perp}$，可能提升超交换耦合 $J_{\perp}$，从而潜在提高超导转变温度 $T_c$。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于以往主要关注空穴掺杂（如Sr替代或调节氧含量）的研究，本工作首次系统地探索了 $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ 薄膜中的电子掺杂途径，并识别出有效的候选掺杂元素。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算进行系统研究，并使用约束随机相位近似（cRPA）评估相互作用参数。

papers.title: Spectroscopic evidence for a molecular orbital Kondo insulator
papers.abstract: A Kondo insulator (KI) is a prototypical example of a highly entangled phase of matter, where many-body interactions between local moments and delocalized electrons engender the non-magnetic insulating ground state. Conventionally, the local moments arise from atomic multiplet states with a narrow bandwidth, limiting Kondo coherence to low temperatures. Here, we realize a new paradigm for constructing the KI state with hybridized molecular orbitals in FeSb2. Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) at the Fe L-edge reveals distinct signatures of band-like continuum states and localized states. Comparisons with first-principles calculations establish a mixed-configuration ground state with hybridized Fe d-Sb p molecular orbitals as basis states. By systematically investigating the RIXS momentum, temperature, and doping dependences, we find propagating collective modes commensurate with many-body charge and spin excitations. Our results pave the way for understanding the emerging class of unconventional d electron insulators and engineering high temperature Kondo many-body states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS)、spectroscopic evidence、momentum/temperature/doping dependences）；研究对象：FeSb₂ 中由杂化分子轨道构建的 Kondo 绝缘体（Kondo insulator, KI）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 FeSb₂ 中，通过 Fe d 与 Sb p 杂化分子轨道实现了新型 Kondo 绝缘体态，并观测到与多体电荷和自旋激发相称的传播性集体模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 FeSb₂ 中，通过 Fe d 与 Sb p 杂化分子轨道实现了新型 Kondo 绝缘体态，并观测到与多体电荷和自旋激发相称的传播性集体模式。；创新点：提出了利用杂化分子轨道（而非传统原子多重态）构建 Kondo 绝缘体的新范式，为理解非常规 d 电子绝缘体及工程化高温 Kondo 多体态开辟了途径。
papers.method_zh: Fe L 边共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS），结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），并系统研究了 RIXS 信号随动量、温度和掺杂的变化。

papers.title: Exploring the Origins of Anti-Ambipolarity in BBL Polymer: Links to Redox Chemistry, Electronic Structure, and Structural Dynamics
papers.abstract: We examine the intrinsic physical-chemical properties of the conjugated ladder-type polymer poly(benzimidazobenzophenanthroline) (BBL) in response to electron transfer. We aim at explaining the origin of the anti-ambipolar behavior behind the observed BBL nonlinear response associated with specific device architectures. To elucidate this point, we use theory and computation based on first principles, including density functional theory optimizations, ab initio molecular dynamics, time-dependent DFT, and Marcus-theory analysis. Our results reveal that this redox response is not simply monotonic but follows an alternating odd/even pattern in which gap narrowing and reopening occur sequentially before near-gapless behavior emerges at high charging. Converging theoretical evidence in this work demonstrates that bell shaped conductivity in BBL originates in its fundamental electronic structure and supramolecular organization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：first principles、density functional theory、ab initio molecular dynamics、time-dependent DFT、Marcus-theory analysis。；研究对象：共轭梯形聚合物聚苯并咪唑苯并菲咯啉（BBL）及其在电子转移过程中的本征物理化学性质，特别是其反双极性（anti-ambipolar）非线性响应的起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BBL的氧化还原响应并非单调，而是呈现交替奇偶模式：能隙先变窄再重新打开，最终在高电荷态下出现近无能隙行为。钟形电导率源于其基本电子结构和超分子组织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BBL的氧化还原响应并非单调，而是呈现交替奇偶模式：能隙先变窄再重新打开，最终在高电荷态下出现近无能隙行为。钟形电导率源于其基本电子结构和超分子组织。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的理论与计算，包括密度泛函理论（DFT）优化、从头算分子动力学（AIMD）、含时密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）以及马库斯理论（Marcus theory）分析。

papers.title: Electronic correlations driving Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity
papers.abstract: We explicitly account for electron-electron interactions when modeling low-dimensional helical organic molecules. We show that competition between various hopping channels, together with interaction-induced double- and superexchange mechanisms, can stabilize non-collinear helical magnetic order. The resulting single-electron bands exhibit partial spin polarization, a manifestation of $p$-wave magnetism. Using density-matrix renormalization group, cluster perturbation theory, and Monte Carlo methods, we find that even vanishingly small spin-orbit coupling triggers strong spin selectivity at temperatures significantly above the spin-orbit scale. While strong correlations are essential for this mechanism, long-range spin ordering is not required. We thus propose non-collinear spin correlations driven by Coulomb interactions as an explanation of chirality-induced spin selectivity and discuss connections to experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“explicitly account for electron-electron interactions”、“using density-matrix renormalization group, cluster perturbation theory, and Monte Carlo methods”，属于理论建模与数值计算。；研究对象：低维螺旋有机分子中的手性诱导自旋选择性（Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity, CISS）现象。具体关注电子-电子相互作用驱动的非共线螺旋磁序及其对自旋极化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子-电子相互作用（特别是双交换和超交换机制）可以稳定非共线螺旋磁序，导致单电子能带出现部分自旋极化（p波磁性）。即使极小的自旋-轨道耦合也能在远高于自旋-轨道能标的温度下引发强自旋选择性，且无需长程自旋序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子-电子相互作用（特别是双交换和超交换机制）可以稳定非共线螺旋磁序，导致单电子能带出现部分自旋极化（p波磁性）。即使极小的自旋-轨道耦合也能在远高于自旋-轨道能标的温度下引发强自旋选择性，且无需长程自旋序。；创新点：首次明确将电子关联（库仑相互作用）作为CISS效应的核心驱动机制，提出非共线自旋关联（而非长程磁序或强自旋-轨道耦合）是自旋选择性的关键，为CISS效应提供了新的物理解释。
papers.method_zh: 密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）、团簇微扰理论（Cluster Perturbation Theory）、蒙特卡洛方法（Monte Carlo methods）。通过显式考虑电子-电子相互作用，建模不同跳跃通道之间的竞争。

papers.title: Induced nonlinear phase shift of forward volume spin waves in magnetic films and one-dimensional magnonic crystals
papers.abstract: A differential phase shift of a low-power spin wave (SW) induced by a high-power pumping wave co-propagating at different frequencies in perpendicularly magnetized magnetic films has been studied. We find that this effect for forward volume SWs propagating in yttrium iron garnet (YIG) films is stronger than that for surface SWs propagating in tangentially magnetized films. The results show that the induced nonlinear phase shift up to 180° takes place for pumping wave power of a few milliwatts. The phenomenon paves the way for fast and energy-efficient control of one-dimensional magnon transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：has been studied、results show、paves the way，未提及具体实验手段，侧重效应分析与物理机制讨论）；研究对象：垂直磁化磁性薄膜（如钇铁石榴石YIG薄膜）及一维磁子晶体中前向体自旋波（forward volume SWs）的非线性相移现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低功率自旋波可被同向传播的高功率泵浦波诱导产生高达180°的差分相移，且该效应在垂直磁化薄膜的前向体自旋波中比切向磁化薄膜的表面自旋波更强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低功率自旋波可被同向传播的高功率泵浦波诱导产生高达180°的差分相移，且该效应在垂直磁化薄膜的前向体自旋波中比切向磁化薄膜的表面自旋波更强。；创新点：揭示了前向体自旋波中更强的非线性相移效应，并指出仅需毫瓦级泵浦功率即可实现180°相移，为快速、低能耗的一维磁子输运控制提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析不同频率自旋波共传播时的非线性相互作用，通过计算泵浦波功率与诱导相移的关系，对比前向体波与表面波的效应强度。

papers.title: Electron momentum densities from QSGW and $G^0W^0$: Revealing the role of many-body effects within the reduced density matrix
papers.abstract: The ground-state many-body electron momentum density, which can be probed by x-ray Compton scattering, holds insights into the electronic structure of materials. Comparisons between the measured so-called Compton profiles and the theoretical ones are invaluable in assessing the successes and failures of the methodology used to generate the theoretical ground-state electronic structure. Here, we present calculations of the Compton profiles of Li, Si, Cr, and Ni using the state-of-the-art QSGW method within the Questaal package compared with density functional theory (DFT), one-shot $GW$ ($G^0W^0$) predictions and with experiment. This comparison reveals significant differences between the QSGW and $G^0W^0$ methods which we attribute to the distinction between the single particle density provided by the QSGW method and the many-body density that we construct from the $G^0W^0$ theory; although in general the QSGW description of the electronic structure is superior to that of $G^0W^0$, we find the use of the many-body reduced density matrix is key to improving the agreement of the Compton profile with experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：QSGW方法、\(G^0W^0\)理论、DFT、Compton profiles计算。；研究对象：Li、Si、Cr、Ni四种材料的电子动量密度（通过X射线康普顿散射探测的Compton谱线）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: QSGW方法与\(G^0W^0\)方法计算的Compton谱线存在显著差异，且使用\(G^0W^0\)理论构建的多体约化密度矩阵是改善Compton谱线与实验吻合度的关键，尽管QSGW对电子结构的描述通常优于\(G^0W^0\)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：QSGW方法与\(G^0W^0\)方法计算的Compton谱线存在显著差异，且使用\(G^0W^0\)理论构建的多体约化密度矩阵是改善Compton谱线与实验吻合度的关键，尽管QSGW对电子结构的描述通常优于\(G^0W^0\)。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Questaal软件包中的QSGW（自洽准粒子GW）方法，并与密度泛函理论（DFT）及单次\(GW\)（\(G^0W^0\)）方法的计算结果进行对比，同时与实验数据比较。

papers.title: Role of structure and charge trapping on the bipolaron formation and magnetic-field response of gated conjugated polymers
papers.abstract: Conjugated polymers exhibit unique spin-dependent phenomena arising from weak yet critical hyperfine interactions. Understanding these spin effects, particularly the spin-dependent formation and decay of correlated spin pairs, is important for advancing both organic electronics and polymer-based spintronics. Intrinsic magnetic-field responses such as magnetoresistance have primarily been investigated in diode architectures, where electrons and holes coexist. However, such systems are less suitable for probing bipolaron formation in unipolar transport, and the relationship between polymer structure and bipolaron formation in lightly doped polymers remains unclear. Here, we systematically investigate intrinsic magnetoresistance in representative conjugated polymers using field-effect transistors and observe a generally positive magnetoresistance. First-principles simulations reveal that bipolarons preferentially form on short conjugated segments associated with amorphous regions. Moreover, comparisons across these polymers show that enhanced charge trapping correlates with stronger magnetoresistance, implying promoted bipolaron formation. Bipolaron-incorporated energylevel-alignment modeling near metal/polymer interfaces suggests that charge traps can increase the bipolaron density.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了使用“field-effect transistors”（场效应晶体管）进行实验测量，以及“First-principles simulations”（第一性原理模拟）进行理论计算。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是门控共轭聚合物（gated conjugated polymers）中的双极化子（bipolaron）形成过程，以及该过程对材料磁电阻（magnetoresistance）响应的影响。核心物理现象是自旋相关的双极化子形成与电荷陷阱（charge trapping）的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共轭聚合物场效应晶体管中观察到普遍的正磁电阻效应。第一性原理计算表明，双极化子优先在非晶区的短共轭片段上形成；并且，更强的电荷陷阱效应会促进双极化子形成，从而增强磁电阻响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共轭聚合物场效应晶体管中观察到普遍的正磁电阻效应。第一性原理计算表明，双极化子优先在非晶区的短共轭片段上形成；并且，更强的电荷陷阱效应会促进双极化子形成，从而增强磁电阻响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）利用场效应晶体管（而非传统的二极管结构）来研究单极性输运中的双极化子形成，避免了电子和空穴共存带来的复杂性；2）系统性地揭示了聚合物微观结构（非晶区短共轭片段）与电荷陷阱对双极化子形成及磁电阻响应的定量关系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用场效应晶体管（FET）器件结构测量本征磁电阻；理论上使用第一性原理模拟（First-principles simulations）研究双极化子形成的结构偏好，并采用包含双极化子的能级对齐模型（energy-level-alignment modeling）分析金属/聚合物界面附近的电荷陷阱对双极化子密度的影响。

papers.title: What drives performance in molecular MPNNs? An operator-level factorial benchmark
papers.abstract: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) are widely used for molecular property prediction, but their deployment as monolithic architectures makes it difficult to identify how specific message-passing operators affect performance. We present an operator-level factorial benchmark that decomposes 2D molecular MPNNs into the three families of message-seed initialization, node-edge fusion, and node update operators. The resulting 84 configurations are benchmarked on ten MoleculeNet datasets under a shared experimental setup and statistical analysis protocol. Across this controlled design, performance variation is associated primarily with message construction rather than update complexity. Message-seed initialization shows significant family-level effects for both regression and classification, node-edge fusion shows a significant family-level effect for regression with descriptive advantages for concatenation-based mixing, and the update family shows no statistically supported effect for either endpoint family. A representation probe into the Quinethazone molecule further demonstrates that concatenation-based mixing can better differentiate chemically distinct heteroatoms and withstand oversmoothing than Hadamard gating. Representative configurations selected separately for classification and regression recover competitive performance relative to established molecular graph neural network (GNN) baselines, ranking numerically best on eight of ten benchmark datasets. These empirical results are interpreted through concise mechanistic analyses of representative node-edge fusion and update operators. Our findings provide empirical design heuristics for molecular MPNNs by turning model design from a search over monolithic architectures into a targeted assessment of where and how chemical information enters the message-passing pipeline.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：factorial benchmark、message-passing neural networks、molecular property prediction、representation probe。；研究对象：分子图神经网络（MPNN）在分子性质预测中的性能驱动因素，具体研究对象为2D分子MPNN中的消息传递算子（message-seed initialization、node-edge fusion、node update）及其组合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分子MPNN的性能差异主要来源于消息构建（message construction）而非更新复杂度（update complexity）；基于拼接（concatenation）的节点-边融合方式比Hadamard门控能更好地区分化合物种类的异质原子并抵抗过平滑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分子MPNN的性能差异主要来源于消息构建（message construction）而非更新复杂度（update complexity）；基于拼接（concatenation）的节点-边融合方式比Hadamard门控能更好地区分化合物种类的异质原子并抵抗过平滑。；创新点：将分子MPNN从整体架构搜索转变为对消息传递管道中化学信息进入位置和方式的针对性评估，通过系统分解算子家族并统计其效应，提供了经验性的设计启发式规则。
papers.method_zh: 采用算子级因子化基准测试（operator-level factorial benchmark），将2D分子MPNN分解为三类算子家族（消息种子初始化、节点-边融合、节点更新），构建84种配置，在10个MoleculeNet数据集上统一实验设置和统计分析协议，并使用表征探针（representation probe）对Quinethazone分子进行可视化分析。

papers.title: Theory of distribution skewness effect on polydisperse random close packing
papers.abstract: We investigate the random close packing density, $φ_\textrm{RCP}$, of polydisperse hard sphere systems using a theoretical framework based on the equilibrium model of crowding. We derive a closed-form solution for $φ_\textrm{RCP}$ in terms of the moments of the diameter distribution, enabling an analytical exploration of the effects of polydispersity ($δ$) and skewness ($S$) on packing density. For a binary mixture, it is possible to explore a broader range of dependence of $φ_\textrm{RCP}$ on $δ$ for a given $S$ or on $S$ for a given $δ$. We show that the dependencies of $φ_\textrm{RCP}$ on skewness for a variety of continuous distributions collapse onto a theoretical master curve obtained for the binary mixture case. By correcting the theory so that it obeys known exact limiting behaviours for extreme size asymmetry, our analytical predictions not only agree with previously obtained numerical results, but also predict previously unexplored regions of the $φ_\textrm{RCP}$ parameter space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、derive a closed-form solution、analytical predictions。；研究对象：多分散硬球系统的随机密堆积（random close packing, RCP）密度，重点研究粒径分布的多分散性（δ）和偏度（S）对堆积密度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出随机密堆积密度φ_RCP关于粒径分布矩的解析解，发现不同连续分布下φ_RCP对偏度的依赖关系可塌缩到二元混合体系的理论主曲线上；通过修正理论使其满足极端尺寸不对称下的已知极限行为，理论预测与已有数值结果一致，并预测了之前未探索的参数空间区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出随机密堆积密度φ_RCP关于粒径分布矩的解析解，发现不同连续分布下φ_RCP对偏度的依赖关系可塌缩到二元混合体系的理论主曲线上；通过修正理论使其满足极端尺寸不对称下的已知极限行为，理论预测与已有数值结果一致，并预测了之前未探索的参数空间区域。；创新点：首次从解析角度系统研究粒径分布偏度对随机密堆积密度的影响，并发现不同连续分布下的偏度效应可统一到二元混合体系的主曲线上。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于拥挤平衡模型（equilibrium model of crowding）的理论框架，推导出φ_RCP关于粒径分布矩的闭式解析解，并对理论进行修正以符合极端尺寸不对称下的精确极限行为。

papers.title: Coherent and Dissipative Spin Torques in Quantum Dots: A Unified Framework for Quantum Spin Dynamics
papers.abstract: The manipulation of single spins through spin-polarized tunneling opens new routes for quantum control at the atomic scale. We present a theoretical framework describing spin-transfer, spin torques and spin resonance in molecular quantum dots weakly coupled to magnetic electrodes. By deriving a Lindblad master equation from microscopic tunneling processes, we capture both coherent exchange interactions and dissipative spin torque effects within a unified approach. We analyze how charge transport through localized orbitals influences spin dynamics and show that modulating the tunneling rates in time can induce electron spin resonance. This framework is further extended to coupled spin systems, revealing how spin coherence and entanglement respond to local spin torques and highlighting sources of transport-driven decoherence. Our results provide a general model to interpret spin-resolved tunneling experiments and extend classical spin torque concepts into the quantum regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical framework”、“Lindblad master equation”、“unified approach”。；研究对象：弱耦合到磁性电极的分子量子点中的自旋转移、自旋扭矩和自旋共振现象，以及耦合自旋系统中的自旋相干性与纠缠。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过从微观隧穿过程推导出林德布拉德主方程，统一描述了量子点中的相干交换相互作用和耗散性自旋扭矩效应，并揭示了通过时间调制隧穿率可诱导电子自旋共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过从微观隧穿过程推导出林德布拉德主方程，统一描述了量子点中的相干交换相互作用和耗散性自旋扭矩效应，并揭示了通过时间调制隧穿率可诱导电子自旋共振。；创新点：将经典的自旋扭矩概念扩展到量子 regime，并提供了一个统一模型来解释自旋分辨隧穿实验，同时揭示了输运驱动的退相干来源。
papers.method_zh: 基于微观隧穿过程推导林德布拉德主方程（Lindblad master equation），建立统一的理论框架，分析电荷输运对自旋动力学的影响，并扩展到耦合自旋系统。

papers.title: Composition-dependent Thin-film Synthesis of Layered Ternary Iron Nitrides FeMN2 (M = W, Mo)
papers.abstract: Ternary transition-metal nitrides with layered crystal structures host anisotropic bonding and reduced dimensionality that may enable unconventional electronic and magnetic behavior. Yet, synthesis of such nitride thin films remains challenging because reactive sputtering often favors metastable rocksalt-derived structures. We report the composition-dependent synthesis, structure, and properties of layered FeMN2 (M = W, Mo) thin films with triangular Fe sublattices, prepared by reactive sputtering and post-deposition NH3 annealing. Using synchrotron grazing-incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS), we investigate the evolution of phase formation, crystallographic texture, and local Fe coordination across composition. Both layered phase form over broad composition ranges. FeWN2 maintains high phase purity across compositions, consistent with cation substitution, whereas FeMoN2 only exhibits good phase purity at Fe-poor compositions. Azimuthal GIWAXS analysis shows that Fe-rich films in both systems exhibit out-of-plane fiber texture, which progressively evolves toward predominantly in-plane orientation near stoichiometry in FeWN2, while FeMoN2 develops a more randomly oriented polycrystalline microstructure. Electrical measurements reveal relatively low and composition-insensitive resistivity in FeWN2 (~1 mΩ.cm), whereas FeMoN2 exhibits a pronounced resistivity maximum near nominal stoichiometry. Preliminary room-temperature magnetization measurements on FeWN2 further reveal weak ferromagnetic-like behavior in Fe-poor films, while stoichiometric compositions remain predominantly paramagnetic.
