These results demonstrate fundamentally different structural accommodation mechanisms in FeWN2 and FeMoN2, and highlight the strong coupling between composition, microstructure, and electronic/magnetic properties in layered nitride thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：reactive sputtering（反应溅射）、synchrotron GIWAXS（同步辐射掠入射广角X射线散射）、XAS（X射线吸收谱）、electrical measurements（电学测量）、magnetization measurements（磁化测量）。；研究对象：层状三元氮化物薄膜 FeMN₂（M = W, Mo），具体研究其成分依赖的合成、结构、电学和磁学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FeWN₂ 和 FeMoN₂ 在成分变化时表现出根本不同的结构容纳机制：FeWN₂ 在宽成分范围内保持高相纯度且电阻率低且对成分不敏感，而 FeMoN₂ 仅在贫铁成分下相纯度好，且在名义化学计量比附近出现电阻率极大值；FeWN₂ 的贫铁薄膜显示弱铁磁性，而化学计量比成分主要为顺磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FeWN₂ 和 FeMoN₂ 在成分变化时表现出根本不同的结构容纳机制：FeWN₂ 在宽成分范围内保持高相纯度且电阻率低且对成分不敏感，而 FeMoN₂ 仅在贫铁成分下相纯度好，且在名义化学计量比附近出现电阻率极大值；FeWN₂ 的贫铁薄膜显示弱铁磁性，而化学计量比成分主要为顺磁性。；创新点：首次系统揭示了层状 FeWN₂ 和 FeMoN₂ 薄膜中成分对相纯度、织构取向、电阻率和磁性的强耦合影响，并指出两者在结构容纳机制上的本质差异（摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比）。
papers.method_zh: 反应溅射制备薄膜 + 沉积后退火（NH₃气氛）；同步辐射 GIWAXS 分析相形成和织构；XAS 分析局域 Fe 配位；电学输运测量（电阻率）；室温磁化测量。

papers.title: Carrier-coupled ultrafast structural dynamics and interlayer energy transport of supported transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures
papers.abstract: Understanding the electronic coupling and energy flow across layered two-dimensional heterostructures (HSs) is crucial to the exploitation of carrier and phonon transports as well as thermal management in next-generation optoelectronic devices. By using reflection ultrafast electron diffraction, we directly examine photoinduced out-of-plane structural dynamics of supported MoS2/WS2 bilayer HSs and their individual monolayers. Experimental evidence reveals the launch of ultrafast carrier-coupled intralayer atomic motions due to interlayer charge transfer across the van der Waals (vdW) heterojunctions that is absent for individual monolayers. Such a notable carrier-lattice correlation is in addition to the electronic coupling manifested in the enhanced optical absorption for HSs. Also, different pathways of energy flow as a result of carrier-phonon coupling and phonon scattering are reported with the corresponding characteristic times. On longer timescales, relaxation of thermalized atomic motions can be sufficiently described by a thermal transport model. A higher thermal boundary conductance (TBC) across MoS2/WS2 HSs is obtained compared to those at the monolayer-substrate interfaces; however, the similar TBC values suggest comparable couplings of phonons across vdW contacts. These results further shed light on the optical, phonon, and interfacial thermal properties of vertically-stacked vdW HSs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了“reflection ultrafast electron diffraction”（反射式超快电子衍射）作为主要实验手段，并提供了直接的实验证据。；研究对象：支撑在基底上的MoS₂/WS₂双层异质结及其单层薄膜，具体研究光致面外结构动力学和层间能量输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验发现，由于层间电荷转移，MoS₂/WS₂异质结中出现了单层膜所没有的超快载流子耦合的层内原子运动；此外，MoS₂/WS₂异质结的界面热导高于单层与基底之间的界面热导，但不同范德华接触的界面热导数值相近，表明声子耦合强度相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验发现，由于层间电荷转移，MoS₂/WS₂异质结中出现了单层膜所没有的超快载流子耦合的层内原子运动；此外，MoS₂/WS₂异质结的界面热导高于单层与基底之间的界面热导，但不同范德华接触的界面热导数值相近，表明声子耦合强度相当。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 反射式超快电子衍射（reflection ultrafast electron diffraction），结合光学吸收测量和热输运模型分析。

papers.title: Engineering Quantum Criticality in the Integer Quantum Hall Regime through a Screening Layer
papers.abstract: Disorder-induced localization of electrons and electron-electron interaction are among the most fundamental problems in condensed matter physics. In two-dimensional electron systems, extensive studies have led to the emergence of a scaling picture, characterized by a set of universal critical exponents that govern the transitions between the integer quantum Hall plateaus. From the temperature dependence of the plateau-to-plateau transitions, experiments primarily report k ~ 0.42, implying a dynamic exponent z = 1, consistent with a theoretical picture where electrons have a long-range (1/r) interaction. Theory also predicts that z = 2 for short-range electron interaction, but an experimental verification has remained elusive. Here, we directly probe the influence of Coulomb interaction on these transitions using a bilayer electron system confined to a GaAs double quantum well device. The two layers are in close proximity, with an interlayer distance approximately equal to the magnetic length at the relevant magnetic fields. By tuning the electron density in the top layer, we access both insulating and metallic phases of the electrons in this layer as a function of magnetic field, allowing in-situ control of the unscreened and screened interaction strengths in the bottom layer as it goes through its plateau-to-plateau transitions. In the unscreened case, we measure k ~ 0.42 consistent with the widely reported value. More importantly, when screening is introduced, k is reduced to ~ 0.22, implying z = 2. Our results provide direct experimental evidence for the role of electron-electron interaction in determining critical behavior in the quantum Hall regime, and demonstrate screening as a powerful tuning parameter for engineering quantum criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experiments primarily report”、“we directly probe”、“we measure”等实验操作和测量结果。；研究对象：GaAs双量子阱器件中的二维电子系统，具体研究整数量子霍尔效应中平台-平台相变的临界行为，以及电子-电子相互作用（库仑相互作用）对临界指数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入屏蔽层，实现了对电子-电子相互作用强度的原位调控，并首次实验观察到短程相互作用对应的动态指数z=2（临界指数k≈0.22），而长程相互作用下k≈0.42（z=1），直接证明了电子-电子相互作用决定量子霍尔临界行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入屏蔽层，实现了对电子-电子相互作用强度的原位调控，并首次实验观察到短程相互作用对应的动态指数z=2（临界指数k≈0.22），而长程相互作用下k≈0.42（z=1），直接证明了电子-电子相互作用决定量子霍尔临界行为。；创新点：首次通过引入屏蔽层实现对量子霍尔相变中电子-电子相互作用强度的原位调控，并实验验证了短程相互作用下动态指数z=2的理论预言，填补了长期以来的实验空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用GaAs双量子阱器件构建双层电子系统，通过调控顶层电子密度使其在绝缘相和金属相之间变化，从而原位控制底层电子在经历平台-平台相变时受到的库仑相互作用是否被屏蔽；测量不同屏蔽条件下的温度依赖关系，提取临界指数k。

papers.title: Towards exascale fully relativistic pseudopotential density functional theory calculations enabled by mixed-precision computation and compressed-communication using residual based subspace iteration
papers.abstract: Noncollinear (NC) magnetism and spin-orbit coupling (SOC) are indispensable for predictive ab initio materials simulations with pronounced relativistic effects and magnetic frustration, yet they significantly increase the cost of cubic-scaling density functional theory (DFT) by introducing complex 2-component wavefunctions per electron and consequently much larger eigenproblems. We present a GPU-centric high-performance framework for NC-SOC DFT that combines: (i) algorithmic advances for solving finite-element (FE) discretized DFT equations; (ii) residual-based Chebyshev filtered subspace iteration (R-ChFSI), tolerant to inexact matrix-vector products, for the resulting sparse generalized eigenproblem; (iii) a matrix-free strategy for accelerating FE Poisson solver; (iv) R-ChFSI-enabled mixed-precision computation with block floating-point compressed MPI communication at compression ratios over 4x, preserving double-precision robustness while reducing compute and data movement costs; and (v) a communication efficient band-partitioning algorithm to improve scalability. Numerical results demonstrate improved time-to-solution and excellent scaling on exascale architectures, enabling fully relativistic pseudopotential DFT simulations of up to 100,000 electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT) calculations、high-performance framework、exascale architectures。；研究对象：摘要未明确说明具体材料或体系，研究对象为一般性的非共线磁性和自旋轨道耦合（NC-SOC）的密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟，适用于具有显著相对论效应和磁阻挫的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合残差基切比雪夫滤波子空间迭代（R-ChFSI）、混合精度计算和压缩通信，实现了在百亿亿次（exascale）架构上高效的全相对论赝势DFT计算，可模拟多达10万个电子的体系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合残差基切比雪夫滤波子空间迭代（R-ChFSI）、混合精度计算和压缩通信，实现了在百亿亿次（exascale）架构上高效的全相对论赝势DFT计算，可模拟多达10万个电子的体系。；创新点：首次将残差基切比雪夫滤波子空间迭代（R-ChFSI）与混合精度计算及压缩通信相结合，在保持双精度鲁棒性的同时大幅降低计算和数据移动成本，实现了百亿亿次架构上全相对论DFT模拟的优异可扩展性。
papers.method_zh: 基于GPU的高性能计算框架，具体包括：有限元（FE）离散化的DFT方程求解、残差基切比雪夫滤波子空间迭代（R-ChFSI）处理稀疏广义本征问题、无矩阵策略加速FE泊松求解器、混合精度计算与块浮点压缩MPI通信（压缩比超过4倍）、以及通信高效的能带划分算法。

papers.title: Quantum Spin-5/2 Blume-Capel Model in a Random Transverse-Crystalline Field Anisotropy
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the thermodynamic properties of the quantum Blume-Capel model with spin \( S = 5/2 \) in the presence of transverse and random crystalline fields. The system is described by a Hamiltonian that includes ferromagnetic exchange interactions between nearest neighbors, a longitudinal single-ion anisotropy, and a transverse single-ion anisotropy. Using a mean-field approach based on Bogoliubov's inequality for the Gibbs free energy, we derive the fundamental thermodynamic potential and the equation of state for the magnetization. The influence of the longitudinal and transverse anisotropy parameters on the magnetic ordering and phase transitions is analyzed in detail. We present magnetization versus temperature diagrams for various combinations of the anisotropies, exploring both positive and negative values. Our results reveal that the system exhibits standard second-order phase transitions for most parameter ranges, with no evidence of tricritical behavior. However, for certain positive values of the anisotropies, the model displays a first-order phase transition within the ordered phase, characterized by a jump from a higher-spin ordered state to a lower-spin ordered state. The critical temperatures are shown to be sensitive to the magnitude and sign of the anisotropy parameters. In particular, negative transverse anisotropies favor magnetic order, raising the critical temperature, while positive anisotropies promote disorder, lowering the critical temperature. This study provides a comprehensive analysis of the phase diagram of the \( S = 5/2 \) quantum Blume-Capel model and highlights the role of transverse fields in modifying the critical behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mean-field approach、Bogoliubov's inequality、thermodynamic potential、equation of state。；研究对象：自旋 S=5/2 的量子 Blume-Capel 模型，在随机横向晶场各向异性下的热力学性质与相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统在大多数参数范围内呈现标准二级相变，未发现三临界点；但在某些正各向异性参数下，有序相内部会出现从高自旋有序态到低自旋有序态的一级相变。负横向各向异性有利于磁有序（提高临界温度），正横向各向异性则促进无序（降低临界温度）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统在大多数参数范围内呈现标准二级相变，未发现三临界点；但在某些正各向异性参数下，有序相内部会出现从高自旋有序态到低自旋有序态的一级相变。负横向各向异性有利于磁有序（提高临界温度），正横向各向异性则促进无序（降低临界温度）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Bogoliubov 不等式对吉布斯自由能进行平均场近似，推导出基本热力学势和磁化状态方程，并通过数值计算分析磁化随温度的变化图。

papers.title: Supercooling of liquids, as described by the Enskog-Vlasov kinetic equation
papers.abstract: A model combining Enskog's collision integral for dense fluids with a Vlasov-style description of the van der Waals force is applied to supercooling. First, the spinodal temperature $T_{s}$ is calculated, at which a liquid becomes unstable to small perturbations and transitions to solid. In particular, it turns out that isochoric cooling allows one to reach a lower temperature than isobaric cooling. Second, the surface tension of a supercooled liquid-vapor interface is shown to diverge at $T_{s}$. The singularity is caused by an oscillatory region emerging on the liquid side of the interface as $T\rightarrow T_{s}$; it develops because the liquid approaches instability, and the interface starts radiating (so far, evanescent) waves. At $T=T_{s}$, the waves cease to be evanescent and the oscillatory region extends to infinity -- hence, the singularity of the surface tension. Since this effect has a clear physical interpretation, it should occur regardless of the model and approximations under which it was obtained. This and the other results of the paper are illustrated using argon and several other fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：基于Enskog-Vlasov动力学方程进行模型推导和计算，未涉及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：过冷液体（supercooled liquids），具体以氩（argon）及其他几种流体为例，研究其从液态到固态的相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 等容冷却比等压冷却能达到更低的温度；过冷液体-蒸气界面的表面张力在旋节线温度 \(T_s\) 处发散，该发散源于界面液体侧出现振荡区域，并在 \(T=T_s\) 时振荡波从倏逝波变为传播波。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：等容冷却比等压冷却能达到更低的温度；过冷液体-蒸气界面的表面张力在旋节线温度 \(T_s\) 处发散，该发散源于界面液体侧出现振荡区域，并在 \(T=T_s\) 时振荡波从倏逝波变为传播波。；创新点：首次揭示过冷液体-蒸气界面表面张力在旋节线温度处的发散机制，该发散由界面液体侧因接近不稳定性而产生的振荡区域引起，且作者认为该效应具有清晰的物理图像，应独立于具体模型和近似而普遍存在。
papers.method_zh: 采用Enskog碰撞积分（描述稠密流体）与Vlasov型范德瓦尔斯力描述相结合的理论模型，计算旋节线温度 \(T_s\) 及界面性质。

papers.title: Electronic Origin of Ferromagnetic Excitations in the Candidate Spin-Triplet Superconductor CeSb2
papers.abstract: The origin of quasi-one-dimensional (q1D) ferromagnetic (FM) excitations in the candidate spin-triplet superconductor CeSb$_2$ has remained unclear. Here we report an electronic mechanism for emergent q1D magnetism in the quasi-two-dimensional lattice of CeSb$_2$, revealed by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). High-resolution ARPES resolves no spin-density-wave gap on the dispersive Fermi pockets, disfavoring a nesting-driven mechanism for the q1D FM excitations. Instead, resonant ARPES reveals a pronounced selective enhancement of Ce 4$f$ spectral weight on the $C_2$-distributed Fermi pockets aligned with the Ce ladder. This observation signifies band-selective Kondo coupling that generates strongly anisotropic magnetic exchange interactions, which can naturally account for both the q1D ferromagnetic excitations and the competing magnetic orders. Our results identify a band-selective Kondo coupling mechanism for emergent low-dimensional magnetism in correlated $f$-electron systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES)”、“resonant ARPES”以及“high-resolution ARPES resolves”表明主要基于角分辨光电子能谱实验。；研究对象：候选自旋三重态超导体CeSb₂中准一维铁磁激发的电子起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过ARPES实验发现，CeSb₂中准一维铁磁激发并非源于费米面嵌套，而是源于能带选择的近藤耦合效应，该效应产生强各向异性磁交换相互作用，从而解释了准一维铁磁激发和竞争磁有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过ARPES实验发现，CeSb₂中准一维铁磁激发并非源于费米面嵌套，而是源于能带选择的近藤耦合效应，该效应产生强各向异性磁交换相互作用，从而解释了准一维铁磁激发和竞争磁有序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和共振角分辨光电子能谱（resonant ARPES）。

papers.title: Slave-rotor theory of correlated altermagnets on the Lieb lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate the metal-insulator transition driven by the onsite repulsive interaction $U$ in an altermagnetic Hubbard model defined on a Lieb lattice. Using the slave-rotor approach at half filling, we find that the system exhibits a cascade of interaction-driven phase transitions. As $U$ increases, the system evolves from a normal metal to an altermagnetic metal, then to an altermagnetic insulator, and eventually to an altermagnetic Mott insulator characterized by the complete suppression of the quasiparticle weight. These phases are supported by the calculation of the electronic spectral function, which features spin-split bands in both the metallic and insulating regimes. However, the spin splitting becomes substantially suppressed in the Mott insulating phase. Our results suggest that the observation of spin splitting in the spectral function of $d$-wave altermagnets with a Lieb-lattice-like structure may be limited to the weak-to-moderate correlation regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“slave-rotor approach”进行理论分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Lieb晶格上反铁磁哈伯德模型中的金属-绝缘体相变，具体关注由在位库仑相互作用U驱动的反铁磁序与电子关联效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着相互作用U增大，系统经历从正常金属到反铁磁金属、再到反铁磁绝缘体、最终到反铁磁Mott绝缘体的级联相变；在Mott绝缘相中，准粒子权重完全被抑制，且自旋劈裂显著减弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着相互作用U增大，系统经历从正常金属到反铁磁金属、再到反铁磁绝缘体、最终到反铁磁Mott绝缘体的级联相变；在Mott绝缘相中，准粒子权重完全被抑制，且自旋劈裂显著减弱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用slave-rotor方法（一种处理强关联电子系统的理论框架）在半满填充下进行计算，并通过电子谱函数分析各相的特征。

papers.title: Surface Originated Cross-Field Anomalous Transport in Magnetoelectric Multilayers
papers.abstract: In material systems with slab geometry, the surface contribution to physical responses is commonly expected to diminish rapidly with increasing thickness, giving way to the bulk response. Here, we show that this conventional wisdom is violated in a class of gate-induced responses, including gate-induced orbital and spin magnetization as well as cross-field anomalous thermoelectric transport. We develop a general framework for these effects, which naturally decomposes the total response into surface- and bulk-contributions treated on equal footing. Remarkably, the volume-averaged surface contribution remains finite in the thick-slab limit and exhibits the same thickness scaling as the bulk term. Furthermore, the surface response originates from band geometric quantities distinct from those in the bulk, being constrained solely by surface symmetries. As a result, it can dominate the overall response when the bulk contribution is symmetry-forbidden. Taking MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ multilayers as an example, we predict a strong surface-dominated cross-field anomalous Nernst effect arising from surface Berry curvature, which is readily accessible to experimental detection. These findings reveal a previously overlooked significance of surface response and open a new direction in the study of surface quantum geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：develop a general framework、predict、theoretical framework。；研究对象：磁电多层膜（magnetoelectric multilayers）中的表面起源交叉场反常输运现象，具体以MnBi₂Te₄多层膜为例，研究门控诱导的轨道磁化、自旋磁化以及交叉场反常热电输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁电多层膜中，表面贡献在厚膜极限下不会随厚度增加而衰减，而是与体贡献具有相同的厚度标度行为；当体贡献因对称性被禁止时，表面贡献可主导整体响应，例如在MnBi₂Te₄多层膜中预测了由表面贝里曲率主导的强交叉场反常能斯特效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁电多层膜中，表面贡献在厚膜极限下不会随厚度增加而衰减，而是与体贡献具有相同的厚度标度行为；当体贡献因对称性被禁止时，表面贡献可主导整体响应，例如在MnBi₂Te₄多层膜中预测了由表面贝里曲率主导的强交叉场反常能斯特效应。；创新点：揭示了传统认知中表面贡献随厚度增加而迅速衰减的违反情况，指出在门控诱导响应中表面贡献在厚膜极限下仍保持有限，且其源于与体贡献不同的带几何量，受表面对称性单独约束。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个将总响应自然分解为表面贡献和体贡献的通用理论框架，两者被平等处理；利用表面对称性约束的带几何量（如表面贝里曲率）进行分析，并以MnBi₂Te₄多层膜为例进行具体预测。

papers.title: Hysteretic Acoustic Band Structures in Shape-Memory Composite Thin Rods
papers.abstract: We investigate the propagation of longitudinal elastic waves in one-dimensional periodic composite rods composed of alternating segments of a shape-memory alloy (NiTiCu) and a polymer spacer (Parylene C). In the thin-rod regime, the longitudinal phase velocity reduces to $c=\sqrt{E/ρ}$, which coincides with the regime in which the elastic modulus of NiTiCu has been measured directly through its acoustic response across the martensitic transformation. Using the standard transfer-matrix method along the heating and cooling branches of the transformation separately, we compute the Bloch band structure of the infinite periodic system and the transmission spectrum of finite composite rods. Because the elastic modulus of NiTiCu follows different paths upon heating and cooling, the same external temperature within the transformation interval corresponds to two different phase fractions and, consequently, to two different phononic spectra. The resulting hysteresis of the underlying material is thus transferred to the collective acoustic response of the periodic structure: stop-band edges trace closed loops in the temperature--frequency plane, and the transmission coefficient of a finite rod at a fixed temperature depends on the previous thermal history. We further show that the geometric filling fraction of the active segment provides a complementary tuning mechanism, modifying the width of the spectral hysteresis loops and the position of specific gap closures independently of temperature. These results illustrate how a first-order structural phase transition with intrinsic thermal hysteresis manifests itself in the dispersion relation of a periodic elastic medium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“transfer-matrix method”（传递矩阵法）计算能带结构和透射谱，属于理论计算范畴，未提及实验测量。；研究对象：由形状记忆合金（NiTiCu）和聚合物间隔层（Parylene C）交替组成的一维周期性复合细棒中的纵向弹性波传播。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 形状记忆合金在相变过程中的弹性模量热滞（加热和冷却路径不同）被传递到周期性复合结构的集体声学响应中，导致声子带隙边缘在温度-频率平面上形成闭合回线，且有限长复合棒的透射系数依赖于热历史。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：形状记忆合金在相变过程中的弹性模量热滞（加热和冷却路径不同）被传递到周期性复合结构的集体声学响应中，导致声子带隙边缘在温度-频率平面上形成闭合回线，且有限长复合棒的透射系数依赖于热历史。；创新点：首次展示了具有本征热滞的一级结构相变如何具体体现在周期性弹性介质的色散关系中，并揭示了通过改变活性段（形状记忆合金）的几何填充因子可以独立于温度调控谱学滞回环的宽度和特定带隙闭合的位置。
papers.method_zh: 采用标准传递矩阵法，分别沿马氏体相变的加热和冷却分支计算无限周期系统的布洛赫能带结构以及有限长复合棒的透射谱。计算基于细棒近似下的纵波相速度公式 \( c=\sqrt{E/\rho} \)。

papers.title: Magnetic precession induced spin accumulation in collinear antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Generating and characterizing uniform and staggered spin polarization in antiferromagnets is one of the key challenges for antiferromagnetic spintronic technology. Here, we perform perturbative theory, group-theoretical symmetry analysis, low energy and ab initio simulations to propose that the magnetic precession near the equilibrium magnetic axis could generate finite uniform and staggered spin polarization at the opposite magnetic sublattices (referring to total magnetic and Néel vector generation) in a single AFM semiconductors. This response does not require the heterojunction setup and could eliminate the lattice mismatch issues at the junction. Through scrutinizing all symmetrically-protected vanishing magnetic moment groups and especially focusing on parity-time (PT ) invariant groups, we identify the symmetry constraints that describe the staggered spin accumulation responses, and disclose their fieldlike and dampinglike characters. This unravels a hidden spin accumulation mode in AFM semiconductors. Furthermore, we simulate such an effect using a perturbative approach and suggest that electric gate field and Floquet light-dressing can effectively manipulate these responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：perturbative theory（微扰理论）、group-theoretical symmetry analysis（群论对称性分析）、low energy and ab initio simulations（低能及第一性原理模拟）。；研究对象：共线反铁磁体（collinear antiferromagnets）中由磁进动（magnetic precession）诱导的自旋积累（spin accumulation）现象，具体关注均匀和交错自旋极化（uniform and staggered spin polarization）的产生。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单一反铁磁半导体中，平衡磁轴附近的磁进动可在相反磁子格点上产生有限的均匀和交错自旋极化（即总磁矩和奈尔矢量的生成），且该响应无需异质结结构，可避免晶格失配问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单一反铁磁半导体中，平衡磁轴附近的磁进动可在相反磁子格点上产生有限的均匀和交错自旋极化（即总磁矩和奈尔矢量的生成），且该响应无需异质结结构，可避免晶格失配问题。；创新点：揭示了反铁磁半导体中一种隐藏的自旋积累模式，并通过对称性分析（特别是PT不变群）明确了描述交错自旋积累响应的对称性约束及其场致类（fieldlike）和阻尼类（dampinglike）特征。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 微扰理论、群论对称性分析、低能有效模型模拟、第一性原理（ab initio）模拟。

papers.title: Charting the thermodynamic stability of hybrid perovskite alloys with machine learning
papers.abstract: Alloy-based perovskite solar cells offer tunable properties and improved stability, but their complexity has impeded accurate modeling, hindering development. We present a machine-learning (ML) accelerated atomistic modeling approach for the phase stability of (Cs/FA)Pb(Br/I)3 and (Cs/FA)Sn(Br/I)3 perovskites, with FA being formamidinium. To make such quaternary alloys tractable, we adopt a two-level ML strategy, combining 1) graph neural network interatomic potentials trained on density functional theory data for efficient structure relaxations with 2) secondary ML models for direct energy prediction from unrelaxed structures. These models enable computations of free energy landscapes across compositions and phases, capturing alloy disorder and FA molecular orientations. Our results reveal narrower stable composition regions for the Sn-based system compared to its Pb-based counterpart, limiting options for compositional engineering. Maximum stability occurs at high I content, and no stabilization is observed near the center of the composition space. Our results guide the design of stable perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning (ML) accelerated atomistic modeling、graph neural network interatomic potentials、density functional theory (DFT) data。；研究对象：混合钙钛矿合金 (Cs/FA)Pb(Br/I)₃ 和 (Cs/FA)Sn(Br/I)₃ 的相稳定性，其中 FA 为甲脒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 锡基混合钙钛矿合金的稳定组分区间比铅基体系更窄，限制了组分工程的选择；最大稳定性出现在高碘含量区域，组分空间中心附近未观察到稳定化效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：锡基混合钙钛矿合金的稳定组分区间比铅基体系更窄，限制了组分工程的选择；最大稳定性出现在高碘含量区域，组分空间中心附近未观察到稳定化效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用两级机器学习加速原子建模策略：1）基于密度泛函理论（DFT）数据训练图神经网络原子间势，用于高效结构弛豫；2）训练二级机器学习模型，直接从未弛豫结构预测能量。结合这些模型计算不同组分和相的自由能景观，捕获合金无序和FA分子取向。

papers.title: Hidden Ising models from the generalized Yang-Baxter equation
papers.abstract: We introduce a one dimensional spin $\frac{1}{2}$ Hamiltonian with multi-site interactions, but still local. The algebra of its Hamiltonian densities resembles that of the transverse field Ising model. Using this fact we show that its spectrum is free-fermionic but with a huge degeneracy for each level. The source of the degeneracy is a set of local conserved quantities that act like a classical background field for the quantum system. The thermodynamics of this system is contrasted with the standard Ising model. At the gapless points in the energy spectrum, we show that this system can be derived from the quantum inverse scattering method adapted to a multi-site generalization of the Yang-Baxter equation as introduced by E. Rowell and Z. Wang. The $R$-matrix is constructed using generators of extraspecial 2-groups. This helps us extract all the conserved charges and lay the framework for a general mechanism to generate such multi-site interaction spin systems that are transverse field Ising models under the hood. A remark on how to obtain P. Fendley's free-fermion in disguise models in this formalism is also included.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入哈密顿量”、“证明其谱是自由费米子”、“从量子逆散射方法推导”等理论推导和构造。；研究对象：一维自旋1/2系统，具有多体相互作用但仍是局域的哈密顿量，其代数结构与横场伊辛模型类似。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系统的能谱是自由费米子型的，但每个能级具有巨大简并度，简并来源是一组局域守恒量，它们对量子系统起到经典背景场的作用。在能谱的无能隙点，该系统可通过推广的Yang-Baxter方程（由E. Rowell和Z. Wang引入）的量子逆散射方法导出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系统的能谱是自由费米子型的，但每个能级具有巨大简并度，简并来源是一组局域守恒量，它们对量子系统起到经典背景场的作用。在能谱的无能隙点，该系统可通过推广的Yang-Baxter方程（由E. Rowell和Z. Wang引入）的量子逆散射方法导出。；创新点：利用超特殊2-群生成元构造R-矩阵，从而将多体相互作用自旋系统与推广的Yang-Baxter方程联系起来，揭示了这类系统本质上是“隐藏的”横场伊辛模型，并建立了生成此类多体相互作用自由费米子模型的通用框架。此外，还指出如何在该形式中重现P. Fendley的“伪装自由费米子”模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：广义Yang-Baxter方程、量子逆散射方法、R-矩阵构造（使用超特殊2-群生成元）、代数结构分析。

papers.title: Thermodynamic and magnetocaloric properties of a triangular spin-1/2 cluster with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical investigation of the magnetic and thermodynamic properties of the triangular spin-1/2 cluster with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, described by a spin-1/2 Heisenberg Hamiltonian with antisymmetric exchange interactions. The energy spectrum and ground-state phase diagram reveal the presence of ferromagnetic (FM), ferrimagnetic (FI), and frustrated (FR) phases, strongly influenced by the total spin and the DM interaction. We analyze magnetization and susceptibility, showing that at low temperatures the system exhibits a characteristic 1/3 magnetization plateau, while thermal fluctuations suppress magnetic order at higher temperatures. The entropy and specific heat display residual entropies due to ground-state degeneracies, Schottky-type anomalies at intermediate temperatures, and additional low-temperature features related to phase transitions. Particular attention is given to the magnetocaloric effect (MCE), characterized by both direct and inverse regimes depending on the magnetic field variation. We find that the DM interaction enhances the complexity of the MCE, leading to nontrivial entropy variations as a function of the magnetic field. These results provide insights into the role of frustration and anisotropy in tuning the MCE of properties triangular spin clusters, with relevance to \mathrm{Cu}_{3}-based molecular magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical investigation”、“described by a Hamiltonian”、“energy spectrum and ground-state phase diagram”。；研究对象：具有Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用的三角自旋-1/2团簇，具体为自旋-1/2海森堡模型描述的三角形分子磁体（如Cu₃基分子磁体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该三角自旋团簇在基态相图中存在铁磁（FM）、亚铁磁（FI）和阻挫（FR）相，且DM相互作用显著增强了磁热效应的复杂性，导致随磁场变化出现非平凡的熵变，并呈现直接和逆两种磁热效应模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该三角自旋团簇在基态相图中存在铁磁（FM）、亚铁磁（FI）和阻挫（FR）相，且DM相互作用显著增强了磁热效应的复杂性，导致随磁场变化出现非平凡的熵变，并呈现直接和逆两种磁热效应模式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析计算。具体包括：求解自旋-1/2海森堡哈密顿量（含反对称交换相互作用）的能量谱，分析基态相图，计算磁化率、比热、熵等热力学量，并基于熵变分析磁热效应（MCE）。

papers.title: Stability Analysis of Superconductivity in $\textit{P6/mmm}$-LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$ and its Experimental Reproducibility from La-Sc Alloys
papers.abstract: In this work, we analyze the feasibility of room-temperature superconductivity in the lanthanum-scandium hydride $\textit{P6/mmm}$-LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$. We demonstrate that the electron-phonon coupling calculations performed using the $σ$-broadening of the double $δ$-function at the Fermi surface lead to a very strong dependence of $\textit{T$_c$}(σ)$ on the arbitrary $σ$, whereas the tetrahedral method for the electron-phonon interaction is free from this drawback and leads to $\textit{T$_c$}$ > 300 K at 300 GPa in agreement with previous predictions. By analyzing the stability of the metallic state of LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$ at 250-300 GPa, we show that this compound is at the edge of the stability region ($ξ$ = 0.54), similar to $\textit{fcc}$ LaH$_{10}$ at 140-150 GPa. Experimental attempts to synthesize LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$ at 250-280 GPa starting from the (La,Sc$_2$) alloy are unsuccessful and indicate the absence of even traces of superconductivity at 245-300 K in all the resulting La-Sc-H hydrides. The method for preparing the precursor by simultaneous deposition of La and Sc metals may be a key factor for the successful synthesis of LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含电子-声子耦合计算（σ展宽方法、四面体方法）和高压合成实验（从La-Sc合金前驱体合成氢化物）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料为镧-钪氢化物 LaSc₂H₂₄（空间群 P6/mmm），重点关注其在250-300 GPa高压下的超导电性及实验可重复性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 使用四面体方法计算电子-声子相互作用得到 LaSc₂H₂₄ 在300 GPa下超导转变温度 Tc > 300 K，但该化合物在250-300 GPa处于稳定性边缘（ξ = 0.54），且实验尝试从(La,Sc₂)合金前驱体合成均未观察到245-300 K温度范围内的超导迹象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：使用四面体方法计算电子-声子相互作用得到 LaSc₂H₂₄ 在300 GPa下超导转变温度 Tc > 300 K，但该化合物在250-300 GPa处于稳定性边缘（ξ = 0.54），且实验尝试从(La,Sc₂)合金前驱体合成均未观察到245-300 K温度范围内的超导迹象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 计算方法：基于密度泛函理论的电子-声子耦合计算，对比了σ展宽的双δ函数方法与四面体方法。实验方法：高压合成实验，以La和Sc共沉积制备前驱体合金，在250-280 GPa条件下尝试合成氢化物，并测量其超导转变温度。

papers.title: Prototype-Guided Latent Alignment for Data-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Molecular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have transformed materials discovery by leveraging graph neural networks (GNNs) to predict material properties with near density functional theory (DFT) accuracy. While large-scale pretrained foundation models offer transferable baseline representations, they frequently struggle to generalise to out-of-distribution (OOD) target systems -- a common challenge in modelling complex or chemically diverse materials. Fine-tuning is the standard remedy, but the high cost of generating DFT-labelled configurations confines adaptation to data-scarce regimes, where over-parameterised GNNs amplify overfitting and degrade target-domain performance. To address this, we propose a prototype-based alignment approach for data-efficient fine-tuning of MLIPs. Our method identifies local structural similarities between the source and target domains by grouping atoms with analogous chemical environments based on their latent representations. Each target-domain atom's energy contribution is aligned to its source-domain prototype, introducing an inductive bias that anchors fine-tuned representations to the pretrained structure, encouraging effective reuse of learned interactions and improving generalisation without restrictive assumptions on the target chemistry. We evaluate our method on the rMD17 benchmark using equivariant MACE and invariant SchNet across varying data budgets, and extend evaluation to the MACE-OFF foundation models on the SPICE dataset. Our approach consistently improves predictive accuracy in the low-data regime, reducing energy MAE by up to 18% over standard fine-tuning baselines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、graph neural networks (GNNs)、fine-tuning、benchmark evaluation。；研究对象：分子体系，具体为rMD17基准数据集和SPICE数据集中的分子，涉及化学环境多样、分布外（OOD）的复杂或化学多样性材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于原型（prototype）的潜在空间对齐方法，在数据稀缺条件下微调分子基础模型，可有效缓解过拟合，将能量预测的平均绝对误差（MAE）相比标准微调基线降低最多18%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于原型（prototype）的潜在空间对齐方法，在数据稀缺条件下微调分子基础模型，可有效缓解过拟合，将能量预测的平均绝对误差（MAE）相比标准微调基线降低最多18%。；创新点：提出一种数据高效的微调策略，通过识别源域与目标域之间的局部结构相似性并利用原型对齐，在不限制目标化学体系的前提下，促进预训练交互的有效复用并提升泛化能力。
papers.method_zh: 采用原型引导的潜在对齐方法，通过将目标域原子的能量贡献对齐到源域的原型（基于化学环境相似性分组），引入归纳偏置以锚定微调表示。具体使用等变MACE和不变SchNet模型在rMD17基准上评估，并扩展至MACE-OFF基础模型在SPICE数据集上的测试。

papers.title: Synergistic approach to probing the dynamics and mechanics of patchy soft matter
papers.abstract: Tailoring microscopic details to tune bulk rheology is a key paradigm in soft matter physics, yet the vast parameter space associated with constituent interactions precludes a fully systematic approach. To address this, we have designed a synergistic strategy to explore the parameter space that comprises simulations, experimental rheology, and machine learning. As a case study, we choose DNA-based self-assembled fluids whose viscoelastic response can be fine-tuned by manipulating the base sequencing of the constituent nucleic acid nanostars. We use coarse-grained simulations, benchmarked against experimental data, to obtain the rheology of the DNA fluids, which feeds forward to a framework of Gaussian Process Regression and active learning. The latter is then used to explore the rheological design space with high predictive precision. The pipeline is designed to be deployed iteratively for the rational design and accelerated discovery of generic soft matter suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（模拟+实验+机器学习）。关键词：simulations, experimental rheology, machine learning。；研究对象：基于DNA自组装的软物质流体（DNA纳米星流体），其粘弹性可通过核酸碱基序列调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合粗粒化模拟、实验流变学和机器学习（高斯过程回归与主动学习），可高效探索软物质流变学设计空间，实现高预测精度的理性设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合粗粒化模拟、实验流变学和机器学习（高斯过程回归与主动学习），可高效探索软物质流变学设计空间，实现高预测精度的理性设计。；创新点：提出一种可迭代部署的协同策略，将模拟、实验与机器学习结合，用于加速发现和理性设计通用软物质悬浮液的流变特性。摘要未突出说明与传统试错法相比的具体效率提升幅度。
papers.method_zh: 粗粒化模拟（经实验数据标定）、实验流变学、高斯过程回归与主动学习框架。

papers.title: Universal thermokinetic decomposition of short-time information fluctuations
papers.abstract: Biological, artificial, and physical systems dissipate energy to accurately transmit information. While tools of information theory have been used to characterize information-processing capabilities, how reliably this information is acquired along individual trajectories, and which aspects require a thermodynamic cost, is an open question. In this work, we focus on the stochastic predictability of an arbitrary Langevin dynamics, defined as the pointwise mutual information between the current and future states of a system. We show that the fluctuations of predictability obey a universal thermokinetic decomposition at short times, which reveals that information fluctuations are suppressed by energy dissipation and become stronger with increased dynamical activity. Remarkably, we find that the average predictability, i.e., the short-time mutual information, does not carry any dependence on the underlying thermodynamic and kinetic features. Thus, the role of dissipation at short times is not to enhance information, but to reduce its fluctuations. Such dissipative control is effective only when instantiated by nonlinear operations. Moreover, energy consumption governs short- and long-time precision in stochastic oscillators through structurally different mechanisms that can be independently tuned. Our decomposition offers a fundamental thermodynamic basis for understanding the reliability of information transmission in nonequilibrium systems, the constraints on precision in biological systems, and the design of energy-limited control strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“我们证明”“我们提出”“我们的分解”等理论推导表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：任意朗之万动力学系统中，当前状态与未来状态之间的点互信息（即随机可预测性）的涨落行为，以及其与热力学耗散、动力学活性的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 短时间尺度下，信息涨落服从普适的热动力学分解：能量耗散抑制信息涨落，而动力学活性增强信息涨落；但平均可预测性（短时互信息）本身与热力学和动力学特征无关，因此耗散的作用不是增强信息量，而是降低其涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：短时间尺度下，信息涨落服从普适的热动力学分解：能量耗散抑制信息涨落，而动力学活性增强信息涨落；但平均可预测性（短时互信息）本身与热力学和动力学特征无关，因此耗散的作用不是增强信息量，而是降低其涨落。；创新点：首次揭示短时信息涨落与耗散、动力学活性之间的普适定量关系，并指出耗散对信息可靠性的控制仅通过非线性操作实现，且短时与长时精度受不同机制独立调控。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机热力学和信息论框架，对任意朗之万动力学进行解析推导，得到短时点互信息涨落的普适分解形式，并分析非线性操作、随机振子等特例。

papers.title: Entropy of Liquids and Glasses from Recurring Structural Patterns
papers.abstract: We compute the low-temperature configurational entropy of a two-dimensional supercooled liquid. Our method, based on a higher-dimensional version of the Grassberger--Procaccia algorithm, can be implemented in a manner that is entirely agnostic with respect to both the dynamics and the theoretical framework, as any genuine notion of order should be. In this construction, entropy is obtained as the decay rate of recurrent structural patterns with increasing patch size, directly linking entropy reduction to the growing persistence of amorphous order. Because the method requires only particle positions, without any knowledge of the interaction potential or even of the particle sizes, it can be applied directly to both equilibrium and nonequilibrium aging configurations. The resulting configurational entropy, together with the higher-order Rényi complexities, agree quantitatively with values obtained from conventional definitions. Remarkably, the entropies measured during aging coincide with their equilibrium counterparts when compared at the same inherent-structure energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：compute（计算）、algorithm（算法）、configurational entropy（构型熵）、method（方法）。；研究对象：二维过冷液体和玻璃的低温构型熵，以及非平衡老化过程中的构型熵。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基于重复结构模式的方法计算得到的构型熵，与常规定义下的结果定量一致；且在老化过程中测量的熵，当与相同固有结构能量下的平衡态熵比较时，两者相等。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基于重复结构模式的方法计算得到的构型熵，与常规定义下的结果定量一致；且在老化过程中测量的熵，当与相同固有结构能量下的平衡态熵比较时，两者相等。；创新点：提出了一种完全与动力学和理论框架无关的构型熵计算方法，直接通过重复结构模式随补丁尺寸增大的衰减率来定义熵，将熵减与无定形有序的持续增长直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于Grassberger-Procaccia算法的高维版本，仅需粒子位置信息，无需相互作用势或粒子尺寸，可同时应用于平衡态和非平衡老化构型。

papers.title: Carrier Localization in Pnictogen-Based Chalcohalides from Defect-Bound Hot Polarons
papers.abstract: Pnictogen-based solar absorbers have gained prominence as promising nontoxic and stable alternatives to lead-halide perovskites (LHPs), but are severely limited by carrier localization, preventing their performance from approaching those of LHPs. Recent efforts have uncovered routes to overcome carrier localization, but these early efforts only considered intrinsic factors. Herein, we push beyond these limited early efforts, examining the role of defects, not only on cold carriers but also hot carriers. Focusing on the structurally one-dimensional pnictogen chalcohalide BiSBr, we find that whilst this material intrinsically does not exhibit carrier localization, vacancies introduced during synthesis or post-treatment lead to pronounced extrinsic self-trapping via the formation of defect-bound hot polarons-excited charge-carriers strongly coupled to local defect-induced vibrational modes. These above-gap defect states divert hot carriers from cooling to the band edge, thus depleting the mobile carrier population. Our findings establish the key role of defect-bound hot polarons in mediating extrinsic localization and offer new mechanistic insights into the interplay between defects, lattice coupling, and excited-state charge-carrier transport, which are critical to designing efficient perovskite-inspired solar absorbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：examining the role of defects, formation of defect-bound hot polarons, mechanistic insights）；研究对象：基于光族元素的硫卤化物太阳能吸收材料，具体为结构上一维的BiSBr，以及其中由缺陷导致的载流子局域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现BiSBr材料本身并不存在本征载流子局域化，但合成或后处理过程中引入的空位缺陷会通过形成“缺陷束缚热极化子”（即激发态载流子与局域缺陷诱导振动模式的强耦合）导致显著的外禀自陷，从而消耗移动载流子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现BiSBr材料本身并不存在本征载流子局域化，但合成或后处理过程中引入的空位缺陷会通过形成“缺陷束缚热极化子”（即激发态载流子与局域缺陷诱导振动模式的强耦合）导致显著的外禀自陷，从而消耗移动载流子。；创新点：该工作超越了以往仅考虑本征因素（如晶格本身）来克服载流子局域化的研究，首次揭示了缺陷在介导外禀载流子局域化中的关键作用，特别是通过形成“缺陷束缚热极化子”这一新机制，为理解缺陷、晶格耦合与激发态载流子输运之间的相互作用提供了新的物理图像。
papers.method_zh: 该研究通过理论分析（摘要未明确说明具体计算方法，如DFT等），考察了缺陷对冷载流子和热载流子的影响，重点分析了缺陷束缚热极化子的形成机制及其对载流子冷却和输运路径的调控作用。

papers.title: Field-induced multipolar character in the dipolar ground state of the honeycomb rare-earth chalcohalide NdOF
papers.abstract: Field-tunable reconstruction of crystalline electric field (CEF) doublets offers a promising avenue for inducing multipolar character, while its observation in real materials has been little explored so far. Here we establish the honeycomb rare-earth chalcohalide NdOF as such a platform. Raman spectroscopy identifies four CEF excitations at 1.7, 15.6, 19.2, and 80.9~meV, and a Zeeman--CEF analysis reproduces their nonlinear field splitting into seven branches. Magnetization and susceptibility over 0.1--9~T are well described by a CEF model for the total angular momentum $J = 9/2$ manifold, confirming the robustness of the extracted CEF scheme. These results demonstrate a field-driven continuous evolution of the ground-state doublet from dipolar to dipolar-multipolar character, with pressure providing a complementary tuning knob, establishing NdOF as a model system for exploring the controlled induction of multipolar components in rare-earth magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Raman spectroscopy、Magnetization、susceptibility）；研究对象：蜂窝状稀土硫卤化物NdOF中晶体电场（CEF）双重态的场致多极特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过磁场驱动，NdOF基态双重态从纯偶极特性连续演变为偶极-多极混合特性，且压力可作为额外的调控手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过磁场驱动，NdOF基态双重态从纯偶极特性连续演变为偶极-多极混合特性，且压力可作为额外的调控手段。；创新点：首次在真实材料中观察到磁场可调谐的CEF双重态重构，并实现了从纯偶极到偶极-多极特性的连续演化，为稀土磁体中多极分量的可控诱导提供了模型体系。
papers.method_zh: 拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）测量CEF激发能级（1.7、15.6、19.2、80.9 meV），结合Zeeman-CEF分析再现非线性场致分裂为七个分支；在0.1–9 T范围内进行磁化率和磁化强度测量，并用总角动量J=9/2的CEF模型进行描述。

papers.title: Topological spin-texture transitions in van der Waals magnets revealed by X-ray Fourier transform holography
papers.abstract: Nontrivial topological spin-textures, such as skyrmions, merons, bimerons, and skyrmioniums, are envisioned as robust building blocks for future memory and logic devices. Controllable transformations between these states require a quantum-mechanical description of electronic degrees of freedom and atomic-scale insight beyond existing phenomenological models. Here, we report an atomic-scale investigation of topological phase transitions and their protection in the two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnet Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ (FGT) using a combined experimental-theoretical approach. Synchrotron-based Fourier transform holography directly images labyrinth domains, isolated skyrmions, mixed labyrinth-skyrmion phases, and skyrmion bags with high spatial resolution. We compare these observations to simulations based on an electronic lattice Hamiltonian that captures both metallicity and relativistic spin-orbit coupling in FGT. By systematically exploring a broad range of temperatures and magnetic fields, we map the mechanisms governing topological transitions and their stability. This sequential-integrated experimental-theoretical framework advances understanding of spin-texture interactions and enables precise control of external tuning parameters. Our results establish a platform for creating, stabilizing, and manipulating topological states, paving the way for engineered spin-texture transitions in next-generation spintronic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论/计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combined experimental-theoretical approach”，实验部分使用同步辐射傅里叶变换全息术，理论部分基于电子晶格哈密顿量进行模拟。；研究对象：二维范德瓦尔斯铁磁体Fe₃GeTe₂（FGT）中的拓扑自旋纹理（如斯格明子、meron、bimeron、skyrmionium）及其拓扑相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子尺度的实验与理论结合，揭示了FGT中从迷宫畴、孤立斯格明子、混合迷宫-斯格明子相到斯格明子袋的拓扑相变及其稳定性机制，并建立了通过温度和磁场精确调控这些拓扑态的平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子尺度的实验与理论结合，揭示了FGT中从迷宫畴、孤立斯格明子、混合迷宫-斯格明子相到斯格明子袋的拓扑相变及其稳定性机制，并建立了通过温度和磁场精确调控这些拓扑态的平台。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：基于同步辐射的X射线傅里叶变换全息术（Fourier transform holography），直接成像具有高空间分辨率的自旋纹理。理论框架：基于电子晶格哈密顿量的模拟，该哈密顿量同时捕捉了FGT的金属性和相对论性自旋-轨道耦合。

papers.title: Charged Abelian Higgs phase transitions in three-dimensional compact lattice U(1) gauge models with multicharge scalar matter
papers.abstract: We consider three-dimensional (3D) lattice Abelian Higgs models, with compact U(1) gauge variables coupled to a doubly-charged $N$-component complex scalar field (CLAH). We focus on their phase transitions between the disordered-confined (DC) and ordered-deconfined (OD) phases. When they are continuous they belong to the 3D Abelian Higgs (AH) universality class associated with the stable charged fixed point (CFP) of the renormalization-group flow of the 3D AH field theory, or scalar electrodynamics, describing $N$-component complex scalar fields minimally coupled to a U(1) gauge field. This CFP exists only for a sufficiently large number of components, i.e., $N \ge N_d^*$, where the integer $N_d^*$ depends on the spatial dimension $d$ (for example $N_4^*=183$). To estimate $N_3^*$, we look for the minimum number $N_{\rm cL}$ of scalar components of 3D doubly-charged CLAH models developing continuous transitions along their DC-OD transition line. For this purpose, we present finite-size scaling analyses of Monte Carlo simulations for $N\in[4,10]$, up to lattice sizes $L\approx 100$. The results provide evidence of continuous DC-OD transitions for $N=10$, and weak first-order transitions for $N\le 7$. They are not conclusive for $N=8,\,9$. Therefore, we estimate $N_{\rm cL}=9(1)$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、finite-size scaling analyses、renormalization-group flow。；研究对象：三维紧致U(1)格点规范模型与双电荷N分量复标量场耦合体系（CLAH模型）中从无序-禁闭相（DC）到有序-退禁闭相（OD）的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于N=10的CLAH模型，DC-OD相变为连续相变，属于三维阿贝尔-希格斯（AH）普适类；对于N≤7，相变为弱一级相变；N=8、9的结果不明确。由此估计出三维AH场论中稳定带电不动点（CFP）存在所需的最小标量分量数N*_3 ≈ 9(1)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于N=10的CLAH模型，DC-OD相变为连续相变，属于三维阿贝尔-希格斯（AH）普适类；对于N≤7，相变为弱一级相变；N=8、9的结果不明确。由此估计出三维AH场论中稳定带电不动点（CFP）存在所需的最小标量分量数N*_3 ≈ 9(1)。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟结合有限尺寸标度分析，对N=4至10的体系进行模拟，最大格点尺寸L≈100。

papers.title: Macroscopic evidence of spatial modulation of conductivity in a microtextured ferromagnetic film
papers.abstract: A 75 nm-thick Fe0.5Pt0.5 film is a ferromagnetic metal showing striped magnetic domains in remanence at room temperature. The magnetoresistance is characterized by varying the external temperature and the in-plane magnetic field intensity, thereby affecting its magnetic structure. Qualitatively, the resistivity is well described by using the generalized Ohm's law. High-field magnetotransport properties are successfully explained by considering the competition between the expected metallic behavior and the electron-magnon interaction. In the low-field condition, we size the contribution of the magnetic texture to the macroscopic magnetotransport response by introducing a new quantity. Consistent with the microscopic modulation of the lateral conduction, low-field measurements reveal inhomogeneities attributed to the spatial distribution of ferromagnetic domains and domain walls. By carefully analyzing the macroscopic response near the coercive field, the additional contribution to the resistivity is attributed to the domain walls themselves. In fact, this term could surpass the anisotropic term at low temperatures. In summary, this study demonstrates that spatial magnetic inhomogeneities are not only macroscopically measurable but also comparable in magnitude to other regularly considered terms, mainly at low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了薄膜的制备（75 nm-thick Fe0.5Pt0.5 film）、磁电阻测量（magnetoresistance is characterized）以及通过改变温度和磁场进行实验。；研究对象：研究对象是厚度为75纳米的铁磁性Fe₀.₅Pt₀.₅薄膜，具体物理现象是条纹状磁畴结构（striped magnetic domains）对宏观电导率（conductivity）的空间调制，以及磁畴壁（domain walls）对电阻的额外贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作通过宏观电输运测量，证明了微结构铁磁薄膜中磁畴和磁畴壁的空间分布会显著调制宏观电阻，且这种由磁不均匀性导致的电阻贡献在低温下甚至可能超过各向异性磁电阻（AMR）项。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作通过宏观电输运测量，证明了微结构铁磁薄膜中磁畴和磁畴壁的空间分布会显著调制宏观电阻，且这种由磁不均匀性导致的电阻贡献在低温下甚至可能超过各向异性磁电阻（AMR）项。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于：1）通过分析低场和矫顽场附近的宏观电阻响应，直接“测量”了磁畴壁对电阻的贡献，并指出该贡献在低温下可与各向异性磁电阻项相比拟；2）证明了空间磁不均匀性不仅在宏观上可测，且其量级在特定条件下（低温）不容忽视。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段是变温（varying external temperature）和变面内磁场（varying in-plane magnetic field intensity）下的磁电阻测量。理论分析上，利用广义欧姆定律（generalized Ohm’s law）定性描述电阻率，并引入了一个新的物理量来量化磁织构（magnetic texture）对宏观磁输运的贡献。

papers.title: Estimates of ground state energies for the quantum SK and 2D-EA model, using deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo mean-field annealing dynamics
papers.abstract: We perform a large scale simulation of quantum annealing in the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) spin glass up to a system size $N=40000$ to estimate its ground state energy using the deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo mean-field Ising dynamics, extending the earlier results (reported in Eur. Phys. J. B {\bf 98}, 226 (2025)). Here we numerically solve the deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo annealing dynamics to obtain the spin configurations and subsequently the ground state energy for a given system size at the end of the annealing (to the desired quantum system at the corresponding values of the transverse field), starting from a quantum paramagnetic state. The method shows high efficiency, with an overall algorithmic cost of $O(N^3)$ in estimating the energy of the ground state. We later extend this method to study the ground state energy of the Edwards-Anderson (EA) spin glass on a square lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：large scale simulation、numerically solve、algorithmic cost。；研究对象：量子Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) 自旋玻璃和二维Edwards-Anderson (EA) 自旋玻璃的基态能量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo平均场退火动力学，对SK模型（系统尺寸达N=40000）和二维方格EA模型进行了大规模模拟，高效估计了其基态能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo平均场退火动力学，对SK模型（系统尺寸达N=40000）和二维方格EA模型进行了大规模模拟，高效估计了其基态能量。；创新点：将deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo平均场退火动力学方法扩展到更大系统尺寸（N=40000）的SK模型，并首次将该方法应用于二维方格EA模型。摘要未突出说明与先前结果（Eur. Phys. J. B 98, 226 (2025)）相比的具体改进。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo平均场伊辛退火动力学，从量子顺磁态开始，在退火结束时（对应特定横向场值）获得自旋构型并计算基态能量。算法整体计算复杂度为O(N³)。

papers.title: Enhanced Density Fluctuations Near a Disordered Chiral Topological Transition
papers.abstract: The universal statistics of density fluctuations of localized quantum states may offer unprecedented opportunities to probe and understand quantum transport in connection with dimensionality, coherence, symmetry and disorder. To date, the possible role of topological phase transitions in the fluctuation statistics is not studied yet. Using a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain subject to off-diagonal disorder (so that chiral symmetry is preserved), this work investigates how a disorder driven topological phase transition impacts on the spatial fluctuations of the logarithmic wave-packet density $\ln P(r)$ at distance $r$ from the initial excitation. Away from the transition, in both topological and trivial localized phases, the standard deviation follows the conventional one-dimensional scaling $σ[\ln P(r)]\sim r^θ$ with $θ\simeq 1/2$. Near the transition, however, the fluctuation growth is enhanced: the fitted exponent $θ$ increases above $1/2$ in a nonmonotonic manner before returning close to $1/2$ at criticality. We interpret this behavior from the energy-resolved density of states and localization length. Near the transition, several energy sectors carry appreciable spectral weight and exhibit competitive decay rates, preventing a single localization scale from dominating the accessible wave-packet tail and thereby enhancing the fluctuations of $\ln P(r)$. Our results establish wave-packet fluctuation statistics as a dynamical diagnostic of disordered chiral topological transitions and motivate broader studies of fluctuation phenomena in disordered topological quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链模型进行数值计算，分析波包密度涨落统计。；研究对象：无序手征拓扑相变附近的密度涨落现象，具体体系为具有非对角无序的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链（保持手征对称性）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序驱动的拓扑相变附近，对数波包密度涨落的标准差增长指数θ从常规一维标度值1/2增大至超过1/2（非单调变化），在临界点附近回落至接近1/2。该增强源于相变附近多个能量区间具有显著谱权重且衰减率相互竞争，导致单一局域化尺度无法主导波包尾部行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序驱动的拓扑相变附近，对数波包密度涨落的标准差增长指数θ从常规一维标度值1/2增大至超过1/2（非单调变化），在临界点附近回落至接近1/2。该增强源于相变附近多个能量区间具有显著谱权重且衰减率相互竞争，导致单一局域化尺度无法主导波包尾部行为。；创新点：首次研究了拓扑相变对局域量子态密度涨落统计的影响，建立了波包涨落统计作为无序手征拓扑相变动力学诊断工具的新方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用具有非对角无序的SSH链模型（保持手征对称性），通过数值计算分析波包密度ln P(r)的空间涨落统计，结合能量分辨态密度和局域化长度进行解释。

papers.title: The flow deep within granular piles
papers.abstract: Grain piles embody the complex mechanics and kinematics of disordered granular materials, including solid-like and fluid-like behaviours, complex kinematics, and preparation history-dependent stress variation. It is widely believed that the bulk of a growing pile is static and flow is confined to a thin layer at the surface, but very few studies have investigated the subsurface kinematics. Here we study the flow within conical grain piles by flow imaging experiments and particle dynamics simulations. We provide direct evidence of continuous plastic flow deep within piles as grains are poured from above, and show that the direction of flow varies smoothly from vertical at the symmetry axis to parallel to the surface at the periphery. Our findings provide new insight into the kinematics and rheology of granular media, including the nature of creep in seemingly solid-like regions, and have important implications for geophysical phenomena such as landslides and industrial processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：flow imaging experiments（流动成像实验）和 particle dynamics simulations（颗粒动力学模拟）。；研究对象：颗粒堆（granular piles）内部的流动行为，特别是锥形颗粒堆（conical grain piles）在堆积过程中的次表层运动学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提供了颗粒从上方倾倒时，堆内部深处存在持续塑性流动的直接证据，并揭示了流动方向从对称轴处的垂直方向平滑过渡到边缘处平行于表面的方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提供了颗粒从上方倾倒时，堆内部深处存在持续塑性流动的直接证据，并揭示了流动方向从对称轴处的垂直方向平滑过渡到边缘处平行于表面的方向。；创新点：首次直接观测并证明了颗粒堆内部深处存在连续塑性流动，推翻了以往认为堆积体内部静止、流动仅局限于表面薄层的普遍观点。
papers.method_zh: 流动成像实验（flow imaging experiments）和颗粒动力学模拟（particle dynamics simulations）。

papers.title: Optical Cooling of Nuclear Spins in a CdTe/CdZnTe Quantum Well: The Impact of Kinetic Local Fields on Cooling Efficiency
papers.abstract: The efficiency of optical cooling of nuclear spins in a CdTe/CdZnTe quantum well is investigated as a function of an external magnetic field. Our results confirm that there is indeed an optimal external magnetic field for optical cooling. We associate it with the kinetic local field $B_{KL}$ defined by the heating rate of the spin-spin reservoir due to the fluctuations of the hyperfine interaction. We also propose an experimental technique for measuring $B_{KL}$. For our sample we find that $B_{KL}=1.0\pm0.4$ G and it is independent of the electron polarization and pump power. The measured values of the kinetic local fields are in good agreement with a theoretical calculation $B_{KL} = 0.7$ G, taking into account indirect spin-spin interactions of Cd and Te nuclear spins and their considerably different hyperfine constants. The hyperfine constants of the magnetic isotopes of Cd and Te in CdTe are estimated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：investigated, experimental technique, measured values, our sample）；研究对象：CdTe/CdZnTe量子阱中核自旋的光学冷却效率，以及动力学局域场对冷却效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证实了光学冷却核自旋存在最优外磁场，该最优场与动力学局域场 \( B_{KL} \) 相关；实验测得 \( B_{KL} = 1.0 \pm 0.4 \) G，与理论计算值 0.7 G 吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证实了光学冷却核自旋存在最优外磁场，该最优场与动力学局域场 \( B_{KL} \) 相关；实验测得 \( B_{KL} = 1.0 \pm 0.4 \) G，与理论计算值 0.7 G 吻合。；创新点：将光学冷却的最优外磁场与动力学局域场 \( B_{KL} \) 关联起来，并提出了测量该场的实验方法；同时给出了CdTe中磁性同位素Cd和Te的超精细常数的估计值。
papers.method_zh: 通过改变外磁场测量核自旋光学冷却效率，提出了一种测量动力学局域场 \( B_{KL} \) 的实验技术；理论计算考虑了Cd和Te核自旋的间接自旋-自旋相互作用及其显著不同的超精细常数。

papers.title: Microfluidic Oscillatory Rheology of Transported Soft Particles
papers.abstract: Microfluidic channels have emerged as useful tools to control dynamic forcing on transported microscale objects, as encountered in emulsions, biological flows, and other soft matter systems. Tailored channel designs enable precise interfacial and bulk rheological measurements of complex materials over a wide range of forcing timescales. After a brief overview of recent experiments illustrating these techniques, we discuss perspectives for future research in this direction, including the study of lubrication films in highly confined droplets, the measurement of fast relaxation dynamics of complex interfaces, and the high-throughput rheological characterization of microscopic soft matter systems ranging from single macromolecules to cells.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述+展望）。关键词：overview of recent experiments, perspectives for future research。；研究对象：微流控通道中输运的软颗粒（如乳液、生物流体中的微观物体）及其流变学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，主要强调微流控通道可用于对输运中的微观物体施加动态力，并实现宽时间尺度下的界面和体相流变测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，主要强调微流控通道可用于对输运中的微观物体施加动态力，并实现宽时间尺度下的界面和体相流变测量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出未来研究方向包括：高受限液滴中的润滑膜研究、复杂界面的快速弛豫动力学测量、以及从单分子到细胞的高通量流变学表征。
papers.method_zh: 微流控实验技术，包括定制通道设计用于界面和体相流变学测量。

papers.title: Accelerated Discovery of Nitrogen-Coordinated Dual-Atom Hydrogen Evolution Reaction Electrocatalysts via Machine Learning Potentials
papers.abstract: The hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) is central to sustainable hydrogen production, and nitrogen coordinated dual atom catalysts (DACs) offer a promising route to noble metal activity at low cost. Yet their vast compositional and coordination design space remains underexplored, as density functional theory (DFT) screening at scale is prohibitive. Here, we map the HER landscape of graphene supported TM2@Nx-Gr DACs, screening 23 transition metals across 20 nitrogen coordination motifs using a machine learning potential (MLP) benchmarked against DFT. Intermediate coordination (2N to 4N) consistently yields near-optimal ΔGH*, with Ti2@2Na, Mn2@2Na, Fe2@2Na, Cu2@2Na, Rh2@2Na, Zr2@2Na, Zr2@2Nb, Zr2@2Nc, Nb2@2Nc, Zr2@2Nd, Mn2@2Ne, Mn2@2Nf, Ti2@3Na, Au2@3Na, Fe2@3Na, Pd2@3Nb, Rh2@3Nc, Rh2@3Nd, Au2@3Nd, V2@4Na, Ti2@4Nb, Pd2@4Nb, Ti2@4Nc, Cr2@4Nd, Ni2@4Nd, Cu2@4Nd emerging as standout, synthesizable candidates, most exhibiting metallic or narrow gap (<0.25 eV) character. The MLP reaches near-DFT accuracy, with a mean absolute error of 80 meV for Gibbs binding free energies at orders of magnitude lower computational cost, establishing MLP driven screening as a practical engine for next-generation catalyst discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning potential (MLP)、density functional theory (DFT) screening、Gibbs binding free energies。；研究对象：石墨烯负载的氮配位双原子催化剂（TM₂@Nx-Gr DACs），用于析氢反应（HER）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中等氮配位数（2N至4N）的催化剂普遍具有接近最优的氢吸附吉布斯自由能（ΔGH*），并筛选出26种性能突出且可合成的候选催化剂，其中多数具有金属性或窄带隙（<0.25 eV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中等氮配位数（2N至4N）的催化剂普遍具有接近最优的氢吸附吉布斯自由能（ΔGH*），并筛选出26种性能突出且可合成的候选催化剂，其中多数具有金属性或窄带隙（<0.25 eV）。；创新点：利用机器学习势（MLP）实现了接近DFT精度的HER催化剂筛选（平均绝对误差80 meV），同时将计算成本降低数个数量级，从而能够高效探索传统DFT难以覆盖的庞大组分与配位空间。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习势（MLP）进行高通量筛选，以密度泛函理论（DFT）为基准进行校准。具体筛选了23种过渡金属与20种氮配位构型的组合，计算了氢吸附吉布斯自由能。

papers.title: Breaking Bipartite and Time Reversal Symmetries by Fusing Porphine Unit in-between two Zigzag-edge Graphene Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: Hybrid structure of two zigzag-edge graphene nanoribbons with a fused porphine ring in between, results in two distinct nearly degenerate ground states: a semiconducting antiferromagnetic state and a conducting ferromagnetic state with unequal and opposite Fermi velocities of majority and minority spins, the former having slightly higher stability. Such ground states result from the broken bipartite symmetry induced by the porphine ring. The incorporation of different transition metal atoms in the porphine cavity reduces their energy difference but keeps their electronic properties mostly unchanged. The splitting of the $d$-orbitals in the distorted square-planar ligand field of porphine produces a high spin ground state that breaks the global time reversal symmetry ($\mathcal{T}$). The opposite Fermi velocities of the majority and minority spins in the ferromagnetic ground state and lower sensitivity of the conducting majority spin channel to the edge disorder, make this class of quasi-one-dimensional hybrid structures promising for dual spin-filtering device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验手段，主要基于电子结构计算分析（如d轨道分裂、费米速度计算），属于理论建模与计算研究。；研究对象：由两个锯齿型石墨烯纳米带（zigzag-edge graphene nanoribbons）中间融合一个卟啉环（porphine ring）构成的准一维杂化结构，以及在该卟啉空腔中嵌入不同过渡金属原子后的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该杂化结构存在两个近简并的基态：一个半导体反铁磁态和一个导电铁磁态（后者中多数自旋与少数自旋具有不等且相反的费米速度），且反铁磁态稳定性略高。卟啉环破坏了体系的二分对称性，而过渡金属的d轨道在畸变四方平面配位场中分裂产生高自旋基态，从而打破全局时间反演对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该杂化结构存在两个近简并的基态：一个半导体反铁磁态和一个导电铁磁态（后者中多数自旋与少数自旋具有不等且相反的费米速度），且反铁磁态稳定性略高。卟啉环破坏了体系的二分对称性，而过渡金属的d轨道在畸变四方平面配位场中分裂产生高自旋基态，从而打破全局时间反演对称性。；创新点：首次提出通过融合卟啉单元在锯齿型石墨烯纳米带之间，同时打破二分对称性和时间反演对称性，并发现由此产生的具有相反费米速度的铁磁态可用于双自旋过滤器件。摘要未突出说明与已有石墨烯纳米带/卟啉杂化结构研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的电子结构计算，具体分析了能带结构、自旋极化、费米速度、d轨道分裂以及边缘无序对输运的影响。摘要未明确提及具体泛函形式（如DFT+U）或软件包。

papers.title: Criticality in the disordered $N$-color Ashkin-Teller model
papers.abstract: The $N$-color Ashkin-Teller model corresponds to $N$ Ising models coupled by four-spin interactions. We consider the two-dimensional case in presence of quenched disorder and use scale invariant scattering theory to determine all the solutions of the exact renormalization group fixed points equations. The weak disorder sector is characterized by a solution that, for any fixed $N$ larger than 1, is a line of fixed points with Ising thermal exponents and continuously varying magnetic exponents. The number of fixed point solutions allowed by the symmetries of the model increases at strong disorder illustrating the growing dependence on the distributions of the two random couplings. The presence of some critical exponents which do not depend on the symmetry parameter $N$ confirms this type of superuniversality as a peculiar feature of random criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“scale invariant scattering theory”、“exact renormalization group fixed points equations”。；研究对象：无序N色Ashkin-Teller模型，即由四自旋相互作用耦合的N个伊辛模型，在二维情况下的临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱无序区域，对于任意N>1，存在一条具有伊辛热力学指数和连续变化磁指数的固定点线；在强无序区域，固定点解的数量增加，且部分临界指数不依赖于对称性参数N，体现了随机临界性中的“超普适性”特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱无序区域，对于任意N>1，存在一条具有伊辛热力学指数和连续变化磁指数的固定点线；在强无序区域，固定点解的数量增加，且部分临界指数不依赖于对称性参数N，体现了随机临界性中的“超普适性”特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用标度不变散射理论（scale invariant scattering theory）求解精确重整化群不动点方程。

papers.title: A trick of the tail: how electrostatics helps a DNA repair enzyme to localize on nucleosomes
papers.abstract: Electrostatic interactions are key to the recognition processes of proteins and DNA and have been previously documented for the action of repair enzymes. Uracil-DNA glycosylase (UDG) is the first in a sequence of enzymes that act in the base-excision repair process (BER) and whose task is the extraction of uracil bases from nuclear DNA. The question of how the molecule targets uracil bases in chromatin, in particular in the condensed protein-DNA complexes of nucleosomes, has only recently become a subject of detailed studies. Here we show that the presence of an arginine anchor motif on the N-terminal tail of UDG can favor its localization on nucleosomes by binding to their acidic patches on their top and bottom surfaces via electrostatic interactions. We argue that this mechanism can play a key role in the detection of uracil defects in nucleosomal DNA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：show, argue, mechanism，通过计算和理论分析论证静电相互作用机制）；研究对象：DNA修复酶（尿嘧啶-DNA糖基化酶，UDG）在核小体上的定位机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: UDG的N端尾部含有的精氨酸锚定基序，能够通过静电相互作用与核小体顶部和底部的酸性斑块结合，从而促进该酶在核小体上的定位。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：UDG的N端尾部含有的精氨酸锚定基序，能够通过静电相互作用与核小体顶部和底部的酸性斑块结合，从而促进该酶在核小体上的定位。；创新点：揭示了UDG的N端尾部（而非其核心催化结构域）在识别和定位到核小体上的关键作用，为理解DNA修复酶如何在染色质凝聚态（核小体）中靶向尿嘧啶缺陷提供了新的机制。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的研究方法（如分子动力学模拟、静电势计算等），仅描述了基于静电相互作用的机制分析。

papers.title: Zeeman Pumping of Higgs Bosons in the Balian--Werthamer State
papers.abstract: Based on equations of motion of an SO(5) pseudo-spin, we demonstrate a quantum quench protocol using the magnetic pulse to excite an $\textit{undamped}$ heavy Higgs boson in the Balian--Werthamer superfluid (or superconductor). To achieve that, it is essential to include the dipolar interaction in the effective Hamiltonian and to calculate the ground state self-consistently. The pumped heavy Higgs mode has the twisted angular momentum $J=2$ with the projection $J^{\,}_z=0$ and couples to a well-known light Higgs mode ($J=1$, $J^{\,}_z=0$). The numerical method of 26-point Lebedev quadrature is implemented concretely so as to observe the real-time coupled oscillation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：基于运动方程、理论协议、数值方法。；研究对象：Balian-Werthamer (BW) 态中的希格斯玻色子。BW态是超流（或超导）的一种特定配对态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种利用磁脉冲激发BW超流（或超导）中无阻尼的重希格斯玻色子的量子淬火协议。该重希格斯模式具有扭曲角动量J=2且投影J_z=0，并与已知的轻希格斯模式（J=1, J_z=0）耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种利用磁脉冲激发BW超流（或超导）中无阻尼的重希格斯玻色子的量子淬火协议。该重希格斯模式具有扭曲角动量J=2且投影J_z=0，并与已知的轻希格斯模式（J=1, J_z=0）耦合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于SO(5)赝自旋的运动方程，在有效哈密顿量中包含了偶极相互作用，并自洽地计算了基态。具体数值方法采用了26点Lebedev求积法来观察实时的耦合振荡。

papers.title: Geometry and localization: Probing Localization Landscape Theory on the Bethe Lattice
papers.abstract: The Localization Landscape Theory (LLT) offers a classical analogy for understanding Anderson localization through an effective confining potential, whose percolation threshold has been proposed to mark the mobility edge. While this correspondence shows striking numerical agreement in three dimensions, its theoretical foundations remain an open question. In this work, we extend the analysis of the LLT on the Bethe lattice presented in~\cite{Tonetti2026}. In this setting in both the Anderson localization transition and the LLT percolation problem admit exact solutions. Our analysis reveals that the two transitions are distinct, with markedly different critical behaviors. Notably, the LLT percolation transition falls into the standard mean-field universality class, in sharp contrast with the unconventional critical behavior of the Anderson transition on the Bethe lattice. Nonetheless, the LLT framework reproduces several exact results, capturing nontrivial features of the very low-disorder regime: it predicts the position of the isolated eigenvalue, the minimal disorder at which both the LLT percolation curve and the mobility edge first appear, and the Aizenman--Warzel lower bound for localization. We also study the dependence of the LLT percolation threshold on the energy shift, evaluate the LLT prediction for the Density of States, and derive several results on the statistical properties of the variables controlling the problem. Finally, we develop an extreme-value analysis showing that the LLT prediction for the Density of States overestimates the amplitude of the tails close to the boundary of the continuous spectrum. These findings provide an exact analytical benchmark showing that, despite its geometric appeal, the LLT does not generally reproduce the quantum critical properties of Anderson localization, while still offering a powerful tool to understand its very low-disorder regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论分析、解析解、临界行为、统计性质。；研究对象：Bethe格点上的Anderson局域化与局域化景观理论（LLT）的渗透问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Bethe格点上，Anderson局域化转变与LLT渗透转变是两种不同的相变，具有截然不同的临界行为；LLT渗透转变属于标准平均场普适类，而Anderson转变则表现出非传统临界行为。尽管如此，LLT框架仍能准确再现极低无序区域的一些精确结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Bethe格点上，Anderson局域化转变与LLT渗透转变是两种不同的相变，具有截然不同的临界行为；LLT渗透转变属于标准平均场普适类，而Anderson转变则表现出非传统临界行为。尽管如此，LLT框架仍能准确再现极低无序区域的一些精确结果。；创新点：在Bethe格点上严格证明了LLT渗透转变与Anderson局域化转变不属于同一普适类，澄清了LLT在量子临界性质上的局限性，同时揭示了其在极低无序区域仍能提供有效预测的精确解析基准。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bethe格点上的解析求解，对Anderson局域化转变与LLT渗透问题进行比较分析；包括对渗透阈值、态密度、控制变量的统计性质以及极值分析等理论推导。

papers.title: Exact Solution of the Discrete Wormlike Chain Model
papers.abstract: We present an exact solution of the discrete wormlike chain (DWLC) model describing a single semiflexible polymer under arbitrary external force. Through exact closure relations between pair angular correlations and single-site angular densities, we derive complete self-consistent equations determining the free energy functional and all thermodynamic properties without additional approximations. The key innovation is an exact closure relation connecting the pair angular distribution function to the single-site angular density, enabling the exact integration of the entropy functional. We validate the theoretical framework against known limits (rigid rod and random coil regimes), compare with continuum wormlike chain predictions, and demonstrate excellent agreement with recent theoretical results (Marantan \& Mahadevan, 2018). The approach naturally extends to multiple-chain systems and phase transitions, positioning it as a versatile framework for understanding polymer mechanics from the nanoscale to the macroscopic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution、theoretical framework、free energy functional。；研究对象：离散蠕虫链（DWLC）模型描述的单个半柔性聚合物在任意外力下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确的闭合关系，推导出决定自由能泛函和所有热力学性质的自洽方程组，无需额外近似，并验证了该理论在刚性杆和随机线圈极限下与已知结果及连续蠕虫链模型预测高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确的闭合关系，推导出决定自由能泛函和所有热力学性质的自洽方程组，无需额外近似，并验证了该理论在刚性杆和随机线圈极限下与已知结果及连续蠕虫链模型预测高度一致。；创新点：提出了连接对角度分布函数与单点角度密度的精确闭合关系，从而实现了熵泛函的精确积分，避免了传统方法中的近似处理。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用对角度关联与单点角度密度之间的精确闭合关系，推导出完整的自洽方程，并精确积分熵泛函。

papers.title: Spin-Orbit Coupling Effects on the Structural and Electronic Properties of Planar Pentagonal p-MS$_{2}$ (M = Si, Ge, and Pb)
papers.abstract: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) plays an important role in determining the structural and electronic properties of recently proposed two-dimensional planar pentagonal materials. In this work, density functional theory calculations are employed to investigate SOC effects in p-MS$_{2}$ systems (M = Si, Ge, and Pb). Our results indicate that the p-SiS$_{2}$ structure is likely unstable, except for p-GeS$_{2}$ and p-PbS$_{2}$. A detailed j-resolved (total angular momentum) orbital analysis reveals that SOC enhances electronic localization, leading to a slight structural contraction and a reconstruction of electronic states near the Fermi level, this effect becoming stronger for heavier M atoms. While p-GeS$_{2}$ remains metallic, SOC drives a metal-semiconductor transition in p-PbS$_{2}$ and opening a quasi-direct band gap of about 0.475 eV. In addition, the conduction band minimum state of p-PbS$_{2}$ exhibits pronounced anisotropy along the S-S bonds. These findings provide insight into SOC-driven structural and electronic reconstruction in planar pentagonal chalcogenides p-MS$_{2}$ and suggest that p-PbS$_{2}$ may be a promising candidate for gas-sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional theory calculations”（密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：二维平面五边形材料p-MS₂（M = Si, Ge, Pb）中自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）对其结构和电子性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SOC增强了电子局域化，导致结构轻微收缩和费米能级附近电子态重构；对于p-PbS₂，SOC驱动了金属-半导体转变，打开约0.475 eV的准直接带隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SOC增强了电子局域化，导致结构轻微收缩和费米能级附近电子态重构；对于p-PbS₂，SOC驱动了金属-半导体转变，打开约0.475 eV的准直接带隙。；创新点：揭示了SOC在平面五边形硫族化物p-MS₂中驱动的结构和电子态重构，并指出p-PbS₂可能成为气体传感应用的候选材料。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，并进行了j分辨（总角动量）轨道分析。

papers.title: Transition metal (group V) doping induced spin and valley polarization in MoS$_2$ monolayer
papers.abstract: Doping in two-dimensional materials has emerged as an effective tool for modulating their electronic properties and thereby enabling their multifunctional applications. In this work, we present a first-principles study on induced effective magnetic moment and metallicity in MoS$_2$ monolayer by substitutional doping of group-5 transition metal (TM) elements -- V, Nb and Ta. From our study, we observe that the V doping induces half-metallicity, whereas metallic characteristics are observed in the case of Nb and Ta doping. Moreover, V and Ta-doped MoS$_2$ monolayers are observed to show total induced magnetic moments of 0.922 and 0.624 $μ_{\rm B}$, respectively. Importantly, the combined effects of strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC), broken inversion symmetry, and structural asymmetry is observed to lead to a permanent valley polarization in the V- and Ta-MoS$_2$ systems. In particular, we observed a valley polarization of 121 and 21 meVs for V and Ta-doped MoS$_2$, respectively. Furthermore, an enhanced piezoelectric coefficient for the doped systems is observed compared to pristine MoS$_2$. Notably, the simultaneous presence of half-metallicity, substantial valley polarization, and enhanced piezoelectricity in V-doped MoS$_2$ establishes this system as a promising multifunctional platform for next-generation spintronic, valleytronic, and piezoelectric nanodevices. Overall, our findings provide fundamental insights into engineering coupled spin-valley-mechanical degrees of freedom in two-dimensional materials for advanced quantum and nanoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles study”（第一性原理研究）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是第五族过渡金属（V、Nb、Ta）替代掺杂的单层MoS₂，以及由此诱导的自旋极化、谷极化和压电特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: V掺杂使MoS₂单层呈现半金属性，而Nb和Ta掺杂使其呈现金属性；V和Ta掺杂分别诱导出0.922 μ_B和0.624 μ_B的总磁矩，并由于强自旋-轨道耦合、反演对称性破缺和结构不对称性，产生了显著的谷极化（V掺杂为121 meV，Ta掺杂为21 meV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：V掺杂使MoS₂单层呈现半金属性，而Nb和Ta掺杂使其呈现金属性；V和Ta掺杂分别诱导出0.922 μ_B和0.624 μ_B的总磁矩，并由于强自旋-轨道耦合、反演对称性破缺和结构不对称性，产生了显著的谷极化（V掺杂为121 meV，Ta掺杂为21 meV）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles study），具体为基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算方法，考虑了自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）效应。

papers.title: Generation of Bloch Points with Controlled Spin Texture Using Geometrical Boundary Conditions
papers.abstract: Bloch points are three-dimensional topological singularities in magnetization that play a key role in topological transformations of spin textures, such as skyrmion creation or annihilation. While topology often enforces the existence of Bloch points in confined geometries like cylindrical nanowires, deterministic control over their position and magnetic configuration remains challenging. Here we demonstrate the generation of Bloch points with controlled spin texture by engineering geometrical boundary conditions in three-dimensional nanomagnets. By introducing a chirality interface between two three-dimensional double-helix nanowires of opposite handedness, forming a kinked, non-collinear structure, we impose competing topological constraints that uniquely define the magnetization configuration surrounding the Bloch point. A saturating magnetic field nucleates head-to-head or tail-to-tail domain configurations at the chirality interface, producing a Bloch-point domain wall with deterministic polarity, circulation and helicity. This geometrical approach enables full three-dimensional control of Bloch point domain walls allowing deterministic engineering of their spin texture and its selective coupling to current-induced Oersted fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：demonstrate, engineering, geometrical approach, 未提及实验或数值模拟具体手段，但基于几何边界条件的设计与拓扑约束分析，属于理论建模与设计范畴）；研究对象：三维纳米磁体中的布洛赫点（Bloch points），特别是双螺旋纳米线中由手性界面产生的布洛赫点畴壁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计三维纳米磁体的几何边界条件（如构建相反手性的双螺旋纳米线之间的手性界面），可以确定性生成具有可控自旋织构（极性、旋向、螺旋性）的布洛赫点，并实现其与电流感应奥斯特场的选择性耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计三维纳米磁体的几何边界条件（如构建相反手性的双螺旋纳米线之间的手性界面），可以确定性生成具有可控自旋织构（极性、旋向、螺旋性）的布洛赫点，并实现其与电流感应奥斯特场的选择性耦合。；创新点：提出一种纯几何方法（而非依赖材料参数或外场调控）实现对布洛赫点位置、磁组态（极性、旋向、螺旋性）的完全三维控制，并展示了其与电流感应奥斯特场的可控耦合。
papers.method_zh: 几何边界条件工程（geometrical boundary conditions），通过构造扭结非共线结构（kinked, non-collinear structure）施加竞争性拓扑约束，并利用饱和磁场在界面处成核头对头或尾对尾畴结构。

papers.title: Thickness-driven crossover from conventional to chiral nonreciprocal superconductivity in kagome metal CsV3Sb5
papers.abstract: Superconductivity and its potential applications are governed by the symmetry of the superconducting order parameter. In the kagome metal CsV3Sb5, most bulk studies indicate conventional s-wave pairing. However, ultrathin flakes exhibit nonreciprocal transport, in particular a zero-field superconducting diode effect, which requires broken inversion and time-reversal symmetries. Here, using thickness dependent transport measurements, we observe the emergence of non-reciprocal second-harmonic magnetotransport signals and a zero-field superconducting diode effect, accompanied by a pronounced reduction of the out-of-plane coherence length with decreasing thickness. Upper critical field measurements further reveal a dimensional crossover from three-dimensional superconductivity in bulk to two-dimensional superconductivity in thin flakes. These findings indicate a thickness-induced chiral superconducting phase that breaks both inversion and time-reversal symmetries in the two-dimensional limit. Our work not only clarifies long-standing controversies regarding the pairing symmetry in CsV3Sb5, but also establishes thin-flake kagome superconductors as a versatile platform for engineering nonreciprocal quantum devices and exploring emergent topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“using thickness dependent transport measurements”（使用厚度依赖的输运测量）、“observe the emergence of...”（观察到...的出现）等实验观测手段。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是笼目（kagome）金属 CsV₃Sb₅，具体物理现象是超导电性，特别是从常规超导到手性非互易超导的厚度驱动转变，以及伴随的零场超导二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CsV₃Sb₅薄片中，随着厚度减小，体系从三维常规s波超导转变为二维手性超导相，该相同时破缺了空间反演对称性和时间反演对称性，并表现出非互易输运和零场超导二极管效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CsV₃Sb₅薄片中，随着厚度减小，体系从三维常规s波超导转变为二维手性超导相，该相同时破缺了空间反演对称性和时间反演对称性，并表现出非互易输运和零场超导二极管效应。；创新点：该工作首次通过厚度调控，在CsV₃Sb₅中观测到从常规超导到手性非互易超导的维度交叉，并直接关联了二维极限下同时破缺反演和时间反演对称性的超导相。这澄清了该材料中关于配对对称性的长期争议，并建立了薄层笼目超导体作为设计非互易量子器件的平台。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了厚度依赖的输运测量（thickness dependent transport measurements），具体包括：二次谐波磁输运信号测量（non-reciprocal second-harmonic magnetotransport signals）、零场超导二极管效应测量（zero-field superconducting diode effect）、以及上临界场测量（upper critical field measurements）以确定维度交叉。

papers.title: Finite-temperature micromagnetic model bridging atomic- and macro-scale magnetism
papers.abstract: A multi-scale finite-temperature micromagnetic model is presented, based on the Landau-Lifshitz equation and the Bernoulli differential equation. This model accurately reproduces classic Maxwell magnetostatics of paramagnets for high temperatures and accurately reproduces standard micromagnetics described by the conventional Landau-Lifshitz model in ferromagnets. The Landau-Lifshitz-Bernoulli (LLBe) model can, by design, directly couple atomic-scale simulations with micromagnetics and output consistent predictions of bulk magnetic properties at finite temperatures, from below to above the material's Curie temperature. The LLBe model is validated against established solvers: MUMAX3 for zero-temperature micromagnetics, and FEMCE for high-temperature classic magnetostatics. We present an application of the LLBe model by simulating Heat-Assisted magnetic recording on a thin magnetic track with local heating, demonstrating the multi-scale finite-temperature capabilities of the LLBe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“presented a multi-scale finite-temperature micromagnetic model”，并基于Landau-Lifshitz方程和Bernoulli微分方程构建模型，且与现有求解器（MUMAX3、FEMCE）进行验证对比。；研究对象：多尺度有限温度下的磁性系统，具体包括顺磁体（高温经典Maxwell静磁学）、铁磁体（标准微磁学）以及热辅助磁记录（Heat-Assisted Magnetic Recording）中的薄磁轨道。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的Landau-Lifshitz-Bernoulli（LLBe）模型能够同时准确复现高温顺磁体的经典Maxwell静磁学和铁磁体的标准微磁学，并可在从低于到高于居里温度的有限温度范围内，直接耦合原子尺度模拟与微磁学，输出一致的体磁性质预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的Landau-Lifshitz-Bernoulli（LLBe）模型能够同时准确复现高温顺磁体的经典Maxwell静磁学和铁磁体的标准微磁学，并可在从低于到高于居里温度的有限温度范围内，直接耦合原子尺度模拟与微磁学，输出一致的体磁性质预测。；创新点：该模型（LLBe）能够直接桥接原子尺度模拟与微磁学，并在有限温度下（包括跨居里温度）输出一致的体磁性质预测，实现了从原子尺度到宏观尺度的多尺度有限温度磁性模拟。
papers.method_zh: 基于Landau-Lifshitz方程与Bernoulli微分方程构建多尺度有限温度微磁模型（LLBe模型）。通过与零温度微磁求解器MUMAX3和高温经典静磁求解器FEMCE进行对比验证，并应用于模拟局部加热下薄磁轨道的热辅助磁记录过程。

papers.title: Disentangling Spin Pumping and Two-Magnon Scattering Contributions to Gilbert Damping in YIG/V Bilayers
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the magnetic damping and spin pumping response of YIG-based bilayers incorporating vanadium (V) as the normal metal layer via broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) measurements as a function of YIG thickness. We show that the apparent enhancement of the Gilbert damping in YIG/V bilayers cannot be solely attributed to spin pumping.
