Instead, two-magnon scattering (TMS) plays a dominant role in governing the thickness dependence of the damping in the nanometer regime. By applying a thickness-dependent damping model that accounts for both spin pumping and two-magnon scattering contributions, we successfully disentangle the different relaxation contributions. Our analysis reveals that neglecting two-magnon scattering leads to an overestimation of the spin-pumping contribution and consequently to unphysically large values of the effective spin-mixing conductance. After isolating the intrinsic spin pumping contribution, we extract a thickness-independent effective spin-mixing conductance of $g^{\uparrow\downarrow}_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1.33 \times 10^{18}~\mathrm{m^{-2}}$. These findings provide a more accurate framework for quantifying spin transport parameters in FM/HM systems and emphasize the necessity of accounting for extrinsic damping mechanisms when interpreting spin pumping and inverse spin Hall effect experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) measurements（宽带铁磁共振测量）。；研究对象：YIG（钇铁石榴石）/V（钒）双层膜体系，具体研究其磁阻尼（Gilbert damping）和自旋泵浦（spin pumping）响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: YIG/V双层膜中吉尔伯特阻尼的表观增强不能仅归因于自旋泵浦，双磁子散射（TMS）在纳米尺度下对阻尼的厚度依赖性起主导作用；忽略TMS会导致自旋泵浦贡献被高估，并得到非物理的有效自旋混合电导值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：YIG/V双层膜中吉尔伯特阻尼的表观增强不能仅归因于自旋泵浦，双磁子散射（TMS）在纳米尺度下对阻尼的厚度依赖性起主导作用；忽略TMS会导致自旋泵浦贡献被高估，并得到非物理的有效自旋混合电导值。；创新点：成功区分并定量分离了自旋泵浦与双磁子散射对YIG/V双层膜吉尔伯特阻尼的贡献，纠正了以往仅用自旋泵浦解释阻尼增强时导致的参数高估问题，为铁磁/重金属体系中的自旋输运参数提取提供了更准确的框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用宽带铁磁共振（FMR）测量，通过改变YIG厚度进行系统实验；并应用一个同时考虑自旋泵浦和双磁子散射贡献的厚度依赖阻尼模型，对不同的弛豫贡献进行分离。

papers.title: Revealing quantum metric multipoles in magnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4
papers.abstract: Nonlinear electronic transport has emerged as a powerful probe of the quantum geometry in topological quantum materials, where the band topology and broken symmetries facilitate power law current voltage responses beyond Ohms law. While nonlinear transport of the second and third orders has been studied in several quantum materials, higher-order transport has so far mainly remained experimentally inaccessible, leaving more detailed features of the quantum geometry unexplored. Here, we observe higher order nonlinear electronic transport up to the seventh harmonic order in multilayer magnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4. We find an even-odd behavior where the odd order nonlinear transport components dominate while the even-order ones are suppressed. Temperature and magnetic field dependent measurements show a strong correlation between the nonlinear transport and the magnetic phases of MnBi2Te4. Through scaling analysis and theoretical calculations, quantum metric multipoles and nonlinear Drude conductivities are identified as the microscopic origins of the nonlinear transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：observe, measurements, scaling analysis）；研究对象：多层磁性拓扑绝缘体 MnBi₂Te₄ 中的高阶非线性电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 MnBi₂Te₄ 中观测到了高达第七谐波的高阶非线性电子输运，并发现奇次谐波占主导、偶次谐波被抑制的奇偶行为。通过标度分析和理论计算，确认量子度量多极子和非线性 Drude 电导率是这种非线性输运的微观起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 MnBi₂Te₄ 中观测到了高达第七谐波的高阶非线性电子输运，并发现奇次谐波占主导、偶次谐波被抑制的奇偶行为。通过标度分析和理论计算，确认量子度量多极子和非线性 Drude 电导率是这种非线性输运的微观起源。；创新点：将非线性输运的研究从常见的二阶、三阶拓展到了更高阶（最高七阶），从而揭示了以往实验上难以触及的量子几何更精细的特征（即量子度量多极子）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过测量多层 MnBi₂Te₄ 样品的高阶谐波响应（最高至第七阶）来研究非线性输运；结合变温、变磁场测量，分析非线性输运与材料磁相之间的关联；通过标度分析和理论计算，识别微观机制。

papers.title: Emergence of Dynamical Anisotropy induced by Demixing in a Binary System with Differential Diffusivity under an External Potential
papers.abstract: Spontaneous demixing in active matter is a ubiquitous phenomenon that is crucial for numerous living processes ranging from bacterial swarming to sorting of cells in dense tissues. Here, we systematically investigate the effect of spatially varying potential acting along one direction and packing fraction on the binary mixture of particles with different diffusivities. Our results indicate that the presence of an external potential promotes demixing over a larger range of packing fractions, while also fostering a more pronounced 'hexatic order' within the bands of less diffusive "cold") particles formed near the minima of the potential. The mean-squared displacements (MSD) of "cold" and "hot" particles in different directions exhibit a distinct behavior. In contrast to the long-time sub-diffusive behavior of the "cold" particles, the "hot" ones display diffusive nature following an intermediate plateau. However, in the direction transverse to the applied potential, both types of particles undergo normal diffusion. Furthermore, interesting non-Gaussian characteristics are observed, corresponding to the spatial distribution of the displacement of "hot" and "cold" particles. Interestingly, our results reveal the formation of a 'percolating band', and the emergence of such dynamic anisotropy is not observed in the absence of an external potential. These aspects are highly relevant to the dynamics of various systems-including densely packed tissues, bacterial motility in confined spaces, and granular segregation in the pharmaceutical industry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：systematically investigate、results indicate、mean-squared displacements (MSD)、non-Gaussian characteristics。；研究对象：具有不同扩散率的二元粒子混合物（“冷”粒子与“热”粒子），在外加一维空间变化势场作用下的自发去混现象及动力学各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外加势场在更宽的堆积分数范围内促进去混，并在势阱附近形成“冷”粒子的六角序条带；同时，在垂直于势场方向两种粒子均表现为正常扩散，而在平行方向“冷”粒子呈现长时间亚扩散，“热”粒子则经历中间平台后转为扩散，形成动力学各向异性，且这种各向异性在无外势时不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外加势场在更宽的堆积分数范围内促进去混，并在势阱附近形成“冷”粒子的六角序条带；同时，在垂直于势场方向两种粒子均表现为正常扩散，而在平行方向“冷”粒子呈现长时间亚扩散，“热”粒子则经历中间平台后转为扩散，形成动力学各向异性，且这种各向异性在无外势时不存在。；创新点：首次揭示了外势诱导的“渗流条带”形成以及由此产生的动力学各向异性，该现象在无外势时不存在。摘要未突出说明与已有去混研究相比的具体理论或模型改进。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值模拟（摘要未明确具体算法，如分子动力学或蒙特卡洛）系统研究空间变化势场（沿一方向）和堆积分数对二元混合体系的影响，分析均方位移（MSD）、非高斯位移分布及六角序参数。

papers.title: Nanoparticle manipulation with a carbon fiber tip in an electron microscope for $μ$-SQUID magnetometry
papers.abstract: We report a carbon-fiber-tip based nanomanipulation system integrated into a scanning electron microscope for individual nanoparticle (NP) manipulation on a surface. Electrochemically etched amorphous carbon fiber tips with excellent mechanical rigidity and sub-100 nm apex radii effectively reduce the van der Waals adhesion and enable reliable positioning of about 100 nm size NPs with about 100 nm precision. This system combines a piezoelectric bimorph for vertical tip motion, a four-quadrant piezo-tube for two-dimensional fine tip control and a two-dimensional piezoelectric walker for coarse lateral translation. Using this setup, we successfully position single Fe$_3$O$_4$ magnetic NPs on micron sized superconducting quantum interference devices for optimal magnetic coupling between them and probe a NP's magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“nanomanipulation system integrated into a scanning electron microscope”、“successfully position single Fe₃O₄ magnetic NPs”、“probe a NP's magnetism”。；研究对象：单个Fe₃O₄磁性纳米颗粒在微米级超导量子干涉器件（μ-SQUID）上的操控与磁学探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用碳纤维尖端纳米操控系统，可将约100 nm大小的Fe₃O₄磁性纳米颗粒以约100 nm的精度定位在μ-SQUID上，实现两者之间的最佳磁耦合，并探测单个纳米颗粒的磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用碳纤维尖端纳米操控系统，可将约100 nm大小的Fe₃O₄磁性纳米颗粒以约100 nm的精度定位在μ-SQUID上，实现两者之间的最佳磁耦合，并探测单个纳米颗粒的磁性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：在扫描电子显微镜（SEM）内集成基于碳纤维尖端的纳米操控系统。该系统包括：电化学刻蚀的非晶碳纤维尖端（机械刚性优异、尖端半径小于100 nm）、用于垂直运动的压电双晶片、用于二维精细控制的四象限压电管，以及用于粗调横向移动的二维压电步进器。

papers.title: On certain combinatorial expressions of TASEP transition probabilities
papers.abstract: We study combinatorial structures arising from finite-time transition probabilities of the Totally Asymmetric Simple Exclusion Process with open boundary conditions. While much of the existing combinatorial theory regarding the TASEP concerns the steady-state distribution, we focus instead on the transient dynamics. We first show that the enumeration of transition sequences between two configurations of the open TASEP is equivalent to the enumeration of standard Young tableaux of a family of non-classical shapes which have been of recent interest in the combinatorial literature. This extends to the open-boundary setting the correspondence between the TASEP with periodic boundaries and cylindric tableaux. We then introduce a family of tableau-like objects associated with Young diagrams in which repetitions of cells are allowed, subject to the partial order induced by the diagram. For each diagram, we collect the numbers of these objects into an exponential generating function. We prove that the entries of the homogeneous open TASEP transition matrix can be expressed as signed sums of such generating functions over suitable families of diagrams. This gives a combinatorial and order-theoretic interpretation of finite-time transition probabilities for the open TASEP, analogous to the combinatorial mappings known for steady-state probabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确讨论“组合结构”、“枚举”、“生成函数”、“证明”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：完全不对称简单排斥过程（TASEP）在开放边界条件下的有限时间跃迁概率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开放边界TASEP的跃迁序列枚举等价于一类非经典形状的标准杨表的枚举，且跃迁矩阵元可表示为特定杨图相关对象的指数生成函数的带符号和。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开放边界TASEP的跃迁序列枚举等价于一类非经典形状的标准杨表的枚举，且跃迁矩阵元可表示为特定杨图相关对象的指数生成函数的带符号和。；创新点：将已知的周期边界TASEP与柱面杨表的对应关系推广到开放边界情形，并首次给出开放TASEP有限时间跃迁概率的组合与序理论解释，此前相关组合理论主要关注稳态分布。
papers.method_zh: 组合数学与代数方法：利用标准杨表、杨图、偏序集、指数生成函数等工具，建立开放边界TASEP有限时间跃迁概率与组合对象之间的对应关系。

papers.title: Shear Viscosity at the van Hove singularity
papers.abstract: The applicability of the semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory is fundamentally challenged in strongly correlated systems where quasiparticle excitations are ill-defined. When the fermion spectral broadening becomes much larger than the boson broadening, the Boltzmann approach to transport is not always valid, particularly in the dirty limit of the critical regime. Using a diagrammatic Kubo formalism, we compute several critical transport coefficients at a van Hove singularity and show that, while the conductivity happens to agree with the Boltzmann result, the dc shear viscosity exhibits qualitatively different behavior. The diagrammatic Kubo results are more reliable because, under the fermion sharp peak approximation--an assumption that strictly breaks down in the dirty critical limit--we demonstrate that the leading order Feynman diagrams reduce to the Boltzmann equation. The same critical model, which can also account for strange metal, makes experimentally testable predictions for the optical and dc shear viscosities, ${\rm Re}[η(Ω)]\sim (|Ω|^{3/2}+T^{3/2})/Ω^2$ and ${\rm Re}[η(Ω=0)]\sim T$, providing further opportunities to assess the validity of our theoretical framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：diagrammatic Kubo formalism、Boltzmann transport theory、Feynman diagrams。；研究对象：van Hove奇点（van Hove singularity）附近的剪切粘滞系数（shear viscosity）等输运系数，以及与之相关的奇异金属（strange metal）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在van Hove奇点处，电导率与玻尔兹曼输运理论结果一致，但直流剪切粘滞系数表现出定性不同的行为；理论预测光学和直流剪切粘滞系数分别满足 Re[η(Ω)]∼(|Ω|^(3/2)+T^(3/2))/Ω² 和 Re[η(Ω=0)]∼T。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在van Hove奇点处，电导率与玻尔兹曼输运理论结果一致，但直流剪切粘滞系数表现出定性不同的行为；理论预测光学和直流剪切粘滞系数分别满足 Re[η(Ω)]∼(|Ω|^(3/2)+T^(3/2))/Ω² 和 Re[η(Ω=0)]∼T。；创新点：揭示了在准粒子激发定义不清的强关联体系中，玻尔兹曼输运理论在脏临界极限下不适用于剪切粘滞系数，而图解Kubo方法更为可靠；给出了可实验检验的粘滞系数标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用图解Kubo形式论（diagrammatic Kubo formalism）计算临界输运系数；通过费米子锐峰近似（fermion sharp peak approximation）论证了领头阶费曼图可约化为玻尔兹曼方程，并指出该近似在脏极限（dirty critical limit）下严格失效。

papers.title: Alternative origins of polarity in compressively strained SrTiO3-RENiO3 capacitors
papers.abstract: Since its original prediction 25 years ago, room-temperature out-of-plane ferroelectricity in compressively strained SrTiO3 remains an ongoing pursuit. In this work, we investigate the structural, electrical and electromechanical properties of highly strained epitaxial SrTiO3 capacitors with rare earth nickelate electrodes. The SrTiO3 layers experience compressive strains up to -3% and exhibit pronounced tetragonality, comparable to that of bulk PbTiO3. Variable-temperature electrical measurements and room-temperature piezoresponse force microscopy reveal butterfly-shaped capacitance-voltage hysteresis and domain-like electromechanical response typical of ferroelectric materials. However, the overall behavior is inconsistent with a stable ferroelectric state. We therefore propose an alternative mechanism for the observed polarity in our samples based on spatially inhomogeneous internal fields. Our first-principles calculations show that such fields may arise from charge discontinuities between the formally charged NdNiO3 layers and charge-neutral SrTiO3 layers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：实验部分涉及结构、电学和电机械性能测量（变温电学测量、压电力显微镜），计算部分包含第一性原理计算。；研究对象：压缩应变下 SrTiO₃（钛酸锶）与稀土镍酸盐（RENiO₃）电极构成的电容器，具体研究其极性行为的起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高度压缩应变（高达-3%）的 SrTiO₃ 薄膜中观察到类似铁电体的电容-电压回滞和电机械响应，但整体行为与稳定铁电态不一致。作者提出极性源于空间不均匀的内建电场，该电场可能由带电的 NdNiO₃ 层与电荷中性的 SrTiO₃ 层之间的电荷不连续性引起。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高度压缩应变（高达-3%）的 SrTiO₃ 薄膜中观察到类似铁电体的电容-电压回滞和电机械响应，但整体行为与稳定铁电态不一致。作者提出极性源于空间不均匀的内建电场，该电场可能由带电的 NdNiO₃ 层与电荷中性的 SrTiO₃ 层之间的电荷不连续性引起。；创新点：提出压缩应变 SrTiO₃ 中观察到的极性行为并非源于本征铁电性，而是由异质结界面的电荷不连续性导致的空间不均匀内建电场所致。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：变温电学测量、室温压电力显微镜（PFM）。计算方法：第一性原理计算（具体方法如 DFT 等，摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Synthesizability, hardness, and stacking order in multicomponent transition metal carbides from machine-learned potentials
papers.abstract: Multicomponent transition metal carbides are promising for extreme-environment applications, but identifying compositions that are both synthesizable and hard remains challenging. We fine-tune the MACE machine-learned interatomic potential on approximately 28,000 density functional theory calculations spanning the composition space of groups 4-6 transition metals and carbon to predict the thermodynamic stability and elastic properties of multicomponent carbides. The fine-tuned model achieves formation energy errors of ~ 10 meV/atom for thermodynamically relevant structures with only 20% of the training data. We screen over 1500 equiatomic compositions across rocksalt, hexagonal, and hcp prototypes, combining free energy models with elasticity-based hardness surrogates. Synthesizability predictions at 1500°C agree well with experimental reports for both single-phase and multiphase carbides. The group number of the constituent metals governs both stability and hardness. Free energy contributions from short-range order are small, typically a few meV/atom, indicating that a perfectly disordered solid solution provides a reasonable approximation for high-throughput screening. For compositions mixing group 4/5 and group 6 metals, we identify a new family of stacking-ordered phases with formation energies well below those of disordered rocksalt or hexagonal structures. DFT calculations corroborate these predictions and suggest that stacking-ordered phases should be experimentally accessible in multicomponent carbides. This study provides a framework for screening synthesizable multicomponent materials with target properties, identifies promising carbide compositions across the full nine-component space, and reveals a new class of stacking-ordered carbides accessible only in multicomponent compositions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine-learned potentials、density functional theory calculations、fine-tune、screen、predict。；研究对象：多组分过渡金属碳化物（multicomponent transition metal carbides），涵盖第4-6族过渡金属与碳的组合，具体包括岩盐、六方和hcp原型结构中的等原子比组分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一类新的堆垛有序相（stacking-ordered phases），其形成能远低于无序岩盐或六方结构，且DFT计算表明这些相在实验上应可合成；同时，组成金属的族数同时决定了稳定性和硬度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一类新的堆垛有序相（stacking-ordered phases），其形成能远低于无序岩盐或六方结构，且DFT计算表明这些相在实验上应可合成；同时，组成金属的族数同时决定了稳定性和硬度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用MACE机器学习原子间势（machine-learned interatomic potential），在约28,000个DFT计算数据上微调，结合自由能模型和基于弹性的硬度代理指标（elasticity-based hardness surrogates），对超过1500种等原子比组分进行高通量筛选。

papers.title: Dynamic charges effect on infrared dielectric response of polar materials
papers.abstract: Predictive modeling of the infrared dielectric function in polar materials is crucial for thermal management and infrared devices design. While the Green-Kubo molecular dynamics (MD) framework provides a nonperturbative route to compute dielectric responses from dipole fluctuations, yet it commonly relies on the fixed-charge approximation that neglects dynamic charge redistribution during atomic motion. Here, we employ a machine-learning neuroevolution potential with dynamic charges (qNEP) combined with Green-Kubo MD to investigate the dynamic charge effect on the infrared dielectric response of rutile TiO$_2$, a material with large Born effective charges (BEC). Our results show that dynamic charge effects become increasingly important at elevated temperatures and are essential for accurately predicting longitudinal optical phonon features and infrared reflectance. This work establishes that accurate prediction of infrared optical properties in polar materials under thermal excitation requires explicit treatment of dynamic charge evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：Green-Kubo molecular dynamics (MD) framework、machine-learning neuroevolution potential、computational modeling。；研究对象：极性材料（polar materials）的红外介电响应，具体以金红石相二氧化钛（rutile TiO₂）为模型体系，该材料具有大的玻恩有效电荷（BEC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 动态电荷效应在高温下对极性材料的红外介电响应至关重要，忽略该效应将无法准确预测纵向光学声子特征和红外反射率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：动态电荷效应在高温下对极性材料的红外介电响应至关重要，忽略该效应将无法准确预测纵向光学声子特征和红外反射率。；创新点：突破了传统固定电荷近似（fixed-charge approximation）的局限，首次在Green-Kubo MD框架中引入动态电荷演化，揭示了动态电荷效应对高温下红外光学性质预测的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习神经进化势（qNEP）结合格林-久保分子动力学（Green-Kubo MD）框架，通过偶极涨落非微扰地计算介电响应，并显式考虑原子运动过程中的动态电荷重新分布。

papers.title: Hole-doped superconductivity above 100 K in infinite-layer cuprate thin films
papers.abstract: Since the discovery of superconductivity in (La,Ba)2CuO2 (Ref.~\cite{bednorz1986possible}), a broad family of structurally distinct cuprate superconductors has been proposed or engineered to elucidate the physics of high-temperature superconductivity~\cite{chu2015hole,plakida2010high}. Among them, the infinite-layer cuprate has the simplest structure, consisting only of the essential ingredients for superconductivity: CuO$_2$ square planes separated by spacer ions~\cite{siegrist1988parent}. Despite being proposed nearly 40 years ago, the hole-doped superconductivity via chemical substitution in this compound has not yet been achieved, a fundamental open question in the field. Here, we report the observation of superconductivity in the hole-doped infinite-layer cuprate thin film. Measurements of resistivity and magnetic-field response in Sr1-xRbxCuO2 single-crystal thin films show superconducting transitions with a high onset temperature of 100 K. Hole doping is achieved via the synergistic effect of rubidium substitution and apical oxygen incorporation, as evidenced by structural analysis and transport measurements. As the parent structure of the cuprate family~\cite{chu2015hole}, hole-doped infinite-layer cuprate provides a unique platform for revisiting key puzzles in cuprate superconductors~\cite{keimer2015quantum,tsuei2000pairing,armitage2010progress,dagotto1994correlated}, including strange metal~\cite{proust2019remarkable,taillefer2010scattering} and electron-hole symmetry~\cite{tohyama2004asymmetry,segawa2010zero,lee2014asymmetry}, while bridging to cuprate-nickelate symmetry~\cite{li2019superconductivity,zeng2022superconductivity,chow2025bulk,lechermann2020late}.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“测量了电阻率和磁场响应”、“单晶薄膜”、“结构分析和输运测量”。；研究对象：空穴掺杂的无限制层铜氧化物薄膜（Sr1-xRbxCuO2单晶薄膜）。具体物理现象是超导电性，特别是通过化学替代实现空穴掺杂后的高温超导转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在空穴掺杂的无限制层铜氧化物Sr1-xRbxCuO2单晶薄膜中，观测到了起始温度高达100 K的超导转变。这是该化合物自提出近40年来首次实现空穴掺杂超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在空穴掺杂的无限制层铜氧化物Sr1-xRbxCuO2单晶薄膜中，观测到了起始温度高达100 K的超导转变。这是该化合物自提出近40年来首次实现空穴掺杂超导电性。；创新点：首次在无限制层铜氧化物中通过化学替代（铷替代锶）成功实现了空穴掺杂，并观测到超导电性。此前，尽管该结构被认为是铜氧化物超导体的母体结构，但空穴掺杂超导一直未能实现。该工作填补了这一长期空白。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：电阻率测量、磁场响应测量（用于确定超导转变）、结构分析（用于表征掺杂效果）以及输运测量。薄膜制备方法摘要未明确说明，但提及了“单晶薄膜”。

papers.title: Tetrahedrally ferromagnetic correlations and a glassy-freezing anomaly in the breathing pyrochlore magnet $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$ with partial $A$-site disorder
papers.abstract: We investigate the chromium breathing pyrochlore sulfide $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$, a chromium-based thiospinel, by synchrotron x-ray and neutron powder diffraction, dc magnetization, and heat capacity. Diffraction confirms the $F\bar{4}3m$ breathing structure with alternating large and small $\mathrm{Cr_4}$ tetrahedra, a large breathing ratio ($d^\prime/d = 1.106$ at 300 K), and substantial Ag/In intermixing on the $A$ sublattice ($\sim 16\%$). No structural transition or magnetic Bragg peaks are detected down to 1.5 K. An enlarged low-angle difference plot between the 1.5 and 20 K neutron diffraction patterns shows a weak broad diffuse-like enhancement, consistent with short-range or frozen correlated moments within the sensitivity of the present data. Susceptibility yields a positive Weiss temperature $θ_{\mathrm{W}} = +92$ K and a moment enhancement in 30--60 K, while the magnetic entropy released by $\sim 30$ K approaches a scale of order $R\ln 13$, together consistent with the development of short-range tetrahedral ferromagnetic correlations and an effective $S = 6$ cluster-moment picture. A broad susceptibility cusp with ZFC--FC bifurcation and a low-temperature specific heat anomaly near 9 K indicate a phenomenological glassy-freezing anomaly without long-range order. $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$ provides a benchmark for the interplay of strong breathing distortion and quenched $A$-site disorder in chromium breathing pyrochlores.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“synchrotron x-ray and neutron powder diffraction, dc magnetization, and heat capacity”等实验手段。；研究对象：具有部分A位无序的呼吸烧绿石磁体 $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$。具体而言，研究其晶体结构、磁性和热力学性质，特别是短程铁磁关联和玻璃态冻结行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$ 在低温下未形成长程磁有序，而是展现出短程四面体铁磁关联（有效自旋 $S=6$ 团簇图像）和一个在约 9 K 附近的玻璃态冻结异常。该现象源于强呼吸畸变与淬火A位无序的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：$\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$ 在低温下未形成长程磁有序，而是展现出短程四面体铁磁关联（有效自旋 $S=6$ 团簇图像）和一个在约 9 K 附近的玻璃态冻结异常。该现象源于强呼吸畸变与淬火A位无序的共同作用。；创新点：首次在具有强呼吸畸变（呼吸比1.106）和显著A位无序（~16% Ag/In互溶）的铬基硫族呼吸烧绿石中，系统揭示了短程铁磁关联与玻璃态冻结异常之间的关联，为理解此类体系中无序与几何阻挫的相互作用提供了基准。
papers.method_zh: 同步辐射X射线和中子粉末衍射（确定晶体结构、呼吸比、Ag/In互溶度及磁结构）、直流磁化率测量（确定居里-外斯温度、磁矩增强及ZFC-FC分叉）、比热测量（确定磁熵变及低温异常）。

papers.title: Effective Theory of Fermion Quartet Condensation
papers.abstract: We develop a theory of superconductivity (or superfluidity) based on condensed fermion quartets focusing on the dilute spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ systems at zero temperature. In the spirit of the Bardeen--Cooper--Schrieffer ansatz, a variational wavefunction is constructed such that, within the so-called ``dilute quartet approximation", it is the ground state of an effective quartic Hamiltonian. For a given two-body interaction in favor of quartetting, the gap parameter is suitably defined and the gap equation is also derived. As to the excited states, an intuitive physical picture based on a sixteen-dimensional ``occupation space" is depicted and the associated eigen-energies are obtained. This theory is applied to compute the superfluid fraction, which is found to be the same as in conventional superconductors, despite the interacting nature of the quartet problem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a theory、variational wavefunction、gap equation、derived。；研究对象：基于费米子四重态凝聚的超导（或超流）理论，具体聚焦于零温下稀薄的自旋-1/2费米子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在“稀薄四重态近似”下，构建了变分波函数作为有效四次哈密顿量的基态，并推导了相应的能隙方程；计算得到的超流分数与传统超导体相同，尽管四重态问题具有相互作用性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在“稀薄四重态近似”下，构建了变分波函数作为有效四次哈密顿量的基态，并推导了相应的能隙方程；计算得到的超流分数与传统超导体相同，尽管四重态问题具有相互作用性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bardeen–Cooper–Schrieffer（BCS）变分波函数思想，在“稀薄四重态近似”下构建有效四次哈密顿量的基态；定义了四重态凝聚的能隙参数并推导了能隙方程；通过十六维“占据空间”的直观物理图像描述激发态并得到本征能量；应用该理论计算超流分数。

papers.title: Topological Lifshitz transition-induced bipolarity of anomalous Nernst effect in kagome magnet YCo3
papers.abstract: The kagome lattice, renowned for hosting topological band structures and rich magnetic behaviors, offers an exceptional setting to investigate unconventional transport in magnetic topological systems. Controlling the polarity of the anomalous Nernst effect (ANE) is crucial for designing flexible thermoelectric devices, such as thermopiles, where the ability to switch the thermoelectric voltage sign can dramatically enhance energy conversion efficiency and output. Here, we demonstrate such a bipolar ANE in the kagome magnet YCo3, driven by a temperature-induced topological Lifshitz transition. With a Curie temperature TC~225 K, sizable anomalous Hall and Nernst effects emerge below TC. Supported by the first-principles calculations, the AHE and ANE are suggested to be dominated by the intrinsic mechanism. Furthermore, the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity exhibits a piecewise-linear dependence on magnetization, with an abrupt slope change near 100 K, consistent with the Karplus-Luttinger mechanism. Concurrently, the anomalous Nernst coefficient SAyx reverses its sign around the same temperature, realizing the crucial bipolarity. These anomalies could be interpreted as a topological Lifshitz transition, enabled by the evolution of Co moments that could shift the Fermi level relative to Weyl nodes. Our work reveals YCo3 as a prototypical kagome magnet where temperature and magnetism directly govern both Weyl node topology and the bipolar ANE, opening a pathway to magnetically control thermoelectric output in topological quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以第一性原理计算）。判断依据：demonstrate、experimental observations、first-principles calculations。；研究对象：笼目磁体YCo₃中的反常能斯特效应（ANE）及其极性调控，涉及拓扑Lifshitz相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在笼目磁体YCo₃中，通过温度诱导的拓扑Lifshitz相变实现了反常能斯特效应的双极性（符号反转），且该效应与Co磁矩演化导致的费米能级相对Weyl节点的移动有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在笼目磁体YCo₃中，通过温度诱导的拓扑Lifshitz相变实现了反常能斯特效应的双极性（符号反转），且该效应与Co磁矩演化导致的费米能级相对Weyl节点的移动有关。；创新点：首次在笼目磁体中通过温度与磁性的协同作用直接调控Weyl节点拓扑，从而实现反常能斯特效应的双极性，为磁性拓扑量子材料中热电输出的磁控开关提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）的温度依赖性；结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）分析其内在机制，并利用Karplus-Luttinger机制解释反常霍尔电导率与磁化强度的分段线性关系。

papers.title: Helimagnetic Josephson diode effect
papers.abstract: We study the Josephson diode effect in the one-dimensional superconductor/helimagnet/superconductor junctions using the Green's function method. For the spin-singlet $s$-wave pairing in superconductors, it is found that the necessary conditions for the Josephson diode effect are the nonzero chemical potential and the conical magnetic configuration in the helimagnet. The diode efficiency is strongly dependent on the chemical potential, chirality, tilt angle and exchange coupling in the helimagnet. The high efficiency close to $40\%$ can be obtained for specific parameter values. The sign of the diode efficiency can be tuned by changing the chirality, tilt angle, exchange coupling and chemical potential. The dependence of the diode efficiency on the number of supercells in the helimagnet is also investigated. The characteristics of the supercurrent nonreciprocity and diode efficiency in the junctions are clarified through the symmetry analysis and the energy band calculations. The diode effect for the spin-triplet $p$-wave pairing in superconductors is also discussed and the nonzero chemical potential is no longer a necessary condition for the Josephson diode effect due to the equal-spin Cooper pair-mediated transport in the $p$-wave junctions. These results provide a scheme for the Josephson diode effect without spin-orbit coupling, which possesses the potential applications in the design of dissipationless electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Green's function method、symmetry analysis、energy band calculations。；研究对象：一维超导体/螺旋磁体/超导体（S/Helimagnet/S）结中的约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋单态s波超导配对下，约瑟夫森二极管效应的必要条件是螺旋磁体中存在非零化学势和锥形磁构型；对于自旋三重态p波超导配对，非零化学势不再是必要条件。二极管效率最高可达约40%，其符号可通过改变手性、倾斜角、交换耦合和化学势进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋单态s波超导配对下，约瑟夫森二极管效应的必要条件是螺旋磁体中存在非零化学势和锥形磁构型；对于自旋三重态p波超导配对，非零化学势不再是必要条件。二极管效率最高可达约40%，其符号可通过改变手性、倾斜角、交换耦合和化学势进行调控。；创新点：提出了无需自旋-轨道耦合即可实现约瑟夫森二极管效应的方案，为无耗散电子器件的设计提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用格林函数方法（Green's function method）计算超流，并结合对称性分析和能带计算阐明超流非互易性与二极管效率的特征。

papers.title: Bistability of midpoint-fused arches with pinned-pinned boundary conditions
papers.abstract: Arranging multiple arches in a circular pattern and fusing them at their midpoint yields a three-dimensional configuration that we refer to as midpoint-fused arches (MFA). This study investigates the structural bistability of MFA, i.e., their ability to admit two distinct, force-free stable equilibrium states. Starting from an as-fabricated, stress-free configuration, MFA can invert into a stressed, toggled state reminiscent of an umbrella's ribs. We develop an analytical model for the response of a pinned-pinned MFA subjected to a concentrated mid-span load by minimizing the total potential energy. Individual arches are treated as spatially deforming, and kinematic compatibility relations are derived at the fusion point to couple their deformations. Various deformation symmetries are then exploited to simplify the problem. We demonstrate the model's utility by characterizing the force-displacement response of a two-arch MFA, identifying distinct deformation pathways and discussing the pathway transitions that occur during toggling. In particular, we show how the structure switches between symmetric and asymmetric deformation modes as it moves between stable configurations. The generality of the framework is further established through analysis of a three-arch MFA, which exhibits richer coupled deformation behaviour. Nonlinear finite-element simulations and table-top experiments corroborate the analytical predictions, showing close agreement in both equilibrium states and the associated transition responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论分析为主，辅以实验验证和数值模拟。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop an analytical model”、“minimizing the total potential energy”、“Nonlinear finite-element simulations and table-top experiments corroborate”。；研究对象：中点融合拱结构（midpoint-fused arches, MFA）的双稳态力学行为，即结构在无外力作用下存在两个不同的稳定平衡态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中点融合拱结构在受集中载荷时，可在对称与不对称变形模式之间切换，并表现出双稳态特性（从无应力制造态翻转到类似伞骨的有应力翻转态）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中点融合拱结构在受集中载荷时，可在对称与不对称变形模式之间切换，并表现出双稳态特性（从无应力制造态翻转到类似伞骨的有应力翻转态）。；创新点：针对中点融合拱结构建立了考虑空间变形和融合点运动学耦合的解析模型，揭示了结构在翻转过程中对称与不对称变形模式之间的切换机制，并推广到三拱系统展示更丰富的耦合变形行为。
papers.method_zh: 基于总势能最小化建立解析模型，将单个拱视为空间变形体，在融合点处推导运动学相容性条件，并利用变形对称性简化问题。同时采用非线性有限元模拟和桌面实验验证理论预测。

papers.title: Partial Entropy production of active particles with hidden states in potentials
papers.abstract: Partially observed stochastic systems can appear (almost) time-reversal symmetric while in fact operating far from equilibrium. The present work extends the perturbative framework introduced in [Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 198302 (2026)] to calculate in a generic confining potential the partial entropy production, which quantifies the time-reversal asymmetry of a generic active particle with hidden self-propulsion. Focusing on the harmonic case, we apply our framework to reproduce an exact result for the partial entropy production rate of an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle and to derive the partial entropy production rate of a run-and-tumble particle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：perturbative framework（微扰框架）、calculate（计算）、derive（推导）。；研究对象：具有隐藏自推进（hidden self-propulsion）的活性粒子（active particles）在一般约束势（generic confining potential）中的部分熵产生（partial entropy production）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微扰框架，在简谐势情形下，成功复现了活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子的部分熵产生率的精确结果，并推导了run-and-tumble粒子的部分熵产生率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微扰框架，在简谐势情形下，成功复现了活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子的部分熵产生率的精确结果，并推导了run-and-tumble粒子的部分熵产生率。；创新点：将部分熵产生的微扰计算方法从特定情形推广至一般约束势，并首次推导了run-and-tumble粒子的部分熵产生率。
papers.method_zh: 采用文献[Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 198302 (2026)]中提出的微扰框架（perturbative framework），将其推广至一般约束势，并针对简谐势（harmonic case）进行具体计算。

papers.title: Records, drift, and the longest increasing subsequence of biased Gaussian random walks
papers.abstract: The longest increasing subsequence (LIS) of a random walk has so far been studied mainly for zero-mean, symmetric step increments. We numerically investigate the LIS of biased Gaussian random walks, with unit-variance increments and positive drift $μ_{p} = Φ^{-1}(p)$, where $p = \mathbb{P}(ξ>0)$. In contrast with the symmetric case, we find that for every fixed $p>1/2$ the mean LIS length grows linearly, $\langle L_{n}(p)\rangle \sim a(p)n$, with $a(p)$ increasing from $0$ at $p=1/2$ to $1$ as $p \to 1$. The record count is also linear, with coefficient $λ(p)$ given by Spitzer's formula for the mean ascending ladder epoch, and the LIS becomes increasingly aligned with this record skeleton as $p$ grows. At the symmetric point $p=1/2$, the record skeleton collapses to the Sparre Andersen $\sqrt{n}$ scale, while the LIS returns to the symmetric finite-variance $\sqrt{n}\log{n}$ regime. Near this limit, the excess $a(μ_{p})-λ(μ_{p})$ vanishes more slowly than linearly in the drift, although our data do not resolve a single power law. The empirical distribution of $L_{n}$ also changes across the singular point, from lognormal-like at $p=1/2$ to fluctuations consistent with Gaussian behavior for every sampled $p>1/2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically investigate（数值研究）、empirical distribution（经验分布）。；研究对象：有偏高斯随机游走（biased Gaussian random walks）的最长递增子序列（LIS）与记录（records）行为，特别是漂移（drift）参数对LIS长度和记录数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于有偏（p>1/2）高斯随机游走，平均LIS长度随步数n线性增长，系数a(p)从p=1/2时的0增加到p→1时的1；而在对称点p=1/2处，LIS恢复为√n log n标度。记录数也呈线性增长，其系数由Spitzer公式给出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于有偏（p>1/2）高斯随机游走，平均LIS长度随步数n线性增长，系数a(p)从p=1/2时的0增加到p→1时的1；而在对称点p=1/2处，LIS恢复为√n log n标度。记录数也呈线性增长，其系数由Spitzer公式给出。；创新点：首次系统研究了有偏（非零均值）随机游走的最长递增子序列，揭示了从对称（p=1/2）到有偏（p>1/2）的标度行为转变，并发现LIS与记录骨架（record skeleton）在强漂移下趋于一致。摘要未明确说明是否首次提出该数值研究。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（numerical investigation），具体为对具有单位方差和正漂移μ_p = Φ^{-1}(p)（其中p = ℙ(ξ>0)）的高斯随机游走进行采样，计算LIS长度和记录数的统计量（均值、分布），并与理论公式（Spitzer公式、Sparre Andersen标度）对比。

papers.title: Sustainable Metal-Organic Framework Water Harvesters in the Artificial Intelligence Era
papers.abstract: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are excellent candidates for water harvesting due to their tunable pore environments, which can be precisely engineered to capture and release water in arid conditions. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into MOF discovery can further accelerate the design of high-performance sorbents by identifying structural features that enhance atmospheric water harvesting (AWH), stability, and cycling efficiency. In this Perspective, we examine key MOF design principles, including cooperative adsorption, operational relative humidity (RH), uptake capacity, hysteresis, and scalability. We highlight recent design advancements such as multivariate strategies and long-arm linker extension, and examine how these principles tune pore capacity and hydrophilicity, while preserving stability and crystallinity. Furthermore, we discuss how AI, large language models (LLMs), and data mining can accelerate the discovery process through predictive synthesis, inverse design, and elucidating synthesis-structure-property relationships for the next generation of MOF water harvesters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（Perspective/综述性观点文章）。判断依据：摘要中提及“examine key MOF design principles”“highlight recent design advancements”“discuss how AI...can accelerate”，属于对已有研究进展的评述与未来展望，而非单一实验或计算工作。；研究对象：金属有机框架（MOFs）材料，具体用于大气水收集（Atmospheric Water Harvesting, AWH）的吸附剂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过可调谐的孔道环境，MOFs能够在干旱条件下高效捕获和释放水；结合人工智能可加速识别提升吸附性能、稳定性和循环效率的结构特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过可调谐的孔道环境，MOFs能够在干旱条件下高效捕获和释放水；结合人工智能可加速识别提升吸附性能、稳定性和循环效率的结构特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统MOF水收集研究相比的具体创新点，但整体视角在于将人工智能（包括大语言模型和数据挖掘）系统性地整合到MOF水收集材料的设计与发现流程中。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算手段，但提及了“multivariate strategies”“long-arm linker extension”等设计策略，以及“predictive synthesis”“inverse design”“data mining”等AI驱动方法。未涉及具体DFT、DMRG、ARPES等凝聚态物理常用技术。

papers.title: Passive memory reshapes active persistence
papers.abstract: Many active systems move in complex environments whose mechanical response is slow and history dependent. To address this regime, we study the collective dynamics of self-sustained active particles in non-Markovian media within a generalized Langevin framework with memory. We focus on the competition between the timescales of active persistence and viscoelastic relaxation in the environment. Using a minimal interacting model with an exponential memory kernel, we show that environmental memory qualitatively reshapes motility-induced phase separation of self-propelled active particles. When the memory timescale becomes comparable to the active persistence time, delayed viscoelastic stresses generate an effective anti-persistence that suppresses clustering and produces a broad metastable regime with slow nucleation dynamics. By contrast, for long memory timescales, reduced friction at short times enhances the effective propulsion velocity and restores phase separation. Our results demonstrate that the surrounding medium is not merely a passive background for active motion, but can actively regulate the emergence, stability, and dynamics of collective organization in active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“generalized Langevin framework with memory”、“minimal interacting model with an exponential memory kernel”，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：在具有记忆效应的非马尔可夫介质中运动的活性粒子体系，具体研究活性持续性与环境粘弹性弛豫时间尺度竞争下的集体动力学与相分离行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 环境记忆效应可以定性改变活性粒子的运动性诱导相分离：当记忆时间尺度与活性持续性时间相当时，延迟的粘弹性应力产生有效反持续性，抑制团簇形成并导致缓慢成核的亚稳态；当记忆时间尺度很长时，短时摩擦减小增强了有效推进速度，从而恢复相分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：环境记忆效应可以定性改变活性粒子的运动性诱导相分离：当记忆时间尺度与活性持续性时间相当时，延迟的粘弹性应力产生有效反持续性，抑制团簇形成并导致缓慢成核的亚稳态；当记忆时间尺度很长时，短时摩擦减小增强了有效推进速度，从而恢复相分离。；创新点：揭示了环境介质并非活性运动的被动背景，而是能够主动调控活性物质集体组织的涌现、稳定性与动力学。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用含指数记忆核的广义朗之万框架，构建最小相互作用模型，通过理论分析与数值模拟研究非马尔可夫介质中自驱动活性粒子的集体动力学。

papers.title: Field-Driven Hybrid Filament Formation Governs Switching in Ta-HfO$_2$-Pt Memristors
papers.abstract: Memristive devices have gained significant attention for their potential in next-generation non-volatile memory and neuromorphic computing architectures. Among emerging candidates, transition metal oxides have proven particularly promising. While the switching mechanism in Ta/HfO$_2$/Pt devices was long attributed solely to oxygen vacancy based filaments, recent experimental evidence suggests a more complex dual-regime: the diffusion of metal cations also contributes to the formation of a conductive bridge. However, the precise atomistic mechanisms governing this metal cation migration remain poorly understood. Additionally, the role of defects such as oxygen vacancies present in the transition metal oxide in determining the final filament size and shape is also not well understood. Here, we employ molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with dynamic charge transfer to provide a detailed analysis of the atomistic mechanisms governing the co-formation of Ta-cation and oxygen-deficient filaments. We clearly show how varying the initial oxygen vacancy concentrations and spatial configurations within the HfO$_2$ matrix influences the final morphology and dimensions of the conductive filament. The switching is governed by field-driven formation and rupture of a hybrid Ta-cation-rich, oxygen-deficient filament in HfO$_2$. Our simulations closely match experiment, validating the model as a robust framework for understanding switching in oxide memristors and guiding designs that reduce cycle-to-cycle and device-to-device variability -- key barriers to high-performance devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：采用分子动力学（MD）模拟方法，并结合动态电荷转移进行原子尺度分析。；研究对象：Ta/HfO₂/Pt 忆阻器中的混合型导电细丝形成与开关机制，具体涉及钽阳离子与氧空位共同主导的导电细丝演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开关行为由电场驱动的混合型细丝（富钽阳离子且缺氧）在HfO₂中的形成与断裂所主导；初始氧空位浓度和空间分布显著影响最终细丝的形貌与尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开关行为由电场驱动的混合型细丝（富钽阳离子且缺氧）在HfO₂中的形成与断裂所主导；初始氧空位浓度和空间分布显著影响最终细丝的形貌与尺寸。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟，并引入动态电荷转移（dynamic charge transfer）方法。

papers.title: Strongly-coupled hybrid lattice-plasmons in layered cuprates
papers.abstract: Metallic systems with delocalized valence electrons host collective charge density oscillations known as plasmons. On the other hand, conventional insulators do not have free electrons and the low energy charge degrees of freedom are pinned to the ions. The fate of the collective charge excitations in the intermediate regime is an outstanding question. This problem is especially important for strongly correlated systems such as the layered cuprates, where unconventional superconductivity and other emergent phenomena arise from valence electrons on the border between Mott localization and itinerancy. Using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering, we track this evolution in the prototypical electron-doped cuprate Nd2-xCexCuO4. We find a continuous transformation of the low-energy charge response: from an acoustic plasmon in the metallic regime, to a gapped hybrid mode at intermediate doping, and finally to a nearly dispersionless 139 meV excitation at half filling. Remarkably, the 139 meV excitation has approximately twice the energy of the oxygen breathing phonon responsible for the dispersion kink observed in angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, and is consistent with a putative 2-phonon excitation observed in Raman spectroscopy. These results establish a unified picture of collective charge excitations across the phase diagram of electron-doped cuprates, showing that such modes persist across the Mott transition via strong coupling to lattice degrees of freedom and revealing a missing link in the charge dynamics of carrier doped Mott insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：resonant inelastic X-ray scattering（共振非弹性X射线散射）。；研究对象：电子掺杂的层状铜氧化物超导体 Nd₂₋ₓCeₓCuO₄ 中的集体电荷激发，特别是从金属态到Mott绝缘体转变过程中的等离激元-晶格杂化模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电子掺杂铜氧化物中，低能电荷响应从金属态的声学等离激元连续演变为中间掺杂的有能隙杂化模式，最终在半填充时变为能量约139 meV的近无色散激发。该激发能量约为氧呼吸声子能量的两倍，表明集体电荷模式通过强耦合晶格自由度跨越Mott转变而持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电子掺杂铜氧化物中，低能电荷响应从金属态的声学等离激元连续演变为中间掺杂的有能隙杂化模式，最终在半填充时变为能量约139 meV的近无色散激发。该激发能量约为氧呼吸声子能量的两倍，表明集体电荷模式通过强耦合晶格自由度跨越Mott转变而持续存在。；创新点：首次通过实验统一描绘了电子掺杂铜氧化物相图中集体电荷激发的完整演化图像，揭示了载流子掺杂Mott绝缘体中电荷动力学缺失的一环——等离激元通过强耦合晶格自由度在Mott转变中持续存在。
papers.method_zh: 共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）。

papers.title: Long-Range Fermi-Polaron Blockade in Monolayer MoSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Strong optical nonlinearities at the few-photon level are a central goal for quantum photonics, yet they remain difficult to realize in solid-state systems. In doped two-dimensional semiconductors, coupling between excitons and a degenerate Fermi sea gives rise to exciton-Fermi polarons, many-body quasiparticles whose optical response is governed by fermionic correlations. Here, using femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption microscopy, we directly image the spatially resolved nonlinear optical response of exciton-Fermi polarons in monolayer MoSe$_2$. We observe a pronounced spatial suppression of resonant absorption associated with the attractive Fermi polaron, from which we extract an optical blockade radius that is more than ten times larger than that of the neutral exciton. Microscopic analysis indicates that this extended nonlinearity arises primarily from fermion-mediated interactions between exciton-Fermi polarons. Our results establish exciton-Fermi polarons in two-dimensional semiconductors as electrically tunable, strongly interacting optical quasiparticles, and identify them as a promising platform for ultralow-power nonlinear optical devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption microscopy”（飞秒泵浦-探测瞬态吸收显微术）这一实验技术，并描述了直接成像（directly image）和提取（extract）物理量的过程。；研究对象：单层二硒化钼（monolayer MoSe₂）中掺杂的二维半导体体系，具体研究其中的激子-费米极化子（exciton-Fermi polarons）的非线性光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验发现激子-费米极化子存在一种长程光学阻塞效应，其光学阻塞半径比中性激子大十倍以上。这种扩展的非线性主要源于费米子介导的极化子间相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验发现激子-费米极化子存在一种长程光学阻塞效应，其光学阻塞半径比中性激子大十倍以上。这种扩展的非线性主要源于费米子介导的极化子间相互作用。；创新点：首次直接空间成像并定量提取了激子-费米极化子的光学阻塞半径，揭示了其远超中性激子的长程非线性特性，并将其归因于费米海介导的相互作用，从而将二维半导体中的激子-费米极化子确立为一种电学可调、强相互作用的准粒子平台。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒泵浦-探测瞬态吸收显微术（femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption microscopy），用于空间分辨地成像非线性光学响应。

papers.title: Multifractal Complexity of the Chandler Wobble and Its Anomalous Disappearance (2015--2020): A MFDFA Study
papers.abstract: The Chandler wobble (CW) -- the $\sim$433-day free nutation of Earth's rotation pole -- experienced an anomalous near-disappearance between 2015 and 2020, followed by a re-excitation with an approximately $180^{\circ}$ phase reversal. Using Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MFDFA) applied to more than six decades (1962--2024) of daily IERS EOP C04 polar motion data, this study provides the first multifractal characterisation of the CW and its recent anomaly. Global MFDFA shows that the residual polar motion components and the CW amplitude are genuine multifractal processes with strongly $q$-dependent generalised Hurst exponents and broad singularity spectra. Surrogate-data tests with shuffled and phase-randomised ensembles demonstrate that this multifractality originates from the combined action of long-range temporal correlations and heavy-tailed excitation statistics. A sliding-window analysis reveals a pronounced collapse in long-range persistence and multifractal spectral width of the geometric polar motion signal several years before and during the 2015--2020 amplitude minimum, indicating a genuine dynamical regime change rather than a simple suppression of oscillation amplitude. In contrast, the amplitude- and phase-related variables retain broad multifractal spectra and stable scaling exponents across all epochs, revealing a dynamical decoupling between the geometry of the CW and the multiscale structure of its amplitude and phase fluctuations. These findings highlight the CW amplitude as an exceptionally multifractal integrator of geophysical excitation and suggest that multifractal metrics may provide early-warning indicators of major transitions in Earth rotation dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据分析文章。判断依据：使用MFDFA（多重分形去趋势波动分析）对长期观测数据（IERS EOP C04极移数据）进行统计分析，属于数据驱动的计算研究。；研究对象：地球自转极的Chandler摆动（CW），即周期约433天的自由章动现象，特别是其在2015–2020年间出现的异常近消失及相位反转。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Chandler摆动振幅是一个真正的多重分形过程，其多重分形性源于长程时间相关性和重尾激发统计的共同作用；2015–2020年振幅极小期前后，极移几何信号的长程持久性和多重分形谱宽度出现显著坍缩，表明发生了真实的动力学状态转变，而非简单的振幅抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Chandler摆动振幅是一个真正的多重分形过程，其多重分形性源于长程时间相关性和重尾激发统计的共同作用；2015–2020年振幅极小期前后，极移几何信号的长程持久性和多重分形谱宽度出现显著坍缩，表明发生了真实的动力学状态转变，而非简单的振幅抑制。；创新点：首次对Chandler摆动进行多重分形表征，并揭示了其振幅与相位波动在动力学上的解耦现象，提出多重分形指标可作为地球自转动力学重大转变的早期预警信号。
papers.method_zh: 多重分形去趋势波动分析（MFDFA），应用于超过六十年（1962–2024）的每日IERS EOP C04极移数据；采用打乱和相位随机化的替代数据检验以区分多重分形来源；使用滑动窗口分析追踪时变特征。

papers.title: Self-Assembly of Lipid-Biopolymer Periodic Nanostructures on Photonic Length Scales
papers.abstract: The self-assembly of photonic nanostructures in insects involves chitin, proteins, and lipids. While synthetic photonic systems have been extensively studied, current lipid-based self-assembly systems are limited in periodicity to $68\,\text{nm}$ compared to photonic length scales ($\approx 450\,\text{nm}$) observed in biological organisms. We hypothesise that lipids facilitate how structural colour arises in vivo by acting as templates for the self-assembly of biopolymers via lipidic lyotropic liquid crystal mesophases. Here, we aim to understand and identify how structural colour is produced in insects by the co-assembly of lipids and biopolymers. We study the effect of biopolymers, pH, temperature, surface charge, and stability on lipid vesicles using dynamic light scattering, X-ray scattering, and zeta potential analysis. Using cryo-electron microscopy, we demonstrate that these vesicles interact with the biopolymers and generate periodic nanostructures with periodicities ranging from $700\,\text{nm}$ to $1.2\,μ\text{m}$ (more than ten times larger than for purely lipidic systems) and dimensionalities ranging from 1D to 3D. Our results establish that lipid mesophases and biopolymers can induce reorganisation into ordered nanostructures, overcoming key limitations of periodicities achieved by lipid-only systems, and providing a methodology for recreating the physicochemical mechanisms underlying biophotonic structural colour.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：dynamic light scattering, X-ray scattering, zeta potential analysis, cryo-electron microscopy。；研究对象：脂质与生物聚合物（如几丁质、蛋白质）共组装形成的周期性纳米结构，以及其在光子尺度上产生结构色的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 脂质与生物聚合物共组装可形成周期从700 nm到1.2 μm的周期性纳米结构（比纯脂质体系大十倍以上），并实现从一维到三维的维度调控，克服了纯脂质体系在周期性尺度上的关键限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：脂质与生物聚合物共组装可形成周期从700 nm到1.2 μm的周期性纳米结构（比纯脂质体系大十倍以上），并实现从一维到三维的维度调控，克服了纯脂质体系在周期性尺度上的关键限制。；创新点：首次证明脂质中间相与生物聚合物可诱导重组为有序纳米结构，突破了纯脂质体系周期性仅达68 nm的局限，为重现生物光子结构色的物理化学机制提供了方法学。
papers.method_zh: 动态光散射、X射线散射、Zeta电位分析、冷冻电子显微镜。

papers.title: Topological superconductivity from Abelian fractional Chern insulators
papers.abstract: Can a Laughlin anyon fluid become a topological superconductor? We answer this question for a $ν=1/3$ fractional Chern insulator (FCI) using a $U(3)$ infrared parton theory. Three charge-$e/3$ constituents form the electron, while three constituent pairs form a gauge-invariant charge-$2e$ Cooper pair. The resulting superconductors share an ordinary charge-$2e$ sector but differ in their neutral color response, giving an SC$^\ast$ with the parent Laughlin $U(1)_3$ order, a chiral topological superconductor with $c_-=3/2$, and a strong-pairing anyon superconductor with $c_-=3$. The same framework organizes a nearby $σ_{xy}=0$ charge density wave (CDW) state. At commensurate filling, the normal state and the $c_-=3$ and $c_-=3/2$ superconducting descendants are naturally tied to a period-three density order background, while the SC$^\ast$ branch can preserve microscopic translations. Away from commensuration, a chargon metal can pair into the same $c_-=3/2$ topological superconductor. The FCI, reentrant CDW, and chiral superconductivity are unified in the $U(3)$ parton theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“infrared parton theory”“U(3) parton theory”等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：Abelian 分数量子霍尔态（Laughlin 任意子流体）在ν=1/3 分数量子陈绝缘体（FCI）中转变为拓扑超导体的可能性，以及相关的电荷密度波（CDW）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Laughlin 任意子流体可以成为拓扑超导体，且存在三种不同的超导分支：具有母体 Laughlin U(1)_3 序的 SC*、手征拓扑超导体（c_-=3/2）和强配对任意子超导体（c_-=3）。这些超导态与周期三密度序背景及电荷密度波态在 U(3) parton 理论框架下统一。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Laughlin 任意子流体可以成为拓扑超导体，且存在三种不同的超导分支：具有母体 Laughlin U(1)_3 序的 SC*、手征拓扑超导体（c_-=3/2）和强配对任意子超导体（c_-=3）。这些超导态与周期三密度序背景及电荷密度波态在 U(3) parton 理论框架下统一。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用 U(3) 红外 parton 理论（infrared parton theory），将电子分解为三个电荷-e/3 的组分，并将三个组分对构成规范不变的电荷-2e 库珀对，从而分析超导配对与拓扑序。

papers.title: Geometry-based Discovery of Calcium Battery Cathodes Accelerated by Foundational Machine-Learned Models
papers.abstract: Calcium batteries (CBs) are an attractive post-Li-ion technology, offering the appeal of Ca's natural abundance and high volumetric energy density. However, practical realization of CBs remains limited by the scarcity of positive electrode (cathode) materials that support reversible Ca$^{2+}$ (de)intercalation under electrochemical conditions. To address this challenge, we screen the materials project (MP) database for novel host structures that can intercalate Ca using geometry- and chemistry-based design principles. Specifically, we employ the Voronoi polyhedral volume as a descriptor of site compatibility for hosting Ca in potential frameworks. Further, we down-select candidate structures progressively through criteria including charge neutrality, absence of non-Ca mobile cations, thermodynamic (meta)stability, average voltage, and Ca migration barriers ($E_m$) using foundational machine-learning (ML) models. Subsequently, we validate the ensemble-ML-predicted $E_m$ in a subset of the final candidates using density functional theory based nudged elastic band calculations. Overall, from an initial pool of 52,945 MP structures, our workflow identifies 37 promising Ca cathode candidates, several of which exhibit favorable combinations of thermodynamic (meta)stability, voltage, and Ca-mobility, marking them as strong candidates for synthesis and electrochemical characterization. Particularly, we identify two Ca cathode candidates with markedly low Ca$^{2+}~E_m$ (CaSc$_2$V$_2$O$_8$ and CaVSO$_4$F$_3$), and four cathode candidates with thermodynamically stable charged states (Ca$_3$(CoO$_2$)$_4$, Ca$_3$Mn$_4$(TeO$_6$)$_2$, CaVF$_5$, and CaVSO$_4$F$_3$). Beyond identifying Ca-cathodes, our work establishes geometry-based descriptors and ML-based workflows as transferable methods for high-throughput screening, enabling the rapid discovery of novel materials for battery and other applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：screening、machine-learning models、density functional theory、nudged elastic band calculations。；研究对象：钙电池（Calcium batteries）的正极（阴极）材料。具体筛选了Materials Project数据库中的多种宿主结构，最终聚焦于CaSc₂V₂O₈、CaVSO₄F₃、Ca₃(CoO₂)₄、Ca₃Mn₄(TeO₆)₂、CaVF₅等候选化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过几何与化学设计原则及机器学习加速筛选，从52,945种结构中识别出37种有前景的钙电池阴极候选材料，其中CaSc₂V₂O₈和CaVSO₄F₃具有极低的Ca²⁺迁移势垒，另有四种候选材料在充电状态下热力学稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过几何与化学设计原则及机器学习加速筛选，从52,945种结构中识别出37种有前景的钙电池阴极候选材料，其中CaSc₂V₂O₈和CaVSO₄F₃具有极低的Ca²⁺迁移势垒，另有四种候选材料在充电状态下热力学稳定。；创新点：建立了基于几何描述符（Voronoi多面体体积）和机器学习工作流的高通量筛选方法，并将其作为可迁移的方法学，不仅用于钙电池阴极发现，还可推广至其他电池材料及应用的快速筛选。
papers.method_zh: 基于Materials Project数据库进行高通量筛选；采用Voronoi多面体体积作为描述Ca离子位点兼容性的几何描述符；通过电荷中性、无非Ca移动阳离子、热力学（亚）稳定性、平均电压和Ca迁移势垒（E_m）等标准逐步筛选；使用基础机器学习模型（foundational ML models）预测E_m；对部分最终候选材料采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的微动弹性带（NEB）方法验证E_m。

papers.title: Critical states and anomalous wave transport in an aperiodic polariton monotile
papers.abstract: Recently "the Hat" monotile was introduced into the family of aperiodic tilings and quasicrystals boasting physical properties lying at the boundary of ordered and disordered systems. Here we study the two-dimensional wave transport, transverse localization and scaling properties of the quantum modes in a Monotile quasilattice. Our system is based on reconfigurable optical lattices for cavity-polaritons which provide flexible means to study wavepacket dynamics, strong nonlinear phenomena, and power-driven condensation in this new type of an aperiodic tiling. We confirm the existence of localized and critical states in the Monotile through direct diagonalization of the Schrödinger equation. Scaling analysis on the moments of the wavefunction distribution reveals anomalous transport regimes of super-diffusive and near sub-diffusive polariton transport associated with the fractal structure of the Monotile Hilbert space. We propose a strategy using resonantly excited polariton fluids to verify our findings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。判断依据：摘要提到“通过直接对角化薛定谔方程”、“标度分析”、“提出策略”等，未提及具体实验操作或数据。；研究对象：基于“Monotile”（单铺砌块）准晶格中的二维波输运、横向局域化以及量子模式的标度性质，具体体系为可重构的腔极化子光学晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Monotile准晶格中确认了局域态和临界态的存在；波函数分布的矩的标度分析揭示了与Monotile希尔伯特空间分形结构相关的反常输运行为，包括超扩散和近亚扩散的极化子输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Monotile准晶格中确认了局域态和临界态的存在；波函数分布的矩的标度分析揭示了与Monotile希尔伯特空间分形结构相关的反常输运行为，包括超扩散和近亚扩散的极化子输运。；创新点：首次将“The Hat”单铺砌块引入凝聚态物理中的波输运研究，并揭示了该新型非周期铺砌体系中临界态与反常输运的关联。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 通过直接对角化薛定谔方程进行数值计算，并对波函数分布的矩进行标度分析；提出利用共振激发极化子流体的实验验证策略。

papers.title: Interaction mechanics of acoustic cavitation with fibrin networks
papers.abstract: Stiff and dense fibrin networks in chronic blood clots impede drug penetration and distribution into the clot core, limiting the efficacy of thrombolytic therapies. Acoustic cavitation of microbubbles is a promising strategy to enhance drug delivery in soft tissues. However, the interaction of these bubbles with stiff fibrin networks has yet to be investigated. Here, we show that ultrasound-driven bubbles undergoing stable periodic oscillations can penetrate and alter dense fibrin networks. The penetrated bubbles create three-dimensional paths that enable nanobeads (matrix transport markers) to infiltrate up to 200 $μ$m m deep into the mesh. Radial bubble oscillation is found to be the dominant forcing mechanism on fibrin fibers. Combining mechanical measurements with these observations reveals that the bubble radial stress is insufficient to break the fibrin fibers in a single cycle. Instead, repeated sub-fracture loading from bubble oscillations induce plastic deformation and damage accumulation with each cycle. This is evident from drastic dissipation losses and softening of the network seen over thousands of cycles. We further explored the softening of fibrin networks at a range of peak applied forces. At low force, the fibrin networks undergo a shakedown effect with initial softening, which is resistant to further damage after hundreds of cycles. At higher force, networks continue to soften without reaching a stable state, indicating progressive damage accumulation. These results show that cavitation can enhance matrix transport in dense fiber networks. The underlying physics is governed by the viscoplastic mechanics of bubble-fibrin interactions. These findings establish a mechanistic framework to design comprehensive treatment strategies for fibrotic aged clots.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验观测（“we show that...”）、机械测量（“mechanical measurements”）以及循环加载实验（“over thousands of cycles”）。；研究对象：声空化气泡与致密纤维蛋白网络（fibrin networks）的相互作用力学，具体涉及慢性血凝块中气泡振荡对纤维网络的渗透、塑性变形和损伤累积。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超声驱动的稳定周期性振荡气泡能够穿透并改变致密纤维蛋白网络，通过反复亚断裂载荷诱导塑性变形和损伤累积，从而增强基质输运；低力下网络出现“安定效应”，高力下则持续软化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超声驱动的稳定周期性振荡气泡能够穿透并改变致密纤维蛋白网络，通过反复亚断裂载荷诱导塑性变形和损伤累积，从而增强基质输运；低力下网络出现“安定效应”，高力下则持续软化。；创新点：首次研究了刚性致密纤维蛋白网络与声空化气泡的相互作用，揭示了气泡径向振荡通过反复亚断裂加载而非单次断裂实现网络塑性变形和损伤累积的机制，并区分了低力下的安定效应与高力下的渐进损伤行为。
papers.method_zh: 使用超声驱动微泡进行稳定周期性振荡实验，结合机械力学测量（如应力、耗散损失）和纳米珠（基质输运标记物）渗透深度观测（可达200 μm），分析气泡径向振荡对纤维的作用力及网络软化的循环依赖性。

papers.title: Measuring anyon dispersion with tunneling probes
papers.abstract: Anyons are usually characterized by their topological data and their fractional quantum numbers under global symmetries. In lattice systems such as fractional Chern insulators (FCI), they are also mobile quasiparticles. Their motion controls the possible ground states of the dilute anyon gas obtained by doping an FCI, including possible superconducting states. We show how tunneling probes can measure this motion. In scanning tunneling spectroscopy, weak disorder produces spatially oscillating quasiparticle-interference patterns whose branches reveal the dispersion of fractionalized constituents. In quantum twisting microscopy, planar momentum-conserving tunneling selects the total momentum of the injected electron, so the continuum thresholds of fractionalized electron spectra encode the dispersion of the constituent anyons. The resulting spectra distinguish compact electron-like excitations, bound anyon molecules, and unbound anyon continuum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show how、reveal、encode、distinguish（理论分析，未涉及具体实验或计算模拟）。；研究对象：分数陈绝缘体（FCI）中任意子的色散关系，以及通过隧穿探针（扫描隧道谱、量子扭转显微镜）测量该色散的方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 隧穿探针（如扫描隧道谱中的准粒子干涉图案、量子扭转显微镜中的连续谱阈值）可以揭示分数化任意子的色散关系，并能区分紧致类电子激发、束缚任意子分子和未束缚任意子连续谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：隧穿探针（如扫描隧道谱中的准粒子干涉图案、量子扭转显微镜中的连续谱阈值）可以揭示分数化任意子的色散关系，并能区分紧致类电子激发、束缚任意子分子和未束缚任意子连续谱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于扫描隧道谱（STS）中弱无序引起的准粒子干涉振荡图案，以及量子扭转显微镜（QTM）中平面动量守恒隧穿过程，推导任意子色散与可观测谱学特征之间的对应关系。

papers.title: Reinterpreting Memory Effects in Nonequilibrium Systems: From Temporal Dynamics to Steady-State Signatures via NEGF
papers.abstract: We investigate memory effects and quantum transport in two-dimensional lattice systems within the framework of non-equilibrium Green's functions and Schwinger-Keldysh non-equilibrium quantum field theory. Starting from a 2D tight-binding Hamiltonian, we employ the Dyson expansion on the Keldysh contour and the second-order Born and self-consistent Born Approximation to derive the electronic self-energies associated with elastic and inelastic scattering mechanisms.Static disorder produces a local self-energy and a rapidly decaying memory kernel, characteristic of Markovian dynamics, whereas electron-phonon coupling generates temporally nonlocal self-energies and genuine Non-Markovian behavior. We demonstrate that these distinct memory signatures are directly reflected in the spectral function, which we propose as a diagnostic probe of non-equilibrium memory effects. Further we explore 1PI and 2PI effective actions to see their memory perspectives studying their coarse-graining behavior. Building on this theoretical framework, we further apply the conventional NEGF formalism to two paradigmatic two-dimensional models-the Hofstadter and an RKKY-coupled system to explore how different microscopic Hamiltonians influence Markovian and Non-Markovian nature. Our results provide a unified connection between scattering mechanisms, memory effects, and quantum transport in low-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-equilibrium Green's functions, Schwinger-Keldysh non-equilibrium quantum field theory, Dyson expansion, 1PI/2PI effective actions。；研究对象：二维晶格系统中的非平衡记忆效应与量子输运，具体包括Hofstadter模型和RKKY耦合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静态无序产生局域自能和快速衰减的记忆核，表现为马尔可夫动力学；而电子-声子耦合产生时间非局域自能和真正的非马尔可夫行为。这些不同的记忆特征可直接反映在谱函数中，因此谱函数可作为非平衡记忆效应的诊断探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静态无序产生局域自能和快速衰减的记忆核，表现为马尔可夫动力学；而电子-声子耦合产生时间非局域自能和真正的非马尔可夫行为。这些不同的记忆特征可直接反映在谱函数中，因此谱函数可作为非平衡记忆效应的诊断探针。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）框架和Schwinger-Keldysh非平衡量子场论，从二维紧束缚哈密顿量出发，利用Keldysh轮廓上的戴森展开以及二阶玻恩近似和自洽玻恩近似，推导与弹性及非弹性散射机制相关的电子自能；并进一步探索1PI和2PI有效作用量以研究其粗粒化行为。

papers.title: Quantum Light Nano-Imaging
papers.abstract: Entanglement and quantum correlations are central to the physics of quantum materials, yet they have remained notoriously difficult to probe experimentally. Probing these phenomena in solids requires quantum optical probes that operate at the native length and time scales of material excitations, below the diffraction limit of light. Developing the requisite tools has previously been infeasible due to the extremely weak intensities of state-of-the-art quantum light sources and extreme inefficiency of near-field light-matter interactions. In this work, we circumvent these challenges and develop a quantum light scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscope (q-SNOM) that can explore the broad domain of solid-state quantum effects at length scales below the diffraction limit. In its first application, we image in real space the self-interference of single hybrid light-matter quasiparticles in a van der Waals semiconductor, providing a direct nanoscale visualization of the wave-particle duality. We also introduce a polaritonic time-of-flight metrology that exploits the temporal correlations among entangled photons to observe the quasiparticle propagation dynamics with femtosecond resolution. This work sets the stage for nanoscale exploration and control of quantum effects in materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了开发新型显微镜（q-SNOM）并进行成像实验，关键词包括“develop”、“image”、“observe”。；研究对象：量子材料中的量子光学效应，具体为范德瓦尔斯半导体中的混合光-物质准粒子（极化激元）及其波粒二象性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功开发了一种量子光散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（q-SNOM），能够在衍射极限以下的空间尺度上直接成像单个混合光-物质准粒子的自干涉，从而在纳米尺度上可视化波粒二象性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功开发了一种量子光散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（q-SNOM），能够在衍射极限以下的空间尺度上直接成像单个混合光-物质准粒子的自干涉，从而在纳米尺度上可视化波粒二象性。；创新点：首次将量子光探针与扫描近场光学显微镜结合，克服了传统量子光源强度极弱和近场相互作用效率极低的难题，从而实现了在衍射极限以下的空间尺度上对固态量子效应的探索和成像。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为量子光散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（q-SNOM）。具体技术包括：利用量子光源和近场光学相互作用，并结合一种基于纠缠光子时间关联的极化激元飞行时间测量方法，以实现飞秒时间分辨率的准粒子传播动力学观测。

papers.title: Symmetry and integrability in the anyon-Hubbard model
papers.abstract: Recent cold atom experiments have realized one-dimensional anyons and enabled the tuning of 1D~statistics between bosons and fermions. Here, we analyze the symmetries, integrability, and resulting degeneracies of the underlying anyon-Hubbard model of finite length. Our results reveal a switching between symmetry classes AI, BDI, and CI in dependence on system size, particle number, and boundary conditions, and show that two anyons with periodic boundaries are integrable, while two anyons with open boundary conditions are not. We include a comprehensive analysis of all model limits, especially of interacting bosons and pseudofermions and resolve spectral signatures. We additionally reveal an exactly solvable doublon state that hides in the continuum of scattering states and the exact solution of the nullspace of two noninteracting anyons. The uncovered symmetries shape the fundamental properties of the one-dimensional anyons at hand, and the predicted states are accessible in state-of-the-art experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“分析对称性、可积性及简并”，并给出“精确可解的双子态”和“零空间的精确解”，属于理论分析。；研究对象：任意子-哈伯德模型（anyon-Hubbard model），具体研究有限长度一维任意子系统的对称性、可积性及其导致的能谱简并。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了任意子-哈伯德模型在有限系统中对称性类（AI、BDI、CI）随系统尺寸、粒子数和边界条件的切换；发现周期性边界条件下两个任意子是可积的，而开放边界条件下则不可积；并发现一个隐藏在连续散射态中的精确可解双子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了任意子-哈伯德模型在有限系统中对称性类（AI、BDI、CI）随系统尺寸、粒子数和边界条件的切换；发现周期性边界条件下两个任意子是可积的，而开放边界条件下则不可积；并发现一个隐藏在连续散射态中的精确可解双子态。；创新点：首次系统揭示了任意子-哈伯德模型中对称性类随系统参数（尺寸、粒子数、边界条件）的切换行为，并发现周期性边界条件下两个任意子的可积性以及隐藏在连续谱中的精确可解双子态。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：对称性分类（基于随机矩阵理论的对称性类）、可积性分析、模型极限（相互作用玻色子、赝费米子）的全面分析、精确求解非相互作用任意子的零空间。

papers.title: Order-disorder trade-off in dirty quantum systems
papers.abstract: We prove a trade-off theorem for order and disorder parameters in one-dimensional quantum spin systems with quenched disorder. For a disordered ensemble with exact Ising symmetry and average translation symmetry, any gapped ensemble must have one and only one of the following: an $O(1)$ order parameter or an $O(1)$ disorder parameter with even parity, both of the Edwards-Anderson type. The result extends to nearly gapped ensembles that accommodate Griffiths-type rare-region effects. These results offer a powerful and rigorous framework to understand the disorder effects beyond perturbative approaches. As applications, we (1) establish the existence of string order parameters for SPT phases; (2) derive a Lieb-Schultz-Mattis-type constraint for disordered ensembles, which requires a nearly gapped ensemble to spontaneously break the symmetry; and (3) discuss similar trade-off relations for disordered fermion chains, leading to an improved understanding of certain "intrinsically disordered" topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：prove a trade-off theorem（证明一个权衡定理）、rigorous framework（严格框架）。；研究对象：一维量子自旋系统中的淬火无序（quenched disorder），具体涉及具有伊辛对称性和平均平移对称性的无序系综，以及无序费米子链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了一维量子自旋系统中存在一个序参量与无序参量之间的权衡定理：对于有能隙的无序系综，要么具有O(1)大小的Edwards-Anderson型序参量，要么具有偶宇称的O(1)大小的无序参量，两者必居其一且仅居其一。该结果可推广至包含Griffiths型稀罕区效应的近能隙系综。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了一维量子自旋系统中存在一个序参量与无序参量之间的权衡定理：对于有能隙的无序系综，要么具有O(1)大小的Edwards-Anderson型序参量，要么具有偶宇称的O(1)大小的无序参量，两者必居其一且仅居其一。该结果可推广至包含Griffiths型稀罕区效应的近能隙系综。；创新点：提供了一个超越微扰方法的严格理论框架来理解无序效应，并首次建立了无序系统中序参量与无序参量之间的严格权衡关系。摘要未突出说明与具体数值或实验结果的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格的数学证明框架，基于对称性分析（伊辛对称性、平均平移对称性）和能隙条件，推导出序参量与无序参量的权衡关系。应用部分涉及对SPT相弦序参量的存在性证明、Lieb-Schultz-Mattis型约束的推导，以及对无序费米子链的讨论。

papers.title: Graph-based emulation of $d$-dimensional curved spaces with superconducting arrays
papers.abstract: We introduce a framework for emulating graphs and, through them, curved spaces of arbitrary dimension, using arrays of superconducting wires. The array consists of two stacked layers of wires, horizontal and vertical, such that wires are parallel within each layer and perpendicular between layers. By discretizing a space into a graph, assigning a superconducting wire with a rigid phase to each vertex, and coupling pairs of wires through Josephson junctions along the graph edges, arbitrary geometries and topologies can be engineered in a controlled setting. The superconducting phases then realize scalar field theories on the emergent geometry. We establish experimentally realistic conditions for implementing these architectures and develop a dictionary relating measurable circuit observables to quantities in the emulated field theory. As an application, we develop the implementation of hyperbolic (Anti-de Sitter) spaces of constant negative curvature and use them as an experimentally accessible platform to explore holographic duality in arbitrary dimensions. We investigate the effects of disorder in the Josephson couplings, which translate into metric variations in the bulk-boundary correspondence, and analyze their impact on boundary scaling exponents both analytically and numerically, finding that holographic duality remains robust even in the presence of strong disorder. Beyond holography, the framework opens a broad range of architectural possibilities, including the exploration of physics on highly nontrivial graphs and toy models of dynamical spacetimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：提出理论框架（framework）、建立对应关系（dictionary）、进行解析与数值分析（analytically and numerically）。；研究对象：基于超导阵列的图模拟系统，用于模拟任意维度的弯曲空间（特别是反德西特空间），并探索全息对偶性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超导约瑟夫森结阵列构建的图模型可以模拟任意维度的弯曲空间，并实现标量场理论；在全息对偶框架下，即使存在强无序，边界标度指数仍保持鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超导约瑟夫森结阵列构建的图模型可以模拟任意维度的弯曲空间，并实现标量场理论；在全息对偶框架下，即使存在强无序，边界标度指数仍保持鲁棒性。；创新点：提出了一种基于超导阵列的通用图模拟框架，能够实现任意维度的弯曲空间（包括常负曲率的反德西特空间），并首次在该平台上系统研究了无序对全息对偶性的影响，发现其在高无序下仍保持稳健。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：将空间离散化为图，每个顶点对应一根具有刚性相位的超导线，边通过约瑟夫森结耦合，从而模拟弯曲空间上的标量场理论。数值分析：研究约瑟夫森耦合无序对边界标度指数的影响。

papers.title: Controlled Loop Expansion for Strained Twisted Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: We develop a controlled diagrammatic framework for periodic Anderson models,and apply it to heterostrained magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) at charge neutrality using the topological heavy-fermion formulation. Building on arXiv:2604.14278, we organize self-energy insertions and perform a Dyson resummation to any order in the small parameter $s^2$ -- the fraction of the moiré Brillouin zone with nontrivial quantum geometry. For strained MATBG, the expansion remains controlled down to arbitrarily low temperatures as long as the strain induced energy scale is not too small. In the flat-chiral limit, an emergent approximate $\rm{U}(1)$ symmetry forbids the leading scattering channel and leaves the Mott bands sharp at order $s^2$. This is in stark contrast to the unstrained case, where the linewidth is of order $N_f s^2 U$ with $U$ the on-site $f$-$f$ Hubbard interaction and $N_f$ the number of $f$ states per site. Away from the chiral limit, the linewidth is non-zero at order $s^2$ but more than an order of magnitude smaller than in the unstrained case. The strain-induced energy scale also imprints itself directly on the spectrum: as an electron-phonon-like kink in the dispersion, and as an additional flat ``trion'' band -- a single-particle excitation bound to a local $f$ particle-hole pair. We use the framework to predict the Quantum Twisting Microscope spectrum at one-loop order for both strained and unstrained MATBG, and compare with recent experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a controlled diagrammatic framework”（发展可控的图解框架）、“perform a Dyson resummation”（进行戴森重求和）、“predict the spectrum”（预测谱），属于理论计算与模型构建工作。；研究对象：异质应变下的魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG），具体研究其在电荷中性点附近的物理性质。使用了拓扑重费米子（topological heavy-fermion）表述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中，基于小参数 \( s^2 \)（具有非平凡量子几何的莫尔布里渊区比例）的受控展开在低温下仍然有效。与无应变情况相比，应变显著抑制了准粒子的线宽（散射率），并在能谱中引入了类似电子-声子耦合的扭结（kink）以及一个额外的平“三子”（trion）能带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在应变魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中，基于小参数 \( s^2 \)（具有非平凡量子几何的莫尔布里渊区比例）的受控展开在低温下仍然有效。与无应变情况相比，应变显著抑制了准粒子的线宽（散射率），并在能谱中引入了类似电子-声子耦合的扭结（kink）以及一个额外的平“三子”（trion）能带。；创新点：1. 将受控图解展开方法（基于arXiv:2604.14278）成功应用于存在异质应变的MATBG体系，并证明了其在低温下的可控性。2. 揭示了应变对电子散射的显著抑制作用：在平坦手征极限下，\( s^2 \) 阶的散射通道被禁止，导致莫特带（Mott bands）保持尖锐；即使偏离手征极限，线宽也比无应变情况小一个数量级以上。3. 预测了应变诱导的能谱特征：色散中的扭结和额外的平“三子”能带。
papers.method_zh: 发展了适用于周期性安德森模型（periodic Anderson model）的受控图解微扰理论框架。具体技术包括：基于自能插入（self-energy insertions）的戴森重求和（Dyson resummation），以及对小参数 \( s^2 \) 进行任意阶展开。计算在一圈图（one-loop order）水平进行，并用于预测量子扭转显微镜（Quantum Twisting Microscope）的谱。

papers.title: Improving CFT Operators Using Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Finite-size effects limit the accuracy with which conformal data can be extracted from lattice simulations of critical systems. While action improvement suppresses some corrections to scaling, it does not address operator-dependent effects arising from imperfect lattice representations of continuum conformal fields. In this work, we propose a data-driven method for improving lattice operators themselves, constructing estimators with enhanced overlap with the corresponding primary operators of the continuum conformal field theory. We identify improved lattice representations of leading spin and energy operators in three two-dimensional critical systems: the Ising model, the q = 3 Potts model, and the dilute q = 3 Potts model. In all cases, the resulting operators exhibit reduced corrections to scaling and yield more accurate estimates of scaling dimensions compared to conventional lattice choices. The code and analysis workflows used to produce these results are made available in an accompanying GitHub repository.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：提出数据驱动方法（data-driven method）、构建算符（constructing estimators）、数值模拟（lattice simulations）。；研究对象：二维临界系统中的共形场论（CFT）算符。具体体系包括：伊辛模型（Ising model）、q=3 Potts模型（q = 3 Potts model）以及稀释的q=3 Potts模型（dilute q = 3 Potts model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习方法改进晶格算符，可以显著增强算符与连续共形场论中初级算符的重叠，从而减小有限尺寸效应带来的标度修正，并得到比传统晶格算符更精确的标度维度估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习方法改进晶格算符，可以显著增强算符与连续共形场论中初级算符的重叠，从而减小有限尺寸效应带来的标度修正，并得到比传统晶格算符更精确的标度维度估计。；创新点：传统方法（如作用量改进）主要抑制标度修正，但无法解决因晶格对连续场的不完美表示而导致的算符依赖效应。本工作的新意在于直接改进晶格算符本身，而非作用量，从而针对性地解决了算符表示不精确的问题。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种数据驱动的（data-driven）方法，用于改进晶格上的算符表示。该方法通过构建新的算符估计量（estimators），使其与连续共形场论中对应的初级算符（primary operators）有更好的重叠。具体应用于三个二维临界系统，识别了改进后的领头自旋算符和能量算符。

papers.title: Comment on "Spin-1/2 Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet: Machine Learning Discovery of the Spinon Pair-Density-Wave Ground State"
papers.abstract: A recent article [Phys. Rev. X 15, 011047 (2025)] utilizes group-equivariant convolutional neural networks to study the ground state of the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet. On the largest finite-size cluster studied to date ($N=108$), the authors report variational energies significantly lower than other numerical methods, including state-of-the-art density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations. In contrast to previous results suggesting a possible spin-liquid ground state, the authors observe a spinon pair-density-wave ground state. We find that: (i) the reported low energies are artifacts of broken ergodicity in the Metropolis--Hastings sampling, since the single-spin-flip update rule utilized by the authors effectively freezes the Markov chains; and (ii) when ergodic sampling is enforced via spin-exchange updates, the neural network converges to energies significantly higher than existing DMRG results, calling the paper's claims into question.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：机器学习、神经网络、数值方法、DMRG。；研究对象：Kagome 晶格上的自旋-1/2 Heisenberg 反铁磁体的基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该文指出，Phys. Rev. X 15, 011047 (2025) 中报道的极低变分能量是 Metropolis-Hastings 采样中遍历性破缺的伪影；当通过自旋交换更新恢复遍历性采样时，神经网络收敛到的能量显著高于现有 DMRG 结果，因此该论文的结论存疑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该文指出，Phys. Rev. X 15, 011047 (2025) 中报道的极低变分能量是 Metropolis-Hastings 采样中遍历性破缺的伪影；当通过自旋交换更新恢复遍历性采样时，神经网络收敛到的能量显著高于现有 DMRG 结果，因此该论文的结论存疑。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析神经网络采样中的单自旋翻转更新规则导致的马尔可夫链冻结问题，并采用自旋交换更新来恢复遍历性采样，重新评估了神经网络变分能量。

papers.title: Quantum Desynchronization of Limit Cycles
papers.abstract: It is well known from classical physics that weakly coupled self-sustained oscillators may spontaneously lock their phases. Just like classical synchronization is known to break down due to noise induced phase slips, we show here how the synchronization of continuous variable quantum systems breaks down by proliferation of quantum phase slips. Within a Keldysh path integral formulation of limit cycles, we analyze the phase dynamics and show how, in spite of strong phase correlations, quantum phase slips degrade the actual phase locking. This approach also allows us to address non-Markovian effects on the synchronization of limit cycles, which we illustrate explicitly for superconducting resonators coupled via a voltage biased double quantum dot.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Keldysh path integral formulation（Keldysh路径积分方法）、phase dynamics analysis（相动力学分析）。；研究对象：连续变量量子系统中极限环的同步与去同步化现象，具体以通过电压偏置双量子点耦合的超导谐振器为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子相位滑移的增殖会导致连续变量量子系统的同步性退化，即使存在强相位关联，量子相位滑移仍会破坏实际的相位锁定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子相位滑移的增殖会导致连续变量量子系统的同步性退化，即使存在强相位关联，量子相位滑移仍会破坏实际的相位锁定。；创新点：将经典噪声诱导相位滑移导致同步失效的概念推广到量子领域，揭示了量子相位滑移如何破坏连续变量量子系统的相位锁定，并首次在理论框架中纳入非马尔可夫效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用Keldysh路径积分形式对极限环进行理论描述，分析其相位动力学，并处理非马尔可夫效应对同步的影响。

papers.title: Quantum Synchronization of Fock States
papers.abstract: Synchronization, a ubiquitous phenomenon in classical systems, has recently been extended to the quantum domain. Here, we show quantum synchronization of a bosonic mode exhibiting a Fock state-like limit cycle, manifesting as a steady state with a negative Wigner function. We demonstrate that this non-classical state can be phase-locked to an external drive, achieving synchronization within an Arnold tongue regime. We argue that synchronization is a dynamical property and fundamentally tied to the suppression of phase slips, which we show to occur with exponentially decreasing probability. We introduce a novel method to extract the phase slip rate from the Lindblad time evolution of the system. This work opens new avenues for understanding and manipulating non-classical synchronization dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、demonstrate、argue、introduce a novel method（理论推导与数值分析）。；研究对象：玻色子模的量子同步现象，具体表现为具有负Wigner函数的Fock态极限环。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fock态极限环可被外部驱动锁相，在Arnold舌区域内实现量子同步，且相位滑移概率呈指数下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fock态极限环可被外部驱动锁相，在Arnold舌区域内实现量子同步，且相位滑移概率呈指数下降。；创新点：首次展示了非经典Fock态（负Wigner函数）的量子同步，并建立了同步与相位滑移抑制之间的指数关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lindblad主方程的时间演化，提出从系统动力学中提取相位滑移率的新方法。

papers.title: Heralded ultrafast generation of macroscopic quantum states in matter with bright squeezed vacuum light
papers.abstract: We show that bright squeezed vacuum light, combined with a single-shot quadrature measurement of the post-interaction light, enables the ultrafast generation of macroscopic quantum states in matter. Although in the weak-coupling regime multiphoton quantum light leaves the unconditional matter state as a classical mixture due to light--matter entanglement, quadrature-based heralding prepares the matter in a Gaussian-weighted quantum superposition. For an ensemble of resonantly electric-dipole-coupled two-level systems, this heralding dynamics acts as a Gaussian filter with respect to the electric polarization, with brighter squeezed-vacuum light accelerating the preparation of the zero-eigenvalue Dicke state. Counter-rotating terms further drive a stroboscopic transition from this Dicke state to a cat-like state. Our results open a route to ultrafast engineering of macroscopic quantum matter with strong-field quantum light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We show、quadrature measurement、heralding dynamics、Gaussian filter。；研究对象：宏观量子态在物质中的超快制备，具体体系为共振电偶极耦合的二能级系统（two-level systems）的系综。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用明亮压缩真空光与物质的弱耦合相互作用，结合单次正交测量（heralding），可在物质中制备高斯加权的量子叠加态（如零本征值Dicke态），并通过反旋转项进一步驱动该Dicke态向类猫态（cat-like state）的随机跃迁。
