papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用明亮压缩真空光与物质的弱耦合相互作用，结合单次正交测量（heralding），可在物质中制备高斯加权的量子叠加态（如零本征值Dicke态），并通过反旋转项进一步驱动该Dicke态向类猫态（cat-like state）的随机跃迁。；创新点：提出利用明亮压缩真空光（而非传统弱光）结合单次正交测量，实现宏观量子态的超快制备，并揭示了反旋转项在从Dicke态到类猫态转变中的关键作用。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于光-物质纠缠的弱耦合模型，采用正交测量（quadrature-based heralding）作为后选择手段，分析明亮压缩真空光对二能级系综的极化滤波效应，并考虑反旋转项（counter-rotating terms）的动力学影响。

papers.title: Ridge Regression from Poisson Resetting: A Renewal Perspective on Spectral Regularization
papers.abstract: We connect stochastic resetting from non-equilibrium statistical physics with ridge regularization in statistical learning. For linear gradient flow, resetting to the origin at rate $r$ produces stationary mean $(X^\top X+rI)^{-1}X^\top y$, exactly the ridge estimator with penalty $λ=r$. This uses the known Laplace-transform relationship between ridge regression and exponential-time averaging of gradient flow, with the exponential time now interpreted as the stationary age associated with Poisson resetting. We then extend this identity to general renewal reset laws: the exponential reset time distribution is the unique renewal law whose stationary mean reproduces scalar ridge in every eigendirection as an exact filter identity for every positive curvature, while non-exponential renewal laws generate alternative spectral filters. At the fluctuation level, we study a separate additive Ornstein-Uhlenbeck extension with constant diffusion, interpreted as a stylized SGD approximation. In this setting, the equality holds only at the level of the mean, since the reset process has a nonzero stationary covariance from accumulated OU noise and reset-timing variance, whereas deterministic ridge is a fixed estimator with the same center. Stylized experiments compare the deterministic renewal-induced filters directly and illustrate when filters induced by non-exponential reset-time laws can differ predictively from ridge. The results for the stationary mean and the induced spectral filters are established for continuous-time gradient flow with isotropic resetting on quadratic objectives; the covariance and risk formulas additionally assume additive noise with state-independent covariance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：连接（connect）、推导（establish）、理论框架（renewal perspective）。；研究对象：统计学习中的岭回归（ridge regression）与非平衡统计物理中的随机重置（stochastic resetting）之间的理论联系，具体研究线性梯度流在二次目标函数上的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于线性梯度流，以速率 \( r \) 重置到原点的随机重置过程产生的稳态均值恰好等于岭回归估计量（惩罚参数 \(\lambda = r\)）；指数重置时间分布是唯一能在每个本征方向上精确实现标量岭回归滤波的更新律，而非指数更新律则生成替代的谱滤波器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于线性梯度流，以速率 \( r \) 重置到原点的随机重置过程产生的稳态均值恰好等于岭回归估计量（惩罚参数 \(\lambda = r\)）；指数重置时间分布是唯一能在每个本征方向上精确实现标量岭回归滤波的更新律，而非指数更新律则生成替代的谱滤波器。；创新点：首次将非平衡统计物理中的随机重置机制与统计学习中的岭正则化建立精确对应关系，并揭示了指数重置律在谱滤波中的唯一性，同时推广到非指数更新律以生成替代滤波器。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用拉普拉斯变换关系将岭回归与梯度流的指数时间平均联系起来，并将指数时间解释为泊松重置的稳态年龄；进一步推广到一般更新重置律；在涨落层面，引入带常数扩散的加性奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程作为随机梯度下降（SGD）的简化近似，分析均值与协方差。

papers.title: Critical exponents for planar random-cluster model with cluster-weight $q=4$
papers.abstract: Using the Baxter-Kelland-Wu coupling and the convergence of the height function of the six-vertex model to the Gaussian Free Field, we extract critical exponents for the planar critical random-cluster model at $q=4$, and the planar four-state Potts model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“提取临界指数”、“耦合”、“收敛性”。；研究对象：平面随机团簇模型（cluster-weight $q=4$）和平面四态Potts模型的临界行为与临界指数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用Baxter-Kelland-Wu耦合以及六顶点模型高度函数收敛到高斯自由场这一结果，成功提取了$q=4$时平面临界随机团簇模型和平面四态Potts模型的临界指数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用Baxter-Kelland-Wu耦合以及六顶点模型高度函数收敛到高斯自由场这一结果，成功提取了$q=4$时平面临界随机团簇模型和平面四态Potts模型的临界指数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与分析。具体框架为：1）利用Baxter-Kelland-Wu耦合将随机团簇模型与六顶点模型联系起来；2）利用六顶点模型的高度函数收敛到高斯自由场这一已知结论，通过该耦合关系推导出目标模型的临界指数。

papers.title: Lattice Brownian bees with cooperative reproduction: steady states, collapse, and spreading
papers.abstract: We extend the ``Brownian bees'' model of Berestycki et al. (2021, 2022) to cooperative reproduction, $kA\to(k{+}1)A$, of a population of $N$ symmetric random walkers with removal, at each birth event, of the particle farthest from the origin. Working in the limit $N\to\infty$, we formulate a hydrodynamic free-boundary problem for this model. Using this formalism, we determine steady state population densities for all~$k$ and prove their linear stability for $k\le 2$ and instability for $k\ge 4$. In the marginal case $k=3$, there is a whole continuous family of steady states at a single, critical ratio of the reproduction and diffusion rates. Above criticality the population undergoes an asymptotically self-similar finite-time collapse to the origin. Below the criticality the population spreads diffusively, but the reproduction remains quantitatively relevant. For $k\ge 4$, the unstable steady state separates regimes of a finite-time collapse and a diffusive spreading. Here the collapse dynamics is asymptotically self-similar, and the population density exhibits a scale separation requiring a matched-asymptotic description. Our analytical predictions are confirmed by numerical solutions of the hydrodynamic free-boundary problem and by Monte Carlo simulations of the original microscopic model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“formulate a hydrodynamic free-boundary problem”、“analytical predictions”、“numerical solutions”和“Monte Carlo simulations”，属于理论建模与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：论文研究的是具有合作繁殖机制的“布朗蜜蜂”格子模型，具体为对称随机游走粒子群体在有限种群（N→∞极限）下的稳态、坍缩与扩散行为，涉及kA→(k+1)A的繁殖反应与每次出生事件中移除离原点最远粒子的规则。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于合作繁殖阶数k，稳态密度在k≤2时线性稳定，k≥4时不稳定；在临界k=3时存在连续稳态族。高于临界繁殖-扩散速率比时种群发生有限时间自相似坍缩至原点，低于临界时种群扩散性扩展但繁殖仍定量重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于合作繁殖阶数k，稳态密度在k≤2时线性稳定，k≥4时不稳定；在临界k=3时存在连续稳态族。高于临界繁殖-扩散速率比时种群发生有限时间自相似坍缩至原点，低于临界时种群扩散性扩展但繁殖仍定量重要。；创新点：将“布朗蜜蜂”模型从单粒子繁殖（k=1）推广至合作繁殖（kA→(k+1)A），揭示了不同k值下稳态稳定性、临界行为以及坍缩/扩散相变的新机制，特别是k≥4时稳态的不稳定性与匹配渐近描述。
papers.method_zh: 采用流体力学自由边界问题（hydrodynamic free-boundary problem）进行理论建模，结合数值求解该自由边界问题以及原始微观模型的蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations）进行验证。

papers.title: Open Problem: Separating Geometric and Algorithmic Compression via Cayley-Table Completion
papers.abstract: Modern statistical learning theory and deep learning characterize generalization primarily in terms of continuous capacity control (e.g., norm-based regularization, margin maximization, low-rank bias). While highly successful in continuous domains, deep learning consistently fails to extrapolate exact algorithmic or discrete algebraic rules, reflecting a missing inductive bias toward algorithmic complexity minimization. We propose the Cayley-table completion as the canonical testbed for this missing bias, serving as the discrete algebraic counterpart to matrix completion. Just as matrix factorization combined with weight decay yields an implicit geometric bias toward low linear rank, recent results demonstrate that operator-valued tensor factorizations paired with a flatness prior yield an implicit algorithmic bias toward exact discrete associativity. We pose the open problem of establishing formal exact recovery bounds for Cayley-table completion, and challenge the community to generalize continuous flatness priors to autonomously discover broader discrete algorithmic axioms without combinatorial search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：open problem, statistical learning theory, inductive bias, algorithmic complexity minimization）；研究对象：Cayley表补全问题，作为离散代数规则学习的测试平台，类比于矩阵补全在连续域中的角色。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理结论或发现，主要提出一个开放问题：如何建立Cayley表补全的精确恢复理论界限，并挑战学界将连续平坦性先验推广至自主发现离散算法公理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论或发现，主要提出一个开放问题：如何建立Cayley表补全的精确恢复理论界限，并挑战学界将连续平坦性先验推广至自主发现离散算法公理。；创新点：将Cayley表补全确立为离散代数版矩阵补全的标准测试问题，并指出当前深度学习缺乏对算法复杂度最小化的归纳偏置，呼吁建立形式化的精确恢复理论。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于算子值张量分解与平坦性先验（flatness prior）的隐式算法偏置，与矩阵分解结合权重衰减产生低秩几何偏置进行类比。

papers.title: Gate Parameter Lee-Yang Zeros and Dynamical Phases in Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract: We propose gate-parameter Lee-Yang zeros of Loschmidt amplitudes as probes of dynamical phases in finite quantum circuits. We illustrate this approach using a brickwork model, where the time evolution is generated by repeated application of a Floquet operator. The Loschmidt amplitude can be expressed as a rational function of the gate parameters. At fixed system size and large circuit depth, its zeros in one complexified gate parameter, with the other parameter held fixed, condense onto limiting curves. We show that these curves comprise a universal component governed by equimodular Floquet eigenvalues, as described by the Beraha-Kahane-Weiss theorem, together with state-dependent contributions controlled by the overlap of eigenstate of the Floquet operator with the initial state. As one of the parameters is varied, the set of zeros reorganizes abruptly, providing a finite-qubit diagnostic of a dynamical phase transition. This mechanism does not rely on integrability: while integrability enables an exact calculation of the Loschmidt amplitude, the condensation of zeros follows from spectral competition and local unitarity alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论框架（“propose gate-parameter Lee-Yang zeros”），并基于数学定理（Beraha-Kahane-Weiss theorem）和谱竞争机制进行分析，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：有限量子电路中的动力学相，具体通过砖墙模型（brickwork model）中的Floquet算符时间演化来研究Loschmidt振幅的零点行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限量子电路中，Loschmidt振幅的复化门参数零点会凝聚成极限曲线，这些曲线由等模Floquet本征值（通用部分）和初态与本征态的重叠（态依赖部分）共同决定；当门参数变化时，零点集合发生突变，可作为有限量子比特系统中动力学相变的诊断工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限量子电路中，Loschmidt振幅的复化门参数零点会凝聚成极限曲线，这些曲线由等模Floquet本征值（通用部分）和初态与本征态的重叠（态依赖部分）共同决定；当门参数变化时，零点集合发生突变，可作为有限量子比特系统中动力学相变的诊断工具。；创新点：首次提出将门参数Lee-Yang零点作为有限量子电路中动力学相的探针，并证明零点凝聚机制仅需谱竞争和局域幺正性，无需系统可积。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：将Loschmidt振幅表示为门参数的有理函数，利用Beraha-Kahane-Weiss定理分析零点凝聚曲线，并基于谱竞争（spectral competition）和局域幺正性（local unitarity）解释机制，不依赖可积性。

papers.title: Low-Magnification SEM May Suffice: Interpretable Deep Learning for Multi-Scale Fracture-Cause Classification in Zirconia-Toughened Alumina
papers.abstract: Reliable identification of fracture origins in alumina matrix composite hip and knee implants is critical for quality assurance and patient safety, yet current fractographic workflows are time-consuming, partly subjective, and reliant on high-magnification scanning electron microscopy (SEM). We present an interpretable vision-transformer (ViT) workflow for automated classification of fracture causes in an alumina matrix composite (BIOLOX delta, CeramTec GmbH) widely used in total joint replacements. A dataset of 8,493 SEM images (50x-10,000x) was curated from five years of in-production burst and proof tests and annotated into three defect categories defined along the manufacturing chain: green body, hard machining, and material defects. Under severe class imbalance, the fine-tuned ViT reached an accuracy of 0.907 and a macro-F1 of 0.888 in stratified five-fold cross-validation, with a two-stage perceptual-hash/SSIM leakage audit confirming negligible specimen overlap. Notably, performance at low magnification (50x) was comparable to that at high magnification (1k-10kx), indicating that macro-scale features - mirror geometry and hackle line fields - already encode sufficient diagnostic signal. Grad-CAM attributions consistently localised on canonical fractographic cues (mirrors, hackles, pores, machining marks), aligning with established fractographic criteria. Together, these results position interpretable ViTs as a complementary tool for ceramic-implant quality assurance, enabling low-magnification pre-screening and reducing reliance on time-intensive high-magnification inspection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：SEM图像、数据集、分类实验、交叉验证。；研究对象：氧化铝增韧氧化锆陶瓷基复合材料（BIOLOX delta，CeramTec GmbH），用于全关节置换植入物的断裂原因分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低倍率（50x）SEM图像与高倍率（1k-10kx）图像在断裂原因分类上性能相当，表明宏观尺度的镜面几何和放射棱线场已包含足够的诊断信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低倍率（50x）SEM图像与高倍率（1k-10kx）图像在断裂原因分类上性能相当，表明宏观尺度的镜面几何和放射棱线场已包含足够的诊断信号。；创新点：首次将可解释的ViT应用于陶瓷植入物断裂原因的低倍率预筛选，减少对耗时的高倍率SEM检查的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 使用可解释的视觉Transformer（ViT）进行自动分类；数据集包含8493张SEM图像（50x-10000x），分为三类缺陷（生坯、硬加工、材料缺陷）；采用分层五折交叉验证，并用感知哈希/SSIM泄漏审计确保数据无重叠；使用Grad-CAM进行归因定位。

papers.title: Community detection in subject-subject networks from psychometrics data
papers.abstract: Identifying subgroups of respondents in psychometric data is traditionally addressed with Latent Class Analysis, which requires the number of classes to be specified a priori and can perform poorly when strong inter-item correlations violate local independence assumptions. We propose a network-theoretic alternative based on community detection in subject-subject similarity networks. To suppress the systematic artifacts induced by the factor structure of the items, the similarity is computed in a low-dimensional factor-score space and the null model for modularity maximisation is obtained by removing the leading (global) mode of the similarity matrix, rather than via the standard Newman--Girvan model. The significance of a detected partition is then assessed against a column-wise resampling null through four complementary observables: the modularity, the differential entropy of the eigenvector point cloud at two neighbourhood scales, and the overlap of the within- and between-community similarity histograms. On a synthetic benchmark with controlled mixture signal, all four metrics correctly identify the homogeneous case as null-compatible -- including the demanding regime of a dataset dominated by a single factor -- and exhibit a graded departure from the null as the cluster separation grows. Applied to 14 widely used psychometric scales, the pipeline isolates a small group of datasets supporting a genuine and directly interpretable modular structure, while the remaining scales fall either in a mixed-signal regime or in one compatible with a single homogeneous community. The significance analysis is independent of the specific community-detection algorithm and provides an operational way to test for modular subject-level structure in questionnaire data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：提出了一种基于网络理论的替代方法（community detection），并使用了合成基准数据和真实心理测量数据进行验证。；研究对象：心理测量数据中的受访者子群识别问题。具体而言，研究对象是“受访者-受访者”相似性网络中的社区结构，其物理现象可类比为复杂网络中的模块化结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于社区检测的网络理论方法，能够有效识别心理测量数据中受访者的潜在子群，并克服了传统潜类分析需要预先指定类别数且对项目间强相关敏感的缺陷。通过显著性分析，该方法能区分出具有真实模块化结构的数据集与仅由单一因子主导的均匀数据集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于社区检测的网络理论方法，能够有效识别心理测量数据中受访者的潜在子群，并克服了传统潜类分析需要预先指定类别数且对项目间强相关敏感的缺陷。通过显著性分析，该方法能区分出具有真实模块化结构的数据集与仅由单一因子主导的均匀数据集。；创新点：1）将社区检测方法引入心理测量学中的受访者子群识别问题，作为传统潜类分析的替代方案。2）提出了一种新的零模型构建方式（移除相似性矩阵的主模），以抑制由项目因子结构引起的系统性伪影。3）建立了一套不依赖于特定社区检测算法的显著性分析框架，用于判断问卷数据中是否存在真实的模块化受访者结构。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用网络理论中的社区检测方法。具体步骤包括：1）在低维因子得分空间中计算受访者间的相似性；2）通过移除相似性矩阵的主模（leading mode）而非标准Newman-Girvan模型来构建模块度最大化的零模型；3）通过四种互补观测量（模块度、两个邻域尺度下的特征向量点云微分熵、以及社区内/社区间相似性直方图的重叠度）并基于列重采样零模型来评估检测到的分区的显著性。

papers.title: Inverse generalised spin models of answers to questionnaires
papers.abstract: Network psychometrics conceptualises psychological constructs as emergent properties of systems of interacting variables. Energy-based probabilistic models have gained popularity as models of these interactions, but their psychometric application has so far been limited, since most implementations assume binary or ternary responses and rely on limiting inference assumptions. We infer and analyse three generalised spin models of ordinal questionnaire data: the generalised Ising, Blume-Capel (BC), and Blume-Emery-Griffiths (BEG) models. We prove the concavity of the maximum likelihood estimation of the parameters, as well as the gauge invariance of the Ising and BC models. Afterwards, we propose an inference protocol of approximated likelihood maximisation, based on the Monte Carlo estimation of the likelihood gradients. We apply this procedure to eleven psychometric and sociological questionnaires, comparing the inferred spin models against the multivariate Gaussian. We then assess whether the inferred models reproduce the empirical features of the data in terms of principal-component histograms, and histograms of Euclidean and Mahalanobis distances to the mean answer. The multi-modality observed in the histograms of principal components is partially captured by the spin models. This trait of polarisation can be understood, in the light of mean-field theory, as coexistence of stable and metastable phases of the spin models. The BEG model systematically outperforms the other models in capturing the distribution of distances to the mean, while all models underestimate the heavy tails of the Mahalanobis distance. Overall, the analysis witnesses the predictive power of the BEG model, able to account better than others for the abundance of outliers and mean responders, and reveals highly non-linear features of questionnaire data that both Gaussian and spin models fail to account for.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：energy-based probabilistic models、maximum likelihood estimation、Monte Carlo estimation、mean-field theory。；研究对象：问卷数据（心理测量学与社会学问卷）的广义自旋模型，具体为广义伊辛模型、Blume-Capel (BC) 模型和 Blume-Emery-Griffiths (BEG) 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BEG模型在捕捉问卷数据中距离均值分布方面系统性优于其他模型，能更好地解释异常值和均值响应者的丰度；但所有模型（包括高斯模型）均未能完全再现马氏距离的重尾特征，揭示了问卷数据中高度非线性的特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BEG模型在捕捉问卷数据中距离均值分布方面系统性优于其他模型，能更好地解释异常值和均值响应者的丰度；但所有模型（包括高斯模型）均未能完全再现马氏距离的重尾特征，揭示了问卷数据中高度非线性的特征。；创新点：将广义自旋模型（特别是BEG模型）系统应用于序数型问卷数据的推断与分析，并利用平均场理论将观测到的多峰极化现象解释为自旋模型中稳定相与亚稳相的共存。
papers.method_zh: 基于能量概率模型的推断框架：证明参数最大似然估计的凹性及伊辛和BC模型的规范不变性；采用蒙特卡洛估计似然梯度的近似似然最大化推断协议；将推断的自旋模型与多元高斯模型进行对比，通过主成分直方图、欧氏距离和马氏距离直方图评估模型对数据经验特征的再现能力。

papers.title: Kernel Renormalization in Bayesian Deep Neural Networks: the Equivalent Wishart Ansatz in the Proportional Regime
papers.abstract: The scaling limit where both the size of the training set $P$ and the width $N$ of a deep neural network grow at the same rate, the so-called proportional-width regime, has been intensely studied for shallow, single-hidden-layer networks. However, extending these non-perturbative results from shallow architectures to deep non-linear networks has proven very challenging. Here we present an effective approximate approach to predict the generalization performance of Bayesian multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) of fixed depth $L$ on arbitrary high-dimensional data. We propose an equivalent Wishart Ansatz to capture the dominant stochastic fluctuations of the hierarchical empirical kernels of MLPs. This allows us to perform a large deviation analysis for the partition function of MLPs in the proportional limit, expressed in terms of a renormalized NNGP kernel. In this description, even strong representation learning in the proportional limit is encoded in at most $L$ scalar order parameters, determined self-consistently. Extending the approach to convolutional architectures (CNNs), we identify a hierarchical local kernel renormalization mechanism, which allows to quantify more complex data-dependent transformations of the large-width kernel in CNNs due to finite-width effects. We test our effective theory against sampling experiments from the Bayesian posterior of finite deep neural networks with depths $L \sim O(10)$ and $P\sim O(10^3)$ on classic benchmark datasets, finding overall very good agreement together with two distinct types of systematic deviations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出等效Wishart Ansatz”、“进行大偏差分析”、“发展有效理论”等理论框架构建与近似方法。；研究对象：贝叶斯深度神经网络（Bayesian deep neural networks），具体包括多层感知机（MLPs）和卷积神经网络（CNNs）在比例极限（proportional regime，即训练集大小P与网络宽度N同比例增长）下的泛化性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出等效Wishart Ansatz，能够有效捕捉深度神经网络中层次化经验核的随机涨落，从而在比例极限下将贝叶斯MLPs的配分函数大偏差分析简化为至多L个标量序参量的自洽方程，并成功预测了有限宽度效应导致的核重整化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出等效Wishart Ansatz，能够有效捕捉深度神经网络中层次化经验核的随机涨落，从而在比例极限下将贝叶斯MLPs的配分函数大偏差分析简化为至多L个标量序参量的自洽方程，并成功预测了有限宽度效应导致的核重整化。；创新点：将原本仅适用于浅层单隐层网络的比例极限非微扰结果，推广至深层非线性网络（MLPs和CNNs），并揭示了CNN中由于有限宽度效应导致的层次化局部核重整化机制。摘要未突出说明与已有理论（如标准NNGP极限）的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：等效Wishart Ansatz（用于近似层次化经验核的随机涨落）、大偏差分析（large deviation analysis）、重整化NNGP核（renormalized NNGP kernel）。验证手段：与深度L~O(10)、训练集大小P~O(10^3)的有限深度贝叶斯神经网络在经典基准数据集上的采样实验进行对比。

papers.title: Channel-agnostic finite-temperature phase estimation averaged over variable grids: reconstruction of Green's function for dynamical mean-field theory
papers.abstract: For treating correlated electronic systems on quantum computers, we propose a quantum-classical hybrid scheme for dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). In the quantum part of the scheme, we use modified quantum phase estimation (QPE) circuits suitable for the one-particle Green's function (GF) at a finite temperature so that we can extract spectral amplitudes and the excitation energies without knowing the excitation channel invoked at each measurement. In the classical part of the scheme, we adopt an approach that estimates reasonably the GF based on the data collected from the QPE sampling. We dub the approach the QPE averaged over variable grids (QAVG), that may help one to reconstruct the GF via optimization of trial parameters and modeling the probability distributions for various settings of the QPE circuits. We apply the QAVG-DMFT scheme to SrVO$_3$ to demonstrate its validity via numerical simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（量子-经典混合方案）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“quantum-classical hybrid scheme”，包含量子部分的改进量子相位估计（QPE）电路和经典部分的QAVG方法。；研究对象：关联电子体系，具体以SrVO₃为例，研究其有限温度下的单粒子格林函数（Green's function）在动力学平均场理论（DMFT）框架下的重构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于改进量子相位估计（QPE）的量子-经典混合方案，能够在无需知道每次测量所激发的具体通道的情况下，提取有限温度下的谱振幅和激发能，并通过经典后处理（QAVG方法）合理重构格林函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于改进量子相位估计（QPE）的量子-经典混合方案，能够在无需知道每次测量所激发的具体通道的情况下，提取有限温度下的谱振幅和激发能，并通过经典后处理（QAVG方法）合理重构格林函数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 量子部分：使用改进的量子相位估计（QPE）电路，适用于有限温度下单粒子格林函数的测量；经典部分：采用“QPE averaged over variable grids”（QAVG）方法，通过优化试探参数和建模不同QPE电路设置下的概率分布来重构格林函数。整体方案应用于SrVO₃的数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Error-corrected phase estimation averaged over variable grids on a trapped-ion quantum computer: hyperacuity spectra of a CO molecule adsorbed onto $χ$-Fe$_5$C$_2$
papers.abstract: Quantum phase estimation (QPE) is an underlying technology for extracting the excitation spectra of many-electron systems, yet its practical use on current hardware is hindered by low grid resolution and environmental noises. Here we propose QPE averaged over variable grids (QAVG), a vernier-type approach that combines low-resolution QPE with multiple origin shifts and physically motivated continuous parametrization to reconstruct the spectra accurately. We introduce this approach into an end-to-end workflow for the {\it ab initio}-based model system for a CO molecule adsorbed onto the $χ$-Fe$_5$C$_2$ surface. We perform experiments on Quantinuum H2-2 using both physical QPE circuits and logical QPE circuits encoded in the Steane code with offline bit-flip correction. We demonstrate that QAVG accurately reconstructs the spectra with deviations much smaller than the nominal QPE resolution, even when the noisy histograms are used. The cost landscapes averaged over the shifted grids substantially suppress the local minima arising from the spectral leakage, thereby stabilizing the optimization of trial parameters. These results indicate that QAVG provides a robust route to quantum simulations of correlated spectra toward the era of early-fault-tolerant quantum computers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时提到了“提出QAVG方法”（理论/算法创新）和“在Quantinuum H2-2量子处理器上进行实验”（实验验证），并使用了物理和逻辑量子电路。；研究对象：吸附在χ-Fe₅C₂表面上的CO分子（CO molecule adsorbed onto χ-Fe₅C₂）的激发谱（excitation spectra）。这是一个基于从头算（ab initio）的模型系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为QAVG（变网格平均量子相位估计）的新方法，能够以远低于名义QPE分辨率的精度准确重构光谱，即使在存在噪声的情况下也能有效抑制由频谱泄漏引起的局部极小值，从而稳定优化过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为QAVG（变网格平均量子相位估计）的新方法，能够以远低于名义QPE分辨率的精度准确重构光谱，即使在存在噪声的情况下也能有效抑制由频谱泄漏引起的局部极小值，从而稳定优化过程。；创新点：提出了QAVG这一新方法，通过将低分辨率QPE与可变网格和连续参数化相结合，有效克服了当前量子硬件上QPE分辨率低和噪声干扰的局限，为早期容错量子计算机上的相关谱量子模拟提供了一条稳健的路径。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了变网格平均量子相位估计（QAVG）方法。这是一种游标卡尺式（vernier-type）的方法，结合了低分辨率QPE、多次原点偏移（multiple origin shifts）以及物理驱动的连续参数化（physically motivated continuous parametrization）。实验在Quantinuum H2-2离子阱量子计算机上进行，使用了物理QPE电路和基于Steane码编码并带有离线比特翻转纠错的逻辑QPE电路。

papers.title: Giant Photon Superbunching from Weak Nonlinearity
papers.abstract: Photon superbunching, which occurs when the second-order correlation satisfies $g^{(2)}> 2$, is typically associated with strong optical nonlinearities or collective multi-photon emission processes. We predict that extreme superbunching can also arise in systems of weakly-nonlinear photonic cavities, via the creation of a squeezed vacuum through interference engineering by fine-tuning inter-cavity couplings and drive parameters. We present numerical calculations indicating that a system of four photonic resonators containing representative Kerr media can achieve $g^{(2)}(0) = 135$ with a $80\,\text{kHz}$ emission rate. Unlike earlier superbunching schemes, this mechanism is highly compatible with integrated photonic platforms constructed using conventional optical media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值计算）。关键词：predict、numerical calculations、interference engineering。；研究对象：弱非线性光子腔系统（包含四个含Kerr介质的谐振腔），通过干涉工程调控腔间耦合与驱动参数实现的光子超聚束现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱非线性光子腔系统中，通过精细调控腔间耦合与驱动参数产生压缩真空态，可实现极端光子超聚束（g^(2)(0)=135，发射率80 kHz），且该机制与常规集成光子平台高度兼容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱非线性光子腔系统中，通过精细调控腔间耦合与驱动参数产生压缩真空态，可实现极端光子超聚束（g^(2)(0)=135，发射率80 kHz），且该机制与常规集成光子平台高度兼容。；创新点：首次提出在弱非线性光子腔系统中，无需强非线性或集体多光子发射过程，仅通过干涉工程即可实现极端光子超聚束，且机制适用于传统光学介质构建的集成光子平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论预测结合数值计算。具体为：通过干涉工程（interference engineering）精细调节腔间耦合参数与驱动参数，计算二阶关联函数g^(2)(0)及发射率。

papers.title: Common Noise-Induced Group-Level Synchronization Between Uncoupled Groups of Oscillators
papers.abstract: We investigate group-level synchronization between oscillator groups induced by common noise in the absence of inter-group coupling. Each group receives a common noise shared by all its oscillators and independent local noise inputs to individual oscillators. The same common noise is applied to all groups. The system is studied with both identical and nonidentical oscillators, and with and without intra-group coupling. In the nonidentical case, natural frequencies are drawn from the same distribution for both groups, making them statistically equivalent. Through numerical simulations of this system, we find that the degree of synchronization within each group, measured by the absolute value of a complex Kuramoto order parameter, typically shows significant temporal fluctuations. Importantly, the complex order parameters representing the collective oscillations of the groups synchronize when the groups are driven by the same common noise. By deriving a phase density evolution mapping, we analytically explain how this group-level synchronization is achieved in the absence of intra-group coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：关键词为“通过数值模拟”、“通过推导相密度演化映射”、“分析解释”。；研究对象：由共同噪声驱动的、无相互耦合的振荡器群组之间的群级同步现象。具体体系为多个振荡器群组，每个群组内部有共享的公共噪声和独立的局部噪声，群组之间无直接耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在没有群间耦合的情况下，当不同群组受到相同的公共噪声驱动时，代表各群组集体振荡的复序参量（如Kuramoto序参量）能够实现同步。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在没有群间耦合的情况下，当不同群组受到相同的公共噪声驱动时，代表各群组集体振荡的复序参量（如Kuramoto序参量）能够实现同步。；创新点：揭示了在无直接耦合的振荡器群组之间，仅通过施加共同的噪声即可诱导出群级别的同步行为，并提供了相应的理论解释。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值模拟方法，研究了包含相同和不同振荡器、以及有无群内耦合的多种情况。同时，通过推导相密度演化映射，从理论上分析了在无群内耦合时实现群级同步的机制。

papers.title: Model-free estimation in scattering analysis of microscopy
papers.abstract: The mean squared displacement (MSD) of particles or probes is commonly estimated from microscopy videos using particle tracking approaches, which rely on tuning parameters manually, and are often unstable over the entire lag time range, especially in dense or low-contrast situations. In this work, we propose model-free ab initio uncertainty quantification (MF-AIUQ), a model-free method for scattering analysis of microscopy video based on a probabilistic framework, which estimates MSD without isolating particles and linking their trajectories. Based on the relationship between the intermediate scattering function (ISF) and the MSD derived from the cumulant theorem, MF-AIUQ estimates the MSD values by the marginal maximum likelihood estimator. To reduce the computational cost, the likelihood function is approximated by a subset of Fourier-transformed intensities. These intensities are equally spaced at the logarithmic values of Fourier basis functions and lag time points. We found that the ISF is smooth in this logarithmic input space, and the information of the ISF can be captured by this subset of inputs. We examine the method through simulation studies covering several representative stochastic processes and three experimental systems: a Newtonian fluid for evaluating performance in optically dense and bright-field settings, a gelation system with an evolving MSD shape, and snail mucin, a viscoelastic biopolymer, for modulus estimation. Across these studies, MF-AIUQ provides smooth and stable MSD estimates over the full lag time range and serves as a useful complementary approach in settings where particle tracking is unreliable or a parametric model of MSD is unavailable or unverifiable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：model-free method、probabilistic framework、marginal maximum likelihood estimator、simulation studies。；研究对象：显微镜视频中粒子或探针的均方位移（MSD）估计，具体应用于密集或低对比度条件下的散射分析，包括牛顿流体、凝胶体系、粘弹性生物聚合物（蜗牛粘液）等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种无需粒子追踪和参数模型的无模型方法（MF-AIUQ），能够从显微镜视频中直接、稳定地估计全滞后时间范围内的均方位移，在粒子追踪不可靠或MSD参数模型未知/不可验证的场景中可作为有效补充。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种无需粒子追踪和参数模型的无模型方法（MF-AIUQ），能够从显微镜视频中直接、稳定地估计全滞后时间范围内的均方位移，在粒子追踪不可靠或MSD参数模型未知/不可验证的场景中可作为有效补充。；创新点：提出一种完全无模型、无需粒子识别与轨迹链接的MSD估计方法，利用ISF在对数输入空间中的平滑性，通过稀疏采样实现高效计算，并在多种模拟和实验体系中验证了其稳定性和可靠性。
papers.method_zh: 基于概率框架的无模型从头不确定性量化方法（MF-AIUQ）。利用累积量定理导出的中间散射函数（ISF）与MSD之间的关系，通过边际最大似然估计器估计MSD值。为降低计算成本，似然函数由傅里叶变换强度的子集近似，这些强度在傅里叶基函数和滞后时间点的对数值上等间距选取。

papers.title: Source-driven torsional optical activity in geometrically chiral media
papers.abstract: We develop an effective field-theoretical model for source-driven electromagnetic waves in a geometrically chiral optical medium described by a uniform axial torsion. Starting from the gauge-invariant electromagnetic field strength, we introduce a Chern--Simons-type coupling between the vector potential and the medium's axial contortion, thereby obtaining an inhomogeneous Maxwell system with prescribed external sources. For transverse cylindrical source profiles, we derive the coupled radial equations and solve them analytically for a circulating cylindrical-shell current. In the circular basis, the homogeneous problem diagonalizes, yielding torsion-split radial wavenumbers that give rise to longitudinal circular birefringence under guided-mode boundary conditions. In the weak-torsion regime, this birefringence produces a polarization rotation proportional to the propagation length and an oscillatory conversion between orthogonal linear polarizations. The source fixes the jump conditions and the relative excitation of the circular eigenmodes, thereby yielding measurable modal power and Poynting-flow signatures. A two-port scattering analysis shows that the apparent direction dependence remains Lorentz reciprocal, placing the effect in the class of reciprocal geometric optical activity rather than Faraday isolation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop an effective field-theoretical model”（发展有效场理论模型）、“derive the coupled radial equations and solve them analytically”（推导并解析求解耦合径向方程）、“two-port scattering analysis”（双端口散射分析），均为理论推导和建模工作。；研究对象：几何手性光学介质中的源驱动电磁波。具体体系为一种由均匀轴向挠率（axial torsion）描述的几何手性介质，并考虑了横向圆柱形源（如循环柱壳电流）的激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在几何手性介质中，由源驱动的电磁波会产生纵向圆双折射，导致偏振旋转与传播长度成正比，并在正交线偏振态之间产生振荡转换。该效应是洛伦兹互易的，属于互易几何光学活性，而非法拉第隔离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在几何手性介质中，由源驱动的电磁波会产生纵向圆双折射，导致偏振旋转与传播长度成正比，并在正交线偏振态之间产生振荡转换。该效应是洛伦兹互易的，属于互易几何光学活性，而非法拉第隔离。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但核心创新在于将几何手性介质中的光学活性与源驱动机制（而非仅本征模式）联系起来，并证明了该效应在弱挠率下表现为互易的偏振旋转，而非通常与手性相关的非互易效应。
papers.method_zh: 有效场理论模型。具体包括：从规范不变的电磁场强出发，引入矢量势与介质轴向挠率之间的Chern-Simons型耦合，构建非齐次麦克斯韦方程组；在圆偏振基下对角化齐次问题，得到由挠率分裂的径向波数；通过解析求解循环柱壳电流的边界条件，分析模态功率和坡印廷流特征；最后进行双端口散射分析以检验互易性。

papers.title: Modular non-Hermitian topology and its application to critical sensing
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian topological systems have attracted a lot of research activities in recent times, both theoretically and experimentally, due to their unique physical properties and association with open quantum systems. We show that modular structures, where specific couplings at regular intervals take distinct values, enrich the unique topological attributes of these systems such as the non-Hermitian skin effect and the breakdown of conventional bulk-boundary correspondence. These systems also possess the capability of displaying criticality-enhanced sensitivity for precision metrology. We establish how the modular structure enhances their sensing performance near spectral topological phase transitions and show that the enhancement can be achieved in multi-parameter estimation scenarios as well.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、establish、theoretical（摘要中虽提及实验，但核心内容为理论分析与建模）。；研究对象：非厄米拓扑系统中的模块化结构（modular structures），以及其导致的非厄米趋肤效应、体边对应失效等拓扑特性，并应用于临界增强传感（criticality-enhanced sensitivity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模块化结构（特定耦合在规则间隔处取不同值）能够丰富非厄米拓扑系统的独特拓扑属性（如非厄米趋肤效应和体边对应失效），并可在谱拓扑相变附近实现临界增强的传感性能，且该增强可推广至多参数估计场景。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模块化结构（特定耦合在规则间隔处取不同值）能够丰富非厄米拓扑系统的独特拓扑属性（如非厄米趋肤效应和体边对应失效），并可在谱拓扑相变附近实现临界增强的传感性能，且该增强可推广至多参数估计场景。；创新点：首次揭示模块化结构对非厄米拓扑系统（如趋肤效应和体边对应）的调控作用，并证明其可在谱拓扑相变附近实现多参数估计场景下的临界增强传感。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型构建。摘要未明确说明具体计算框架（如是否使用紧束缚模型、非布洛赫理论等），仅提及“建立模块化结构如何增强传感性能”。

papers.title: Dynamical Tsallis WIMP Freeze-Out and Residual Memory Channels in the Radiation Sector
papers.abstract: In this work we generalize the thermal decoupling, or freeze-out, of weakly interacting massive particle dark matter within the Tsallis nonextensive formalism. The generalization is implemented through $q$-deformed distribution functions obtained from the maximum entropy principle with Curado-Tsallis constraints. The Tsallis parameter $q$, which measures deviations from extensivity with respect to the limit $q=1$, is promoted to a dynamical quantity depending on the dimensionless variable $x=m_χ/T$, where $m_χ$ is the dark matter mass. This dynamical evolution is characterized by a relaxation toward extensivity, while requiring that the nonextensive deformation is not completely erased before freeze-out. We solve the Boltzmann equation assuming a sectorial deformation, where only the dark matter equilibrium abundance is generalized and the radiation background remains extensive. The relic abundance is computed for different dark matter masses and initial values of the Tsallis parameter. From this evolution, we extract the residual value $q_χ^{\rm fo}$ at freeze-out, which is then used as the initial input for a phenomenological memory channel. This channel propagates the residual nonextensivity into the radiation sector, specifically into the electron-positron plasma and neutrinos, while photons are kept extensive in order to avoid direct tensions with CMB physics. The resulting deformation modifies the neutrino energy density and the photon reheating contribution, producing a correction to $N_{\rm eff}$. We compare the predicted values with the compressed CMB+BAO constraint on $N_{\rm eff}$ and find that the residual-memory scenario can remain phenomenologically compatible with current bounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“generalize the thermal decoupling”“solve the Boltzmann equation”“phenomenological memory channel”，属于理论推导与唯象分析。；研究对象：弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）暗物质的热退耦（freeze-out）过程，以及该过程中非广延性残余对辐射扇区（电子-正电子等离子体、中微子）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Tsallis非广延框架下，将Tsallis参数q推广为动力学变量，发现暗物质冻结后残余的非广延性可通过记忆通道传递到辐射扇区，修正中微子能量密度和光子再加热贡献，从而对有效中微子代数N_eff产生可观测的修正，且该修正与当前CMB+BAO约束兼容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Tsallis非广延框架下，将Tsallis参数q推广为动力学变量，发现暗物质冻结后残余的非广延性可通过记忆通道传递到辐射扇区，修正中微子能量密度和光子再加热贡献，从而对有效中微子代数N_eff产生可观测的修正，且该修正与当前CMB+BAO约束兼容。；创新点：首次将Tsallis非广延参数q推广为动力学变量，并引入“残余记忆通道”概念，将暗物质冻结后的非广延性传递到辐射扇区，从而在N_eff中产生可检验的唯象信号。
papers.method_zh: 基于最大熵原理与Curado-Tsallis约束，引入q-变形分布函数；将q参数设为动力学变量（依赖于x=m_χ/T），并假设扇区变形（仅暗物质平衡丰度非广延，辐射背景保持广延）；求解玻尔兹曼方程计算残余丰度；将冻结时的残余q值作为输入，通过唯象记忆通道将非广延性引入辐射扇区（电子-正电子等离子体和中微子），同时保持光子广延以避免与CMB直接冲突；最后将预测的N_eff与CMB+BAO约束比较。

papers.title: Local diagnostics for strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking and non-equilibrium phase transitions
papers.abstract: We construct strongly $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric local Markov/Lindblad dynamics exhibiting transitions between strong-paramagnetic behavior and strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. In 1+1d, an absorbing-state construction gives a transition with scaling consistent with the parity-conserving branching-annihilating random-walk universality class. In 2+1d, a pair-flip variant of Toom's rule provides evidence for a stable strong-paramagnetic/weakly symmetry-broken regime and a transition into an active SWSSB regime. We also introduce a marginal fidelity correlator of radius $R$, a local proxy for the usual SWSSB fidelity order parameter requiring tomography only on $\mathcal{O}(R^d)$-size regions. For broad classes of states, including symmetry-projected Gibbs-like states satisfying suitable local indistinguishability assumptions, we bound the error between the marginal and global fidelity correlators by terms decaying exponentially in $R$. These marginal fidelities provide a model-independent diagnostic of SWSSB in absorbing-state transitions, where microscopic notions of defects or activity are not universal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“构造动力学”、“提出关联子”、“证明误差界”等理论推导和模型构建关键词。；研究对象：强-弱自发对称性破缺（SWSSB）的局域诊断方法，以及与之相关的非平衡相变，具体包括1+1维和2+1维的马尔可夫/林德布拉德动力学系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了具有强Z₂对称性的局域动力学，展示了从强顺磁行为到强-弱自发对称性破缺的相变；并引入了一种仅需对O(R^d)大小区域进行层析的边际保真度关联子，可作为SWSSB的模型无关诊断工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了具有强Z₂对称性的局域动力学，展示了从强顺磁行为到强-弱自发对称性破缺的相变；并引入了一种仅需对O(R^d)大小区域进行层析的边际保真度关联子，可作为SWSSB的模型无关诊断工具。；创新点：提出了一个无需全局层析、仅需局域测量的边际保真度关联子，作为SWSSB的模型无关诊断工具，并严格证明了其在广泛状态类（包括对称投影吉布斯态）中的有效性。
papers.method_zh: 采用强对称马尔可夫/林德布拉德动力学模型；在1+1维使用吸收态构造（与宇称守恒的分支-湮灭随机游走普适类一致）；在2+1维使用Toom规则的pair-flip变体；引入边际保真度关联子，并利用局域不可区分性假设对误差进行指数衰减的数学证明。

papers.title: Comparing Spatially Periodic Feedback and Space-Time Modulation for Unidirectional Wave Propagation in a 1D Mass-Spring-Damper System
papers.abstract: Unidirectional wave propagation has emerged as a key concept in the dynamics of non-reciprocal mechanical and acoustic metamaterials. This work investigates two fundamentally distinct strategies for achieving directional wave propagation in a periodic one-dimensional mass-spring-damper lumped system: space-time modulation and spatially periodic feedback. In the first approach, the stiffness is modulated periodically in both space and time. The resulting space-time periodic system is analyzed using a Plane Wave Expansion (PWE) formulation based on the Bloch-Floquet theory to obtain the dispersion relation. The traveling modulation produces asymmetric dispersion diagrams and directional band gaps, within which elastic waves propagate preferentially in a single direction due to broken time-reversal symmetry. In the second approach, non-reciprocity is introduced through a spatially periodic feedback action. The force can depend on the displacement and/or its derivatives, such as velocity or acceleration, and is applied to the masses along the system. The lumped system with a finite number of unit cells is modeled using classical mechanics principles, yielding a state-space model of the system. The active mechanism can generate directional amplification or attenuation via the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE), characterized by boundary-localized modes identified by a topological invariant, the winding number. The stability of the space-time periodic system is assessed through the Lyapunov-Floquet theory. In the periodic feedback case, stability is investigated using the eigenvalues of the state matrix. These results provide design guidelines for directional wave propagation in elastic waveguides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Plane Wave Expansion (PWE) formulation、Bloch-Floquet theory、state-space model、Lyapunov-Floquet theory、winding number。；研究对象：一维质量-弹簧-阻尼集总系统中的单向波传播现象，具体对比了两种实现策略：时空刚度调制与空间周期性反馈。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时空调制通过打破时间反演对称性产生非对称色散关系和定向带隙，实现单向波传播；空间周期性反馈则通过非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）产生边界局域模式，实现定向放大或衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时空调制通过打破时间反演对称性产生非对称色散关系和定向带隙，实现单向波传播；空间周期性反馈则通过非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）产生边界局域模式，实现定向放大或衰减。；创新点：首次在同一框架下系统比较了时空调制与空间周期性反馈这两种截然不同的单向波传播实现机制，并分别给出了稳定性判据和设计准则。摘要未突出说明两种方法在实验实现难度或适用频段上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 1）时空调制系统：基于Bloch-Floquet理论的平面波展开（PWE）法求解色散关系，采用Lyapunov-Floquet理论分析稳定性。2）空间周期性反馈系统：基于经典力学原理建立有限单元集总系统的状态空间模型，通过状态矩阵特征值分析稳定性，利用拓扑不变量（缠绕数）表征边界局域模式。

papers.title: Material selection for mid-infrared thin-film coatings and windows
papers.abstract: We summarized the room-temperature optical properties for infrared-transparent materials, defining transparency windows for two different applications: thin-film coatings (absorption coefficient $α< 10 cm^{-1}$) and windows ($α< 1 cm^{-1}$). The transparency requirements for thin films are substantially less stringent, enabling the use of many more optical materials for a given wavelength range. To make an easy-to-use reference, we categorized materials by chemical group, crystallinity, and typical deposition technique, and discussed practical pros and cons such as chemical and thermal stability, mechanical hardness, and cost. The datasets and plotting scripts are provided so that users can regenerate transparency-window maps for different applications. If you do optical design at infrared wavelengths, we recommend that you print out the figures and stick them on your wall.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：optical properties, absorption coefficient, transparency windows, datasets and plotting scripts）；研究对象：红外透明材料，具体针对中红外波段薄膜涂层和窗口应用的光学材料选择。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 定义了两种不同应用场景下的透明窗口：薄膜涂层要求吸收系数α<10 cm⁻¹，窗口要求α<1 cm⁻¹。薄膜的透明度要求远低于窗口，因此在给定波长范围内可使用更多光学材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：定义了两种不同应用场景下的透明窗口：薄膜涂层要求吸收系数α<10 cm⁻¹，窗口要求α<1 cm⁻¹。薄膜的透明度要求远低于窗口，因此在给定波长范围内可使用更多光学材料。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但工作提供了可自定义透明度窗口地图的实用工具，并建议红外光学设计者打印图表使用。
papers.method_zh: 系统总结了红外透明材料在室温下的光学性质，按化学基团、结晶度和典型沉积技术对材料进行分类，并讨论了化学与热稳定性、机械硬度和成本等实际优缺点。提供了数据集和绘图脚本。

papers.title: Nonlinear Dynamics of Rapidly Driven Systems
papers.abstract: We consider systems characterized by the presence of a rapidly oscillating force. A general method is presented for the construction of the effective action governing the large-scale nonlinear dynamics of such systems order by order in inverse powers of the oscillation frequency $ω$. The explicit expression for the effective Lagrangian is derived up to ${\cal O}(1/ω^6)$ next-to-next-to-leading approximation. The general structure of the high-frequency expansion reveals a broad class of nonlinear systems whose transition curves are identical to those of the linear Mathieu equation, which enables a fully nonperturbative stability analysis in the case of strong driving and nonlinearity. The method is generalized to velocity-dependent forces and configuration space with curvature, characteristic to systems with constraints. Several applications are discussed in detail, including the dynamical magnetic trapping of electric charges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：general method、effective action、high-frequency expansion、nonperturbative stability analysis。；研究对象：受快速振荡力驱动的非线性系统，包括速度依赖力系统、具有曲率的位形空间（约束系统），以及具体应用如电荷的动态磁捕获。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出快速驱动系统有效拉格朗日量至 \( \mathcal{O}(1/\omega^6) \) 阶的显式表达式，并发现一大类非线性系统的转变曲线与线性Mathieu方程相同，从而可在强驱动和强非线性下进行完全非微扰的稳定性分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出快速驱动系统有效拉格朗日量至 \( \mathcal{O}(1/\omega^6) \) 阶的显式表达式，并发现一大类非线性系统的转变曲线与线性Mathieu方程相同，从而可在强驱动和强非线性下进行完全非微扰的稳定性分析。；创新点：揭示了快速驱动非线性系统与线性Mathieu方程在稳定性上的普适等价性，实现了强驱动和强非线性情形下的非微扰稳定性分析，并将方法推广至含约束的曲率空间。
papers.method_zh: 采用高频展开方法，按振荡频率 \(\omega\) 的逆幂次逐阶构造有效作用量，推导有效拉格朗日量至次次领头阶（\(1/\omega^6\) 阶），并推广至速度依赖力和弯曲位形空间。

papers.title: Local Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: We propose a local notion of strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB), through a local one-point fidelity correlator. Compared with the previous definition in terms of a two-point fidelity correlator, our local formulation offers two key advantages: (1) it is easier to detect in large systems: for a system of size $N$ and with ${\rm poly}(N)$ amount of resources, one can detect the local fidelity order up to volume scale $O(\log(N))$; and (2) the local SW-SSB order remains well defined in the thermodynamic limit, where the density matrix itself is not well defined. We show that key features of SW-SSB, including stability under finite-depth symmetric channels and long-range conditional mutual information, persist within this local framework. Our definition is conceptually analogous to local thermalization, as exemplified by pure states obeying the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH). For critical states, the local one-point fidelity correlator defines an interesting class of defect problems. We demonstrate the applicability of the local formulation through several concrete examples, and derive the universal scaling behavior of the local fidelity correlator in a range of critical systems, including ground states of conformal field theories as well as ballistic and diffusive free-fermion metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论概念（local notion of strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking）、推导普适标度行为（universal scaling behavior），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：强到弱自发对称性破缺（SW-SSB）的局域化定义及其在量子多体系统（包括共形场论基态、弹道和扩散自由费米子金属）中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于局域一点保真度关联函数的SW-SSB新定义，该定义在热力学极限下依然良好，且能在系统尺寸N下用poly(N)资源探测到体积尺度O(log(N))的局域保真度序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于局域一点保真度关联函数的SW-SSB新定义，该定义在热力学极限下依然良好，且能在系统尺寸N下用poly(N)资源探测到体积尺度O(log(N))的局域保真度序。；创新点：相比以往基于两点保真度关联函数的定义，新局域定义在大系统中更易探测（资源需求为poly(N)），且在热力学极限下密度矩阵本身不定义时仍有效。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：局域一点保真度关联函数（local one-point fidelity correlator）；类比局域热化（local thermalization）和本征态热化假说（ETH）；分析有限深度对称信道下的稳定性、长程条件互信息；推导临界系统中局域保真度关联函数的普适标度行为。

papers.title: Constrained integrability and anyonic chains
papers.abstract: We review the notion of Yang-Baxter integrability for spin chains that have Hilbert spaces with constraints, such as a Rydberg blockade. We focus on anyonic chains, whose constraints arise from the fusion rules of the fusion categories on which they are based. We discuss the emergence of Temperley-Lieb algebras and present a new result on which types of anyonic chains exhibit them. We then give an overview of known results for integrable anyonic chains and extend them to several fusion categories up to rank $7$. Using a modification of the boost operator formalism, we find several new integrable anyonic chains and discuss some of their properties. These include spin-$\frac32$ models for $\mathfrak{su}(2)_k$ fusion categories, anyonic chains based on the Tambara-Yamagami fusion categories TY$(\mathbb{Z}_n)$, and product fusion categories Fib$\times$Fib and Fib$\times$Ising. We review recent results for spin chains based on the Haagerup-Izumi fusion category HI$(\mathbb{Z}_3)$, and present preliminary numerics for a HI$(\mathbb{Z}_5)$ model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：review（综述）、integrable（可积性）、formalism（形式理论）、numerics（数值计算）。；研究对象：具有约束条件的自旋链，特别是基于融合范畴的任意子链（anyonic chains），以及其可积性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文综述了具有希尔伯特空间约束（如里德伯阻塞）的自旋链的杨-巴克斯特可积性，重点研究了任意子链中Temperley-Lieb代数的出现条件，并利用改进的升压算子形式主义发现了多个新的可积任意子链模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文综述了具有希尔伯特空间约束（如里德伯阻塞）的自旋链的杨-巴克斯特可积性，重点研究了任意子链中Temperley-Lieb代数的出现条件，并利用改进的升压算子形式主义发现了多个新的可积任意子链模型。；创新点：首次系统研究了哪些类型的任意子链会表现出Temperley-Lieb代数；将已知可积任意子链结果推广至秩高达7的多个融合范畴；发现了基于Tambara-Yamagami融合范畴TY(ℤₙ)、乘积融合范畴Fib×Fib和Fib×Ising等的新可积任意子链模型。
papers.method_zh: 采用杨-巴克斯特可积性理论、融合范畴与Temperley-Lieb代数框架，结合改进的升压算子形式主义（boost operator formalism）进行理论推导；对HI(ℤ₅)模型进行了初步数值计算（preliminary numerics）。

papers.title: FunKit: A computer algebra toolkit for functional approaches
papers.abstract: We introduce FunKit, a Mathematica package for the derivation and tracing of functional equations from arbitrary master equations. FunKit provides an expression vocabulary and a set of rules that allow for derivations in any given field theory and master equation. It also allows users to add extensions for more specific equation systems. Therefore, it can be used in a wide range of situations, for example Dyson--Schwinger or functional RG equations, flowing reparametrisations, nPI equations, (modified) STIs and WTIs, functional Polchinski and Wegner flows, functional master equations with sources, and many others. Besides interfacing with the \FORM language to trace large tensor expressions efficiently, FunKit also provides facilities to export arbitrary Mathematica expressions to C++, Julia or Fortran code, including the results of derivations, which can then be evaluated numerically. Both the tracing and code generation can also be used independently and in combination with other packages.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Mathematica package、derivation、tracing、code generation。；研究对象：功能方法（functional approaches）中的方程推导与计算工具，适用于多种场论主方程（如Dyson-Schwinger方程、功能RG方程、nPI方程等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一个名为FunKit的Mathematica软件包，能够从任意主方程出发推导并追踪功能方程，并支持将结果导出为C++、Julia或Fortran代码进行数值计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一个名为FunKit的Mathematica软件包，能够从任意主方程出发推导并追踪功能方程，并支持将结果导出为C++、Julia或Fortran代码进行数值计算。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Mathematica的符号计算框架，提供表达式词汇和规则集用于场论推导；集成FORM语言进行高效张量追踪；支持代码生成（C++/Julia/Fortran）用于数值评估。

papers.title: Analytic Bootstrap for $O(N)$ Boundary Conformal Field Theories with Interacting Boundaries
papers.abstract: We investigate $O(N)$ boundary conformal field theories (BCFTs) with boundary interactions in $d=4-ε$ and $d=3-ε$ employing the analytic bootstrap. By deriving universal constraints on conformal data, we show that infinitely many operator expansions can be expressed in terms of a finite set of inputs. Complementing the analytic bootstrap with a perturbative renormalization-group analysis, we identify totally new boundary fixed points in $d=4-ε$, including non-unitary ones, generated by a boundary cubic coupling, and compute their conformal data to leading order. Moreover, we leverage our solution in $d=3-ε$ to extract, for the first time, the boundary conformal data for the tricritical $O(N)$ model. Altogether, our approach provides a unified prescription for BCFTs with interacting boundaries and streamlines the determination of bulk and boundary operator expansions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytic bootstrap、perturbative renormalization-group analysis、conformal field theories。；研究对象：具有边界相互作用的O(N)边界共形场论（BCFTs），具体在d=4-ε和d=3-ε维度下，包括三临界O(N)模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析自举方法，发现无限多的算符展开可以用有限个输入量表达；在d=4-ε中识别出由边界三次耦合产生的新边界固定点（包括非幺正固定点），并在d=3-ε中首次提取了三临界O(N)模型的边界共形数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析自举方法，发现无限多的算符展开可以用有限个输入量表达；在d=4-ε中识别出由边界三次耦合产生的新边界固定点（包括非幺正固定点），并在d=3-ε中首次提取了三临界O(N)模型的边界共形数据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析自举（analytic bootstrap）结合微扰重整化群分析（perturbative renormalization-group analysis）。

papers.title: Learning quantum ground states in the space of measurement outcomes
papers.abstract: We investigate variational learning of quantum many-body ground states directly in measurement space using autoregressive neural networks. In particular, we represent quantum states via probability distributions of outcomes over a symmetric informationally complete positive operator-valued measure (SIC-POVM). The probability distribution is encoded in the parameters of an autoregressive neural-network-based on gated recurrent units (GRUs). Ground states are obtained by gradient descent that updates the probability distribution to minimize the energy with respect to a given Hamiltonian, while enforcing positivity constraints that ensure that the distribution of measurement outcomes correspond to a physical quantum state. We analyze the role of constraint enforcement (hierarchy of positivity conditions), variety of neural network architectures (multiple layers, dilation, and modifications of input data) in determining the success of this approach. We benchmark our approach on one-dimensional transverse-field Ising model and the Heisenberg model, along with gapping fields, for system sizes up to L=128, illustrating its efficacy across a wide variety of models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“variational learning”“gradient descent”“benchmark”等计算与理论方法关键词。；研究对象：量子多体系统的基态，具体包括一维横场伊辛模型（transverse-field Ising model）和海森堡模型（Heisenberg model），以及带能隙场的变体，系统尺寸最大至L=128。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用自回归神经网络在对称信息完备正算子值测度（SIC-POVM）的测量结果空间中直接变分学习量子多体基态是有效的，该方法在多种模型上均表现出良好性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用自回归神经网络在对称信息完备正算子值测度（SIC-POVM）的测量结果空间中直接变分学习量子多体基态是有效的，该方法在多种模型上均表现出良好性能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于门控循环单元（GRU）的自回归神经网络来编码SIC-POVM测量结果的概率分布；通过梯度下降更新概率分布以最小化给定哈密顿量的能量，同时施加正性约束（正性条件层次）确保测量结果分布对应物理量子态；分析了约束施加方式、神经网络架构（多层、膨胀、输入数据修改）对方法成功的影响。

papers.title: A local description of strong symmetries and strong-to-weak symmetry breaking in quantum many-body systems
papers.abstract: In mixed states of quantum systems, symmetries come in two types: strong and weak. Furthermore, it has been argued that in quantum many-body systems, strong symmetries can be "spontaneously broken" down to weak symmetries. An issue is that as previously formulated, such "strong-to-weak symmetry breaking" appears to be a fairly non-local effect. In this paper, we show how to understand and diagnose strong symmetries and strong-to-weak symmetry breaking in an explicitly local way. Our main technical tool is a rigorous definition of strong symmetry in the limit of infinite volume, which generalizes the conventional finite-volume definitions, and for which we give several equivalent formulations, including one involving the concept of "local charge coherence". Finally, we introduce von Neumann systems, which in infinite-volume symmetries are intermediate between strong and weak symmetries. We derive a Lieb-Schultz-Mattis type anomaly constraint for von Neumann symmetries (and therefore, in particular, strong symmetries) in quantum spin chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：local description、rigorous definition、Lieb-Schultz-Mattis type anomaly constraint。；研究对象：量子多体混合态中的强对称性（strong symmetries）以及强到弱对称性破缺（strong-to-weak symmetry breaking）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种在无穷体积极限下严格定义强对称性的局域描述方式，并证明了强到弱对称性破缺可以局域地理解与诊断；此外，引入了介于强对称性与弱对称性之间的“冯·诺依曼对称性”（von Neumann symmetries），并推导了量子自旋链中该类对称性的Lieb-Schultz-Mattis型反常约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种在无穷体积极限下严格定义强对称性的局域描述方式，并证明了强到弱对称性破缺可以局域地理解与诊断；此外，引入了介于强对称性与弱对称性之间的“冯·诺依曼对称性”（von Neumann symmetries），并推导了量子自旋链中该类对称性的Lieb-Schultz-Mattis型反常约束。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用无穷体积极限下的严格数学定义，推广了传统有限体积定义；通过“局域电荷相干性”（local charge coherence）等概念给出多种等价表述；运用Lieb-Schultz-Mattis型反常约束分析。

papers.title: The Funessian process: Non-Markovian dynamics shaped by the first event
papers.abstract: We construct a continuous-time, positively divisible non-Markovian process with memory of the initial state that satisfies the differential Chapman--Kolmogorov equation. In the stationary state, the correlation function exhibits exponential decay, a behavior typically regarded as characteristic of Markovian dynamics. Nevertheless, the memory is preserved throughout the evolution of the process, manifesting itself in observable statistical quantities. We further demonstrate that mutual information serves as a reliable measure of the non-Markovian character of the process. As an application, we study a random walk driven by the constructed process and show that the memory effect breaks ergodicity and modifies transport properties such as the diffusion coefficient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构建）、satisfies the differential Chapman--Kolmogorov equation（满足微分Chapman-Kolmogorov方程）、demonstrate（论证）、study（研究）。；研究对象：一种新型连续时间非马尔可夫随机过程（称为“Funessian过程”），其动力学由首次事件塑造，并保留对初始状态的记忆。具体应用为驱动随机游走，研究其输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该过程在稳态下相关函数呈指数衰减（通常被视为马尔可夫动力学特征），但记忆效应在整个演化过程中持续存在，并体现在可观测统计量中；记忆效应会打破遍历性并改变扩散系数等输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该过程在稳态下相关函数呈指数衰减（通常被视为马尔可夫动力学特征），但记忆效应在整个演化过程中持续存在，并体现在可观测统计量中；记忆效应会打破遍历性并改变扩散系数等输运性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建：基于微分Chapman-Kolmogorov方程构造一个正可分的非马尔可夫过程；使用互信息作为非马尔可夫性的可靠度量；将该过程应用于随机游走模型以分析其动力学和输运性质。

papers.title: Towards standardisation of average grain size measurement of additively manufactured microstructures using EBSD
papers.abstract: Additively manufactured (AM) alloys have heterogeneous microstructures with broad grain size distributions and highly anisotropic and/or non-convex grain shapes. AM components can have complex geometries and porosity which may affect the local microstructure. Currently there is no electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD)-based grain size measurement standard suitable for typical AM materials. An interlaboratory comparison study was conducted to find out what grain size metrics and summary statistics are currently used to describe average grain size. Participants were asked to measure and report the average grain size from the same EBSD map dataset. Detailed reports have been published in Reference [1]. Based on these results, we have tested and propose recommendations for a new standard for measuring average grain size in AM materials. The present work demonstrates the suitability and limitations of the proposal across several different Ni and Al AM components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：interlaboratory comparison study（实验室间对比研究）、EBSD map dataset（EBSD图谱数据集）、measure and report（测量与报告）。；研究对象：增材制造（AM）合金的微观结构，具体涉及Ni基和Al基增材制造部件中的晶粒尺寸测量标准化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当前缺乏适用于增材制造材料的基于EBSD的晶粒尺寸测量标准；通过实验室间对比研究，提出了针对AM材料平均晶粒尺寸测量的新标准建议，并在多种Ni和Al增材制造部件上验证了该建议的适用性与局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当前缺乏适用于增材制造材料的基于EBSD的晶粒尺寸测量标准；通过实验室间对比研究，提出了针对AM材料平均晶粒尺寸测量的新标准建议，并在多种Ni和Al增材制造部件上验证了该建议的适用性与局限性。；创新点：针对增材制造材料特有的宽晶粒尺寸分布、高度各向异性及非凸晶粒形状，首次提出并测试了基于EBSD的平均晶粒尺寸测量标准建议。
papers.method_zh: 采用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）技术进行晶粒尺寸测量，通过组织多个实验室对同一EBSD图谱数据集进行平均晶粒尺寸的测量与报告，基于结果提出标准化建议。

papers.title: Fermion Families and Pontryagin Class: Topological Field Theory via Colour Symmetry Extension
papers.abstract: Family puzzle asks why the Standard Model (SM) features exactly 3 families of quarks and leptons. Motivated by topological constraints, we study 4-dimensional fermionic anomalies with discrete $Z_n$ symmetry, classified by the 5d spin bordism group. We show that only the group-cohomology subclass H$^5(Z_n,U(1))\cong Z_n$ can be canceled by an anomalous $Z_n$-symmetric 4d $Z_n$-gauge topological quantum field theory (TQFT), while beyond-group-cohomology $A_{Z_n} p_1$ involving the Pontryagin class $p_1$ cannot (except $n=2,3$). More generally, we prove that any cocycle $α_d\in$H$^d(Z_n,U(1))$ in odd spacetime dimension $d\ge3$ is trivialised by the symmetry extension $1\to Z_n\to Z_{n^2}\to Z_n\to 1,$ and we construct the corresponding symmetric anomalous boundary TQFT. For $d=5$ and $n=3$, this yields a Spin$\times Z_3$-symmetric 4d $Z_3$-gauge TQFT that cancels the mixed discrete $(\bf B+L)$-gauge-gravitational anomaly of the SM in the absence of 3 "sterile" right-handed neutrinos $ν_R$. We further analyze a generalized SM with $N_c$ colors and $N_f$ families and argue that missing $N_f$ copies of the $ν_R$ can be naturally replaced by that 4d anomalous $Spin\times_{Z_2^F} Z_{2 N_f,{{\bf B} + {\bf L}}}$ symmetric $Z_{N_c}$-gauge TQFT under the anomaly cancellation, via an appropriate $Z_{N_c}$-color symmetry extension construction $1\to Z_{N_c}\to Spin\times Z_{N_cN_f}\to Spin\times_{Z_2^F} Z_{2N_f}\to1$ of anomalous topological order. For minimal nonzero positive integers $N_c$ and $N_f$, we find the minimal color extensions: $N_c=3, N_f \ge 3$; $N_c=4, N_f \ge 2$; and $N_c=12, N_f \ge 6$. If we further require that an SM baryon is a fermion so $N_c$ is odd, then $Z_{N_c}=Z($SU$(N_c))$ color center, we prove 3 families and 3 colors, $N_c=N_f=3$, is the unique case that stands out. We also prove that $A_{Z_3}p_1= 0\mod3$ for the mod 3 cohomology class in an appropriate context.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：拓扑场论、对称性扩展、反常抵消、群上同调、自旋配边群。；研究对象：标准模型中夸克和轻子的三代（家族）结构（family puzzle），以及与之相关的费米子反常、离散对称性、庞特里亚金类（Pontryagin class）和颜色对称性扩展的拓扑量子场论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了只有群上同调子类H⁵(Z_n,U(1))≅Z_n可以被4维Z_n规范拓扑量子场论（TQFT）抵消，而涉及庞特里亚金类p₁的超越群上同调类A_{Z_n} p₁则不能（除n=2,3外）。进一步发现，在标准模型中，缺失的3个“惰性”右手中微子ν_R可以被一个Spin×Z_3对称的4维Z_3规范TQFT替代，从而抵消混合的(B+L)-规范-引力反常；对于广义标准模型，当N_c=3且N_f=3时，三代与三色是唯一突出的情况。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了只有群上同调子类H⁵(Z_n,U(1))≅Z_n可以被4维Z_n规范拓扑量子场论（TQFT）抵消，而涉及庞特里亚金类p₁的超越群上同调类A_{Z_n} p₁则不能（除n=2,3外）。进一步发现，在标准模型中，缺失的3个“惰性”右手中微子ν_R可以被一个Spin×Z_3对称的4维Z_3规范TQFT替代，从而抵消混合的(B+L)-规范-引力反常；对于广义标准模型，当N_c=3且N_f=3时，三代与三色是唯一突出的情况。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用5维自旋配边群对4维费米子反常进行分类；通过对称性扩展构造（1→Z_n→Z_{n²}→Z_n→1）来平凡化奇数时空维度d≥3的上同调类；构造相应的对称反常边界TQFT；分析颜色对称性扩展1→Z_{N_c}→Spin×Z_{N_c N_f}→Spin×_{Z_2^F} Z_{2N_f}→1下的反常抵消条件。
